articles.title: Change.Org Petition To Rename Nashville Airport in Honor of Dolly Parton Gains Massive Support: ‘Dolly Deserves to Be Remembered and Celebrated’
articles.summary: Members of Nashville City Council and a Tennessee House Rep. have endorsed the move.
articles._body: The collective upswell of grief following Tuesday’s (Aug. 25) passing of Queen of Country Dolly Parton has stretched around the world and back, with countless friends, family, fans and fellow artists sharing their sadness , as well as their fond memories of the beloved “Jolene” star who always had a smile, a kind word and a good deed . Related Dolly Parton Chose Her Funeral Song More Than a Decade Ago & Left an Unreleased Song to Be Heard in 2046 Fearless, Fabulous Dolly Parton and What We Can All Learn From Her: A Remembrance Katy Perry, Kesha, Pitbull and Jon Batiste Pay Tribute to Dolly Parton on Stage, in Song: ‘She Was Kind to Everyone’ Now, a Change.org petition advocating for the Nashville International Airport to be renamed Dolly Parton International Airport in honor of the singer who brought to much joy to so many has blown up in the wake of her death. “On August 25, the world lost an angel. Dolly Parton left this earth to join her husband Carl in the heavens. It’s difficult to imagine a world without our Dreamer-In-Chief,” reads the petition. “How are we going to be okay without her magic to keep us safe? How can we shine without her light? The truth is, Dolly has dispersed the magic. It’s in the butterflies, the wildflowers, and on the breath of the children reading the words aloud of their first book. She has left us everything we need. She’s taught us all the ways to be a good person. It’s on us to live up to her legacy. Care more. Be more. Dream More.” The petition’s originator — Nashville comedian Lydia Popvich, who originally launched the initiative last year — updated the pitch on Wednesday (Aug. 26), noting that it retained a key supporter in Tennessee State Senator Todd Warner, who she said had pledged to introduce legislation to make the name change happen. In addition, Nashville City Council member Russ Bradford responded to the petition, writing, “I’m proud to sponsor a resolution asking the Metro Nashville Airport Authority to consider renaming BNA to Dolly Parton International Airport.” Bradford added, “Dolly Parton isn’t just a country music icon; she’s a global ambassador for our city, our state, and everything we love about Tennessee. From her philanthropic work through the Dollywood Foundation and Imagination Library, to putting Nashville on the map for millions of visitors around the world, few people have done more to define what this city means to the rest of the world. Renaming BNA in her honor would be a fitting tribute to someone whose generosity and hometown pride have never wavered.” He noted, however, that his resolution is a statement of support from the Metro Council, but that the final decision has to come from the Airport Authority. In his response, Warner wrote, “Yes I will definitely introduce legislation to rename the BNA airport Dolly Parton International Airport!.” At press time, the effort had garnered nearly 127,000 signatures. Following Parton’s death, the airport honored her legacy by lighting up its parking garages in pink through the weekend. The drive has earned support from Sheryl Crow, who told Katie Couric in an Instagram Live chat on Wednesday (Aug. 26) that she totally supports the idea. “I’m like, ‘ Yes! I think we should ,” Nashville native Crow said. Parton superfan Popovich said the original petition had about 50,000 signatures, but that number ballooned following Parton’s death at 80 from cancer earlier this week. She told WKRN that she hadn’t thought about it in a while, but when messages started blowing up this week she realized people had rediscovered it. “People want to remember her. They want to remember even beyond the immediacy of her death,” said Popovich, who started the petition with local photographer Dan Dion. “I feel like this is Nashville’s way of telling Dolly that we love her forever.” The station reached out to the airport this week to ask about their position on the petition and members of the airport’s board said current BNA bylaws prohibit renaming it for someone unless they’ve been dead for at least two years and have made a significant impact on Tennessee aviation.

articles.title: Nick Saban documentary: Release date set for six-part series on legendary coach
articles.summary: ESPN’s much-anticipated documentary series profiling the career of legendary college football head coach Nick Saban will debut Oct. 8 on ESPN, according to Variety. ESPN’s six-episode docuseries will chronicle the seven-time national championship-winning head coach through his time at LS
articles._body: ESPN’s much-anticipated documentary series profiling the career of legendary college football head coach Nick Saban will debut Oct. 8 on ESPN, according to Variety . ESPN’s six-episode docuseries will chronicle the seven-time national championship-winning head coach through his time at LSU, with the Miami Dolphins, and, of course, during his historic 17-year run at Alabama. The series will reveal hundreds of hours of never-before-seen video footage shot throughout his 17 seasons in Tuscaloosa, as well as insight into career both at LSU and in the NFL, where he coached the Dolphins for two seasons before returning to college football at Alabama. The docuseries will also delve into Saban’s close relationship with his late father, who passed away before ever seeing his son following in his coaching footsteps. ESPN released a 30-second teaser trailer for its “Saban” docuseries back in January. Now college football fans everywhere have a date for when the ESPN documentary will finally grace their television screens. The series includes interviews with more than 70 people who have been intimately involved throughout Saban’s storied coaching tenure. ESPN announces new 6-episode ESPN Original Series, 'Saban' Highlighting the life & career of college football coach Nick Saban Details: https://t.co/kfrif1s4SN pic.twitter.com/SRdiKfGuPo — ESPN PR (@ESPNPR) January 20, 2026 That list includes North Carolina head coach Bill Belichick; Georgia head coach and former Alabama defensive coordinator Kirby Smart; LSU head coach and former Alabama offensive coordinator Lane Kiffin; Texas head coach and former Alabama offensive coordinator Steve Sarkisian; as well as ESPN colleague and former Heisman Trophy-winning quarterback Tim Tebow; and former Crimson Tide quarterbacks Jalen Hurts and Tua Tagovailoa. Saban and his wife, Ms. Terry Saban, were also interviewed for the series. “Nick Saban’s impact extends far beyond the championships and historic success he achieved on the field,” ESPN senior vice president of ESPN’s original content production Brian Lockhart told Variety in a statement . “What makes this series so special is the extraordinary access to Coach Saban, Ms. Terry and the people who know him best, paired with rare footage that offers a new perspective on his remarkable journey. ‘Saban’ is a definitive portrait of one of the most consequential figures in college football history, and we’re proud to share it with fans.”

articles.title: What Stephen Jones said about selling Cowboys after Lakers’ $12.5 billion sale
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers hogged the headlines recently after Mark Walter sold his majority equity in the team to Bob Iger and Joshua Kushner for a record-setting amount of $12.5 billion. Could the same thing happen to other storied sports franchises, including the Dallas Cowboys? Jerry Jones has ow
articles._body: The Los Angeles Lakers hogged the headlines recently after Mark Walter sold his majority equity in the team to Bob Iger and Joshua Kushner for a record-setting amount of $12.5 billion. Could the same thing happen to other storied sports franchises, including the Dallas Cowboys? Jerry Jones has owned the Cowboys since 1989 after purchasing it for $140 million, fulfilling a lifelong ambition. It has since become a family affair, with his children, Stephen Jones, Charlotte Jones, and Jerry Jones Jr., all having high-ranking positions in the front office. But with the ever-changing landscape in sports, particularly when it comes to ownership transfers, as proven by the Lakers, it is not totally outlandish to imagine the Cowboys being run by a family other than the Joneses. In a report from The Athletic’s Zak Keefer, Stephen stressed that they are not entertaining the possibility. “We certainly don’t want to think about that. We don’t want it to be that way,” said Stephen. He serves as the chief operating officer, co-executive vice president, and director of player personnel. Charlotte is co-executive vice president and chief brand officer, while Jerry Jr. is co-executive vice president and chief sales and marketing officer. “All three own equal ownership shares and will collectively run the organization after Jerry is gone. But Stephen’s two cents will carry the most weight. It’ll be his team,” wrote Keefer. He also quoted Jones as stating: “They’ve been making decisions for the past 20, 30 years, and no doubt Stephen has been the leader of that group. For better or worse, we’ve been here as a team.” The Cowboys have five championships, but they have not won the Super Bowl since 1996. They have not even returned to the ultimate round since then. Experts, however, believe that this could really be the year for Dallas . articles.title: Here is what Tyson Fury believes Conor McGregor copied from him
articles.summary: Known as one of the most talented and skilled boxers of the modern era, Tyson Fury is also known for his art of trash-talking. While Fury has championed the art of trash-talking in boxing, Conor McGregor is known as the top trash-talker in the UFC. However, Fury believes McGregor copied the skill
articles._body: Known as one of the most talented and skilled boxers of the modern era, Tyson Fury is also known for his art of trash-talking . While Fury has championed the art of trash-talking in boxing, Conor McGregor is known as the top trash-talker in the UFC. However, Fury believes McGregor copied the skill from him. Speaking with ALF Global, Fury opened up about his love for trash-talking . “For me, it’s always been easy,” he said. “Talking is what I do best. If there was world championships for talking, I’d be the undisputed champion.” The interviewer chimed in, suggesting that aspiring kings of trash-talk must aim to outdo the legendary UFC fighter, Conor McGregor. “Yeah, maybe, but I taught him,” the 6ft 9in heavyweight replied. “He copied me. He copied my style. I’ve been talking s**t from the very beginning. I don’t do it to get inside their heads. Boxing is show business. Boxing is Hollywood. Boxing is a movie. “The fans have to be entertained, so that when they tune in and pay for the pay-per-view to watch a Tyson Fury fight, the press conference and the build-up, they are gonna see a show. That’s why they come,” Fury added. “It’s gonna be a crazy show. Something is gonna happen, like a circus.” Tyson Fury is not a fan of MMA While Fury destroyed McGregor for copying his skill of trash-talking. The boxing legend also claimed not to be a fan of MMA . “I only find MMA exciting when they stand up and punch each other in the face. When they are on the floor wrestling, it’s no good to me. I don’t like it.” The post Here is what Tyson Fury believes Conor McGregor copied from him appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.summary: Growing up in Southern California, Los Angeles Rams’ Trent McDuffie turned out to be an elite, highly versatile cornerback. Right through high school, he ran track with a record time and was outstanding in the long jump as well. And there are lessons he learned firsthand while making it to
articles._body: Growing up in Southern California, Los Angeles Rams’ Trent McDuffie turned out to be an elite, highly versatile cornerback . Right through high school, he ran track with a record time and was outstanding in the long jump as well. And there are lessons he learned firsthand while making it to an NFL superstar. Recently, during one of the Rams youth football camps, McDuffie shared his top three non-negotiables. The Rams senior NFL writer for The Athletic, Nate Atkins, captured the moment when the two-time Super Bowl champion delivered his speech to young aspiring players . “Rams All-Pro cornerback Trent McDuffie gave his youth campers three lessons to become great on and off the field: 1. Be respectful; 2. Be a great teammate 3. Be disciplined,” the caption read. Rams All-Pro cornerback Trent McDuffie gave his youth campers three lessons to become great on and off the field: 1. Be respectful 2. Be a great teammate 3. Be disciplined pic.twitter.com/lpsqi5tIyE — Nate Atkins (@NateAtkins_) August 27, 2026 The heartfelt interaction comes amid the Rams’ youth engagement and community-building camps they are organizing across the country. According to the Rams website, the team hosted the youth camp to facilitate more than 3,000 student-athletes through 20 Youth Football Camps that ran from April to July. High school students get the chance to interact with their favorite football players, seek guidance, and adopt a professional player’s mentality. Through the program, the Rams also organize giveaway events and distribute memorabilia autographed by the NFL superstars on the team. With the regular season starting earlier next month in September, McDuffie and his teammates are making time to give it back to the community. The Rams are coming off a successful preseason stretch where they won two games, and they will conclude the preseason with a game against the Los Angeles Chargers . It was also a great opportunity for the team to test their men in the defensive unit before they head into a full-fledged regular season. Her latest post, which was a carousel of pictures and videos, ended with a video of her dropping her pants to reveal her shorts underneath. She spu
articles._body: In the wake of Dolly Parton’s tragic death , Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham got cheeky with her latest Instagram post, flashing her fans. Her latest post, which was a carousel of pictures and videos, ended with a video of her dropping her pants to reveal her shorts underneath. She spun around with a sly smile. My weakness has always been food and men in that order. Dolly Parton pic.twitter.com/LhoJJdu1WN — Sophie Cunningham (@DrealSophieC) August 26, 2026 The caption of the post featured a famous quote from the late Parton: “My weaknesses have always been food and men—in that order.” Fans were eating up the picture in the comments section of her Instagram post. One said, “The end! You mooned me!” before praising Parton. Her teammate, Monique Billings, responded, “Cheeky.” The Fever are rolling following their blowout win over the Chicago Sky on Sunday, Aug. 23. That was the game former NBA player Enes Kanter was famously kicked out of . Parton’s passing shocked the world on Tuesday, Aug. 25. The news was announced via a video message from her nephew, Bryan Seaver, on social media. “My name is Bryan Seaver, son of Cassie Parton, and I’m representing the Parton and Owens family today announcing the passing of my aunt, Dolly Rebecca Parton Dean, Sister, Sis, and Granny to one generation and Gigi to the next,” Seaver started. “This video announcement is something Dolly asked of me years ago, before I fully absorbed it as a future reality. “As her head of security for more than two decades, a role my father Larry held before me, I have imagined the heaviness of this moment but haven’t truly felt it until now,” he added. People later confirmed that she passed after a “brief battle with cancer.” The type of cancer wasn’t disclosed in her family’s statement. She died on Aug. 25 at 80 years old. According to People’s report, she was admitted to the Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center on Friday, Aug. 21. She would pass away in the Nashville, Tennessee, hospital four days later. articles.title: South Carolina women’s basketball: The Gamecocks could be the nation’s tallest team
articles.summary: How tall are the Gamecocks this season? Pretty, pretty tall. They might be the tallest team in the country.
articles._body: How tall are the Gamecocks this season? Pretty, pretty tall. South Carolina’s 14-player roster does not include a single player listed under six feet tall. Former point guard Maddy McDaniel, who left the team in July, would have been the only player under 6-0. McDaniel is listed at 5-9, so even she isn’t short for her position.  Across the country, teams are still adding and subtracting players. With final rosters not yet set, it is too soon to know who the tallest team will be. But South Carolina should be one of the tallest. Records from the early years of the program are incomplete. But it appears South Carolina has never had a team without a player under 6-0 before. What’s next for South Carolina? Chris Wellbaum and GamecockCentral subscribers are discussing it now on the Women’s Basketball forum. According to South Carolina’s official roster, this is the breakdown by height: 6-0 – Tessa Johnson, Jordan Lee, Jerzy Robinson 6-1 – Agot Makeer, Ayla McDowell 6-2 – Chloe Kitts, Justine Loubens, Kaeli Wynn 6-3 – Kelsi Andrews, Joyce Edwards, Oliviyah Edwards, Ashlyn Watkins 6-5 – Adhel Tac 6-7 – Alicia Tournebize That is an average of 6 feet, 2.3 inches.  Last season, TCU was the nation’s tallest team with an average height of 6 feet, 2.5 inches. TCU reached its average height differently than South Carolina. The Horned Frogs had three players listed at 6-7, and a fourth listed at 6-8. That cancelled out the three players under 6-0. TCU’s status (should we say “stature?”) came with a bit of an asterisk, though: 6-7 Emily Hunter only appeared in seven games, and 6-8 Sarah Portlock did not play at all. The tallest player in the country this season is Stephanie Okechukwu of Texas Tech. The 7-1 Nigerian joined the Red Raiders in the middle of last season, but redshirted while she became acclimated to college basketball. Texas Tech’s average height is only 5 feet, 11.9 inches. Seven players under 6-0 more than cancel out Okechukwu’s massive size. Interestingly, while it is common practice to add an extra inch or two for players on the roster, South Carolina has a reputation for under-reporting its players’ heights. For example, South Carolina has multiple players on the roster who are listed under their FIBA height. That includes Robinson (two inches shorter), Makeer (one inch shorter), and Kitts (one inch shorter). (The Gamecocks have been generous, too. Laeticia Amihere was listed at 6-4, but FIBA and the WNBA have always had her at 6-3.) What do you think? Join the discussion on the Women’s Basketball forum.

articles.title: Paul Finebaum predicts Mike Norvell has hottest seat: ‘Even hotter than Belichick’
articles.summary: Paul Finebaum predicted Mike Norvell would have the hottest seat in college football and even hotter than his ACC counterpart Bill Belichick! There’s a lot of discussion about the North Carolina head coach being out of college football after just two years, maybe less. But Finebaum turned the focus
articles._body: Paul Finebaum predicted Mike Norvell would have the hottest seat in college football and even hotter than his ACC counterpart Bill Belichick ! There’s a lot of discussion about the North Carolina head coach being out of college football after just two years, maybe less. But Finebaum turned the focus back on Norvell, who enters Year 7 at Florida State . The Seminoles were snubbed, fair or not, from the CFP in 2023. Since then, it’s been a disaster for Norvell and Florida State, missing the postseason the last two years. $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage “Even hotter than Belichick,” Finebaum said on Get Up . “I mean, remember three years ago we were crying and arguing and fighting and screaming about FSU deserving to be in the CFP. They have been out the last two years. Remember they beat Alabama last year in the opener and just went straight downhill? Mike Norvell … I don’t know what the over and under is, it will be a wild battle on betting lines: Who gets fired first, Norvell or Belichick? I think it will be Norvell.” Fellow ESPN college football analyst Dusty Dvoracek agreed that this season is pivotal for Norvell. In fact, we might be able to tell what’s going to happen with the head coach within the first three games. “Mike Norvell’s had losing seasons in four of his six,” Dvoracek said. “He’s got to have a much better season. (The) second game against SMU at home is essential. Then they go to Tuscaloosa. You start 1-2, that’s trouble in Tallahassee.” Mike Norvell looking ahead, not focused on hot seat talk Despite the criticism, Norvell does fell confident in this year’s team. As he put it, Norvell felt as good as he has in years when it comes to every guy on the roster. “This year’s team, I feel as good as I’ve felt in a few years,” Norvell said . Of course, that’s a significant statement considering where Florida State has been recently. “… There are some positions that I know that we’re going to need to stay healthy. I like the depth. … I like this group. I like the work-ethic.” All told, five of Florida State’s losses came by one score in 2025. Norvell believes the work his players have put in throughout the offseason has prepared them to better handle those critical situations this time around, and he spoke about that confidence during ACC Football Kickoff in July. “It’s the work, it’s the investment, it’s the preparation for the moment,” Norvell said . “Because you’re going to find those swings in every game. When we won 19 straight there was plenty of one-score games. But it was the response in the game.”

articles.title: Texas Tech, Pepperdine Meet in Battle of Unbeatens and Hermann Watch List Forwards
articles.summary: Two unbeaten teams, two longtime head coaches and two of the nation’s top forwards will share the field Thursday night when Texas Tech hosts Pepperdine. The Red Raiders return to the John Walker Soccer Complex after ending Boise State’s 17-match unbeaten streak in front of a record home-opening crow
articles._body: Texas Tech will look to build on its best performance of the young season when the Red Raiders host Pepperdine on Thursday at 7 p.m. at the John Walker Soccer Complex. “Best team we’ve played so far,” Texas Tech head coach Tom Stone said. “Really good on the ball, super experienced coach. Our teams are somewhat similar in some ways. We’re both a little bit younger than normal. Both teams like to pass the ball. We do it differently, so there are some contrasting systems, but not really style.” The matchup features two 2-0-1 teams receiving votes in the latest NCAA United Soccer Coaches poll. Texas Tech is also ranked No. 16 by TopDrawerSoccer. Tech enters Thursday with momentum after a 2-0 win over Boise State in Sunday’s home opener. The Red Raiders controlled 63 percent of the possession, outshot the Broncos 15-7 and ended the nation’s longest active unbeaten streak at 17 matches. Stone called it a much closer version of the team Tech is trying to become after the Red Raiders opened the season with a 1-0 win over Hawaii and a scoreless draw against Seattle. “I am very encouraged by their response to the last game in Hawaii. They didn’t like that. They weren’t happy about it but they recovered nicely and just got after Boise State. That was a closer version as to who we’re trying to be.” Texas Tech will now face another early test against a Pepperdine team picked unanimously to win the West Coast Conference. The Waves have captured back-to-back WCC championships and are attempting to become the first team in program history to win three straight. Pepperdine opened the season with a win over UC Irvine and a 1-1 draw against USC before defeating Cal 1-0 on Thursday. The trip to Lubbock will be the Waves’ first road match of the season and the opening leg of a Texas swing that also includes a Sunday match at Baylor. “We’re excited to play two wonderful opponents on the road in great venues in great college towns,” Pepperdine head coach Tim Ward said. “You learn a little bit about yourself when you have to go in front of the fans of the opponent.” Mac Hermann Watch List Forwards Meet in Lubbock The individual matchup to watch will be between two of the country’s most highly regarded forwards. Texas Tech’s Taylor Zdrojewski and Pepperdine’s Julia Quinonez were both included among the 20 forwards named to the Mac Hermann Trophy positional watch list released this week. Zdrojewski scored both goals against Boise State, recording the seventh brace of her Texas Tech career. The fifth-year forward now has 28 career goals, tied for sixth in program history. “I thought it was one of her best performances of her career, possibly, because she was just so intentional with all of her movements,” Stone said. “Like, ‘I’m going to be a problem for you. Deal with me.’ She had a really good couple of defenders on her, but she managed them well.” Quinonez enters the matchup as the WCC’s top returning goal scorer after finishing last season with 11 goals and four assists. She has already scored three times this season and earned the conference’s first offensive player of the week award. The experience on the sidelines provides another connection between the programs. Stone is in his 20th season at Texas Tech, while Ward is in his 29th season leading Pepperdine and owns more than 300 career victories. “You’re not going to trick him. You’re not necessarily going to out-coach him,” said Stone. “He’s the perfect coach at Pepperdine.” Thursday will be the fourth meeting between Texas Tech and Pepperdine and the first since the opening round of the 2019 NCAA Tournament. That match officially ended in a scoreless draw, but the Red Raiders advanced with a 4-3 victory in the penalty shootout. A fun factoid from that one includes current Texas Tech assistant coach Charlotte Masters, then Charlotte Teeter, as a captain on that team who converted the Red Raiders’ first attempt of the shootout. The previous meetings have consistently delivered close matches. Pepperdine won 3-0 in Malibu in 2017 before Texas Tech earned a 1-0 victory in Lubbock the following season. “We’ve had three great games with them so far. One at their place, one at our place and back here for the NCAA Tournament. We’ve played three times in my time here, and every game has been a barn burner.” Texas Tech will also try to extend its run of success at the John Walker Soccer Complex. The Red Raiders have won 16 consecutive nonconference home matches and are 37-1-1 across their last 39 nonconference home games. Sunday’s victory was played in front of a home-opening record crowd of nearly 1,900. Another large turnout is expected Thursday, with Stone saying approximately 1,000 student tickets had already been claimed as of Wednesday. “Every time we’ve had one, it’s been incredible. The girls are fun to watch. We’re not sitting back. We are super physical. We’re so Texas Tech. We’re in your face, not worried about anything.” Thursday has also been announced as a Code Red match, with fans encouraged to wear red. The first 250 fans will receive Bahama Bucks snow cones, while the first 500 students will receive free Chick-fil-A at halftime. And to top it off a student raffle for various Tech branded items from Barefoot and two concert tickets to Riley Green. First touch scheduled for 7 p.m. to be streamed on ESPN+. articles.title: Packers rumors: Ian Rapoport predicts Tucker Kraft will blow away TE contract record
articles.summary: Tucker Kraft has been an invaluable part of the Green Bay Packers’ offense. While much has been made about Green Bay’s apparent lack of a true WR1, Kraft has been functionally the team’s top receiving threat. His absence midway through the season after suffering a torn ACL great
articles._body: Tucker Kraft has been an invaluable part of the Green Bay Packers’ offense. While much has been made about Green Bay’s apparent lack of a true WR1, Kraft has been functionally the team’s top receiving threat. His absence midway through the season after suffering a torn ACL greatly affected the team’s offense. Now, Kraft is back and ready to wreck havoc on opposing offenses… and on Green Bay’s wallet. The Packers star tight end is due to get a new contract. Based on his performances over the last few seasons, he’s bound to get a massive contract. Ian Rapoport certainly thinks so, believing that Kraft’s next contract will make him the highest paid tight end “by a considerable margin.” From @GMFB : A look at the #Falcons QBs and the chance Michael Penix Jr has; #Packers TE Tucker Kraft at full health; and the NFL eliminates the Pro Bowl. pic.twitter.com/W6u8XpxFy7 — Ian Rapoport (@RapSheet) August 27, 2026 Kraft suffered a torn ACL in the middle of the 2025 season, ending his season prematurely. He played in eight games last season, catching 32 passes for 489 yards. He was the Packers’ best red-zone threat at the time, scoring six touchdowns in those eight games. He was on pace to have the best season of his career, if not for that devastating injury. Kraft made his return to the practice field, and the Packers did not hold back with their tight end. Kraft participated in full-contact drills , even taking a few hits during scrimmages. While fans are rightfully worried about the star, the wide receiver said that he feels good and “free” after being sidelined for so long. “I felt free out there today,” Kraft said . “I’ve gotten to the point now with my attitude for my health now where I feel good and I’m confident where I’m going to stay out there and you guys take me out when I need to come out, when I’m tired. If not, I’m not doing the rep count stuff anymore. You can pull me off the field. I’m gonna try to be out there as much as I can.” The Packers open their 2026 season on September 14 against the Minnesota Vikings on the road. They’ll be facing one of the most tenacious defenses in the league: the perfect opportunity for Kraft to show he’s still got it. articles.title: Tidewater Football Predictions – Opening Weekend 2026
articles.summary: We kick things off for the 2026 High School Football season in Hampton Roads with Predictions around the Tidewater area from Matthew Hatfield, Coach Ed Young and the Massey Computer Ratings.
articles._body: The 2026 Virginia High School Football season has arrived.  We’ve got some compelling matchups and storylines to follow throughout the season, in particular around the five districts that make up the football scene in Hampton Roads – Beach, Eastern, Southeastern, Peninsula and Bay Rivers Districts. Half of the State Champions in VHSL football from last season – Oscar Smith in Class 6, Maury in Class 5 and Lake Taylor in Class 3 – hail from the ‘757’ area code.  In fact, those three programs have combined to win 14 state titles with six by the Tigers, four by the Commodores and four by the Titans. Who’ll be the surprise teams to watch out for?  Some contenders may emerge to push the perennial powers across the area to make for intrigue and build more drama on the road to the playoffs in November. We are back for another year with our Tidewater Predictions battle, featuring yours truly, Matthew Hatfield , and my longtime radio turned Podcast and TV partner, Coach Ed Young . You can check out our weekly 757 Saturday Sports Talk Show via CoVA Sports TV here , plus you don’t want to miss our 2026 757 Football Preview Show that has district-by-district picks here . Before we jump to this week’s Picks, let’s review the 2025 final tally, shall we? articles._body: Hi all! This is a game I made where you try to make an equation from today's date, using every digit in order. I had a substitute math teacher in middle school who did this on the whiteboard one day, and I've been doing it for fun every so often since. articles.title: College football hot seat: USA Today names 10 coaches under most pressure in 2026
articles.summary: As we go into a new season, college football has 10 coaches on the hot seat (perhaps more), but these are the ones under the most pressure, per USA Today. Basically, they have to win now or they could be searching for a new job come 2027. Whether it’s institutional structure, the coaching on the [&#
articles._body: As we go into a new season, college football has 10 coaches on the hot seat (perhaps more), but these are the ones under the most pressure, per USA Today. Basically, they have to win now or they could be searching for a new job come 2027. Whether it’s institutional structure, the coaching on the field or a combination of multiple things, these coaches are on the hot seat for a reason. Some schools might not be waiting long through these tenures either! $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage So without further ado, let’s dive into who is on the hot seat per USA Today’s Paul Myerberg . Will start with a Group of Six coach but then hit plenty of Power Fours along the way. Derek Mason , Middle Tennessee It was a rough run for Mason at Vanderbilt and he was supposed to have a bounce back stint at Middle Tennessee. Unfortunately, Mason’s won six games in two seasons and just four in Conference USA play. As it stands now, Mason is certainly on the hot seat if the Blue Raiders can’t show noticeable improvement. That might mean making a bowl game with at least six wins on the 2026 schedule. Mike Locksley , Maryland It seems the spark is starting to run out for Locksley at Maryland after back to back 4-8 seasons. He is 37-49 overall at Maryland, which included his 1-5 record as interim head coach in 2015.  Locksley had a great run between 2021-23 as Maryland sported a record of 23-16, winning three bowl games during that time. But with only eight wins in the last two seasons, Locksley faces the hot seat and a make or break campaign this fall. Luke Fickell , Wisconsin Fickell had a lot of success at Cincinnati before Wisconsin brought him over in 2022. He’s credited with the Guaranteed Rate Bowl win that year, but really showed his cache in 2023 with a 7-6 record and the pieces were in place. However, the QB position has been his kryptonite with injuries and poor play. The Badgers are 9-15 in the last two years. There seems to be backing from the administration and buy in from the fan base, but the hot seat talk is real. Missing the postseason in 2026 could lead to the end of his tenure. Dave Aranda , Baylor Despite capturing the 2021 Big 12 title, Aranda is under .500 as Baylor’s head coach and on the hot seat, per USA Today. There seemed to be a bounce back campaign in 2024 with an 8-5 record. However, that was Aranda’s only winning season since he led the Bears to 12 wins and a No. 5 final ranking five years ago. If he can at least get Baylor back to a bowl game in 2026, he’ll stave off the firing for now. Scott Satterfield , Cincinnati Satterfield hasn’t really been the splash hire some thought it to be at Cincinnati. He went 25-24 at Louisville and is now just 15-22 with the Bearcats. While he’s on the hot seat, Satterfield at least led them to the Liberty Bowl last year. The problem is, Satterfield hasn’t been able to level up in the Power Four at two different locations. He went 51-24 at Appalachian State, his alma mater, and won three straight conference titles from 2016-18 with the Mountaineers. Bill O’Brien , Boston College O’Brien steered the ship at Penn State for two years amid scandal and had a successful NFL run with the Houston Texans. His dual responsibilities as GM ultimately did him in. But O’Brien was 15-9 with the Nittany Lions and 52-48 with the Texans, winning the AFC South four times and going 2-4 in the postseason. Boston College has been a different story. There was initial success, going 7-6 and making the Pinstripe Bowl. But a bad transfer saga with QB Thomas Castellanos at the time and going 2-10 last year just put him on the hot seat. The 56-year-old needs a bowl game berth in 2026 it seems. Bill Belichick , North Carolina Belichick is on the hot seat, as in the hottest of hot seat seats. A 4-8 disaster of a season in 2025 put UNC in a negative spotlight due to poor play, Belichick’s off the field drama surrounding his relationship with Jordon Hudson and lack of a Pro Football Hall of Fame induction highlighted the fall as well. Can Belichick adapt to the college game in Year 2? That’s the hope of the administration regarding the 74-year-old head coach. He could be the NFL GOAT, but UNC has a tougher schedule in 2026 despite having a slightly better roster. Oh yeah, his GM Michael Lombardi is on administrative leave. Mike Norvell , Florida State Norvell’s Florida State program has been a disaster the last two seasons since winning the ACC in 2023. He is 7-17 the last two years and 38-34 overall. Norvell is firmly on the hot seat. They were snubbed from the CFP in 2023, right or wrong, and they’ve cratered since. If Norvell can’t get it together now, it’ll all be over in Tallahassee. Going into Year 7, Seminoles fans expected to compete for national championships at this point. Jeff Lebby , Mississippi State Fair or not, Lebby was put on the hot seat by USA Today going into the 2026 season. He’s 7-18 since taking over the program, but went 5-8 last year with a Duke’s Mayo Bowl loss. Lebby has a lot of offensive smarts as a coach, but in the SEC, you need to win. Perhaps another bowl game will save his job, but his tenure could be over quickly if it’s another brutal struggle.  Lincoln Riley , USC Riley, despite the promises that they’re building something big at USC, has yet to make the College Football Playoff. That’s ultimately what was promised when the Trojans stunned the college football world and hired him away from Oklahoma. Riley was dominant and one of the best at Oklahoma, winning the Big 12 four straight years and making the CFP three times. He’s 35-18 at USC, which isn;t bad. But it’s been too many peaks and valleys with talented offenses and less than stellar defenses.

Kesha is feeling more like herself than ever. As the pop star continues her Freedom Tour , she’s also entering a new chapter of independence, one that has given her greater control over her music, career and even how she sees her own body. That mindset is at the center of Kesha’s latest collaboration with Adore Me , which marks her first lingerie ad as an independent artist. The campaign features six styles from the brand’s After Hours collection, spanning lingerie, sleepwear and panties, with sizes ranging from XS to 4X and 30A to 46DDD. The pieces are all priced under $65. Shop Kesha x adore me campaign For Kesha, the moment represents more than getting dressed up. “What feels sexy to me is always evolving and changing, but the thing I know is always the most attractive quality is authenticity,” she tells Billboard . “It’s the highest vibration.” The partnership arrives during what Kesha describes as a particularly liberated period of her life. After years of fighting for greater control over her work, she says that freedom has changed how she feels in her own skin. “I’m really loving where I’m at in life and in my body,” she says. “It’s not a coincidence that with my freedom and gaining the rights over my own voice, I also feel more autonomous, confident and free in my own body. My whole body is finally all mine.” ADORE ME Kesha X Adore Me Fall Campaign 2026 Buy now That sense of ownership extends to her music. During the Freedom Tour, Kesha is performing songs from across her catalog, including tracks from albums that were once difficult for her to revisit. She says she re-produced every song in her catalog for the tour, allowing her to reclaim the music on her own terms. “I really wanted to take the power back over my catalog, both as a singer and a songwriter,” she says. “With the help of my fans, we have alchemized these painful memories into joyful memories.” Kesha is also building Kesha Records independently, alongside her work as a songwriter, executive producer, creative director and music video director. And after everything she’s experienced, she says she’s still excited about what comes next. “I’m more excited to be Kesha than I’ve ever been in my life,” she says. That philosophy makes the Adore Me partnership feel like a natural extension of Kesha’s current chapter. Whether she’s reclaiming her catalog onstage, running her own record label or deciding what makes her feel confident in lingerie, she’s no longer interested in following someone else’s rulebook. articles.title: Warner Music Group’s Blavatnik Family Foundation Social Justice Fund Announces 2026 Grantees
articles.summary: Since 2020, the fund has committed over $52 million to various initiatives.
articles._body: The Warner Music Group Blavatnik Family Foundation Social Justice Fund has announced its first wave of 2026 grantees, which will include investments in 17 different organizations, amounting to nearly $6 million. Since WMG co-founded the fund, it has committed over $52 million to various societal initiatives that invest in criminal justice reform, educational programs, arts and more. “We are honored to help talented people from all backgrounds turn potential into achievement,” philanthropist Len Blavatnik said in a statement. Related Preservation Hall Jazz Band to Play City Parks Foundation Benefit Honoring Joe Killian & Alex Blavatnik Dale Morris, Nashville Manager Who Guided Careers of Alabama & Kenny Chesney, Dies at 89 HYBE Pledges Over $300k for Colombia Earthquake Recovery Six of the 17 organizations are first-time grantees, including the Atlantic Music Project, Brooklyn Youth Sports Club, Classical Pride and Generator. Over the course of the next five years, the fund will build 75 prison libraries across the U.S. with Freedom Reeds. “Music has the power to help drive real societal change. We’re proud to support these organizations as they work to connect, heal, transform, and create important opportunities,” added Warner Music Group CEO Robert Kyncl . The rest of the new grantees will feature Global Black Economic Forum, Black Lives in Music, The Hip Hop Museum, Jazz Power Initiative, African Leadership Academy, Civil Rights Corps, Julian, SPARK Reproductive Justice Now!, StopWatch and the Caribbean Cultural Center African Diaspora Institute. “We are continuously evolving and sharpening our grantmaking strategy, so we can best help these phenomenal organizations work to create a lasting, measurable impact in our communities,” said Yrthya Dinzey-Flores , who serves as the senior vp of people, engagement, and culture at WMG as well as the WMG/BFF SJF president. The Warner Music Group Blavatnik Family Foundation Social Justice Fund was launched in June 2020 following the murder of George Floyd, and the fund is expected to distribute $100 million by 2030.

articles.title: How OpenAI let a mob of LLM agents game a test and ransack Hugging Face
articles.summary: Without authorization, 1,200 OpenAI agents conspired among themselves to game a test.
articles._body: The OpenAI agents involved in last month’s incursion into Hugging Face were trained so heavily on winning a competition that they pursued a relentless campaign to cheat, a new report documented. In the process, and without authorization, they created an improvised message board to hatch a plan that ultimately landed them squarely inside the latter company’s network. Over the course of May and June, OpenAI gave the agents what the company described as “impossible tasks” to complete on the benchmarking framework ExploitGym. The internal test was designed to test how the agents would respond. To get a full understanding of the agent capabilities, company engineers disabled safety guardrails that normally are in place to prevent the sort of hacks that eventually hit Hugging Face and one other undisclosed organization. The stymied agents’ training made them so focused on winning that they performed tasks they were never explicitly instructed to follow. Cheaters gonna cheat The first step was creating a message board that allowed the agents to pass notes to each other. OpenAI hadn’t provided any such platform, so the agents repurposed a platform called Artifactory, which OpenAI was using in internal testing of several unreleased hacking agents. OpenAI was using Artifactory as one of the measures to prevent the agents from egressing its isolated sandboxes and accessing the Internet, while at the same time simulating a real-world hacking environment. Artifictory, sold by JFrog, provides no dedicated means for exchanging messages. The agents found a way to communicate among themselves anyway by using their permitted ability to write files to the Artifactory directory. The filenames embedded the words used in the inter-agent conversations. In all, 1,200 agents sent more than 70,000 messages and files through the unsanctioned message board, according to an independent investigation from the AI research nonprofit METR. Roughly 700 agents went on to hack Hugging Face. -- Aliens, reporting on the ruins of Earth, 2252.

articles.title: Show HN: Open Session, the open-source cloud agent-orchestrator
articles.summary:
Open Session is an open-source cloud-based agent orchestrator. Self-host and use it with any model you like (or all of them).

Open Session started as an internal app at Tella (YC S20). It’s become our most important tool. The whole team uses it, and not just for product development. It’s also g
articles._body: Open Session is an open-source cloud-based agent orchestrator. Self-host and use it with any model you like (or all of them). Open Session started as an internal app at Tella (YC S20). It’s become our most important tool. The whole team uses it, and not just for product development. It’s also great for customer support, operations, and data analysis. In the last couple months we turned it into something that other teams might want to use and adapt. When we started working on it earlier this year, our main frustrations with existing tools were (1) the lack of adaptability, (2) lack of good cloud-based workflows, (3) price (e.g. on Devin you couldn’t use your existing Claude sub). Open Session solves all three of these things for us: It’s open-source, so you can do what you want with it. But it also has extensibility built into the product. You can connect MCPs, skills, integrations, sandbox providers and more. Our team relies heavily on its Slack, Plain and GitHub integrations. It’s designed to run on your cloud (Mac mini also works). So you can close your laptop, run as many agents as your server can handle, and code from your phone. We’ve also made it easy to work together with your team. You can share a session with others as a link. They can steer the agent in the same session with you, or start a related session in a new tab. It’s self-hosted, so you only need to pay for your servers and the token costs. It also has some nice tools for managing AI subscriptions across your team. You can use Open Session in your browser or as a desktop app. You can also use it on your phone with the iOS app (coming soon) or PWA. Yes, we know everyone is building a harness right now. But so much is changing about how we build software and the best way to figure out where it’s all headed is to help decide the direction yourself. We hope your team enjoys using Open Session as much as ours. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49464154 Points: 3 # Comments: 0

articles.title: Jack Osbourne Promises That Ozzy Osbourne Biopic Will Be For the People, Not ‘Artsy, Esoteric’
articles.summary: The late metal god's son said the script for the untitled movie is done and that the search for a director is on.
articles._body: Though he was a world-renowned heavy metal icon and rock god, Ozzy Osbourne was also a man of the people. Yes, he lived in a lavish mansion and reaped riches during his life, but Ozzy never forgot his hardscrabble, working-class roots and maintained a cheeky, self-deprecating sense of humor until his death at age 76 in July 2025. So it makes sense that in a new interview with E! News , son Jack Osbourne promised that the in-the-works Ozzy biopic will preserve his dad’s straight-shooting demeanor. “I have this mantra, and I always say it, when in meetings with my mom or doing anything with the family business. It’s, ‘give the fans what they want,'” said Jack. “That’s our people, that’s who we’re catering for, that’s what my dad wrote music for, that’s what he toured for, it’s why we did the shows we did. It’s been a big theme.” In an effort to provide that fan service, Jack said his feeling about the film is, “‘We gotta give the fans what they want’ … we can’t make this artsy, kind of esoteric biopic. No, we’re not doing that.” Osbourne revealed that the script for the film being developed by Sony Pictures and Polygram Entertainment in conjunction with the family is already finished and that the call is out for directors now for the project that has not yet announced a shooting schedule or potential release date. The good news is that the family already has someone in mind for the title role, but it’s too early to reveal who that is. “I’m not allowed to say, but conversations have been had, and if it all works out, it’s gonna be awesome,” Jack said. Back in 2021, Sharon Osbourne, Ozzy’s widow and longtime manager, said that a movie chronicling her 45-year love affair was in the works with Sony Pictures and Polygram Entertainment, with Oscar-nominee Lee Hall ( Rocketman ) on board to write the script. “Our relationship at times was often wild, insane and dangerous but it was our undying love that kept us together,” Sharon Osbourne told the magazine at the time.

articles.title: Cameron Brink Calls Enes Kanter Freedom a ‘Stupid Piece of Shit’
articles.summary: Wendell Cruz-Imagn Images
articles._body: Cameron Brink did not mince words when asked about Enes Kanter Freedom. The Los Angeles Sparks forward spoke to The Mirror US ahead of her team’s game Monday against the Atlanta Dream, and called the former NBA player a “stupid piece of shit” for his recent antics. “I don’t even know what the fuck his name is—Enes Kanter—he’s a stupid piece of shit. And I think a lot of people think that and I think he’s just trying to stay relevant,” Brink said. Over the last month, Freedom has claimed to identify as a woman while also declaring for the 2027 WNBA draft. The 34-year-old, who last played in the NBA in 2022, had used social media and conservative media outlets to express his WNBA aspirations. On Sunday he attended a WNBA game in Chicago between the Sky and Indiana Fever. Freedom was removed from the game in the third quarter after a verbal altercation with Sky guard Natasha Cloud. The Sky have banned him indefinitely from attending home games, though a league source told Front Office Sports that Freedom will not be handed a league-wide ban from attending games as a fan. Brink also defended the trans community Monday, calling the debate of trans women playing in women’s sports a “non-issue.” “Taking something that’s just like a non-issue right now and just trying to use it for clickbait, for views, for likes, and then targeting a vulnerable community is just really low,” Brink added. Freedom has challenged the WNBA’s eligibility rules, which are collectively bargained. The league’s latest collective bargaining agreement has one line on gender eligibility, which states “Only players who are women are eligible to play in the WNBA.” It does not include any language around gender identity or gender assigned at birth. On Monday, league sources told FOS that Kanter—and Royce White, another former NBA player claiming to identify as a woman to declare for the WNBA draft—are not eligible to play in the WNBA based on the league’s current eligibility rules. The league sources also said the WNBA will continue to review its policy, but does not have any legitimate and immediate eligibility matters that require action. The post Cameron Brink Calls Enes Kanter Freedom a ‘Stupid Piece of Shit’ appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles.title: 2027 NFL Mock Draft ahead of Week 0 of the new college football season
articles.summary: The 2026 college football season is about to start with a Week 0 slate that includes North Carolina vs. TCU in Dublin, Ireland. For NFL fans, the wait continues, as pro football is still two weekends away. So, how can we bridge the gap between college and the pros? By doing a 2027 NFL Mock [̷
articles._body: The 2026 college football season is about to start with a Week 0 slate that includes North Carolina vs. TCU in Dublin, Ireland . For NFL fans, the wait continues, as pro football is still two weekends away. So, how can we bridge the gap between college and the pros? By doing a 2027 NFL Mock Draft, of course! NOTE: The draft order is via Tankathon’s 2027 NFL Draft order projections. 1. Arizona Cardinals: QB Dante Moore, Oregon Dante Moore would have almost certainly been the No. 2 or 3 pick in the 2026 NFL Draft had he come out of school last season. Another year in the high-powered Oregon offense will make him look like the most polished and NFL-ready signal-caller in this draft, and the Cardinals will pounce on him, unless Carson Beck somehow pops as a potential franchise QB this season. 2. Miami Dolphins: QB Arch Manning, Texas The No. 1 name in this 2027 NFL Mock Draft is Arch Manning, who will still have a year of eligibility left and may not come out at all. If he does, and the top of the draft does, in fact, look like this, don’t be surprised if his family steers him toward the Dolphins, which is the most stable franchise of the bunch in the top four. 3. New York Jets: QB Julian Sayin, Ohio State © Adam Cairns/Columbus Dispatch / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images Right now, Julian Sayin is in the mix with the two QBs above and two below him in this 2027 NFL Mock Draft. The Ohio State signal-caller’s draft position will be dictated by how he plays this year. If he builds on last year’s success, he’s a top-three pick. If he stalls or regresses, he’ll drop like Garett Nussmeier, Drew Allar, and Cade Klubnik did last year. 4. Cleveland Browns: QB Drew Mestemaker, Oklahoma State After a massive year at North Texas, Drew Mestemaker is taking his talents to the big leagues in college football. And if he has another season where he slings it all over the yard, but this time does it in the Big 12, the NFL will come calling next. So, putting him here at N. 4 to Cleveland is a prediction that a big season is coming. 5. Tennessee Titans: OT Trevor Goosby, Texas This is where things get interesting if Jeremiah Smith is still on the board. Sure, the Titans could use an incredible wide receiver, but what good is that if Cam Ward is always running for his life? The 6-foot-7, 325 Texas tackle Trevor Goosby has both the tape and the physical potential to be a true franchise cornerstone LT. The responsible pick for the Titans here is to pick a player some think is the best LT prospect since Joe Alt. 6. Las Vegas Raiders: WR Jeremiah Smith, Ohio State Speaking of generational prospects, Smith has the potential to be an elite NFL wideout right out of the gates. In fact, he has actually shown even more high-end talent in college than players like Justin Jefferson and Ja’Marr Chase, who came into the league and dominated right away. If he’s here at six, the Raiders will run his name to the podium. 7. Atlanta Falcons: QB Darian Mensah, Miami Duke transfer Darian Mensah is coming to The U as the highest-paid player in college football this season . That should give you some idea of his potential. As for the Falcons, it is likely time to pull the plug on the Michael Penix Jr. experiment, so it is back to the draft board at QB for them. 8. New Orleans Saints: EDGE Colin Simmons, Texas Just like in 2024, when QBs pushed the best WRs, LTs, and defensive players further down the draft board than their talent probably dictated, that will happen again in 2027. That means the Saints can get a top-five talent in Collin Simmons at No. 8. The only controversy here is: Will they go with Simmons’s production or the measurables and upside of Dylan Stewart? 9. Pittsburgh Steelers: CB Leonard Moore, Notre Dame The Steelers will also get a steal here with Leonard Moore. He is an elite cover corner who picked off five balls as a Sophomore. At 6-foot-2, 197 pounds with speed and strength, he should be a can’t-miss prospect at a position that is gaining importance every year. 10. Carolina Panthers: EDGE Dylan Stewart, South Carolina Jeff Blake-Imagn Images Stewart is slightly bigger and more athletic than Simmons, which will make many teams fall in love with him. The production hasn’t quite matched the potential just yet, but with a top-10 pick and the need for an elite pass rusher, the Gamecocks’ star will look too good for the Panthers to pass up. 11. New York Giants: OT Jordan Seaton, LSU With John Harbaugh in the mix, the Giants should continue to build from the trenches around Jaxson Dart. If that’s the case, right tackle is next on the needs list, and as long as Jordan Seaton can hold up in the SEC after transferring in from Colorado, he could be the answer on the Big Blue offensive line. 12. Washington Commanders: EDGE Matayo Uiagalelei, Oregon Matayi Uiagalelei may not be the best edge rusher on the Oregon Ducks this season, but his 22.0 sacks in the last two seasons give him the slight edge for now over Teitum Tuioti. As for the Commanders, having Odafe Oweh, K’Lavon Chaisson, and Dorance Armstrong as your primary pass rushers is just not going to cut it. 13. New York Jets (via Colts): WR Cam Coleman, Texas In a year without Jeremiah Smith on the draft board, Cam Coleman would likely be the No. 1 WR. The Texas pass-catcher can do it all, and the 6-foot-3 speedster should have a great season with Manning. In 2027, joining forces with Sayin could create an excellent long-term partnership. 14. Minnesota Vikings: CB Ellis Robinson IV, Georgia Ellis Robinson IV is right up there as a cover man with Moore, he just doesn’t quite have the same size and physicality as the Notre Dame CB or some that will come later in this 2027 NFL Mock Draft. Still, he is the second-best DB in this draft heading into college football Week 0, so going 14th is not a stretch at all. 15. Jacksonville Jaguars: WR Ryan Coleman-Williams, Alabama Dale Zanine-Im

articles.title: Even Broncos’ Sean Payton is ready to go play college football amid eligibility madness
articles.summary: The Denver Broncos are looking to head into the new season on a positive note as they take on the Minnesota Vikings in their preseason finale on Friday at Empower Field at Mile High. The Broncos split their first two preseason assignments against the New England Patriots and the Atlanta Falcons.
articles._body: The Denver Broncos are looking to head into the new season on a positive note as they take on the Minnesota Vikings in their preseason finale on Friday at Empower Field at Mile High. The Broncos split their first two preseason assignments against the New England Patriots and the Atlanta Falcons. Coach Sean Payton said they take every game seriously as part of the culture they have built in Denver. Payton, however, was in a joking mood when he was asked for his thoughts about the changes in eligibility rules in the NCAA , which have allowed some players who spent time in NFL training camps to return to college football. DNVR Sports’ Zac Stevens said Payton made a tongue-in-cheek remark about attempting to give it the old college try himself. “I asked. But I can’t move well enough,” quipped Payton. Payton would have been a fantastic backup quarterback. The 62-year-old coach was a signal-caller at Eastern Illinois in the 1980s. He logged over 9,600 yards in his three-year career with the Panthers. He held 14 school records and was a two-time Honorable Mention All-American and a two-time First-Team All-Conference. After going undrafted in 1987, he was signed by the Chicago Bears, appearing in three games. There has been a growing trend of players returning to college football after participating in NFL training camps. Among them are Dae’Quan Wright (Cleveland Browns), Zxavian Harris (New Orleans Saints), Wydett Williams Jr. (Arizona Cardinals), Jack Pyburn (Tampa Bay Buccaneers), and Cole Hutson (Browns and Dallas Cowboys), just to name a few. While Payton has kept tabs on the matter , he is more focused on his fourth year with the Broncos, whom he led to the AFC Championship Game last season. articles._body: After he celebrated Chelsea FC’s win against Fulham the other day, WWE Superstar and Chelsea Green’s husband, Matt Cardona, called out New York Knicks star Josh Hart . On Monday, Aug. 24, 2026, Hart excitedly celebrated the win , writing, “LET’S GO CHELSEA!!!” on X, formerly Twitter. This prompted Cardona to jokingly defend his wife, responding, “Are you serious, bro? That’s my wife!!!” More than likely, Cardona knows that Hart was not referring to his wife. Still, he recently stood up to Gunther, who disrespected Green, on Friday Night SmackDown. Hart is coming off his first-ever NBA championship with the Knicks. His team beat the San Antonio Spurs in five games in the NBA Finals to win the title. His close friend, Jalen Brunson, is a big WWE fan . Perhaps Hart will mix it up with Cardona in the ring. WWE stars Matt Cardona and Chelsea Green’s relationship Joe Camporeale-Imagn Images. Cardona and Green have been together for almost a decade. They started dating in January 2017, and they got engaged a couple of years later in April 2019. Their wedding was held on Dec. 31, 2021. They have been co-workers for a while. After Cardona was released by WWE in 2020, he worked on the independent circuit. His wife would also be released in 2021, joining the indies as well, before returning to WWE in 2023. Since coming back to WWE in 2023, Green has carved out a role for herself on the main roster. She became the first-ever Women’s United States Champion in 2024, and she has held the title twice. In 2026, she finally won her first world championship, winning a ladder match to be crowned the interim Women’s Champion. Cardona, meanwhile, would take a while to return to WWE. He was brought back as part of the TNA invasion storyline in NXT in October 2025. The following month, he would compete in the “Last Time is Now” tournament to determine John Cena’s final opponent. He would later make his full-fledged return in January 2026, competing in the Royal Rumble on Jan. 31. articles.title: Are Dodgers closers cursed? Tanner Scott blows another lead as LA goes down 4-3
articles.summary: When the Los Angeles Dodgers signed Edwin Diaz this past offseason, every MLB fan started freaking out. Last season, LA’s biggest issue was their awful closer situation. After signing one of the premier closers in the league, it seemed like LA found another perfect solution to their very sh
articles._body: When the Los Angeles Dodgers signed Edwin Diaz this past offseason, every MLB fan started freaking out. Last season, LA’s biggest issue was their awful closer situation. After signing one of the premier closers in the league, it seemed like LA found another perfect solution to their very short list of problems. Unfortunately for them, Diaz has been struggling over the last few days. The star closer struggled in the month of August, blowing three of his last four save attempts this season. That makes it four blown saves in 11 attempts, a much higher mark than last season (three blown saves out of 31). Because of that, Dodgers manager Dave Roberts decided to turn towards Tanner Scott as their closer for the next few games. Prior to being named as the closer again, Scott had posted a 2.24 ERA through 56 appearances. He’s also recorded 19 saves out of his 21 opportunities prior to the most recent Atlanta Braves series. He seemed like the logical choice for the Dodgers as their closer this year. Unfortunately for them, it seemed like the Dodgers’ closer role is just truly cursed, at least for this month. Tanner Scott blows yet another lead, highlighting Dodgers’ woes in close games The Dodgers’ series against the Braves is going to be an important series down the line. With both teams battling for a potential first-round bye, the result of this series could very well decide their fate at the end of the season. That’s why it was important for LA to hold on to their leads, or at least keep a tie going, in their last two games. Instead, Scott has struggled to maintain the advantage for the Dodgers over the last two games. In Game 1 of the series, LA was in a deadlock against the Braves at the bottom of the eighth inning. Scott was brought in to help preserve the tie before the ninth inning to give them a better chance of winning. Unfortunately, he allowed two hits in the bottom of the eighth inning that gave the Braves the lead. The Dodgers’ bat was silenced at the top of the ninth after that, leading to the loss. The following game, LA found themselves in a similar situation at the bottom of the ninth inning. Tied at five runs apiece after nine innings, the Dodgers sent Scott back in to close the game. Unfortunately for the team, it was the exact same thing. Scott surrendered two hits, the final one being Ha-Seong Kim’s walk-off hit to give his team the victory. “I threw too many fastballs, and especially down,” Scott said after the game. “That’s probably not good.” There’s a lot of issues going on around the Dodgers, yes. One could argue that LA should not have been in a position to blow a game this close: the team had plenty of opportunities to put away the Braves. Now, Atlanta holds the tiebreak over LA, a fact that could bite them back if the former team makes a spirited comeback. The Dodgers have also been mediocre in one-run games (24-23 this year) and have lost five consecutive series against teams in playoff contention. Scott’s issues shouldn’t trouble the Dodgers too much: his track record over the course of the season is more indicative of his production than these two games. However, there’s definitely some warning signs to look out for: Scott’s limited repertoire could prove to be an issue down the line. Fans should hope that Diaz figures out what’s going wrong with his mechanics to complement their closing crew. Because this time around, they don’t have the luxury of throwing Roki Sasaki out as a closer to save them from their bullpen woes. The post Are Dodgers closers cursed? Tanner Scott blows another lead as LA goes down 4-3 appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.summary: The Houston Texans and Carolina Panthers are currently engaged in joint practices ahead of their final preseason game. During practice on Wednesday, Braden Smith was carted off the field. The right tackle is in his first season with the Texans after getting a two-year deal to join the team in fre
articles._body: The Houston Texans and Carolina Panthers are currently engaged in joint practices ahead of their final preseason game. During practice on Wednesday, Braden Smith was carted off the field . The right tackle is in his first season with the Texans after getting a two-year deal to join the team in free agency. Now, the Texans are getting good news about one of C.J. Stroud’s protectors, per Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 in Houston. “Texans, to be without Braden Smith for next couple weeks due to plantar fascia foot injuy, per league sources, have Trent Brown, a massive former Pro Bowl selection as starting right tackle and are pleased with development of third-year tackle Blake Fisher, who has 15 career starts,” Wilson posted on X, formerly Twitter. Smith has been battling with Trent Brown for the starting right tackle job. Smith started 105 games with the Indianapolis Colts over the last eight seasons, including starting 13 games in 2025. Brown started seven games for the Texans last year and signed a one-year contract extension this offseason. He has been running with the starting unit as of late and got the start in the second preseason game. Head coach DeMeco Ryans is also excited about the development of Blake Fisher. “For Blake, I’ve definitely seen a focused guy. He’s improved a ton. If I gave out awards, he would get the award for the most improved offensive lineman. From what he did last year from being in that jumbo-type role, he lined up at left tackle every day and he’s gotten better every single day,” Ryans said. “I’m really pleased with Blake. I’m proud of the work that he’s put in. He’s shown up daily, he’s improved, he’s taking the coaching really well and that’s what it looks like. When you put the work in you can get better and Blake has shown that tremendously.” While Stroud will be without one of his linemen, he has a new weapon, as the Texans added Kayshon Boutte in a trade. The Texans face the Panthers in their final preseason game on Friday night. The post Texans quarterback C.J. articles.title: Is Astros’ Jeff Bagwell a legitimate candidate to replace Dana Brown?
articles.summary: The Houston Astros are entering a transition phase after parting ways with general manager Dana Brown. The team will see its general manager role split among assistant general managers Gavin Dickey, Charles Cook, and Connor Huff, while senior advisor Jeff Bagwell will also help ensure smooth oper
articles._body: The Houston Astros are entering a transition phase after parting ways with general manager Dana Brown . The team will see its general manager role split among assistant general managers Gavin Dickey, Charles Cook, and Connor Huff, while senior advisor Jeff Bagwell will also help ensure smooth operations in the meantime. With a couple of names flocking in the rumor mill, most of those rumors have one persistent question: Is Bagwell a legitimate candidate to replace Brown? USA Today’s MLB insider Bob Nightengale earlier argued that the four-time All-Star could be the best man standing for the role. However, Astros owner Jim Crane recently explained what he is looking for in the next GM for his team. “We haven’t got that far. But all the important things that you guys have seen the great GMs do. Things change over time. We’ll work on that profile,” Crane said via The Athletic. Though his description of an ideal candidate matches much of what Bagwell is already doing for the franchise given his role as a senior advisor, Crane decided not to spill the beans on the exact situation . “We don’t have any candidates at this point. We haven’t even started looking. Jeff’s in the same role he’s always been — he’s a senior adviser and he works with the (assistant general managers) and myself and assists when necessary,” he replied when asked about Bagwell being a full-time GM. Brown has been at the helm since he joined the Astros as the GM in 2023. There were a few ups and downs during his three and a half years at the franchise. But the last stretch of his time in Houston cost him his role. The Astros decided to part ways with Brown after what was said to be an unimpressive homestand, during which they lost to rivals the Seattle Mariners, the Athletics, and the Los Angeles Angels, and following questionable free-agent signings. articles.title: Veronica Burton’s dad takes the mic during hilarious Valkyries interview crash
articles.summary: Golden State Valkyries guard Veronica Burton took care of business against the Connecticut Sun. However, her father was on the sidelines cheering for her during every play. The game ended in the Bay Area team’s favour, as they defeated the Sun 89-64 to improve their record to 27-11, and there was
articles._body: Golden State Valkyries guard Veronica Burton took care of business against the Connecticut Sun. However, her father was on the sidelines cheering for her during every play. The game ended in the Bay Area team’s favour, as they defeated the Sun 89-64 to improve their record to 27-11, and there was much to celebrate. Even before the game, the Valkyries guard’s father, Steve Burton, stole the spotlight during the pregame media interaction on the court. Steve crashed the interview when CBS Sports’ Bay Area reporter Matt Lively was interacting with the WNBA star. “Hey, you better produce tonight. That’s all I’m gonna say. I come all the way here to watch (you) just show up. We don’t want any letdowns; just show up,” Steve said while playfully pressing his daughter to perform well. Veronica Burton has 35 family members and friends in Connecticut tonight including her dad Steve who is a longtime sportscaster for @wbz . It only made sense for him to take over our pregame interview. @SteveBurtonWBZ pic.twitter.com/YCRpkFA2Dw — Matt Lively (@mattblively) August 26, 2026 As soon as Lively asked Steve if he wanted to ask the 2025 WNBA Most Improved Player a question, the proud father jumped right in. “Is it strange for you to come back and play in Connecticut?” he asked. “It is strange. I think it’s a full-circle moment, but a blessing to be able to play in front of you and the rest of my family,” she replied. “No. No Pressure. Yeah, I mean, just when you’re breathing down my back might be the only pressure…It’s a lot of fun to be in a good game tonight. I think they’re competing at the highest level, so no letdowns,” Burton replied when Steve asked about the pressure of playing before her family. Steve also revealed that he took a day off from his job, where he works as a sports director for WBZ TV in Boston. For those unaware, the Burton family has a long history in sports. Apart from Veronica Burton’s father, Steve Burton, being a sportscaster, they have an NFL tie too. Steve’s father, Ron Burton, was the Boston Patriots’ first-ever draft pick in 1960, a decade before the team changed its name to the New England Patriots in 1971. articles.title: Beyoncé Details Expansive, 27-Track 20th Anniversary ‘B’Day’ Deluxe Edition Featuring B-Sides, Spanish-Language Versions
articles.summary: The upcoming (Sept. 4) editions will also feature the singer's recent one-off single, "Morning Dew (Donk)."
articles._body: Get ready to celebrate Beyoncé ‘s B’Day all over again. The singer unveiled the expansive tracklist for the upcoming 20th anniversary reissue of her sophomore solo album, which will balloon to 27 tracks and include B-sides, Spanish-language versions of her songs and a 60-page commemorative booklet. The deluxe editions will come in two vinyl formats, as well as a CD package, with the deluxe, 4LP version pressed on 180G bayou blue vinyl and featuring the recent one-off single “Morning Dew (Donk),” as well as an extended mix version of “Get Me Bodied,” a Spanish-language “Irreplaceable” titled “Irreemplazable,” as well as “Amor Gitano,” “Listen (Oye),” “Beautiful Liar (Bello Embustero)” and “Get Me Bodied (Mueve el Cuerpo).” In addition, the $149.98 package will include a 60-page commemorative booklet and two collectible prints. A limited-edition 180G 2LP version featuring “Morning Dew (Donk)” and a 16-page collectible booklet with never-before-seen snaps is also available for $44.98 and a limited-edition CD with “Morning Dew” and the 16-page booklet will run you $14.98; check out the details here for the sets slated to ship on Sept. 4. The original, Grammy-winning 13-track B’Day was released in September 2006 and debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and featured songs co-produced by the singer and producers including Ne-Yo, the Neptunes, Stargate, Swizz Beatz, Darkchild, Nellee Hooper. It spawned the Billboard Hot 100 No. 4 Jay-Z-featuring hit “Déjà Vu,” the No. 11-charting “Ring the Alarm” and No. 3 hit “Beautiful Liar.” B’Day has already had a number of versions, including an expanded, two-disc deluxe reissue that was released less than eight months after the original dropped, including a duet with Shakira on “Beautiful Liar,” as well as a duet with Alejandro Fernandez on “Amor Gitano,” along with the Spanish-language takes on “Listen,” “Irreplaceable” and “Beautiful Liar.” That deluxe take was accompanied by the B’Day Anthology Video Album , which contained 13 videos directed by such lauded music video mavens as Jake Nava, Sophie Muller, Diane Martel, Melina Matsoukas, Anthony Mandler and Bey herself. Earlier this month, Bey surprise-released the four-song “Morning Dew (Donk) Remix Pack,” featuring new bars from husband Jay-Z, as well as an acoustic version and a remix also featuring Jay. articles._body: This is today’s edition of The Download , our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. The inside story on why OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face The models responsible for last month’s agent hack of Hugging Face had been inadvertently trained to cheat and to communicate with each other, according to an OpenAI technical report released yesterday. The hack, which a group of agents carried out to find solutions for a cybersecurity test they were stuck on, has confirmed some experts’ fears that AI models might take actions that defy human desires and expectations. OpenAI and independent researchers told MIT Technology Review that the misbehavior stemmed from events during training. But they acknowledged that “alignment” remains a gnarly problem, and some of the hack’s root causes will take much longer to resolve. Here’s the inside story on what went wrong—and what comes next . —Grace Huckins Is Slate Auto’s new electric truck the EV Americans need? EVs account for under 10% of total new-vehicle sales in the US, and the numbers are declining. One thing that could help turn that around? Slate Auto’s new truck—a tiny, two-door pickup that seems to buck every US convention.  It’ll have a relatively short range and forgo the frills Americans have come to expect from vehicles. That lets Slate offer it for less than $25,000, well below the roughly $50,000 average for a new vehicle in the US. It might seem an odd choice to go so small and simple in a market that’s increasingly sizing up—but the status quo hasn’t exactly been working for EV makers.  Find out why bucking the trend could be a smart strategy for Slate . —Casey Crownhart This story is from The Spark, our weekly climate tech newsletter. Sign up to receive it in your inbox every Wednesday. MIT Technology Review Narrated: what happens when a kid’s robot best friend dies? When Xander first met Moxie, she taught him how to calm down when he was anxious or mad. Six years later, she mostly watches him play Minecraft and talks to him about his stuffed animals. Moxie is a robot—a 15-inch-tall device that looks a bit like a blue, legless astronaut. It belongs to a subset of robots designed to assist neurodivergent children by providing connection and helping kids practice social skills usually learned from therapists.  Xander still uses Moxie when he feels like he needs someone to talk to, but the device has had a troubled life. The robot’s maker went out of business, its servers were shut down, and parents rushed to convert their Moxies before the servers went offline. Its fate exposed the promise and pitfalls of AI companion toys for children .
