articles.title: Taylor Rapp release was due to personal issue, could re-join Broncos at later date
articles.summary: The Denver Broncos have released veteran safety Taylor Rapp, less than a week after signing him to a one-year, $1.3 million contract with no guarantees. The 28-year-old practiced on Monday, missed Tuesday’s session and was released on Wednesday as the Broncos approach the upcoming roster de
articles._body: The Denver Broncos have released veteran safety Taylor Rapp, less than a week after signing him to a one-year, $1.3 million contract with no guarantees. The 28-year-old practiced on Monday, missed Tuesday’s session and was released on Wednesday as the Broncos approach the upcoming roster deadline. Speaking after Wednesday’s practice, head coach Sean Payton provided an update on Rapp, saying the now-free-agent is dealing with personal issues and “needs some time at home.” However, Payton added that there is a “better-than-good chance” Rapp will return and re-sign with the team at some point. Taylor Rapp is dealing with a personal issue and needs time. Better chance than not he re-signs with the Broncos, per Sean Payton pic.twitter.com/fFX4Ja0luH — Zac Stevens (@ZacStevens) August 26, 2026 Denver had expressed interest in Rapp because of his experience and the need for additional depth at safety. The team’s starting duo remains Talanoa Hufanga and Brandon Jones, while JL Skinner and Devon Key are currently positioned behind them. Other safeties in the Broncos room include rookie seventh-round pick Miles Scott and free-agent addition Tycen Anderson. Rapp had been available since the Buffalo Bills released him in March. Denver viewed him as a potential answer to its lack of experience behind the starters following PJ Locke’s departure to the Dallas Cowboys in free agency. The former Los Angeles Rams second-round selection from the 2019 NFL Draft has played seven NFL seasons. He has appeared in 93 games, including 72 starts, while recording 488 tackles, 11 tackles for loss, two sacks, 12 interceptions, 31 pass deflections and two forced fumbles. Rapp spent the previous three seasons with Buffalo and played only six games in 2025 after suffering a knee injury that required surgery. The Bills subsequently moved on and added CJ Gardner-Johnson alongside Cole Bishop. Rapp also brings championship experience from his time with Los Angeles, helping the Rams win Super Bowl LVI. The Broncos released Rapp as part of Wednesday’s roster moves that included the additions of offensive lineman Foster Sarell and defensive lineman Israel Antwine, while wide receiver Kyre Duplessis was waived. No specific timetable was provided for Rapp’s potential return, but Payton’s comments make clear that his release does not necessarily mean the end of his time in Denver. Leonard also stated that the Giants defenders were “sick of his BS” about what happened. Giants offensive lineman Jermaine
articles._body: Earlier on Wednesday, Giants writer/reporter Pat Leonard tweeted out that Cam Skattebo was at the center of attention when he caused a near-fight during practice. Leonard also stated that the Giants defenders were “sick of his BS” about what happened. Giants offensive lineman Jermaine Eluemunor quickly said that wasn’t the case . “Stop trying to create a BS Narrative,” Eluemunor said on X with the “cap” emoji. So, after all, it seemed as if the defense may have been showing signs of frustration in another area. However, Skattebo did get a 15-yard penalty at the end of practice that head coach John Harbaugh was not happy about. John Harbaugh was asked if Cam Skattebo's energy is "infectious" for the rest of the team: "Skatt’s great. He does bring a lot of energy. But he did get a 15-yard penalty at the end of practice. Did you notice that? That's not infectious. Well, it is infectious, actually.… pic.twitter.com/cwhKpIfzUb — SNY Giants (@SNYGiants) August 26, 2026 “He got a 15-yard penalty at the end of practice. Did you see that? Yeah it’s infectious. It can be infectious the other way, an infectious disease type of thing. We want it to be in a positive way.” The hope is that the emotions from practice are left behind them and it doesn’t cause any further drama. Skattebo means too much to the team for this unnecessary drama to surface again. This doesn’t mean that Skattebo can’t piss off opposing defenders during games. That is what he does best when he blasts through them for extra gains. The Giants and New York Jets meet this weekend as they always do for preseason action. All games will finish on Saturday, and then it will be time for coaches and staff to figure out the 53-man rosters. Stay tuned for what the Giants do in about a week’s time. articles.title: Carson Hocevar spin sparks controversy after giving him exactly what he needed at New Hampshire
articles.summary: Corey LaJoie and Dale Earnhardt Jr. raise questions about Carson Hocevar’s controversial spin after it helped him recover at New Hampshire.
articles._body: During Sunday’s Dollar Tree 301 at New Hampshire , Carson Hocevar had an eventful day that included three spins.  One came on the pace lap , another after contact with Connor Zilisch , and the third- that one is raising eyebrows.   After Hocevar spun alone on Lap 203 of the race, Kyle Larson asked his spotter if Hocevar had taken the wave around during the Stage 2 break.  Nine laps in, the Hocevar spin brought another caution.  When Larson was told Hocevar did take the wave before, he simply laughed and said how convenient.  While Larson didn’t accuse Hocevar of spinning intentionally to get his laps back, after going two down for the Zilisch contact, others have gone a step further.  Both Dale Earnhardt Jr. and Corey LaJoie were two of those people on their podcasts.  LaJoie just says it Corey LaJoie left nothing to the imagination .  On this week’s Stacking Pennies with co-host Ryan Flores and guest Connor Zilisch, LaJoie said Hocevar did it on purpose.   “He takes the wave around and spins out on purpose to re-rack it,” said LaJoie. “So he got his life back for free. “I mean, there’s no rule against it. That’s the sort of stuff, like, in my opinion… I’ve taken my fair share of wave rounds. Every time, you’re like, I could just spin out and get my lap back here. But no. “Because it always comes back around. It will… The ball don’t lie. It might not come back around because he finished in 19th or something.” Zilisch chimed in.  He’s definitely considered it before.  “I was talking to some of my friends about that,” said Zilisch. “I was like, man, that’s just like… We always think about doing it, but nobody ever actually does it.  “He doesn’t care. He does not care.” LaJoie called it bad etiquette.   “I guess if you’re willing to do anything to manufacture a good day,” said LaJoie. “I don’t know. “I would say that that’s bad etiquette. But you gotta take your medicine and let the race play out. Or you can spin out and get your lap back, and everybody keep moving. And people forget about it.”  Dale Jr. said it without saying it Dale Earnhardt Jr. called it questionable .  He admitted to doing it himself and said that it looks like what Hocevar did.  “And then there was a spin later in the race that is questionable, whether it was intentional or not,” said Earnhardt Jr. “I mean, I’ve spun out on purpose before when my race was falling out of reach; you get desperate. “I’m assuming, or I’m speculating, that he did spin on purpose. I’m not saying that he did. I didn’t really get a great look at that last spin, but I’ve seen other guys spin on purpose. “And I know it, when I see it, I see, I suppose I could say, cause I’ve done it myself.”

articles.summary: Ohio State will have new on-field suites for the 2026 college football season. On Wednesday, Conner Smith of Buckeye Huddle shared a video of the suites, which are currently under construction. Smith said the total cost is $142,700 per suite, and each can hold 12 people, with eight standing-room spo
articles._body: Ohio State will have new on-field suites for the 2026 college football season. On Wednesday, Conner Smith of Buckeye Huddle shared a video of the suites, which are currently under construction. Smith said the total cost is $142,700 per suite, and each can hold 12 people, with eight standing-room spots. The on-field suites are just one of the few upgrades being made at Ohio Stadium, as there will also be new turf, video boards, signage, and upgraded fan Wi-Fi. The staff is putting the final touches on the upgrades ahead of the season opener, which is against Ball State on Sept. 5. [ $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage ] Here are Ohio State’s brand-new on-field suites for this upcoming season. The total cost is $142,700 per suite, and each can hold 12 people, with eight standing-room spots. pic.twitter.com/mgFDgyaCkN — Conner Smith (@CSmithMedia) August 26, 2026 “Everyone wants to be closer to the program. And this is literally a way to be like on top of the action,” Lauren Windle, senior director of premium seating, said, per Spectrum News 1. “So it’s just a totally unique experience.” “We want our fans to keep coming back. Our football team is always good, right?” Mike Penner, executive associate athletic director, said. “And so we just want to make sure that when the fans come here, they can enjoy everything else in addition to the game.” More upgrades coming for Ohio State’s football stadium Along with the upgrades to the stadium, Ohio State plans to renovate its football facilit y. In June, Buckeyes athletic director Ross Bjork detailed the renovation project of the Woody Hayes Athletic Center, which will cost $125 million. “What we’re really looking at is the existing building that is on the north side of the building. The offices, the team meeting rooms, the coaches’ conference rooms, Coach [Ryan] Day ’s office, the locker room, the training room,” Bjork told reporters, per Eleven Warriors . “What we want to do is we want to expand the locker room, expand the training room, develop a bigger team meeting room at some place within that structure.” Bjork added, “Right now, not everyone can fit in the team meeting room when we have a team meeting. The individual position rooms are in the same place as the coaches’ offices. So if (offensive line coach) Tyler Bowen needs to have a private meeting and somebody wants an offensive lineman to watch film, somebody has to leave.”

articles.title: Hit-Boy Says He Hasn’t Spoken to Nas in 3 Years: ‘I Don’t See Us Working Again’
articles.summary: The pair made six albums in three years and have three Grammy nominations (and one win) to show for it.
articles._body: Hit-Boy revealed that he and Nas have had a falling-out, despite the critically acclaimed work they’ve done together over the past several years. The West Coast beatmaker sat down with DJ Vlad and Elliott Wilson recently and mentioned that he and the Queens legend aren’t on speaking terms anymore and he doesn’t see them ever collaborating again. “I ain’t spoke to Nas in three years,” Hit-Boy admitted. “We did six albums, 80 songs in three years. I produced almost every single song on his album that won a Grammy, King’s Disease .” Related Hit-Boy Partners With HarbourView: ‘This Next Chapter Is About My Creative Freedom’ Nicole Kidman Says She's Planning to See Adéla Live in Nashville & The 'Nicole Kidman' Singer Is Freaking Out Jay Wheeler's 'De Lejitos' Gets Up Close With No. 1 on Latin Airplay: 'Fills Me With Great Pride' He added: “We did a lot of great work, but I don’t see us working again.” He was then asked by Wilson if there was any specific reason as to why they fell out, but Hit didn’t really want to get into specifics. “It’s a lot of reasons, you know what I mean?” he said. “But it’s something I don’t really wanna dig too deep in ’cause the sh– is pretty deep. Respect to what we did get accomplished in three years.” From 2020 to 2023, Nas and Hit-Boy made King’s Disease , King’s Disease II , Magic , King’s Disease III , Magic 2 and Magic 3 , with their King’s Disease series earning them three Grammy nominations, including a win for best rap album in 2021. Billboard has reached out to Nas’ team for comment. You can check out the clip below. (You’ll have to subscribe to DJ Vlad’s YouTube channel in order to watch the full conversation .)

articles.summary: After a breakout season as an NBA on Prime studio analyst, Blake Griffin is looking to expand his media career even further. For an exclusive report by The Hollywood Reporter, Griffin is partnering with Prime Video, Wonderly, and YouTube for a brand-new sports-based talk show entitled The Step Ba
articles._body: After a breakout season as an NBA on Prime studio analyst, Blake Griffin is looking to expand his media career even further. For an exclusive report by The Hollywood Reporter, Griffin is partnering with Prime Video, Wonderly, and YouTube for a brand-new sports-based talk show entitled The Step Back with Blake Griffin . The Hollywood Reporter’s description of the show details an ambitious project that aligns it with other popular late-night vehicles. ” it features the host sitting behind a desk chronicling and opining on the juiciest sports topics of our time — think John Oliver, but for all things athletic,” the article reads. Griffin is going to take on the litany of topics, including NIL, gambling, and “the state of sports journalism.” The Hollywood Reporter obtained a snippet of the upcoming press release describing the show. “Drawing on his unique lens as a veteran player, sports dad, and lifelong superfan, Griffin breaks down the biggest topics in sports for a live studio audience — delivering a smart blend of late-night comedy and cultural analysis.” In a quote obtained by The Hollywood Reporter, Griffin said his inspiration for the show came from recognizable variety talk shows in the TV landscape. “I’ve watched and idolized shows like The Daily Show and Last Week Tonight , so to follow in their footsteps while putting my own stamp on the genre is an amazing opportunity that I’m grateful to take part in,” he notes. The show is set to debut on October 20th, coinciding with the start of the NBA season , with new episodes releasing every Tuesday. articles.title: Jaye P. Morgan, A Jack-of-All-Trades Entertainer Who Was a Pop & TV Star, Dies at 94
articles.summary: Morgan’s biggest hit was 1954's “That’s All I Want From You.”
articles._body: Jaye P. Morgan, one of the top female recording artists of the 1950s with seven top 40 pop hits in 1954-55 alone, including “That’s All I Want From You,” and who later became a frequent talk show guest and game show panelist, infamously taking off her shirt on The Gong Show , has died. She was 94. Morgan died Monday of natural causes in Longview, Washington, said Mark Sendroff, longtime attorney and friend. She had been living with her nephew and niece, Duke Morgan Spencer and Peggy Sue Spencer. Related Gone But Not Forgotten: Musicians We Lost in 2026 Jay-Z 30 Pop-Up Experience to Open In London Ahead of Historic Tottenham Hotspur Stadium Shows Camilo's 'Vida de Rico' Enters YouTube's Billion Views Club Morgan’s biggest hit was 1954’s “That’s All I Want From You,” which reached No. 3 on the Most Played by Jockeys chart and No. 5 on the Best Sellers in Stores list. In the Billboard Hot 100 era, she scored three hits: “Are You Lonesome Tonight” (No. 65 in 1959); “Miss You” (No. 78, 1959); and “I Walk the Line” (No. 66, 1960). Later, she would become a regular guest on The Tonight Show and make appearances with Merv Griffin, Dick Cavett and Mike Douglas as well as spots on The Love Boat and Fantasy Island . But it was her years hamming it up as a celebrity judge — along with Jamie Farr and Rip Taylor — on the chaotic The Gong Show starting in 1976 that cemented her fame. On the show, amateur performers tried out their acts, and when one of the judges couldn’t stand it anymore, they smashed a gong, ending the proceedings. Whichever performer won the day’s show received a check for the random amount of $516.32. On one episode, Eugene Patton — the dancing stagehand performing as Gene Gene the Dancing Machine — started his thing when Morgan opened her shirt to expose her breasts, helping bring an end to the show’s run on NBC in 1978. “It paid good money, and it was great exposure. I really enjoyed it,” she told the Los Angeles Times in 1992. “Jaye P. Morgan’s devil-may-care ad libs on television game shows have probably made her more famous as a personality than as a singer,” The New York Times wrote in 1984. “But the same kooky recklessness that inspires Miss Morgan’s remarks is also a part of her musical sensibility.” Her film credits include The All-American Boy with Jon Voight, Loose Shoes, The Gong Show Movie, Night Patrol and the 2002 Miramax release Confessions of a Dangerous Mind , directed by George Clooney. Jaye P. Morgan’s early life Morgan was born Mary Margaret Morgan in a log cabin in Mancos, Colorado, and her show business career started early. At the age of 3, she was part of the Morgan Family, a traveling vaudeville act that included her mother, her father, her sister and five brothers. The group disbanded after their father’s death in 1945. Morgan was class treasurer of her California high school and her peers nicknamed her J.P. after the 19th century financier J.P. Morgan. She later feminized it by changing the initial J to Jaye. But by the time she was 17, she was singing professionally again, and in 1950 she joined Frank De Vol’s orchestra, singing with it for three years. Her recording career got underway via “Life Is Just a Bowl of Cherries” and “Just a Gigolo” with De Vol on a small label, Derby Records, that reached No. 26 on the Billboard chart. That led RCA Records to come calling with a recording contract. She was a regular on the Robert Q. Lewis national daytime variety TV show and the nighttime game show “Stop the Music” hosted by Bert Parks. In 1954, DownBeat magazine’s annual DJ poll crowned her best new female singer of the year. She took her nightclub act on the road and made her Las Vegas debut at the New Frontier Hotel & Casino. Morgan’s onscreen career Morgan even got her own TV show in 1956 — The Jaye P. Morgan Show , which featured four of her brothers. Her solo albums include Jaye P. Morgan and a joint album with Kaye Ballard called Long Time Friends. She scored two hits on Billboard ‘s Adult Contemporary (which started in 1961): “Love of a Gentle Man” reached No. 37 and “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life” reached No. 40, both in 1970. An appearance on The Tonight Show opened up a career for her on television talk shows and she kept returning to Johnny Carson for five years. “I take my body everyplace I go,” she joked to the host in a 1972 episode. She also was a guest on The Odd Couple playing herself and singing their goofy song “Happy, Peppy and Bursting with Love.” During one memorable episode of The Muppet Show , Morgan appeared in a bird costume and seemed unhappy she was there at all. When Kermit tells her it’s a thrill to have her on, she replies: “I’m really indifferent about being here.” Kermit is aghast, calling the opening number cute. “I hate cute,” replies Morgan. Other Morgan credits include a role in Home Alone 2 , with Macaulay Culkin, appearances on The Love Boat and Fantasy Island , and co-starring with Eddie Bracken in the national tour of Sugar Babies . Married and divorced three times, Morgan is survived by a son, Paul Kane.

He is the talk of the town leading up to the tournament for obvious reasons. Sch
articles._body: Not only is Scottie Scheffler the World’s top golfer, but he is first in the FedEx Cup standings, coming off a solid tournament last weekend and a win two weeks prior to the Tour Championship starting Thursday. He is the talk of the town leading up to the tournament for obvious reasons. Scheffler is not shy of winning big tournaments in the Peach State. The 2026 Tour Championship is at East Lake Golf Club in Atlanta, Georgia, where Tommy Fleetwood was crowned 2025 champion. Scheffler has won the Masters twice in Augusta and the 2024 Tour Championship here in the ATL. 2024 was a massive year for Scheffler, and he looks to end on top once again. One player who is all too familiar with the acts of the Dallas, Texas native is Gary Woodland. Woodland, who had an incredible victory earlier this season at the Texas Children’s Houston Open. On Wednesday, he discussed his relationship with Scheffler and the “ATM” stories about their play in Dallas. "I've had to go to the ATM a couple times playing [Scottie] in Dallas." Gary Woodland says he's never beaten Scottie Scheffler on his home course in Dallas, and Scottie doesn't let him forget. pic.twitter.com/8V4tlHBrvQ — Golf Digest (@GolfDigest) August 26, 2026 “I’ve never beaten Scottie in Dallas,” Woodland said. “He asks me if I just hand him money every time he sees me, and unfortunately that is the case when we have been in Dallas. He is hard to beat there. Back in Memphis, I was giving him a hard time about how he can’t finish and couldn’t handle the pressure. He parred the last three holes and shot 60 one day. That did not work for Si-Woo (Kim) and I; he is hard to beat out here.” Woodland was then asked about the game they play, and Woodland responded: “We play a 100 a hole… I have had to go to the ATM a couple of times playing in Dallas.” The post Gary Woodland shares ‘ATM’ admission about playing Scottie Scheffler on PGA Tour appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Timberwolves land Jonathan Kuminga with $13 million contract late in free agency
articles.summary: The Minnesota Timberwolves and unrestricted free agent forward Jonathan Kuminga are finalizing a new 2-year, $13 million contract, as first reported by ESPN. This new contract with Minnesota contains a second-year player option, allowing Kuminga to potentially enter unrestricted free agency once
articles._body: The Minnesota Timberwolves and unrestricted free agent forward Jonathan Kuminga are finalizing a new 2-year, $13 million contract, as first reported by ESPN. This new contract with Minnesota contains a second-year player option, allowing Kuminga to potentially enter unrestricted free agency once again in 2027. After months of speculation as to where Kuminga would potentially end up, he finds a new home with a Timberwolves team aiming to be competing at the top of the Western Conference during the 2026-27 NBA season. He will slide into a starting role at the power forward position. Although Kuminga and his representation had been waiting throughout the offseason for a big deal to come their way, this never occurred. As a result, teams began making moves and filling up their roster with a variety of offseason moves, leaving Kuminga with little options available. Over the last several weeks, Kuminga had been linked heavily to the Cleveland Cavaliers. However, the Cavs recently finalized a sign-and-trade agreement with the Denver Nuggets to acquire restricted free agent Peyton Watson , which effectively took them off the board as a Kuminga suitor. Despite the Los Angeles Lakers looming large as a suitor for the 23-year-old, their only path to potentially landing him was by way of a sign-and-trade agreement with the Atlanta Hawks. While the Lakers were attempting to unload Jarred Vanderbilt in a sign-and-trade framework with Atlanta earlier , this was a deal that the Hawks held no interest in, sources said. Originally, the Lakers had pursued Kuminga outright when free agency began with a two-year, near $20 million contract. Once he and his agent declined this deal from Los Angeles, the Lakers went in a different direction with their cap space and mid-level exception, signing the likes of Sandro Mamukelashvili, Quentin Grimes, and Collin Sexton. Due to their being limited opportunities late in free agency and with training camp right around the corner, Kuminga is betting on himself by accepting this $13 million contract from the Timberwolves. In Minnesota, Kuminga will immediately fill a key need the Wolves had at the forward positions alongside Jaden McDaniels. Other teams had pursued Kuminga in free agency and by way of a sign-and-trade, but he and his representation wanted control of his immediate future. As a result, this “1+1” deal with the Timberwolves allows Kuminga to have the flexibility he wants to decide on his future next offseason. Between his athleticism, speed, and strong frame, Kuminga checks off the boxes for being an impactful secondary talent at either forward position with the Timberwolves. This is especially true on offense, where Kuminga will be on the receiving end of lobs and passes off the cut from LaMelo Ball and Anthony Edwards. Kuminga, who was originally drafted seventh overall by the Golden State Warriors in 2021, spent the first four years of his career as a secondary piece next to Stephen Curry. While the Warriors always held high hopes for Kuminga’s potential, he was never able to carve out a consistent role in Steve Kerr’s rotations. However, he did shine in the Warriors’ second-round playoff series against the Timberwolves in 2025. With Curry and Jimmy Butler injured, Kuminga stepped up to average 20.8 points and 3.0 rebounds per game while shooting 54.3 percent from the floor. This performance in the playoffs really put him on Minnesota’s radar. After a long standoff with Golden State’s leadership last offseason regarding contract demands, Kuminga and his side accepted a two-year, $48.5 million deal with a team option for the second year of the contract. He was traded less than five months later to the Hawks with sharpshooter Buddy Hield in a trade that sent Kristaps Porzingis to the Warriors. Although Kuminga played well with the Hawks, averaging 12.3 points, 5.3 rebounds, and 2.1 assists per game while shooting 47.6 percent from the floor in 16 regular-season games after the trade deadline, the team decided to move on from the 23-year-old by declining his $24.3 million team option. With his new $13 million contract with the Timberwolves, Kuminga has now found a team where he can not only be paid but prove himself in a key role. It is likely that he will start alongside McDaniels and help fill the hole left behind by Julius Randle, who was dealt to the Brooklyn Nets this offseason in the multi-team trade that brought Ball to Minnesota. The Timberwolves finished the 2025-26 season with a 49-33 record, marking the fifth straight seasons the organization has had a winning record and their third straight with at least 49 wins. This franchise has won a playoff series three years in a row, including reaching the Western Conference Finals in both 2024 and 2025. articles.title: Kyle Schwarber bashes 40th home run for 2nd-straight season
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies wouldn’t be Wild Card contenders without Kyle Schwarber in part. He’s been on a roll lately and at the right time. Schwarber is fresh off hitting a walk-off homer against the St. Louis Cardinals. That power surged Wednesday on the road against the Seattle Mar
articles._body: The Philadelphia Phillies wouldn’t be Wild Card contenders without Kyle Schwarber in part. He’s been on a roll lately and at the right time. Schwarber is fresh off hitting a walk-off homer against the St. Louis Cardinals. That power surged Wednesday on the road against the Seattle Mariners. In the 3rd inning, Schwarber launched a rocket to right field to add three runs on the board. Along the way, he hit his 40th home run of the year and his second consecutive season. It also marks the fourth time in his career that he has hit 40 home runs in a season. HE DOES IT AGAIN Kyle Schwarber of the Philadelphia Phillies has now reached 40 home runs for the 4th time in his career pic.twitter.com/niN4vMh53U — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) August 26, 2026 Schwarber came into the game hitting 39 home runs and had 78 RBIs along with batting .241. Meanwhile, the Phillies came in with a 73-60 record, but had lost the first two games of the three-game series to Seattle. The Phillies are trailing the Chicago Cubs by 2.5 games in the National League Wild Card standings. Schwarber is looking to exceed his previous year’s stats, which is without a question a tall order. He finished 2025 with a batting average of .240, 145 hits, 56 home runs, and 132 RBIs. In the process, the Phillies won the National League East Division with a record of 96-66. Ultimately, they lost to the eventual champion Los Angeles Dodgers in four games in the NLDS. Schwarber’s other 40 home run seasons came in 2022, 2023, and 2025. In 2022, he hit 46 home runs, and in 2023, he hit 47. The Phillies defeated the Mariners 6-0. On Friday, Philadelphia will head to Los Angeles to play the Angels in a three-game series. articles.title: Training camp interceptions are part of Eagles QB Jalen Hurts’ process
articles.summary: When it comes to the 2026 edition of Philadelphia Eagles training camp, the biggest storyline has been the sheer volume of interceptions Jalen Hurts has thrown. Now granted, there are extenuating factors involved, like Vic Fangio’s defense being very good, Sean Mannion installing a new offe
articles._body: When it comes to the 2026 edition of Philadelphia Eagles training camp, the biggest storyline has been the sheer volume of interceptions Jalen Hurts has thrown . Now granted, there are extenuating factors involved, like Vic Fangio’s defense being very good, Sean Mannion installing a new offense, and top targets like DeVonta Smith and Makai Lemon spending much of the summer on the sidelines , but that still hasn’t stopped football fans from questioning Hurts’ game heading into the preseason finale against the Cincinnati Bengals. Discussing his seventh summer in Eagles training camp, Hurts commented on his ball placement, noting that when a new system is being installed, learning the boundaries when the bullets aren’t live is a paramount part of the process . “I think generally speaking, you learn from every play, regardless of how the result is, especially when you’re putting in something new. And so, I think every time you come out here and you get a chance to be on the grass, you need to take the coach and apply it, be aggressive with it. And then, once you’re experienced, you reflect on it, think about it, and you can play the game in this type of way, in that type of way,” Hurts said. “So, I use the term calibrate with you guys and all of that, the whole entire process is on your mind of how you calculate when you play the game. So, it’s been a really good camp. I’m happy about the experiences that we’ve had to be able to grow from them. I’m very excited about the opportunity to be able to practice with the guys. I received a call that the guys that are going to start were banged up, so, just to have the time to build chemistry with everyone as a unit, I feel like that was very valuable.” Is it concerning that Hurts is throwing a number of interceptions this summer? Sure, but historically speaking, he’s one of the least intercepted quarterbacks in the NFL, with just one season with double-digit picks on his resume over his first six as a pro. Considering how often Hurts has been criticized for being overly conservative as a passer, especially over the middle of the field, letting it loose in camp might actually be a good thing, especially if he can get more run with his usual starters before Week 1. Jalen Hurts gave a lengthy answer on how he views interceptions in camp. He said he’s tried to learn from every play as they install a new scheme and highlighted the “calibrating” that they’ve had to do the last few weeks. “I think it’s been a good camp.” #Eagles pic.twitter.com/mPYB9LVWiF — EJ Smith (@EJSmith94) August 26, 2026 The post Training camp interceptions are part of Eagles QB Jalen Hurts’ process appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Reds’ Sal Stewart accomplishes feat not seen since Pete Alonso in 2019
articles.summary: Cincinnati Reds rookie Sal Stewart is having a big rookie season to say the least. Stewart has already established himself as one of the best young hitters in the game. According to MLB, the Reds infielder became the first rookie with a 100-RBI season on Wednesday since Pete Alonso in 2019. Not o
articles._body: Cincinnati Reds rookie Sal Stewart is having a big rookie season to say the least. Stewart has already established himself as one of the best young hitters in the game. According to MLB, the Reds infielder became the first rookie with a 100-RBI season on Wednesday since Pete Alonso in 2019. Not only is Sal Stewart the first player to 100 RBI, but he is the first rookie with a 100-RBI season since Pete Alonso in 2019! pic.twitter.com/xl0yOB6sXI — MLB (@MLB) August 26, 2026 Stewart also happens to lead the National League — as well as all of MLB — with 100 RBIs. According to Sarah Langs, Stewart would become the third player in MLB history to lead his league in RBIs in his rookie season if he can accomplish the feat, as the Reds emerging star would join Ted Williams (1939) and Walt Dropo (1950). Williams and Dropo both recorded 144 RBIs in their rookie seasons. The Reds ultimately earned a 10-9 win in the game as well. Stewart did not get a hit but he did record an RBI as well as a walk and a run scored. Stewart is making a strong National League Rookie of the Year argument . He is now hitting .261/.334/.472 across 134 games played this season. He also has 28 home runs, 24 doubles, 12 stolen bases and the aforementioned 100 RBI. The Reds have endured a disappointing season overall. Stewart is certainly not to blame, however. He’s been impressive as a rookie, and his future in the big leagues is bright without question. Meanwhile, the Reds avoided a sweep against the Giants with their Wednesday win. Cincinnati will now travel to Chicago to begin a three-game series against the Cubs, with the first game scheduled for Friday afternoon at 2:20 PM ET. articles.summary:
As models have become more capable of running autonomously, I’ve been running more and more agents in parallel. But it’s never been clear to me what the number of agents I can handle is - should I be conservative and try 2-3 agents at a time, or try to push myself to go 5+?

articles._body: As models have become more capable of running autonomously, I’ve been running more and more agents in parallel. But it’s never been clear to me what the number of agents I can handle is - should I be conservative and try 2-3 agents at a time, or try to push myself to go 5+? So we set out to create a new kind of agent visualization that answered this question. There were two types of agent visualizations we found in our research. One was cursor-wrapped or git-style visualizations that showed high level usage statistics throughout the year. The other was single agent visualizations - showing tool calls and back and forths from an agent session. We found the former too high-level, and the latter too granular. We experimented with a lot of different designs, but we settled on a clock-like design that cleanly shows when your agents were working autonomously, and when they were waiting on your input. This made it easy to visualize how many agents you were running in parallel and quickly spot when you’re the bottleneck. I’ve realized that I’m the kind of person who can only juggle 2-3 at a time - curious to hear what other people’s experiences are! (Especially if you've noticed an improvement) It’s simple to use - npx agentplayback or bunx agentplayback. Or you can clone it from https://github.com/JerryZLiu/AgentPlayback and modify/run it yourself. Open sourced under MIT license. articles._body: Texas Tech football drew new interest into its quarterback situation Wednesday. Ex-Florida State quarterback Tommy Castellanos officially joined the Red Raiders following his high-profile move back to college. Which now raises a new question involving Will Hammond. Is the former FSU dual-threat Castellanos now the starter? College football insider Pete Nakos cleared the air there following the College Football Transfer Portal move. “Castellanos will arrive at Texas Tech as Will Hammond’s backup,” Nakos posted on the social media website X, formerly Twitter. So Hammond’s job is safe even amid this move made possible by a landmark injunction. Castellanos joins a long list of undrafted NFL rookies aiming for another collegiate shot. All thanks to one Louisiana judge ruling in favor of some 2022 prep graduates seeking a fifth eligibility season. However, Castellanos avoids getting denied a new playing opportunity compared to SEC schools. The SEC enforced its own ruling that prohibits athletes from coming back after previously declaring for the NFL Draft, plus other major sports drafts. This rule also includes players who signed a previous contract with a pro sports franchise. The Big Ten also followed suit with a similar ruling. Yet Castellanos goes free and clear as he heads to Lubbock. Which also includes theories he’ll play another position as Hammond becomes entrenched with QB1 duties. Castellanos gave wide receiver a try with the Tennessee Titans but that experiment never manifested. He’s joining the reigning Big 12 champions who are seeking a return to the College Football Playoffs this season. articles.title: The NCAA is Starting to Win Appeals and Overturn TROs
articles.summary: College sports fans have transformed into judicial experts thanks to gross incompetence from the NCAA. Since the NCAA instituted it’s new five-for-five rule, without granting eligibility retroactively to the class of 2022, we’ve played a nauseating back-and-forth game between fifth-year
articles._body: College sports fans have transformed into judicial experts thanks to gross incompetence from the NCAA. Since the NCAA instituted it’s new five-for-five rule, without granting eligibility retroactively to the class of 2022, we’ve played a nauseating back-and-forth game between fifth-year players and the four-letter institution. I regret to inform you that the seesaw is tilting in a different direction, again. Candidly, I am just as exhausted from all of this as you. That’s why I will try to explain this in the most succinct form possible. Last Friday’s ruling in the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals favored the NCAA. If players did not receive specific temporary restraining order (TRO) protections in state courts, they could not seek an additional year of eligibility. Ignore the mess conferences have made over the last two days. The part that matters right now is what’s happening in state courts. The NCAA had time to appeal state-level decisions that gave athletes TROs. Well, they’re finally securing some winning appeals in state courts. After picking up a win in Ohio, on Wednesday, the NCAA was granted a stay in the state of Tennessee . Jalen Washington , a 6-foot-10 forward, transferred from Vanderbilt to Tennessee about a month ago, thanks to a TRO in Nashville. The winning appeal from the NCAA now makes him ineligible. The news of the NCAA’s win dropped shortly after we learned that Mark Mitchell fit the criteria from the SEC’s new rule , allowing him to play for the Wildcats. Today’s ruling in Tennessee is a reminder that the NCAA can still fight the Louisville TRO to sideline Mitchell and a handful of other players. When all of this madness started, the scales were tilted heavily in favor of the players. With classes underway across the country and football season on the horizon, it’s tilting back toward the NCAA. When will the dust finally settle? Your guess is as good as mine. I think we can all agree that the sooner we reach some sort of resolution, the better.

articles.title: Bob Myers gets real on trading Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Klay Thompson
articles.summary: The Golden State Warriors were able to build a dynasty thanks to the on-court wizardry of Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, and Draymond Green along with the off-court genius of Steve Kerr and Bob Myers. The group stayed together for years, winning three championship from 2015 to 2018 and a fourth NB
articles._body: The Golden State Warriors were able to build a dynasty thanks to the on-court wizardry of Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, and Draymond Green along with the off-court genius of Steve Kerr and Bob Myers. The group stayed together for years, winning three championship from 2015 to 2018 and a fourth NBA Championship back in 2022. Former General Manager and President of Basketball Operations Bob Myers, who was with the organization from 2012 to 2023, got a lot of credit for his decisions during the Warriors’ title runs. Now with the Philadelphia 76ers trying to re-create that same magic, Myers has another tough task after adding Jaylen Brown and LeBron James to a Sixers team already led by Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid. Myers recently made an appearance on the Cousins Podcast with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady, where he was asked if he ever let his emotion dictate a move or if he would have. “It never did, but had I stayed in Golden State, it might have,” Bob Myers told Carter and McGrady. “Okay, like if I had to move off a clay, I might have had a hard time with that. If, if I had been there, and like, I had to do something with Draymond or staff or something like that, that that would have been personal. Yeah. Because of what we went through together. Guys like Iguodala Livingston guys that won multiple championships. If I don’t feel a part, then I what the hell was I do? If I don’t have a relationship with those guys? Now, there’s not 10 of them. “But there’s a few guys where I would have a hard time, I think I’d still do the right thing for the organization. But it would be really hard to tell a guy like, all that that guy did for my life, my life, like personally, forget about the organization, like, which is what you’re, you’re, you’re hired to do what’s best for the organization when you’re executive, but when you win, and win multiple championships with people that played and gave everything and and made my life changed my life, personally, not the organization’s mine. How can I not let that affect you understand, like, so there would have been, could have been situations where it got there.” Bob Myers on if he ever let emotions interfere with his decision making as a GM: "It never did, but had I stayed in Golden State, it might've. Like if I had to move off of Klay, I might've had a hard time with that. If I had been there and had to do something with Draymond, or… pic.twitter.com/MHe0smJu7i — Chef (@CurryForGame) August 26, 2026 The Warriors still haven’t traded Stephen Curry or Draymond Green, but did part ways with Klay Thompson. It’s clear, however, that all three of those players will retire as members of the Golden State Warriors franchise. articles.title: Big Ten extends Tony Petitti as commissioner through 2033
articles.summary: The Big Ten has agreed to a five-year contract extension with commissioner Tony Petitti, keeping him in charge of the conference through June 2033. The extension received unanimous approval from the Big Ten Council of Presidents and Chancellors. Petitti became the Big Ten’s seventh commissi
articles._body: The Big Ten has agreed to a five-year contract extension with commissioner Tony Petitti, keeping him in charge of the conference through June 2033. The extension received unanimous approval from the Big Ten Council of Presidents and Chancellors. Petitti became the Big Ten’s seventh commissioner in May 2023 after Kevin Warren left the position to become president and CEO of the Chicago Bears. Before joining the conference, Petitti held major roles in sports media and Major League Baseball , including serving as MLB Network’s president and CEO and as a deputy commissioner and chief operating officer of MLB. During Petitti’s tenure, the Big Ten has expanded from 14 to 18 schools. Oregon, Washington, USC and UCLA joined the conference in 2024 after leaving the Pac-12. The expansion also preceded the full implementation of the conference’s current seven-year, $7 billion media rights agreement involving FOX, CBS and NBC. The financial growth of the conference has been significant under Petitti. The Big Ten generated a record $1.37 billion in revenue distribution during the 2024-25 fiscal year, compared with $883 million the previous year. The $1.37 billion distribution surpassed the SEC’s reported $1.03 billion figure. Petitti’s tenure has also coincided with major championship success. Big Ten teams have won the last three football national championships, with Michigan winning in 2023, Ohio State in 2024 and Indiana in 2025. In basketball, the Wolverines won the men’s national championship and the Bruins won the women’s national championship in 2025. The conference also performed well in the expanded College Football Playoff. Four Big Ten teams, Ohio State, Indiana, Penn State and Oregon, reached the 12-team field in 2024, with the Buckeyes ultimately winning the national championship. The conference had two teams reach the CFP semifinals the following season. The extension also positions Petitti to handle negotiations for the Big Ten’s next media rights agreement. The conference’s existing seven-year, $7 billion deal is scheduled to expire in 2030. Petitti has additionally been involved in efforts concerning federal legislation for college athletics and has supported expanding the College Football Playoff from 12 to 24 teams. With his new contract, Petitti is set to remain commissioner through 2033 while overseeing the Big Ten’s next phase of competition, expansion and media negotiations. articles.title: Jeanie Buss moves to block siblings’ attempted sale of Lakers shares
articles.summary: As Jeanie Buss’ shares in the Los Angeles Lakers hangs in the balance, she’s not giving up. After reports predicted NBA commissioner Adam Silver to get involved with the sale of the Buss’ family affairs, Jeanie isn’t ready to sell. Buss is attempting to block the sale, acc
articles._body: As Jeanie Buss’ shares in the Los Angeles Lakers hangs in the balance , she’s not giving up. After reports predicted NBA commissioner Adam Silver to get involved with the sale of the Buss’ family affairs, Jeanie isn’t ready to sell. Buss is attempting to block the sale , according to The Athletic’s Sam Amick. “Jeanie Buss is not only calling for the family’s vote of the Lakers shares to be deemed void, but for co-trustees Joey and Janie Buss be removed from those positions for “breach of fiduciary duty.” She calls for her siblings to be liable “for loss and damages” as well,” Amick reported. “Their conduct is not driven by financial necessity but by animosity toward Jeanie and in willful disregard for the (Trust), this Court’s 2017 Order, their fiduciary duties, and Dr. Buss’s express intent,” the petition reads,” as Amick noted. A petition to block the Lakers' sale has been filed by Jeanie Buss. She is also calling for Joey and Janie Buss to be removed from their roles, per @sam_amick . pic.twitter.com/1W2l4MIYN2 — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) August 26, 2026 This is just another chapter into the family’s saga. Adam Silver expected to insert himself into Buss’ Lakers sale Amid the Lakers’ longtime minority owners Jeanie Buss and her family’s riff over the sale of their shares of the team, NBA commissioner Adam Silver could play a role in the family’s feud. Silver could help the process , according to Sports Business Journal’s Tom Friend. “The Lakers’ situation isn’t as clear cut, with sources believing Commissioner Adam Silver — who has always been close with Jeanie Buss — will try to help smooth over the Buss family chaos. The weeks ahead may or may not calm down,” Friend reported. It’ll be interesting to see how this all pans out for the Buss family. articles.title: Rafael Devers surpasses Willie Mays in Giants history with massive home run
articles.summary: The San Francisco Giants swung a huge trade last season for slugging infielder Rafael Devers. The veteran slugger had a falling out with the Boston Red Sox. And he was shipped out of Boston as a result. The Giants certainly aren’t complaining as Devers continues to make an impact in their l
articles._body: The San Francisco Giants swung a huge trade last season for slugging infielder Rafael Devers. The veteran slugger had a falling out with the Boston Red Sox . And he was shipped out of Boston as a result. The Giants certainly aren’t complaining as Devers continues to make an impact in their lineup. Devers and the Giants took on the Cincinnati Reds on Wednesday. In this contest, the veteran infielder slugged his 29th home run of the season. It was his third straight game with a home run, and he made some history in the process. Rafael Devers has homered in three consecutive games for the Giants pic.twitter.com/U8i0sVHa1a — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) August 26, 2026 Devers is now second all-time among San Francisco hitters with 49 home runs in his first 225 games with the team, according to MLB analyst Sarah Langs. He has passed Willie Mays with this home run. He only trails Barry Bonds, who slugged 61 homers in his first 225 games with the team. The Giants have certainly taken full advantage of Devers’ offense on Wednesday. San Francisco currently leads the Reds by a score of 9-4 in the top of the ninth. In addition to the home run, San Francisco’s veteran infielder added a single and a walk. San Francisco has struggled mightily in 2026 as a whole. However, Devers has remained a bright spot in this lineup. He now has 29 home runs and 76 runs batted in on the year. Additionally, he carries a slash line of .244/.322/.480. The Giants are on the verge of a big sweep of the Reds on Wednesday. It would be a huge momentum boost late in the season if San Francisco can close this out. Following Wednesday’s win, they begin a four-game series at home against the Arizona Diamondbacks on Thursday. articles.title: Draymond Green warns Heat fans not to expect Warriors Klay Thompson in 2026
articles.summary: The Miami Heat recently made headlines when they signed wing Klay Thompson following his buyout with the Dallas Mavericks. The move gives the Heat some much-needed shooting, which was the most obvious area of concern following their trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo. However, recently, ThompsonR
articles._body: The Miami Heat recently made headlines when they signed wing Klay Thompson following his buyout with the Dallas Mavericks. The move gives the Heat some much-needed shooting, which was the most obvious area of concern following their trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo. However, recently, Thompson’s former Golden State Warriors teammate Draymond Green warned fans to temper their expectations for the future Hall of Famer this season. “I don’t like how everybody is trying to act like ‘oh it’s Klay Thompson! Klay to the Heat!’ Like this is Klay from 2018. The reason I don’t like it is because I feel like everybody is trying to set Klay up for failure. I’m going to say it right here right now. Let’s stop acting like it’s 2017 Klay going to Miami,” said Green, per The Draymond Green Show, via Heat Nation on X, formerly Twitter. Green then spoke on a more realistic comparison he sees for the deal. “I wish sports media would speak on it more like when Ray Allen went to Miami. Don’t try to set my brother up like you getting the 2018 version so when you don’t, you can bash him,” he said. Other fans have made the exact same comparison, although Green evidently hasn’t been perusing social media enough to have seen that. While Thompson is no longer the prime version of himself, having taken major steps back in both defense and shot creation, he is still an elite outside shooter who opponents have to respect on the perimeter, which should free up space for Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo to work around the basket. The Heat will kick off their season on September 21 vs the Minnesota Timberwolves. articles.title: RIP, Tim Curry: Ars remembers his top 10 iconic performances
articles.summary: A dashing pirate, a butler, a shapeshifting killer clown, an alien mad scientist in drag—the man had range.
articles._body: It's said celebrity deaths come in threes. We lost Sam Neill last month , and the legendary Dolly Parton yesterday . Now we find out that the universe has also seen fit to deprive us of the glorious presence of Tim Curry, who died at home yesterday in Los Angeles at the age of 80. No cause of death has been given, but Curry had been in ill health since 2012, when he suffered a stroke and required brain surgery; he had been confined to a wheelchair ever since. Curry's longtime friend and manager, Marcia Hurwitz, confirmed the actor's passing to Deadline and said Curry had died peacefully. Per the official announcement: Throughout his life, he refused to be boxed in or confined to others’ expectations. Across five decades, he moved fluidly between comedy, horror, drama, and music, delighting himself and his legion of fans with his countless dynamic personas. … He is, depending on who you ask, the definitive Dr. Frank-N-Furter, the definitive Pennywise, the man who made a butler’s death-scene monologue in Clue an all-time comedic bit, or simply ‘that unforgettable voice’ from a beloved cartoon of someone’s childhood. Few actors can claim to have left as many distinct fingerprints on pop culture and though he suffered a debilitating stroke in 2012, he continued adding to his achievements as an artist and, most recently, a writer. Though widely known for his inimitable, flamboyant characters and colorful stage performances, his greatest legacies to those who knew him were his curious, expansive mind and generous, gentle heart, both of which remained open and filled with anticipation until his final breath. As obituaries and fond tributes roll in, we at Ars choose to mark the passing of this extraordinary performer with our choices for Curry's top 10 most iconic portrayals on stage, in film, and on television. Coming off an ACL tear in 2025, the concern was especially heightened. However, that doesn’t appear to be the case. Head coach Joh
articles._body: The New York Giants received a bit of a scare on Wednesday. Wide receiver Malik Nabers left practice early, and many feared he had suffered some sort of injury. Coming off an ACL tear in 2025 , the concern was especially heightened. However, that doesn’t appear to be the case. Head coach John Harbaugh addressed the matter for reporters. He said that, whatever the reason for his early departure, he received no word that Nabers sustained an injury. “It wasn’t part of the plan. I’ll find out what was going on. I’m sure it’s something with the trainers. There’s no injury. We talk afterwards — we always get the injury report right after and there was no talk about Malik that way,” the Giants head coach said, via Dan Duggan of The Athletic. As mentioned, Giants wideout Nabers went through a significant injury in 2025 . He tore his ACL in September last year. In October, he underwent surgery to repair the ligament in his knee. He has been hard at work recovering from the injury since. Nabers was stellar as a rookie, racking up 1200 receiving yards and seven touchdowns in his debut season. The Giants star was on track for another fantastic year before the ACL injury, as well. Unfortunately, the Giants could not recover from Nabers’s injury. New York had some bright spots, with quarterback Jaxson Dart and running back Cam Skattebo providing promising flashes. Unfortunately, New York still missed the playoffs. Thankfully, it appears Nabers has avoided another significant injury. Hopefully, the young pass catcher left practice early as a precaution, and any worst-case scenario has been avoided. articles.title: Lions’ Aidan Hutchinson and Chris Long hate Amon-Ra St. Brown’s edge rusher assertions
articles.summary: Amon-Ra St. Brown is one of the best receivers in the NFL. Aidan Hutchinson is one of the best defensive ends in the NFL. While both Detroit Lions players are among the very best in the entire league, regardless of position, the pass catcher clearly thinks he has things a little bit harder than h
articles._body: Amon-Ra St. Brown is one of the best receivers in the NFL . Aidan Hutchinson is one of the best defensive ends in the NFL. While both Detroit Lions players are among the very best in the entire league , regardless of position, the pass catcher clearly thinks he has things a little bit harder than his pass-rushing teammate does. On the Green Light with Chris Long podcast, St. Brown claimed that the defensive end spot is the easiest position to play in the NFL. “I think edge rusher is the easiest position in football,” St. Brown said. “All you’ve got to do is make one play a game. [They] can get a coverage sack, [and what if] the DBs play well. There’s a sack, dog. Here’s $50 million. Like what the?” Amon-Ra St. Brown says edge rusher is the easiest position in football Aidan Hutchinson & Chris disagree pic.twitter.com/1KDwNO0FSk — Green Light with Chris Long (@greenlight) August 26, 2026 Long, a former defensive end in his own right, had to get Hutchinson’s thoughts on the matter. “Everybody always busts my balls about how D-end is the easiest position,” Hutchinson said. “I tell them that my job isn’t in the playbook. I have to create for myself. I always argue with St. Brown, like you’re a receiver; you get the plays drawn up for you.” The edge rushing position is often called the second most important position in football, as they are tasked with making life harder on quarterbacks, who do play the most important, and arguably hardest position in the sport. St. Brown made a point that even the best of the best are only getting around one sack per game, though, and sacks are the name of the edge rushing game. Obviously, there is more to it than sacks. Quarterback pressures can disrupt a play, even if the QB isn’t brought down to the ground. There is a reason DEs are paid more than anybody besides players at the quarterback position. articles.title: 5-star DL Jalen Brewster ends recruitment, talks picking Texas Tech
articles.summary: Texas Tech football five-star commit Jalen Brewster first turned heads with a big transfer. The Red Raiders watched him leave the Lone Star State for Georgia powerhouse Buford. But TTU and coach Joey McGuire won’t be losing him on the College Football Recruiting trail amid some flip rumors.
articles._body: Texas Tech football five-star commit Jalen Brewster first turned heads with a big transfer . The Red Raiders watched him leave the Lone Star State for Georgia powerhouse Buford. But TTU and coach Joey McGuire won’t be losing him on the College Football Recruiting trail amid some flip rumors. Despite pushes from notable powers like LSU, the defensive tackle isn’t going anywhere. He officially shut his recruitment down and detailed the reasons why with On3 Wednesday. “The way they feed into their players. The words, the practices, practice like games. Culture for sure,” Brewster told Steve Wiltfong of On3. He added via Hayes Fawcett of the same national outlet : “I feel like Texas Tech is the best place for me and the best place to build my own legacy.” He raved about the family structure in place from McGuire. TTU has risen in popularity among recruits like Brewster, especially in the NIL era. The Red Raiders have received prominent financial backing in recent years. Especially in winning over 2025 five-star offensive tackle Felix Ojo thanks to a big NIL push that led to a $2.3 million deal. But again, Texas Tech and McGuire needed to hold off on some serious lurkers for Brewster’s services. LSU wasn’t the only one aiming to flip the massive and powerful 6-foot-3, 300-pounder. Defending national champion Indiana tried to coax him into coming over. Same with Florida, with the Gators creating their own impressive recruiting run under new head coach Jon Sumrall. The Red Raiders are once again vying for the top recruiting class among Big 12 teams. While also putting together a top five class for this cycle. articles._body: This is something I have been working on, on and off, for about a year but now I feel that it is stable enough to release. It really only has two tool sets, an execute tool for arbitrary code, and a bash tool, both of which run 100% in browser. As of now it's free and you can use your ChatGPT subscription or an OpenAI endpoint. There is an optional companion PWA that allows you to drive the extension from your phone and click captchas for it remotely, which I might charge for in the future. But for now it's free and optional. The extension itself has no backend and does not collect any data. The hard part is MV3 extensions do everything they can to make sure your extension does not take up too much memory or run too long. So I rewrote durable objects in javascript to make it so that the agents in the extension can safely recover from their process randomly restarting constantly. each "agent" is an web-worker with a sqlite database and unique address. All the things I don't have to solve because the agent lives in a chrome extension: a) Identity - it inherits the chrome profile it lives in. It can ride your profile or you can give it its own and sandbox it with chrome enterprise. b) File system isolation - Each Rook extension gets its own private file system (opfs) which it can execute bash over. You can also mount local files via the file system access APIs and have the agent copy files between them. c) Sandboxing - extensions come with a sandbox api which allows the model to author arbitrary js safely. You can control the browser level allowed hosts in chrome enterprise as well. d) Browser use - the model just writes playwright and webmcp code in its sandbox. This works really well and is what SOTA computer use harnesses do. e) Scheduler/routines - you can set recurring work in your extension since extensions ship with their own alarms api. f) Channels - Slack and Discord let you connect to the extension directly via websocket so I don't need a proxy server or backend. I use this for basically everything these days and have ~8 unique browser profiles running on a single mac studio at all times. They are designed to take a task and work for extended periods of time. Cheers! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49456492 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

articles.title: Dolly Parton’s Legacy on the Billboard 200 Chart: 7 Decades of Hit Albums
articles.summary: She scored more top 40-charted sets in the 2020s than in any other decade.
articles._body: For seven straight decades, from the 1960s on through the 2020s, the late Dolly Parton charted an iconic string of 50 albums on the all-genre Billboard 200 chart — including 15 top 40-charted sets. From her debut with Porter Wagoner on Just the Two of Us in 1969, on through her most recent new entry, 2023’s Rockstar , the singer-songwriter left a remarkable impression on Billboard ’s signature album chart. Related Dolly Parton Hit Billboard’s Dance Charts, Too, And Even Earned a No. 1 Hit Dolly Parton’s Manager Details the Business Ventures ‘She Had Yet to Fulfill’ Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library Program Honored by Library of Congress: ‘Titan of Children’s Literacy’ Parton notched four early albums on the Billboard 200 with her former TV co-star and duet partner Wagoner in 1969-71. She charted her first solo entry also in 1969, with My Blue Ridge Mountain Boy . Parton would not reach the top 40 of the all-genre Billboard 200 albums chart until 1978, when Here You Come Again climbed to a No. 20 peak off the strength of its smash title track. The single sailed to No. 3 on the overall Billboard Hot 100 songs chart, and marked her first of eight top 40 hits on the ranking. After the Here You Come Again album, Parton would hit the top 40 again in short order with Heartbreaker (No. 27 in 1978), Great Balls of Fire (No. 40 in 1979) and 9 to 5 and Odd Jobs (No. 11 in 1981). The latter boasted her first Hot 100 No. 1 in “9 to 5,” which also scored Parton her first Academy Award nomination, for best original song (from the film of the same name in which Parton co-starred with Jane Fonda and Lily Tomlin). Parton would hit the top 40 of the Billboard 200 again in late 1984 with her holiday album Once Upon a Christmas , with Kenny Rogers. Just a year before, the pair teamed up on Parton’s second Hot 100 No. 1, “Islands in the Stream.” In 1987, Parton joined Linda Ronstadt and Emmylou Harris for the successful Trio album, which reached No. 6 on the Billboard 200 and granted Parton her first top 10 on the chart. Trio would garner Parton her first, and so far only, Grammy Award nomination for album of the year. In the 1990s, Parton notched two more top 40 albums on the Billboard 200 with Eagle When She Flies (No. 24 in 1991) and Slow Dancing With the Moon (No. 16 in 1993). In the 2000s, she brought Backwoods Barbie to the top 40, hitting No. 17 in 2009. In 2014, Parton achieved her first top 10 on the Billboard 200 unaccompanied by any other acts, as Blue Smoke debuted and peaked at No. 6. She followed it with another top 40 album two years later, Pure & Simple , which hit No. 11. In the 2020s, Parton has claimed four new top 40-charted albums — more than in any other decade. In 2020, she reached No. 16 with A Holly Dolly Christmas and followed it with Run, Rose, Run (No. 34 in 2022) and the best-of compilation Diamonds & Rhinestones: The Greatest Hits Collection (No. 27 in 2022). In 2023, Parton claimed her highest charting Billboard 200 album ever, as the all-star collabrations project Rockstar debuted and peaked at No. 3. The Rockstar project was promoted as Parton’s first rock album, and its recording was sparked by Parton’s induction to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2022. Through her career, Parton primarily recorded country music, but took detours (via albums and songs) into such genres as Americana/folk, bluegrass, children’s music, Christian, dance/electronic and pop. The 30-song Rockstar album mixed covers and original tunes and included guests such as Pat Benatar, Miley Cyrus, Melissa Etheridge, Joan Jett and The Blackhearts, Elton John, Lynyrd Skynyrd, Paul McCartney, Stevie Nicks, Chris Stapleton, Ringo Starr, Sting and Steven Tyler.

articles.title: Kehlani Cancels 2 Tour Dates After Hospitalization: ‘Breaks My Heart to Ever Have to Do This’
articles.summary: The Kehlani World Tour will pick back up in Richmond, Virginia, on Aug. 29.
articles._body: Kehlani is pressing pause on her world tour and will focus on getting her health back to where it needs to be. The Grammy-winning singer announced Wednesday (Aug. 26) on social media that she’s canceling her next two shows in New Jersey and Maryland on the Kehlani World Tour after being hospitalized for a painful illness that made her unable to swallow. “After two off days feeling completely normal.. ive been up all night unable to swallow & in so much pain,” she wrote. “I just left the hospital & am not cleared to sing for the next two shows. i’m so sorry Camden & DC. my team is working on a solution.” Related Kehlani Gets Candid With Longtime Pal Leon Thomas About R&B, ‘Changing the World’ & Her ‘Sinus Surgery From Hell’ Jay-Z 30 Pop-Up Experience to Open In London Ahead of Historic Tottenham Hotspur Stadium Shows Camilo's 'Vida de Rico' Enters YouTube's Billion Views Club Kehlani revealed that the trek will restart on Aug. 29 at the Allianz Amphitheater at Riverfront in Richmond, Virginia. She continued: “Breaks my heart to have to ever do this. i do everything i’m supposed to to ensure my health stays up to par & it still isn’t guaranteed. we will pick back up in Virginia.” Kehlani had been prioritizing her health and mental well-being while on the road, as she’s been making stops at bathhouses, yoga studios and wellness centers across North America. The tour still has plenty of runway left and will be running through September and wrapping up in early October with a show in San Francisco. The “Folded” singer is the cover star of Billboard ‘s 2026 R&B/Hip-Hop Power Players issue, which features Kehlani speaking with her friend and collaborator Leon Thomas. During the conversation, Kehlani dispelled the narrative that R&B is dying. “I hate the idea that R&B is dead,” she said. “It’s never gone anywhere. People are just a little lazy in looking up new artists to dive into. There’s plenty everywhere you look. I’m finding someone I like every day.” The 31-year-old released her self-titled album in April, which reached No. 1 on the  Top R&B Albums  chart and earned a top five debut on the  Billboard 200.   Billboard has reached out to Kehlani’s reps for further comment. articles.title: Promising Clippers guard gets brutal injury update right after Bennedict Mathurin leaves for Pelicans
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Clippers are undergoing a change of the guard after watching Kawhi Leonard, James Harden, and Ivica Zubac depart the franchise in a six-month span this calendar year. Unfortunately, things aren’t off to a great start as they’ll be entering the season without fourth-yea
articles._body: The Los Angeles Clippers are undergoing a change of the guard after watching Kawhi Leonard, James Harden, and Ivica Zubac depart the franchise in a six-month span this calendar year. Unfortunately, things aren’t off to a great start as they’ll be entering the season without fourth-year guard Jordan Miller. Miller underwent surgery on Wednesday to repair a torn rotator cuff in his left shoulder, the Clippers announced. The injury was sustained during an offseason workout last week and he’ll be re-evaluated in six months. Six months from now would effectively rule him out of playing with the Clippers until February 2026. And the six-month timeline isn’t necessarily the return-to-play date, but rather the re-evaluation date. Miller could be looking at an even longer absence. The news of the surgery comes just hours after reports surfaced of Bennedict Mathurin agreeing to a two-year, $16 million contract with the New Orleans Pelicans. The Clippers have made swift changes to their roster, seeing guys like Kawhi Leonard, James Harden, Ivica Zubac, John Collins, Bogdan Bogdanovic, Nicolas Batum, and Mathurin depart while bringing in guys like Darius Garland, Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, Rui Hachimura, Max Strus, and Keaton Wagler via the fifth overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft. Jordan Miller was expected to play a significant role for the Clippers this season as a ball-handler, playmaker, and scorer, but that will unfortunately be shelved until he can return from his torn rotator cuff injury. In 60 appearances for the Clippers this season, Miller averaged 10 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.3 assists, and 0.8 steals while shooting 53.1 percent from the field. articles._body: Hey HN, I'm a Rwandan-American software engineer. I was fortunate enough to make it to the US, build a career here, and have opportunities that changed the trajectory of my life. I've been thinking for a long time about how I could give something back. So I built joinfabfriends.org. The idea is pretty simple: think GoFundMe, but specifically for Rwandan college students who need help paying for things like tuition and textbooks. I'm starting small. I want to learn whether this model works, how to make the process trustworthy and transparent. And because just asking HN for money felt boring, here's my slightly unusual donor perk: If you become a donor(Good Samaritan), you're invited to come to Rwanda with me in summer 2027. You still have to pay your own way! But I'll be your guide. We'll see Rwanda, eat very well, meet some of the students we've helped(make sure to bring hiking shoes). I'd love your feedback, especially around: -what level of transparency you'd expect around donations -what would make you trust/distrust a platform like this -anything about the sitethat feels confusing And, of course, if one of the students' stories resonates with you, I'd be grateful if you can help. https://joinfabfriends.org Murakoze cyane! More specifically, we tested 16 top LLMs align most with human sense of humor. We ran >100k judgements and got >1.6k human ratings to see where do we agree across clean and dark jokes.

articles._body: What if LLMs were good banter? Well we tested which LLMs have the best sense of humor. More specifically, we tested 16 top LLMs align most with human sense of humor. We ran >100k judgements and got >1.6k human ratings to see where do we agree across clean and dark jokes. The main findings: - Gemini 3.7 Flash has the best taste at 64% although it's really close at the top - However, we've trained our own judge that reaches 74% - Humans agree up to ~80%, the other part is subjectivity Other notes: - All frontier models have worse taste on dark jokes except Grok (unsurprisingly haha) - Model intelligence correlates decently (+0.42) with judgement of humor. As many say, humor is a sign of intelligence! Check our website to see what humor research is coming next! Full report here: https://laugh.so/research/judge-leaderboard . articles.title: Troye Sivan Wants His New Album to Make a Cultural Impact, Not Just a Commercial One: ‘This One Is Going to Age Well’
articles.summary: "The heartbreaking thing would be if [the album] went by without any sort of cultural impact," the Australian pop singer said.
articles._body: Troye Sivan isn’t losing a wink of sleep over the concept of first-week sales. For his upcoming fourth studio album, She’s the Best , the Australian pop star has something bigger in mind: making something people remember. “I honest to God could not tell you what my first-week sales [are],” Sivan said during an appearance on Las Culturistas With Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang . “I’ve just never really been numbers-minded when it comes to music stuff.” Related Nicole Kidman Is 100% ‘That Girl’ in Ultra Glam Video For Troye Sivan’s ‘She’s the Best’ Single Troye Sivan’s ‘Blue Neighbourhood’ 10th Anniversary Edition Includes ‘Strawberries & Cigarettes,’ ‘Swimming Pools’: Stream It Now ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Has Led Billboard’s Top Soundtracks Chart for 57 Weeks: Only One Soundtrack Has Led Longer (Full List) Instead, Sivan said the metric that matters most to him is whether the album leaves a mark on pop culture. “The heartbreaking thing, like rather than it only [selling] however many thousand or whatever, would be if it went by without any sort of cultural impact,” he said. “I would be devastated.” That mind-set does make sense for the singer, given the fact that his previous era became one of the most visible queer-pop moments of the past few years. Sivan’s 2023 album Something to Give Each Other debuted at No. 20 on the all-genre Billboard 200 and at No. 1 on Billboard ‘s Dance/Electronic Albums chart, while its singles “Rush” and “One of Your Girls” helped earn him spots on the Billboard Hot 100 . The era eventually expanded beyond the album itself, culminating in Sivan and Charli xcx ‘s 2024 SWEAT Tour — the kind of pop-cultural moment Sivan says he hopes he can create again. “I think back to those moments of like the first time I watched Moulin Rouge! or the first time I saw the ‘Dirrty’ video from Christina Aguilera ,” he explained. “Those things, those sort of moments, I’m obsessed with the idea of being able to try and give that to people.” If Something to Give Each Other was Sivan’s exercise in “perfect pop,” his new album is cooking up to be something a little messier — and, in his words, more expressive. “I do feel like this album … is the most potent distillation of the references, musical references, that have made me the person that I am,” he said. Those references run the gamut. Sivan pointed to Janet Jackson’s “Together Again” as one musical touchstone, while describing the album as influenced by late-’90s grunge-pop á la Marcy Playground , with even some Fatboy Slim energy thrown into the mix. The result, he said, is intentionally “chaotic” and layered. That was a deliberate departure from his old approach. “My last album, my goal was like perfect pop,” Sivan said, describing himself as a “student of the school of Max Martin and Swedish people.” But after spending years obsessing over the mechanics of a pristine pop song, he felt a natural “pendulum swing” toward something more expressive. “I made a lot of the album with my little brother,” he said. “I made a lot of the album at home.” And he isn’t interested in over-explaining the new era before listeners get to experience it. Sivan said the rollout for She’s the Best will be “very quick,” partly because he wants fans to hear the project in full rather than spend months dissecting individual pieces. “I think the album is best experienced when listened top to bottom,” he said. “It’s like a journey.” That journey officially began Aug. 14 with the release of “She’s the Best,” the title track and lead single from the album, which arrives Oct. 9. The record is his first full-length project since Something to Give Each Other and his first new music since signing with Interscope Records. The title track’s accompanying video, directed by Gordon von Steiner and co-starring Nicole Kidman, also gives a glimpse at the scale of Sivan’s latest visual world. The video follows previous collaborations between Sivan and von Steiner, including “Rush” and “One of Your Girls,” while bringing Kidman — Sivan’s fellow Australian and Boy Erased co-star — into this new album’s realm. And when Sivan played an unreleased song and its video for the Las Culturistas hosts during the interview, their reaction suggested he may already be onto the kind of cultural moment he says he wants. “That’s gonna be a huge f—ing moment,” host Matt Rogers declared. For Sivan, though, the goal isn’t simply to make a bigger pop moment than the last one. It’s to make something that lasts. “I think to me personally this one is going to age well,” he said. “I think I’m gonna look back on it in like 50 years and be able to play a couple of the songs or all of the songs and be like, wow, I’m really proud of 31-year-old Troye for doing that.” Watch the full interview below.

articles.title: AI agents meant to replace Meta workers made “large-scale, disruptive actions”
articles.summary: Report shows Meta's challenges replacing people with AI agents.
articles._body: Earlier this year, Meta created a “plan” to reduce some of its teams by as much as 60 percent to make the company “AI native,” Reuters reported today, citing two people familiar with Meta’s internal affairs. Reuters’ report highlights the challenges organizations face when analyzing the best uses for AI and determining when the technology is a better fit for certain tasks than employees. Meta confirmed to Reuters that the plan, reportedly codenamed Project OT (short for organization transformation), explored scenarios in which Meta reduced some team headcounts by 60 percent and that the plan called for two rounds of layoffs. Meta wouldn’t confirm which teams Project OT affected. Read full article Comments

Check out some other great shows and content on the Blue & Gold YouTube channel as well, including the live Notre Dame Football Show , on Tuesday nights at 8 ET. ► The Third & Gold Podcast is available at all the places where you find podcasts, as well as our YouTube Channel .
