articles.title: Kalshi Incorrectly Claimed Deals With Giants, Braves Were Exclusive
articles.summary: Neville E. Guard-Imagn Images
articles._body: Kalshi described the deals with five MLB teams it announced Tuesday as all being “exclusive,” but that’s not exactly right, Front Office Sports has learned. Although Kalshi’s press release originally described all the deals as “exclusive, multi-year brand partnerships,” two of the deals—with the Braves and Giants—are not exclusive, two sources tell FOS . Those teams can enter into other prediction-market partnerships if they so choose. A representative for the Giants confirmed to FOS that the deal is not exclusive. The deals with the Dodgers and Red Sox are exclusive, according to the press releases issued by both of those teams. A source familiar with the matter tells FOS the Padres deal is also exclusive. Representatives for the Braves and Padres declined to comment. A representative for Kalshi tells FOS the error was not on purpose and the company has amended its press release. The company also issued individual press releases about each deal to local media on Tuesday that had the correct information. Some of the deals are not guaranteed to last multiple years, with at least the Giants and Padres agreements including mutual opt-out clauses under which either side can walk away in October, sources say. The deals announced Tuesday were major for Kalshi, as they represented the prediction-market giant’s first MLB team deals (it does have a team-level deal with the Blackhawks; Kalshi and Polymarket are both official partners of the NHL). Polymarket scored the overall deal with MLB back in March, an agreement sources told FOS was worth up to $300 million over four years . Under Polymarket’s deal, it became the exclusive prediction-market partner of the league, but teams remained free to enter into their own agreements. MLB has since named other companies as authorized prediction-market platforms under the league’s integrity framework, including Kalshi and Novig—the latter of which was the first platform to reach a team-level deal , with the Mets (that deal is exclusive and multiple years). Polymarket has since reached an agreement with the Yankees that, for now, is just through the rest of this season. As of Tuesday, there are now seven individual teams with prediction-market agreements, representing nearly one-quarter of the league. FOS reached out to every MLB team on Tuesday to ask if they have any prediction-market partnerships; representatives for the Guardians, Nationals, Phillies, Rockies, and Angels all said they do not. Sports-event contracts from Kalshi and other prediction-market platforms are the subject of numerous lawsuits winding through the U.S. court system; several states argue they should be treated like traditional sports betting, which is regulated by individual states. articles._body: The New York Yankees have been ravaged by injuries all season long. Of course, Aaron Judge’s rip issue has been the biggest concern for the team, as the three-time MVP has been out since May. Plenty of other players have spent time on the sideline this season, though, and one of New York’s best bullpen arms just landed on the 15-Day Injured List. Reliever Fernando Cruz started experiencing right elbow discomfort and will now be out of action for the foreseeable future . Of course, elbow injuries are always worrisome for pitchers. Cruz was fourth among relief pitchers on the Yankees in innings pitched (54.2). He put up impressive numbers during that time, too, evidenced by his 3.13 ERA and 1.335 WHIP. With New York’s bullpen experience streakiness all season long, Cruz was a steady presence on the bump. In a corresponding move, the Yankees signed Michael Fulmer to a major league contract. The 33-year-old pitcher was an All-Star back in 2017, and while he isn’t the same caliber of player he once was, he provides depth and a healthy arm for a team that desperately needs as much. The righty made three appearances for the Los Angeles Angels this season before he was designated for assignment. Fulmer didn’t allow a run over 3.2 innings of work. New York’s injury issues have led to their divisional title hopes slipping away. The Yankees are 74-57, four games back from the Tampa Bay Rays. Max Fried, Giancarlo Stanton, and Ryan McMahon are other stars of theirs who are on the mend. The post Yankees dealt another injury concern as pitcher lands on IL appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles._body: Just wanted to share an idea I've had for a while for creating social networks that are useful but don't lead to eventual enshittification. The idea is simple: - Each user gets 10 connections - User networks go out to MAX 3rd degree connections - Users can set their max network preference (1st, 2nd or 3rd degree) This leads to networks that have a maximum 1,110 theoretical connections. articles.title: ESPN Replaces Lead ‘College GameDay’ Producer in Shakeup
articles.summary: Adam Cairns-Imagn Images
articles._body: On the eve of the new college football season, ESPN is shaking up production leadership on College GameDay , Front Office Sports has confirmed. Producer Jim Gaiero is being transferred into a broader role across ESPN’s live events portfolio, sources say. Matthew Garrett is taking over as executive producer for the venerable college football pregame show. As vice president of production, Garrett has overseen and worked on the show since 2023. His previous roles include serving as coordinating producer of Sunday NFL Countdown and Monday Night Countdown . Awful Announcing broke the news of GameDay ’s producer change . Gaiero led GameDay for the past 10 years—a period of major cast changes that included the addition of Pat McAfee and Nick Saban, the departure of David Pollack, and the retirement of Lee Corso. With the sports media giant going all-out for its first-ever Super Bowl telecast, Gaiero, a 31-year ESPN veteran, is expected to produce pregame and related programming around ESPN/ABC’s simulcast of Super Bowl LXI on Feb. 14, 2027. Gaiero will also continue to produce college football games. Mike McQuade, ESPN’s executive vice president of sports production, is also expected to employ Gaiero on Masters and PGA Championship golf coverage, with an eye toward him assuming full production responsibilities in 2028. It’s the second time in three years that ESPN has shaken up production leadership around the 40-year-old GameDay . In August 2023, ESPN parted ways with star producer Lee Fitting, who now serves as head of media and production for WWE. As for Garrett, the 21-year ESPN veteran has been a vocal supporter of McAfee’s in recent years. In a 2024 interview with Sports Business Journal , Garrett referred to the West Virginia product as “a unique talent,” while praising his “incredible ability for engaging the on-site crowd.” “If you ask me, it’s unmatched by anybody else on television,” he said of McAfee. The surprise GameDay leadership switch will inevitably lead to soap opera-like speculation about what role McAfee played, if any, behind the scenes. There’s no question that the addition of McAfee in 2022 and Saban in 2024 has revitalized the iconic show. GameDay is coming off its most-watched season ever, averaging 2.7 million viewers in 2025, a 22% increase. Led by Corso’s Week 1 farewell, the show posted its nine most-watched regular-season episodes ever last season. But the mercurial, 39-year-old McAfee has also butted heads with GameDay colleagues and ESPN executives, mocking them as “old white people.” Last year, FOS reported that some co-workers were fed up with McAfee’s “diva-like” behavior. McAfee previously lashed out at powerful former ESPN executive Norby Williamson as a “rat” trying to sabotage his show. Meanwhile, McAfee’s ESPN portfolio continues to grow, including joining the cast of the Monday Night Countdown NFL pregame show this season and likely hosting his own “Field Pass” of Super Bowl LXI. The former NFL punter has the support of ESPN’s most powerful executives. They include: chairman Jimmy Pitaro; president of content Burke Magnus; and Mike Foss, the increasingly influential executive vice president, executive editor of sports news and entertainment, who serves as McAfee’s liaison. Even McAfee GameDay castmates would admit he’s now the show’s biggest star. His weekly field goal contest, in which he’s generously given away $6 million of his own money, has become must-see TV. When ESPN issued its press release touting GameDay’s upcoming season, McAfee was conspicuously pictured front and center alongside Herbstreit, Saban, and Davis. In July, FOS first reported that McAfee had begun early talks on a long-term contract extension , worth an estimated $60 million a year . While McAfee licenses his eponymous weekday show to ESPN, he has a separate deal for GameDay . His current ESPN deals are set to expire in 2028. Meanwhile, ESPN’s top execs are said to be thrilled at GameDay’s newfound ability to reach both younger (under 25) and female viewers. Audiences in those two key advertising-desired demos grew 35% and 34% last season, respectively. GameDay’s ratings grew 23% last year and would have still increased by 12% without the bump it received from Nielsen’s Big Data measurement system. This season’s nine-person GameDay cast of McAfee, Saban, Herbstreit, Davis, Desmond Howard, “Stanford Steve” Coughlin, Jen Lada, Jess Sims, and Pete Thamel is poised to kick off the new season with a trip to Baton Rouge, Louisiana, in Week 1. The telecast will mark GameDay’s 500th road show. This will be Herbstreit’s 30th season on the show. In May, the GameDay team won its third consecutive Sports Emmy for outstanding weekly sports studio program. ESPN declined to comment. The post ESPN Replaces Lead ‘College GameDay’ Producer in Shakeup appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles.title: Meta settles states' child-safety claims for $18B; Florida rejects deal as "peanuts"
articles.summary: Meta to impose daily limit on child social media use in deal with nearly every state.
articles._body: Meta agreed to impose daily limits on children's social media use and pay nearly $18 billion in settlements with nearly every US state today, cutting short a trial in which Meta said several of the states were demanding over $1.4 trillion. The settlement requires court approval. Meta is facing claims that it designed its products to foster compulsive use by children and failed to warn users of addiction and mental health risks. Meta, which already uses ID checks and face analysis to verify user ages, said it agreed to impose on people under 18 a "default two-hour daily time limit that teens can only turn off with a parent’s permission," a default block between midnight and 6 am, and a school mode in which notifications are muted by default from 8 am to 3 pm. The two-hour daily "limit is cumulative across Facebook and Instagram, and time spent scrolling on both apps counts toward the total, including if we detect that someone has multiple accounts," Meta said. Teens will "receive prompts after every 15 minutes of continuous screen time on Facebook or Instagram," and "prompts when their total daily usage hits 60 minutes and 90 minutes." articles.title: Another LIV Vendor Ramps Up Legal Fight As Layoffs Hit League
articles.summary: Jerod Ringwald-Imagn Images
articles._body: Another former LIV Golf vendor is waging a legal fight with the league over missed payments, as LIV’s future is in limbo . Deltatre, a sports technology service provider that began working with LIV during its 2025 season, requested a motion for summary judgment in the Supreme Court of the State of New York earlier this month—effectively asking for a judge to rule in its favor without needing further court proceedings. The company filed a breach-of-contract lawsuit against LIV with the court on May 22, which had not been previously reported. Deltatre said at the time that LIV owed it $858,548.15. With additional costs from interest and attorneys’ fees, that total has risen to approximately $935,000, a source with knowledge of the legal proceedings told Front Office Sports . “LIV does not deny the contracts, the services, its acceptance of those services, or its receipt of the invoices or its failure to object to them,” Deltatre wrote in its latest filing on Aug. 13. “It admits each of those facts. That leaves a straightforward question for this motion: whether a customer that accepted the contracted-for services, retained the resulting invoices without objection, approved the invoices for payment, and nevertheless left $858,548.15 unpaid as of the date of the filing of this action may avoid judgment through generalized affirmative defenses unsupported by the factual record. It may not.” Deltatre is not the only vendor to sue LIV. Fresh Tape Media, which produced LIV’s preseason media days event in January, is suing the league for more than $1.23 million in missed payments and interest. Mobii Systems Group Limited, a former technology partner of LIV, has also sued the league for more than $1.1 million for breach of contract, unpaid invoices, and interest. Other vendors and contractors have told FOS they are also owed money by the league. LIV CEO Scott O’Neil was asked about the status of unpaid vendors last week ahead of LIV’s season finale in Indianapolis. “What I would say to them is we’re doing everything we can to make sure we can do right by them and the work they committed,” O’Neil said. “And I hope we can.” Layoffs Coming to LIV LIV’s financial issues go beyond unpaid invoices. LIV announced Wednesday that it is laying off staff and scaling back its operations now that the Saudi PIF is no longer funding the league. The league is in talks with BC Partners Credit over a new funding deal . “The funding commitment announced by PIF earlier this year will reach its conclusion,” a LIV spokesperson said in a statement Wednesday to FOS . “As a result, we are scaling back operations as we transition to the next chapter of LIV Golf and work toward making LIV 2.0 a reality. This week, we informed many of our colleagues that their employment under LIV 1.0 will end in the first week of September. We are grateful to our employees for their hard work and dedication in building LIV Golf, and we remain committed to supporting those affected through this transition.” The layoffs were not unexpected given LIV’s uncertain future, and employees could have additional opportunities with LIV if the league lives on. While there is no public deadline for LIV to finalize a deal with BC Partners, Sept. 1 has been floating among golf industry sources as a working deadline—one that may be necessary to meet to plan a 2027 schedule. The post Another LIV Vendor Ramps Up Legal Fight As Layoffs Hit League appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles.title: Katy Perry Draws 310,000 Fans to Free Concert in Mexico: 5 Best Moments
articles.summary: During her show at the National Fair of San Luis Potosí, the pop star paid tribute to the iconic Dolly Parton, who had passed away hours earlier.
articles._body: Pop superstar Katy Perry returned to Mexico to present her Out of Office Tour on Tuesday (Aug. 25) at the Feria Nacional Potosina (FENAPO), in a free concert that turned out to be one of the most massive shows she has ever performed — drawing 310,000 people, according to figures provided by the organizers. The show included a heartfelt tribute to country legend Dolly Parton, who had passed away hours earlier. Held in the Mexican state of San Luis Potosi, the concert was part of a series of shows and a mini-tour of European festivals where Perry blends biggest hits like “California Gurls,” “Roar” and “Firework” with large-scale technological elements such as a laptop, a smartphone, a sunflower and an enormous plastic bottle she climbs into to interact with the crowd. The show was also streamed on FENAPO’s social media channels, as previously announced by the state governor Ricardo Gallardo, who told Billboard Español that Perry’s performance would set a precedent for the event, as it “confirms Mexico’s place in the entertainment world, but also its standing in Latin America,” he declared. Over nearly two hours, the California star delivered a journey through her biggest hits, spoke a bit of Spanish, dedicated a song to her young daughter Daisy Dove for her birthday, and invited a child onto the stage to join her. A standout moment included her invitation to a group of local fans who recorded a video with her to the rhythm of “Watch It Burn” as a thank-you for camping outside the venue for days to be among the first to enter the concert. Perry returned to the Latin American country after previously kicking off her global The Lifetimes Tour at Arena Ciudad de México in April 2025. Below, our five favorite moments from Katy Perry’s show at FENAPO.

articles.title: Owners approve historic Seahawks’ $9.6 billion sale to Vinod Khosla’s ownership group
articles.summary: The Seattle Seahawks officially have a new ownership group over them, as the league approved a $9.612 billion sale from Paul Allen’s estate to a group led by Vinod Khosla’s family, according to ClutchPoints. “NFL owners have unanimously approved the $9.6 billion sale of the Seat
articles._body: The Seattle Seahawks officially have a new ownership group over them, as the league approved a $9.612 billion sale from Paul Allen’s estate to a group led by Vinod Khosla’s family, according to ClutchPoints. “NFL owners have unanimously approved the $9.6 billion sale of the Seattle Seahawks to a group led by Vinod Khosla’s family, making it the most expensive purchase of an NFL franchise in league history,” ClutchPoints wrote on X, formerly Twitter. The sale was agreed to in July, and they needed approval from 24 of the 32 NFL owners in order for it to be official, but it was expected that they would get the necessary votes. The voting took place at a meeting in the Atlanta Airport Marriott, according to ESPN’s Brady Henderson. The purchase is the highest ever for an NFL team, which tops the Washington Commanders when they were sold for $6.05 billion in 2023. It’s not the highest for a North American sports team, as the Los Angeles Lakers were sold for $10 billion and are about to be sold at an even higher price. Khosla is the co-founder of Sun Microsystems and founder of Khosla Ventures, which is a venture capital firm. It’s made investments in companies such as DoorDash and Instacart. Khosla joined the 49ers’ ownership group in 2025, as he bought 3.1% of the team at an $8.5 billion valuation. With him now taking ownership of the Seahawks, he has to remove his stake from the 49ers as part of the agreement. The transaction for the sale is set to happen before the Seahawks’ season opener against the New England Patriots. articles.title: Thomas Castellanos officially commits to Texas Tech
articles.summary: Thomas Castellanos has committed to the Red Raiders, according to ESPN’s Pete Thamel. Castellanos previously played for UCF, Boston College, and Florida State before choosing Texas Tech as the next stop in his college career. He arrives in Lubbock with extensive experience and proven production.
articles._body: Thomas Castellanos has committed to the Red Raiders, according to ESPN’s Pete Thamel. Castellanos previously played for UCF, Boston College, and Florida State before choosing Texas Tech as the next stop in his college career . He arrives in Lubbock with extensive experience and proven production. Castellanos has accumulated 6,449 passing yards and 48 touchdown passes during his career. His ability to create plays with his legs also separates him from many quarterbacks, as he has added 24 rushing touchdowns. That dual-threat skill set gives Texas Tech another intriguing option at the position. Castellanos’ best stretch came at Boston College, where he became one of the most dangerous rushing quarterbacks in college football. His mobility can stress opposing defenses, especially when designed runs and off-script plays force defenders to account for him outside the pocket. The interceptions are a problem, but rushing for 13 touchdowns in one season is not seen often for a QB in the ACC. There are now questions about how the quarterback depth chart will unfold, but Castellanos did not choose his fourth program to sit quietly in the background. He will expect a legitimate opportunity to earn meaningful snaps. His competition will be against Will Hammond, who would still get some playing time if Castellanos becomes the starter later on. Pete Nakos expects Hammond to remain the starter on the depth chart , so Castellanos may have to quickly learn the playbook to get him on the field as soon as possible. The Red Raiders will take on Abilene Christian on Sept. 5 for their home opener. The post Thomas Castellanos officially commits to Texas Tech appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Florida Catholics slap down state AG by rejecting religious vaccine exemptions
articles.summary: The bishops' snub comes as the state continues to attack vaccines.
articles._body: Florida's attorney general got a fiery rebuke and some ecclesiastical schooling from the state's Catholic bishops after he boldly threatened to block funding to Catholic schools unless the church bends to the state's anti-vaccine policies—policies allegedly intended to uphold religious freedom. On July 31, Attorney General James Uthmeier sent a questionable letter to the bishops regarding exemptions to school vaccination requirements. Florida law requires public and private schools to allow vaccination exemptions based on religious grounds. But Catholic schools in the state do not accept religious exemptions; Florida's Catholic dioceses support vaccination and recognize no theological argument against it. The schools only accept exemptions based on medical conditions that are verified by a healthcare provider. Uthmeier, himself a Catholic, wrote to the bishops in an open letter that, based on his own understanding of Catholicism, he saw " no legitimate religious reason to refuse granting religious exemptions ." He reviewed select theological positions regarding the use of "abortion-derived vaccines," and suggested to the bishops that it was "morally reprehensible" that they not grant religious exemptions. articles.summary: Bitcoin Magazine
articles._body: Bitcoin Magazine Forget the Trump Bump — Bitcoin Would Be Fine Under Democrats, Says VanEck President Donald Trump may be the most crypto-friendly leader the U.S. has had so far — but what would happen to Bitcoin if the Democrats were to get back in power?  Well, it wouldn’t necessarily be bad, according to asset manager VanEck’s Head of Digital Assets Research, Matthew Sigel.  Speaking on CNBC Wednesday, the analyst also said that contrary to what many believe, ex-President Joe Biden wasn’t anti-Bitcoin.  Republicans have repeatedly blasted Democrats as anti-crypto. Regulators under ex-president Joe Biden cracked down on digital asset companies, filing various lawsuits.   “Biden was actually okay for Bitcoin,” Sigel said. “It’s the rest of cryptos that might have a problem [if Democrats get back in power].”  He added: “With the ascendant socialist wing of the Democrat Party, I can tell you here in New York City that there are plenty who are reminded of why there is value in a decentralized, scarce asset that can’t be printed and spent on nonsense.” President Trump campaigned on a ticket to help the digital asset industry and has passed a number of pro-crypto executive orders, including setting up a Bitcoin Strategic Reserve .  The price of Bitcoin surged off the back of Trump’s 2024 victory and notched a new record last year. Despite some sluggish months in 2026, the leading digital asset began to rise again last week after the president urged lawmakers to get the long-awaited crypto Clarity Act over the line. Bitcoin has jumped nearly 24% over the past seven days, touching as high as $81,160 this week before dropping again to its current price of $78,438.  Pro-crypto lawmakers had hoped to pass the Clarity Act before Congress broke for August recess, but the vote slipped to September after Democrats balked at the latest draft.  Some Republican senators have accused Democrats of deliberately holding the legislation back.  The Clarity Act aims to create a legal framework classifying digital assets as securities, commodities or payment stablecoins, and determining which regulator oversees each. Sigel’s comments echo those of Coinbase’s Chief Policy Officer, Faryar Shirzad, who said in July that crypto was “maybe the most bipartisan issue in Washington.” Speaking about the delay in a vote on the Clarity Act, Shirzad said that while some lawmakers were holding back the long-awaited legislation, younger Democrats were for the framework.  “A lot of the opposition is generational — so it is Democrats who oppose it — but I think younger members who understand the technology, understand that money is transforming how we should engage financially, how we need to adapt, and so it’s really a generational shift,” he said on The Hill’s Rising show.  This post Forget the Trump Bump — Bitcoin Would Be Fine Under Democrats, Says VanEck first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

articles._body: There is no denying that Victor Wembanyama is a special talent. The French big man stands 7-foot-4 and joined the San Antonio Spurs as one of the most highly touted prospects ever . He has already established himself as the best defensive player in the NBA, but he does things offensively that nobody his height should be able to do, too. Darko Rajakovic, the head coach of the Toronto Raptors, believes Wemby can become an all-time great. “Victor Wembanyama is a unique player,” Rajakovic said on an interview with Basketball Sphere. “I think he will be in the category of players who change the game. Furthermore, he reportedly has unmatched motivation and discipline to become great. The Alien averaged 25 points per game and was the Defensive Player of the Year last season. That was surely just the start of a career that legitimately has the potential to match that of LeBron James and Michael Jordan. articles.title: Olivia Dean Says She Used to Think Making Pop Music Was ‘Lame’ Until ‘Man I Need’ Turned Her ‘Shame’ Into Gold
articles.summary: "Man I Need" peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100.
articles._body: While she has a pair of Billboard Hot 100 top five hits and the longest-running No. 1 in U.K. history to her name, Olivia Dean wasn’t planning on dominating the charts. The Grammy-winning singer graced the cover of The Wall Street Journal on Wednesday (Aug. 26), where she opened up about her “pop shame” and perfectionism that almost didn’t allow her to release “Man I Need.” “I used to have kind of a thing about pop music, like wanting to make pop music is lame. Maybe this is a bit too far, babe?” she recalled thinking. Eventually, Dean went ahead and “Man I Need” arrived as a single in August 2025 ahead of The Art of Loving , which arrived a month later. “Just let go,” she told herself. “Man I Need” eventually surged to No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 in late January but was ultimately blocked from the top spot by Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas,” a fate many massive hits suffered in 2026. Billboard ‘s staff ranked “Man I Need” as the 63rd greatest No. 2 hit of all time on the Hot 100 . The Art of Loving peaked at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 and produced another top five Hot 100 hit with “So Easy (To Fall in Love)” reaching No. 5. Dean’s “Rein Me In” collaboration with Sam Fender surged to No. 45 on this week’s Hot 100 chart dated Aug. 29. The track continues its run as the longest-running No. 1 of all time in the U.K., notching a 22nd week at the summit. Olivia Dean is on the road for her headlining North American arena run The Art of Loving Live , which is wrapping up with a pair of shows in Austin on Aug. 28-29.

articles._body: Hi HN, Hearing a lot of buzz around GLM-5.3, which I expect to be the best open-source coding model with the weights dropping soon, I wanted to test it where I actually do my work. I just mapped GLM-5.3 to TokenGo so I could swap out the base URL and use it directly in my IDE. The backend handles the edge routing via Cloudflare to keep latency low, critical when you're waiting for inline code completions. If you want to try GLM-5.3 (or glm-5.3-flash) in your own workflow, here is the setup. For Cursor: Go to Settings > Models. Add your API key in the OpenAI API Key field. Toggle "Override OpenAI Base URL" and set it to: https://api.tokengo.com/v1 Under "Model Names", add z-ai/glm-5.3. Select it in your chat panel dropdown. We're one of the first inference providers to get the GLM 5.3 family online and fully accessible for IDEs. articles._body: Currently, interim Women’s Champion WWE star Chelsea Green is dealing with an injury , but she almost suffered another during a pre-taped episode of Friday Night SmackDown . Warning: Spoilers ahead for the Aug. 28 edition of SmackDown. During the Aug. 28, 2026, edition of SmackDown, which was pre-taped on Monday, Aug. 24, Green teamed up with Tiffany Stratton to face the Irresistible Forces (Nia Jax and Lash Legend). Chelsea Green can’t catch a break pic.twitter.com/JQgX8mbVAk — The Squared Times (@TheSquaredTimes) August 25, 2026 At one point, the WWE medical staff tried to take her backstage . This is her first match since suffering the broken orbital bone injury during the SmackDown after SummerSlam 2026. Fans were left speculating about the legitimacy and severity of the injury. It sounds like she returned to the ring to finish the match, but her team still lost. Hopefully, she is okay. WWE Women’s Champion Chelsea Green’s injury Joe Camporeale-Imagn Images. Green has had some bad luck in recent weeks. At SummerSlam 2026, she finally captured her first-ever world championship. She beat the likes of former world champions such as Charlotte Flair, Jade Cargill, and Stratton to win the interim Women’s Championship. WWE held the ladder match to determine an interim champion as Rhea Ripley recovers from a torn meniscus . Green ended up breaking an orbital bone during her next televised match during the Aug. 7 edition of SmackDown. She and Stratton lost to Fatal Influence’s Fallon Henley and Lainey Reid. That was a devastating blow to Green. Initially, it looked like general manager Nick Aldis was going to force her to relinquish the championship. Instead, he gave her 30 days to get medically cleared to compete. It appears she came through, judging by the spoiler results for the Aug. 28 edition of SmackDown. For most of her career, Green was used as a midcard talent. She was the inaugural Women’s United States Champion in 2024 and has won the title once since. However, she is now in the main event scene as the interim Women’s Champion. The post WWE champion Chelsea Green suffers injury scare during SmackDown taping appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Beyoncé to Donate $1 Million to Colombia Earthquake Relief Efforts
articles.summary: Queen Bey’s seven-figure contribution will provide food and housing supplies to communities devastated by the disaster.
articles._body: Beyoncé will contribute $1 million to organizations providing on-the-ground assistance in Colombia, Parkwood Entertainment announced Tuesday (Aug. 25) in a press release. The funds are earmarked for immediate food and housing supplies for communities hardest hit by the magnitude-7.4 earthquake that struck near San José del Palmar, in Chocó, on Aug. 10. Related Karol G, Maluma & More Unite for Colombia Earthquake Relief & More Uplifting Moments in Latin Music Shakira Pledges $1.25 Million to Rebuild Colombia Schools After Earthquake Karol G Donates $1.2 Million to Earthquake Victims in Colombia Through Her Foundation The quake caused extensive damage to homes, infrastructure and roads, while also disrupting food supplies across multiple areas. In response, Parkwood and the superstar encouraged those seeking to support relief efforts to donate to Food For The Poor and World Central Kitchen , both actively aiding affected communities. Beyoncé’s donation joins support from fellow artists with close ties to Colombia. During Bogotá’s Colombia: Voces por la Vida benefit concert on Sunday (Aug. 23), it was announced that Karol G’s Con Cora Foundation had contributed $1.2 million. The event, featuring Maluma, Eladio Carrión, Grupo Niche and more than 30 other acts, raised over 11 billion Colombian pesos — approximately $3.6 million — for affected families. Meanwhile, Shakira, Global Citizen, Live Nation and CAF have committed an initial $1.25 million to rebuild schools damaged in Chocó, with Shakira’s Pies Descalzos Foundation set to lead the effort. The Houston megastar’s contribution also arrives as a broad coalition of Latin artists, athletes and organizations mobilizes to support Chocó’s recovery. The initiative Marea Viva por el Chocó del Mañana — led by Progresa Chocó, Fundación Mi Sangre, Fundación Bancolombia and Grupo Argos — includes Juanes, James Rodríguez, Mariana Pajón, Rigoberto Urán, David Ospina, Néstor Lorenzo, Manuel Medrano, Goyo, Jhon Arias, Juan Luis Guerra, Alejandro Sanz, Nicky Jam and Altafulla.

articles.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have been up and down over the last couple of weeks, recently losing the first game of their series against the Atlanta Braves. The Dodgers have multiple injured players reportedly on the mend, including pitcher Justin Wrobleski, who is currently dealing with a forearm iss
articles._body: The Los Angeles Dodgers have been up and down over the last couple of weeks, recently losing the first game of their series against the Atlanta Braves . The Dodgers have multiple injured players reportedly on the mend, including pitcher Justin Wrobleski, who is currently dealing with a forearm issue. On Wednesday, the Dodgers got a positive update concerning his status moving forward. “Justin Wrobleski is facing hitters at Truist Park,” reported David Vassegh of AM 570 LA Sports on X, formerly Twitter, prior to that night’s game against the Braves on the road. Wrobleski has stepped up this season with several other Dodgers pitchers missing time, including Blake Snell and Tyler Glasnow, among others. He was named to the NL All-Star team for his work this season, although he will be moving to the bullpen upon his injury return in order to make room for other starters who are now healthy. Still, it will certainly be good for the Dodgers to have the talented pitcher back in the rotation ahead of the playoffs, which are just over a month away. The Dodgers are also awaiting the return of reliever Edwin Diaz, who has been on the injured list due to a neck injury, suffered not long after his return from a different injury that kept him out for a good chunk of the season. In any case, the Dodgers are set to continue their regular season schedule on Wednesday evening for the second of three games in Atlanta against the Braves. articles.title: Google announces Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for AI-powered speech-to-text
articles.summary: The AI that powers Gboard's Rambler is coming to more Google products, including Chrome.
articles._body: While we wait ( possibly in vain ) for Gemini 3.5 Pro to launch, Google is releasing a different model in the 3.5 branch. The company has announced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, an AI model designed to streamline voice input by editing out "ums" and corrections, outputting polished AI text. This model already powers the Gboard "Rambler" feature on the Pixel 11 , but it's about to appear throughout the Google ecosystem. According to Google, Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is much faster and more accurate than its previous voice-to-text engine, known as Chirp 3. The new AI model should be about 70 percent faster from voice to final transcribed text, and the live-speech error rate has dropped to 5.5 percent. That's only a little better than Chirp 3, which Google measures at 7.32 percent. Still, it's a pain to fix typos when you're using voice input, so any improvement here is beneficial. Credit: Google Read full article Comments

articles.title: Jaguars QB Trevor Lawrence gets completely real on preparing for start of regular season
articles.summary: The Jacksonville Jaguars should be an exciting team to watch in 2026. Jacksonville assembled an excellent roster during the offseason and it will soon be time to put it to the test. One Jaguars player sounds ready for the challenges ahead as the regular season approaches. Jaguars QB Trevor Lawren
articles._body: The Jacksonville Jaguars should be an exciting team to watch in 2026. Jacksonville assembled an excellent roster during the offseason and it will soon be time to put it to the test. One Jaguars player sounds ready for the challenges ahead as the regular season approaches. Jaguars QB Trevor Lawrence spoke completely honestly about the end of training camp and the transition to the regular season. “I always feel like there’s something around the corner to stay ready for,” Lawrence told reporters on Wednesday. “You know next week is kind of an in-between week as well and we still have some prep this week to finish up. But I mean, just in general that feeling of the season being so close and obviously in camp, when you start off you have so much camp ahead of you, so much time to work on different things. It can be kind of a grind, but now when you get to this point you’re like man, we got two weeks? Less than two weeks before we’re preparing to play Cleveland. But I mean we play in basically two weeks. So that sounds crazy thinking about it, how close it is.” There are still plenty of unknowns surrounding the Jaguars before the season begins. Will Travis Hunter continue playing on offense and defense ? And how will Jacksonville get by without Travis Etienne Jr. in the backfield? The Jaguars only have a few weeks to get everything sorted before every snap matters. Fortunately, it sounds like Lawrence is already prepared for the grind of the regular season. “We’re on track but we’ve got to keep plugging away every day,” Lawrence added. “You can’t relax. But physically, I think coach does a really good job of transitioning and shifting to where guys can get their bodies back a little bit.” Jaguars fans do not have to wait much longer before their team’s first real game of the 2026 season. In the meantime, the Jaguars must play their preseason finale against the Buccaneers on August 28th. articles.title: Ravyn Lenae Postpones ‘Blue Island’ Tour, Promises Shows Will Be ‘Worth the Wait’
articles.summary: "I hate to disappoint you. Connecting with my fans through live performance is one of my favorite experiences as an artist," the R&B singer shared on Instagram.
articles._body: Ravyn Lenae has postponed her upcoming Blue Island tour, which was scheduled to kick off next month. Related How a Grammy Rule Change Gave 5 Artists Another Chance at a 2027 Best New Artist Nomination — UPDATE Corinne Bailey Rae & Ravyn Lenae Talk Managing Mental Health Amid Success for BetterHelp ‘Like Minded’ Series at Billboard House @ SXSW Ravyn Lenae Runs Into KATSEYE, Talks Opening Up For Sabrina Carpenter | Spotify Best New Artist Party 2026 The singer announced the news on Wednesday (Aug. 26) in a statement shared to her Instagram story, telling fans that she made the “difficult decision” to postpone her fall touring plans after speaking with her team. “Hi everyone,” Lenae began, before thanking fans for their support of Blue Island , her third studio album. “The love I’ve received so far is so beautiful, and I’m eternally grateful for the time you’ve spent with it.” Lenae acknowledged that the postponement may come as a letdown to fans but assured them that she plans to make her return to the stage worthwhile. “I hate to disappoint you,” she wrote. “Connecting with my fans through live performance is one of my favorite experiences as an artist but promise when I bring the show to you in the new year it’ll be worth the wait.” The Blue Island tour was originally set to begin Sept. 15 in Sacramento, Calif., before traveling through cities including Oakland, Las Vegas, Minneapolis, Chicago, Washington D.C., Toronto, Raleigh, Memphis, Dallas, Austin and Phoenix. A Los Angeles date at the Greek Theatre was scheduled for Oct. 21, with Lexa Gates and Nourished By Time among the artists announced as supporting acts on select dates. Lenae did not provide a specific reason for the postponement. She did, however, confirm that fans who have already purchased tickets will receive refunds. “All purchased tickets will be refunded at the point of purchase,” she wrote. The announcement comes less than three weeks after Lenae released Blue Island on Aug. 7. The album follows her 2024 sophomore set Bird’s Eye , which included her first Billboard Hot 100 hit “Love Me Not.” Lenae’s representatives offered no additional comments for Billboard at the time of publishing. For now, Lenae has not announced new dates for the tour, but she promised fans that she plans to bring the Blue Island show to them in the new year.

articles.title: Scottie Scheffler reveals how Tiger Woods impacted his game
articles.summary: Scottie Scheffler has established himself as the dominant player of his generation, but one important part of his approach came from watching Tiger Woods. Scheffler recently explained that Woods taught him about competitive instinct and maintaining intensity throughout every tournament. Although
articles._body: Scottie Scheffler has established himself as the dominant player of his generation, but one important part of his approach came from watching Tiger Woods. Scheffler recently explained that Woods taught him about competitive instinct and maintaining intensity throughout every tournament. Although the two have competed together only once, their round at the Masters left a lasting impression. Scheffler recalled being paired with Woods and Shane Lowry while sitting around 20th place entering the day. He wondered whether Woods would approach the round with the same focus despite being outside the lead. Video courtesy of Chris McKee. Scottie Scheffler shares the story of the only time he ever played a round with Tiger Woods at the 2020 Masters, "My main takeaway was the intensity that he brought to each and every shot and that's something I've definitely tried to model in my game." pic.twitter.com/VWkz8ulIJR — Chris McKee (@mrmckee) August 26, 2026 “When I talk about competitive instincts and talk about intensity each week, that is stuff I learned just from watching Tiger (Woods),” Scheffler said. “I only played in competition with him once, and it was at the Masters… We were 20th place going into the day. It was me, him, and Shane Lowry. I hadn’t played in competition with him yet, so I go, ‘gosh, I wonder what this will be like.’ I just remember walking up with him on the first green and watching him read his putt, and I was like, ‘Holy smokes, this guy is into it.” That was my main takeaway: the intensity he brought to each and every shot, and that is something that I have definitely tried to model in my game. I have learned a lot just by watching him play.” The influence is easy to recognize. Scheffler rarely appears satisfied simply because he is playing well. His calm demeanor can hide a relentless competitive drive, allowing him to remain focused whether he is leading a tournament or trying to climb back into contention. Scheffler will compete for the Tour Championship starting Thursday. A win to cap off the season would not shock anyone. The post Scottie Scheffler reveals how Tiger Woods impacted his game appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: NFL Owners Unanimously Approve $9.6 Billion Seahawks Sale
articles.summary: Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images
articles._body: ATLANTA — NFL team owners voted unanimously Wednesday to ratify the league-record $9.612 billion sale of the Seahawks , ushering in a new era for the reigning Super Bowl champions following nearly three decades of ownership by the family of late Microsoft cofounder Paul Allen. The owners vote came during a special one-day league meeting at an Atlanta airport hotel. The result was a foregone conclusion after the owners on the NFL’s finance and ownership policy committees voted unanimously last week to recommend approval of the purchase by a group led by the family of venture capitalist Vinod Khosla. “As Roger [Goodell] said, it’s pretty simple when the team is functioning as well as it is today,” Khosla said. “How often do you get to buy a franchise that just won the Super Bowl? So we are incredibly lucky and humbled by this gift… from the Allen trust.” The deal is expected to close next month. Allen’s estate announced last month that it had reached an agreement with the Khosla-led group. Khosla’s wife, Neeru Khosla, will serve as the Seahawks’ controlling owner. Their son, Neal Khosla, is to have a role in ownership of the franchise. Applause could be heard from inside the owners’ meeting room following the vote. “The task ahead is actually pretty simple: Keep the winning streak alive,” Vinod Khosla said. “Get another Super Bowl. That’s simple. In general, our approach is generally going to be long-term focused. That’s our inclination always. So keep winning, take a longterm approach and learn a lot…. We’ll just be in learning mode for quite some time.” The Khosla family holds a minority ownership stake in the 49ers and must divest itself of that interest, although similar situations involving other NFL owners sometimes have taken months to resolve. “They know our league well,” Goodell said. “… They understand the passion of the NFL. They understand the 12s,” he said, referring to the nickname for Seattle’s rabid fans. “They understand the Seattle community and the NFL. And so that makes this transaction particularly attractive to all of us.” Goodell also cited the experience by the Khosla family in the technology sector. “As we address many of those issues, I think their expertise will be incredibly valuable to us in helping us make better decisions moving forward,” Goodell said. “And I know, most importantly with tremendous confidence, that they will be outstanding caretakers of the Seattle Seahawks and the organization and the great partnership they have with their community.” The new Seahawks owners have not yet identified the other investors in their ownership group. Under NFL rules, the group can contain no more than 25 investors and the principal owner must hold at least a 30 percent stake. The sale price represents a 59 percent increase over the $6.05 billion that a group led by private equity investor Josh Harris paid to buy the Commanders from Daniel Snyder in 2023, the previous NFL record. Khosla, 71, is the co-founder of Sun Microsystems and the founder of Khosla Ventures. Forbes estimates his net worth at $13.4 billion. The new owners inherit one of the NFL’s most stable and successful franchises, with a devoted fan base, a front office overseen on the football-operations side by widely respected executive John Schneider, and a well-regarded coach in Mike Macdonald. The Seahawks beat the Patriots in February in Santa Clara, Calif., for their second Super Bowl title under the Allen family’s ownership. Allen purchased an option in 1996 to buy the franchise from Ken Behring and completed the $194 million deal in 1997. He died in 2018. Allen directed that the Seahawks and the NBA team that he owned, the Trail Blazers, be sold and the proceeds donated to charity. His sister, Jody Allen, served as the Seahawks’ de facto owner after his death, as trustee of her brother’s trust. The estate announced following the Super Bowl that it had commenced the sale process for the Seahawks, overseen by investment bank Allen & Company and law firm Latham & Watkins. The Seahawks are scheduled to host the NFL’s season-opening game Sept. 9 against the Patriots at Lumen Field in Seattle. “I also have to say you have great timing,” Goodell said, addressing the Khosla family directly. “It’s not very often you can buy a Super Bowl championship team. But you’ve done that. Many of our owners struggle to find ways to get in the Super Bowl and win a trophy. And you’ll be walking into your new building shortly with a fresh, shiny trophy there for you.” The post NFL Owners Unanimously Approve $9.6 Billion Seahawks Sale appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles._body: With the recent trend of NFL players wanting to go back to college to play, the NFL is stepping in and bringing clarity to the rules surrounding the matter, according to ESPN’s Adam Schefter. “Sources: The NFL will provide clarity to clubs later today regarding league rules governing player eligibility that have been in place and remain unaltered. A player that goes back to college this season will be prohibited from signing with an NFL team this year. A player signed to an NFL contract who is subsequently cut is a free agent. He may sign with another NFL club, the CFL or return to college, but that player is considered a free agent and will not be subject to a future draft,” Schefter wrote on X, formerly Twitter. articles.title: The inside story on why OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face
articles.summary: The models responsible for last month’s agent hack of Hugging Face had been inadvertently trained to cheat and to communicate with each other, according to an OpenAI technical report released today. The hack, which a group of agents undertook to find solutions for a cybersecurity test that they were
articles._body: The models responsible for last month’s agent hack of Hugging Face had been inadvertently trained to cheat and to communicate with each other, according to an OpenAI technical report released today . The hack, which a group of agents undertook to find solutions for a cybersecurity test that they were stuck on, has confirmed some experts’ fears that AI models might take actions that defy human desires and expectations. Since the hack, OpenAI employees—as well as researchers at the AI evaluation nonprofit METR, which released its own report on the hack today—have worked to understand what went wrong and how similar missteps might be prevented in the future. OpenAI has already put some preventative measures in place based on what they discovered. But making sure AI models do what we want them to do, or “alignment,” remains a gnarly problem, and some of the root causes of the hack will take much longer than a month to resolve. “It’s not something you can solve overnight,” says Kai Chen, who runs OpenAI’s alignment research team. “There are challenges we’ve been tracking for a very long time, and we’re now seeing them with much greater precision.” The Hugging Face hack was a product of months of misbehavior from OpenAI agents, first as they were being trained and then as their abilities were being evaluated. This May, agents in training figured out how to use OpenAI’s infrastructure to communicate with one another and get support with difficult training tasks, including some that were impossible to solve without hacking or otherwise misbehaving. That “message board” was shut down. Then in July, while being evaluated for their cybersecurity abilities, some models created a new message board. They were supposed to be isolated from the internet, but by working together they managed to get online, hack Hugging Face, and obtain solutions for the cybersecurity problems that had stumped them. Based on their investigation, OpenAI researchers believe that events during the training phase led directly to the hack. “For almost every behavior that was worrisome at evaluation time, [we were able to] find some sort of associated behavior at training time that actually we think might have contributed to it,” says Eric Wallace, a member of OpenAI’s alignment research team.  When models correctly solve problems during training, the behaviors that led them to that solution are reinforced, and they become more likely to engage in them in the future. So if a model completed a task in May after using the original message board, it became more likely to participate in a new message board later on. This phenomenon, where AI agents misbehave in ways that are reinforced during the training process, is known as reward hacking . Reward hacking also helps to explain why the models worked so hard to make their way onto the internet. During its investigation of the incident, the OpenAI team found that, over the course of training, the models became more and more likely to probe their digital environment for weaknesses and use the tools at their disposal in unexpected ways—a sign that these behaviors were being gradually reinforced. By the time the models were facing tricky cybersecurity problems, they had learned that hacking was an effective way to achieve their goals. These results suggest that the Hugging Face hack could have been avoided if the models weren’t rewarded for misbehaving during training. While researchers don’t yet know how to prevent reward hacking entirely, OpenAI is taking some steps toward mitigating its effects. The company will now look for signs of cheating in all frontier models during training by keeping an eye on their chains of thought —internal notepads where they sketch out their answers and plan their actions.  This solution isn’t as much of a slam dunk as it might seem: In earlier research , OpenAI showed that punishing models that mention cheating in their chains of thought teaches them to keep their intentions hidden from researchers. But monitoring its models’ thinking does give OpenAI the chance to halt the training process and reassess its approach if models do start learning to reward hack. If OpenAI stops reinforcing reward hacking in its models—and that’s a huge “if”—that would be a huge step forward. But it wouldn’t solve the alignment problem. The first time a model communicated with other agents or hacked its infrastructure during training, those behaviors had never been reinforced, so agent misbehavior can’t only be attributed to that reinforcement. Jeffrey Ladish, director of the AI safety nonprofit Palisade Research, compares the agents to a human who commits their first financial crime. “It’s not like they had to do fraud before to figure out that fraud is an effective strategy, and you have the same problem with models,” Ladish says. “Alignment science needs to be understanding how model motivations get shaped, such that we can actually figure out how to get models to care about the consequences of their actions.” OpenAI’s researchers do have a hypothesis for where some of the misbehavior originated. Before the models formed their first secret message board, they had been trained to communicate and coordinate with subagents—less powerful agents to whom a main agent can delegate tasks.  That learned communication behavior could have transferred to this new setting. The METR report, which investigates the messages that the models sent to one another in detail, supports this hypothesis: One agent on the message board took charge and assigned tasks to the other agents, effectively treating them as subagents. OpenAI could try to prevent agents from secretly communicating with one another by not training this subagent behavior in the future, but that would make the models less useful.  This tension between capability and safety is at the heart of what went wrong with the Hugging Face incident. articles.title: Eric Clapton and John Mayer Join Forces for Limited-Edition Guitar Collection in Aid of Charity: Shop Here
articles.summary: Proceeds from the collection will benefit Crossroads Centre Antigua, the addiction treatment center founded by Eric Clapton in 1998.
articles._body: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes. Eric Clapton is giving guitar collectors a reason to make room on the wall. Today (Aug. 26), Guitar Center unveiled its 2026 exclusive Crossroads guitar collection , with limited-edition guitars across five models. The line-up was created in collaboration with Clapton and includes a new John Mayer x PRS Silver Sky . Mayer will debut the model onstage at this year’s Crossroads Guitar Festival in Austin, Texas. Previous Clapton-exclusive guitars have been a hot commodity at Guitar Center, with the remake of the singer’s 2006 “Blackie” flying off the shelves in just four hours, the fastest-selling guitar launch at that time. Almost two decades later, in 2025, the Gibson Custom Eric Clapton 1958 Les Paul sold out in under 12 hours. Shop collection at guitar center The new collection arrives Aug. 26 at Guitar Center stores nationwide and online . Fans at the 2026 Crossroads Guitar Festival from Sept. 26-27 can also shop the collection at The Guitar Center Experience, alongside Clapton’s original “Blackie” and other Legends Collection instruments. SIGNATURE ACOUSTIC Martin 000-13E Eric Clapton (Natural) $1,899.99 Buy Now at guitar center Available at Guitar Center until Jan. 27, 2027. The Martin 000-13E brings Clapton’s signature acoustic formula to a more attainable price point. Its compact 000 body reflects a shape he has favored for decades, and comes in antique toner natural and 1935 sunburst. JOHN MAYER COLLAB PRS John Mayer Silver Sky $3,750.00 Buy Now at guitar center Only 70 of these guitars will be produced, making it one of the collection’s most limited releases. Created in partnership with John Mayer , the PRS Silver Sky is the collection’s wildcard. Finished in incline blue, the guitar features a rosewood fretboard, a custom “Crossroads Sun” inlay at the 12th fret and a festival-specific neck plate. Mayer will bring the guitar model to the stage for the first time at the 2026 Crossroads Guitar Festival. 1969 REPLICA Fender Blind Faith Telecaster $4,999.99 Buy Now at guitar center A total of 130 will be sold. Clapton’s famous Blind Faith guitar gets a meticulous Fender re-creation. What makes it stand out is its combination of a Telecaster custom body with a replica 1956 “Brownie” Stratocaster neck, mimicking the guitar Clapton played during Blind Faith’s legendary 1969 Hyde Park performance. TWO FINISHES Martin Custom 000-42 Eric Clapton Ziricote (Natural & Sunburst) $9,699.99 Buy Now at guitar center Only 100 made. For collectors looking for something considerably more exclusive, Martin’s 000-42 pairs Clapton’s preferred 000 shape with ziricote wood, prized for its distinctive grain and tonal qualities. Only 50 guitars will be made in each of the two finishes, 1935 Sunburst and Clear Natural. SIGNED BY CLAPTON Martin Custom 000-42 Eric Clapton (Brazilian) $24,999.99 Buy Now at guitar center Exceptionally rare and limited to just five worldwide. Crafted with Brazilian rosewood back and sides plus a solid Adirondack spruce top, the Martin 000-42 Eric Clapton Brazilian features Clapton’s favored 000 body shape. Each guitar is personally signed by Eric Clapton and includes a Certificate of Authenticity, making it a remarkable collector’s piece. As well as guitars, Clapton is also getting his first signature string set made in collaboration with Ernie Ball for $29.99. The limited-edition release includes three sets of Slinky 10–46 strings in a collectible commemorative tin. Only 5,000 tins are being produced, exclusively for Guitar Center, as part of the 2026 Crossroads guitar collection. Guitar Center’s Clapton connection dates back to 2004, when the company acquired several historic instruments at the Crossroads guitar auction , including “Blackie,” Clapton’s Cream-era Gibson ES-335, and George Harrison’s Martin 00-21. Those guitars now form part of the retailer’s Legends Collection at its Hollywood flagship. Proceeds made from the 2026 Crossroads guitar collection will go to the Crossroads Centre Antigua, a treatment and education center founded by Clapton in 1998 for people affected by chemical and alcohol dependency. articles.title: mikako of Nagie Lane on the Mind-Set for Living Amid Diversity, Cultivated in Vienna: Billboard Japan Women In Music Interview
articles.summary: mikako spoke with Billboard Japan about the sense of gender equity she's developed after spending her childhood in Vienna.
articles._body: Billboard Japan spoke with Nagie Lane member mikako, the multilingual musician who emceed the Women In Music – EQUAL STAGE event held in June, for the latest WIM interview. Japan’s WIM initiative launched in 2022 to celebrate artists, producers and executives who have made significant contributions to music and entertainment and inspired other women through their work, following the footsteps of Billboard’s annual WIM honors. This interview series featuring female players in the Japanese entertainment industry is one of the highlights of Japan’s WIM project. Presented by Billboard Japan and Spotify, the Women In Music – EQUAL STAGE event took place at SGC Hall Ariake in Tokyo on June 9, featuring a star-studded all-female lineup. Beyond her impressions of this event, mikako spoke about the sense of gender equity she’s developed after spending her childhood in Vienna and her mindset around working in a mixed-gender group. You emceed the live event Women In Music – EQUAL STAGE in June. Could you start by telling us your impressions of the day? I felt it was a really meaningful event. First of all, it became a chance for me to look back on things I’d experienced because I’m a woman — moments where I thought, “Wait, that was actually kind of uncomfortable,” or things that had stuck with me. Personally, when something unpleasant happens to me, I tend to try to forget it quickly or just let it slide more often than not. But when this event set out to get us thinking about gender equity for women, it made me realize, “Maybe there are other people who’ve felt this too.” It was a really good opportunity to feel that I’m not alone. In particular, I thought the very act of inviting artists who are active on the world stage and holding an event like that is a big statement in itself, a good message to send. I was happy to serve as emcee, and I hope this continues going forward. If you don’t mind sharing, could you tell us more about what you meant by things that “stuck with you”? There’s this idea in society that women are quick to become emotional. I’ve actually seen dramas that deal with that as a theme. Personally, in important discussions for example, I’ve had moments where my voice trembled a bit or I nearly cried. But when that happens, I’ve worried that I’d just be seen as being emotional, and that my actual point wouldn’t be treated as an equal opinion. So in those kinds of settings, I’ve tried to put on a strong front. Maybe I was overly conscious of it, but after hearing the phrase “women are quick to become emotional” over the course of my life, I noticed there was a part of me that tried not to fit that mold. At Women In Music – EQUAL STAGE, ATARASHII GAKKO!, Hitsujibungaku, LANA, and Awich performed live. What messages did you take away from their and performances and comments onstage? Everyone was so powerful, and what they had in common was that each of them had a message they wanted to convey. ATARASHII GAKKO! said in their interview that their concept is “ hamidashi ” (going beyond) and not “ marudashi ” (anything goes). That’s exactly what they showed through their music and performance — how to stay true to yourself while still working within the rules. I thought it was really cool how Hitsujibungaku made a point of being candid, saying, “We’re figuring it out too,” while laying that bare through such a powerful sound. LANA said that she doesn’t put on airs, and I felt that’s exactly what came through. Awich said she wanted to fully convey the strength and love that came from her own lived experience. All four acts put 120% of themselves into that stage, and I had so much respect for them as artists. When people like that let their performance carry words and expressions that remind you, “They’re human, just like me,” their passion and feelings come through directly, and I was deeply moved watching from the wings. There are as many different forms of expression as there are people in the world, and that’s true whether you’re an artist or not. Just getting to see four different types of expression in that one day carries a lot of meaning on its own. It felt like proof that all we need to do is shine as ourselves, and I thought that was wonderful. Nagie Lane is a mixed-gender group. In the course of your work, is there ever a moment where you become conscious of being a woman? Nagie Lane is a chorus group now, but we started out as an a cappella group. The original lineup was three men and three women, and back then, there was a time I wondered whether I should be showing more “feminine” qualities. But having grown up in Vienna, I hadn’t really been exposed to what’s generally considered “kawaii” (cute) in Japan, so I wasn’t very conscious of that to begin with. I also felt that it just wasn’t tied to who I really am, so I dropped that idea pretty early on. So there was a time early on when I wondered, “Maybe I should look more feminine — skirts, cute clothes, that sort of thing?” but then realized, “I was never really drawn to that in the first place,” and settled on, “I’ll just be myself.” I like dancing and moving around onstage, so if you ask what “mikako-like” means, it’s definitely pants, and that’s why my stage costume is pants-based. Nagie Lane formed in 2018, and though the lineup has changed a few times, you’ve been with the group from the start. What have you valued in order to keep going? Keeping a group going can be difficult. But that’s only natural, right? You have people who were born in different places and raised in different environments coming together, so their ways of thinking are different, and even with a shared goal, everyone’s approach to getting there is different. articles.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s ‘Setsuna Hanabi’ Tops Japan Hot 100
articles.summary: AKB48's "Suki-ish" bows at No. 2.
articles._body: TOMORROW X TOGETHER ‘s “Setsuna Hanabi” debuts at No. 1 on the Billboard Japan Hot 100 , on the chart released Aug. 26. The title track of the group’s fifth Japan single dropped Aug. 19 and ruled both radio airplay and downloads while moving 420,878 physical copies for No. 2 on sales. The song also lands at No. 13 for streaming and No. 21 for video views. AKB48’s “Suki-ish” bows at No. 2. The title track of the group’s 68th single was released Aug. 19 and marked the week’s highest physical sales with 765,977 copies sold. EBiDAN’s “Yes! Tokyo” falls to No. 3 but continues to dominate video with several member-group “ taiken nyugaku ” (experience enrollment) versions also continuing to climb — the GNJB version rises 46-37, the Bullet Train version 66-50, and the ONE N’ ONLY version 80-62. Kento Nakajima’s “ONIGOTO” debuts at No. 4. The opener for the anime series The Elusive Samurai Season 2 launched with 90,112 copies to hit No. 3 for sales while also placing No. 4 for downloads. Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s “Brand New” — the theme song for Japan’s dubbed version of Spider-Man: Brand New Day — slips to No. 5 while retaining its No. 1 position on streaming for another week. M!LK’s “Sukisugite Metsu!” follows at No. 6, Spitz’s “Mishiranu Ito” at No. 7 (No. 2 for downloads), and ILLIT’s “It’s Me” at No. 8. Kenshi Yonezu’s “IRIS OUT” sits at No. 11, reaching a cumulative total of 49 weeks on the Japan Hot 100. Fujifabric’s “Wakamono no Subete” (2008) climbs 78-43 with radio airplay landing at No. 15 — a testament to the track’s enduring momentum more than 11 years after its release. Wasureranneyo’s “Nanmonee” debuts at No. 55, placing No. 13 for video and No. 19 for downloads. articles.title: Inside Boise State ahead of Memphis’ Week Two matchup
articles.summary: Memphis heads to Boise Sept. 12 for the second-ever meeting between these programs. A breakdown of Boise State's quarterback, its dominant backfield and a defense undergoing a overhaul.
articles._body: For Week 2 Memphis heads to Boise Sept. 12 for the second-ever meeting between these programs, the first to be played at Albertsons Stadium, and another early test for Charles Huff ’s team as Boise State opens its Pac-12 era at home. The Tigers won the first meeting in 2023, 35-32, rallying from a 17-0 deficit. This will be Boise State’s home opener after opening its season at Oregon. The Broncos will be looking to strike back against a Memphis team that might be even more dangerous than it was three years ago. Boise State’s still winning, even after leaving the Mountain West The Broncos went 9-5 last season and captured their third straight Mountain West title before jumping to the Pac-12. Boise State is the preseason favorite to win its new conference, led by 2024 Mountain West Coach of the Year Spencer Danielson (24-8 all-time record), who has won a title in each of his first three seasons. Danielson looks to bring those winning habits into a revamped Pac-12, as Boise State also returns most of its coaching staff, alongside two new co-coordinators. Zak Hill was promoted to co-offensive coordinator after Matt Miller left for Washington State, while Terrance Brown arrived from Cal as co-defensive coordinator after Tyler Stockton departed for Michigan. A quarterback good enough to win the Mountain West, but can he beat the big boys?    Quarterback Maddux Madsen is entering his third year as the starter, and when you look at his quality of wins, it tells two different stories. As a starter, he has an overall record of 20-6 and is 14-1 against Mountain West opponents but 0-4 against Power Four teams, with two touchdowns and nine interceptions in those four losses. The 23-year-old passers’ completion percentage dipped to 58 last season after being at 62 in 2024, and he missed three games with a lower-leg injury. Tigers fans may remember Madsen from that 2023 game, as he went 11-of-14 for 175 yards and two touchdowns as a redshirt freshman against Memphis. Madsen is in his senior season and has shown that he can do damage with his legs, putting up 423 rushing yards and 11 touchdowns across 26 career games. Teams that have had success against Boise State stop the run. The numbers show how important Boise State’s run game is to Madsen. In his 20 career wins as a starter, the Broncos have averaged 238.9 rushing yards per game. In his six losses, that number drops to 116.7. Memphis will try to follow this trend and make Madsen beat them through the air, which will be a tougher ask for the senior passer this year. Boise State lost its top four pass-catchers from a season ago, leaving junior Cameron Bates as the most proven name in the room aside from the transfers. Last season Bates hauled in 17 receptions for 302 yards and a touchdown, this year he will look to expand on that production and be a potential go-to target for Madsen. Possibly best backfield in the conference The biggest strength on this roster, like many Boise State teams over the years, is the running back room. Junior Dylan Riley and sophomore Sire Gaines were both preseason first-team all-Pac-12 picks. A year ago, Riley ran for 1,125 yards and 10 touchdowns, while Gaines added 811 yards and nine scores. Both return for the Broncos and both should be in the mix for Pac-12 Offensive Player of the Year. Up front, Boise State returns three starters, including fifth-year guard Roger Carreon , a preseason all-conference pick himself. The left side is a question mark, with Kage Casey off to the Denver Broncos and a new starter needed at left tackle. This is an offense bringing back a lot of familiar pieces and hoping it can be more effective and efficient than last year. In the Broncos’ five losses last season, they scored a combined 38 points and were shut out in the second half in four of those five games. Memphis will look to repeat that pattern and make it a long day for Boise State. A defense undergoing a overhaul Last season Boise State’s pass rush took a significant step back, with sacks falling from 55 in 2024 to 27 a year ago, and edge rusher Jayden Virgin-Morgan is one of the few proven pieces up front under defensive coordinator Erik Chinander . The secondary is almost entirely new as well, with only senior Jaden Mickey returning as a starter from last year. Boise State lost multiple key players and turned to the portal to replace it, landing juniors from South Dakota in Roman Tillmon at safety and Kennesaw State’s JeRico Washington Jr . at cornerback. Tillmon racked up 94 total tackles a season ago, while Washington Jr. defended 11 passes and forced two fumbles for the Conference USA champions. Boise State’s pass defense was one of the better units in the country last season, ranking 15 th nationally at 175.6 yards allowed per game. Despite the roster turnover and 16 new players, including eight recruits and eight transfers, this is still a defense to watch out for under Chinander in his third year as coordinator. What revolves around this game A win in Boise would be a massive boost for the Tigers and their College Football Playoff hopes. The Tigers scheduled this game in hopes of proving that Memphis is an elite G6 program that can compete with the best of the best regardless of conference. They will get a chance to prove that in Week 2. A loss would not be crushing this early in the season, but it would put pressure on the Tigers as they had into a stretch against UT Martin, Charlotte and UAB that Memphis needs to handle. For Boise State, Memphis is exactly the kind of physical, well-coached opponent that gave the Broncos trouble last season in their five losses. How they respond to Memphis after taking on Oregon will say a lot heading into the program’s first Pac-12 season.
