articles.title: Everything South Carolina DC Clayton White said in his first press conference of 2026 season
articles.summary: South Carolina defensive coordinator Clayton White spoke to local media for the first time during preseason camp for the Gamecocks.
articles._body: South Carolina defensive coordinator Clayton White spoke with local media for the first time ahead of the 2026 season. Here is everything he had to say. Have a question for the GamecockCentral staff? Ask it now on The Insiders Forum. Opening Statement “Good afternoon. Just wanted to express excitement coming into the new season. Brand-new year, brand-new season. I’m excited about where we are on the defensive side. Really excited about the football team and just can’t wait to get out there at Williams-Brice Stadium on Saturday, get back under the lights, see our Williams-Brice friends. I’ve got a couple of fans I always speak to, I’m kinda excited to see them when I first walk into the stadium. “Shoutout to Steve Fink, my first press conference without him. What’s up, Steve, I know you’re probably watching it, but miss you, man. Hope you’re enjoying your retirement.” What have you seen of Ethan Johnson and in his tape to convince you guys to get him here? “I think the first thing [is] we looked at our squad, we saw some things that we had some concerns about as far as depth at certain positions. More if something were to happen, who would be the next guy? I think our guys that are behind Judge [Collier] and Vicari [Swain] are doing a great job; we just [needed] to get more bodies there. “Ethan, right now, is in a phase where he’s just making sure his conditioning is good. The past couple of weeks, he’s been job searching. He got word of this stuff last week, so he started back training and working out. Right now, I talked to coach [Luke] Day and our strength staff and [told them to] give him a week in the hole, just conditioning-wise, to make sure he’s good to go. “But he’s doing great, very smart, great human being. Had nothing but high praise from guys who knew him previously, and just the great person that he is, so we’re excited that he’s here.” You’ve seen this defense through two scrimmages now. What have you liked about where you guys are at? “To me, it’s been the resilience. Just being able to — first scrimmage, the first five plays weren’t the standard, but the next 70 probably were. And then the next scrimmage, I kinda liked how we started the scrimmage. To me, it’s not about winning against the offense; it’s about how we operate. The way we take the field, want to look like the veteran defense we are, and I feel like for the most part we were able to do that. “Get some young guys in, give them a chance to run around the stadium, make some plays, but for the guys that have been around here, they kind of know the standard of how we approach those preseason games. We don’t call them scrimmages; we call them preseason games because we want that mindset to be there. Very proud of how they’ve been resilient of some things and love how they responded.” What have you seen from the young guys at defensive end? “Yeah, I thought that room has done a really good job. The young guys, to me, are in their first or second season, or you’ve never played significant downs at Williams-Brice; I considered those guys as young players. I think those guys are flashing; they’re playing the run and the pass. I think Coach [Deion] Barnes and Coach [Kevin] Hubbard are doing a good job of getting those guys ready to go every day. It’s not about rushing the pass all the time. You gotta understand backfield sets and the big picture part of defense and Anthony Addison, Julian Walker, Jaquavious Dodd, all those young guys, Drew Collins — that young crew right there is doing a really good job.” With having Justin Okoronkwo, Shawn Murphy and Fred “JayR” Johnson back, what’s the benefit of having them back for an extra year? “Hope you felt the smile when you said those three linebackers. I mean, that’s all you can do when you think about how they practice every single day. Coach [Trey] Money has taken the bull by the horns, and those guys have been responding to everything we’ve been doing since we’ve been here. So, just credit to Coach Money for getting those guys right, and a lot of credit to those guys, just trying to be leaders on defense, taking that role to the next level. It’s fun watching them; it’s fun in the meeting room. Those guys are doing an outstanding job, and I think the team is realizing that is a good group and kind of wants to emulate that at times.” What does experience allow you as a defensive coordinator to do in the preseason? “During preseason, you’re able to frontload the install because guys either [have] been around a lot of football, and you can kind of frontload the brain, frontload the learning. It’s all about getting them ready to play, the readiness to play the game on Saturday, and you can’t just sit back and install two things a day. You have to kind of think of every day as a semi-gameplan, and I’m able to do that with the older group because they want that challenge. They want to be able to be pushed in the meeting room, in the classroom, on the field, in walkthroughs. “You’ve got to keep it very active for those guys because that’s the best way to learn the game. Once you get game week, it gets more dialed into situations and all that good old stuff, and it just makes you better for the fall.” I know you guys are looking for that fourth linebacker. Is that something you’ve seen some separation there? “Yeah, I do feel there’s some separation there, and I feel like to me Rish [Jamaian Risher Jr.] has been the clear-cut. He’s done an outstanding job the past couple years, to be honest with you. Very serious guy, understands our defense, he plays MIKE and WILL. articles.title: Chargers player on roster bubble with most at stake in 2026 NFL preseason finale
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Chargers will finalize their initial 53-man roster next week, and Thursday night’s preseason finale against the Los Angeles Rams represents one final opportunity for players on the bubble to save their jobs. Nobody may have more at stake than Trevor Penning. The Chargers acquired
articles._body: The Los Angeles Chargers will finalize their initial 53-man roster next week, and Thursday night’s preseason finale against the Los Angeles Rams represents one final opportunity for players on the bubble to save their jobs. Nobody may have more at stake than Trevor Penning . The Chargers acquired the former New Orleans Saints first-round pick last season, hoping a change of scenery would help him revive his career. Instead, Penning has done little to prove he deserves a place on Los Angeles’ offensive line. He entered training camp with a chance to compete for the starting left guard position. That opportunity appears to have slipped away. Even after center Tyler Biadasz suffered a season-ending injury , Penning has not emerged as a serious option at left guard. His absence from the competition is particularly concerning because Los Angeles now needs to devote another roster spot to a backup center. Every offensive-line spot matters, and Penning does not offer the positional value the Chargers suddenly need. Chargers’ need for two centers could cost Trevor Penning his roster spot Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Jake Slaughter is expected to take over as the starting center following Biadasz’s injury. Preseason star Jacob Spomer could claim the final offensive-line position as Slaughter’s backup, giving the Chargers necessary insurance at one of the offense’s most important positions. That leaves Penning competing for a spot without a clear role. My projected nine offensive linemen for Los Angeles’ initial roster are Joe Alt, Trey Pipkins III, Rashawn Slater, Cole Strange, Jacob Spomer, Kayode Awosika, Jake Slaughter, Travis Burke, and Branson Taylor. Alt and Slater are locked in as the franchise’s starting tackles, while Strange also offers the group valuable experience at right guard, though not long-term. Slaughter’s expected promotion and Spomer’s value as another center make both difficult to leave off the roster. Meanwhile, Pipkins III, Awosika, and Taylor remain involved in the left guard competition. Chargers coaches have indicated that Awosika currently has the advantage , although the job does not appear to be settled entering the preseason finale. Penning’s name is noticeably absent from that battle. For a former first-round pick who was brought in to compete for an interior job, that is a major problem. Draft status can create extra opportunities, but it cannot secure a roster spot forever. Trevor Penning needs a DOMINANT preseason finale against Rams Penning’s path to the roster is narrow, but it has not disappeared completely. Thursday’s game will give him one final chance to remind the Chargers why they traded for him. He must display the power that once made him a first-round prospect while avoiding the penalties and inconsistent technique that have followed him throughout his career. The Rams game will also help determine the winner of the left guard competition and which reserve linemen survive roster cuts. If the starters participate, they will likely play no more than a couple of series or one quarter. That would leave plenty of snaps for Los Angeles to evaluate its depth. Penning needs to make every one of those snaps count. He must be perfect. His versatility at tackle and guard could still appeal to the Chargers, especially given how quickly injuries can damage an offensive line. But versatility means little if the coaching staff does not trust him at either position. If Penning fails to impress Thursday, Los Angeles should prioritize Spomer’s ability to play center and the linemen who have performed better at guard. A release would not necessarily end Penning’s NFL career. His age, size, and status as a former first-round pick would almost certainly generate interest from another team searching for offensive-line depth. The question is whether he has done enough to remain with this one. Penning arrived in Los Angeles with an opportunity to repair his career. Entering the final preseason game, he may be one disappointing performance away from needing another fresh start. articles.title: Cayden Daughtry is down to 14 schools (yes, 14!) with Kentucky still in the mix
articles.summary: When you go on one of the most absurd runs in the history of travel basketball, you deserve to release one of the most absurd list cuts in the history of high school recruiting. Don’t ask questions, just let Cayden Daughtry do his thing — his way tends to work just fine. The five-star gu
articles._body: When you go on one of the most absurd runs in the history of travel basketball, you deserve to release one of the most absurd list cuts in the history of high school recruiting. Don’t ask questions, just let Cayden Daughtry do his thing — his way tends to work just fine. The five-star guard dropped a final 14 on Wednesday, stressing just how hectic his recruitment has been since going nuclear at Peach Jam back in July. That group includes Mark Pope and the Kentucky Wildcats, cutting down from over 30 scholarship offers to leave the following contenders: Arkansas Florida Florida State Iowa Kentucky Louisville Miami Michigan Providence Tennessee UConn USC Vanderbilt Villanova Joe Tipton of Rivals was the first to break the news. Daughtry has visited Miami (FL) and Michigan unofficially while scheduling officials to Florida State (Aug. 28-30) and Iowa (Sept. 12-14) to begin his fall tour. The 6-0, 160-pound point guard finished the EYBL regular season with a circuit-leading 25.6 PPG to go with 6.0 APG, 5.2 RPG and 1.8 SPG on 55/34/90 shooting splits, then somehow managed to top it in North Augusta, exploding for 32.3 PPG, 6.1 APG, 4.9 RPG and 2.9 SPG while inexplicably improving his splits at 59/49/91 in eight dominant outings with just one single game under 30 points. He announced an offer from Kentucky back in May following a red-hot start to the spring — only a preview of what was to come the rest of the way. “It was definitely very cool, just being the first blue-blood offer I’ve ever gotten,” Daughtry told KSR+ at the time. “Being able to talk to Mo Williams, he’s a pretty legendary guy, especially since he was a guard like me. He told me that when he was watching me, he basically saw himself in me. It’s definitely very cool. I got to see the opportunity, and I’ll definitely see him down the road.” We’ll see what that means regarding an official visit this fall, but for now, the Wildcats remain in the mix for the most electric scoring guard in high school basketball.

articles.title: Why this insider would be hesitant to immediately make Edwin Diaz Dodgers’ closer again
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have been up and down in recent weeks, dropping the first game of their series vs the Atlanta Braves on Tuesday evening. Reliever Edwin Diaz has been on the injured list recently due to a neck issue, which occurred after he struggled following his return from a different i
articles._body: The Los Angeles Dodgers have been up and down in recent weeks, dropping the first game of their series vs the Atlanta Braves on Tuesday evening. Reliever Edwin Diaz has been on the injured list recently due to a neck issue, which occurred after he struggled following his return from a different injury. Now, MLB insider Tom Verducci broke down why he wouldn’t be in a rush to bring Diaz back if he were Los Angeles. “The arm is down a little bit from where it was last year, but to me, I’ve got to find him a runway to get him back confidence-wise and stuff-wise. He’s got to establish strike one, show hitters he can land that slider in the zone. So I’m not just handing him the job there,” he said, per Foul Territory on X, formerly Twitter. Diaz had spent a good chunk of the year sidelined with a different injury before returning and looking like a shell of the New York Mets star that the Dodgers thought they were signing in free agency last year. Of course, Los Angeles still has plenty of other options at its disposal for the closing role, so if Diaz is unable to round back into form before the playoffs arrive, it wouldn’t be a shock to see Dave Roberts and company turn in a different direction for the playoffs. The Dodgers are one of two teams in the MLB with 80 or more wins this season, along with the Milwaukee Brewers, and will look to get hot at the right time ahead of the playoffs. Los Angeles will continue its season on Wednesday on the road against the Braves. articles.title: AEW’s Tony Khan reveals whether or not he really would’ve let Edge wrestle John Cena
articles.summary: One of the notable omissions from John Cena’s WWE retirement tour was Edge, but AEW’s Tony Khan would’ve let Adam Copeland wrestle him. Speaking to Metro, Khan said that he was open to letting Copeland return to WWE for a one-off match against Cena. However, he never received th
articles._body: One of the notable omissions from John Cena’s WWE retirement tour was Edge , but AEW’s Tony Khan would’ve let Adam Copeland wrestle him . Speaking to Metro, Khan said that he was open to letting Copeland return to WWE for a one-off match against Cena. However, he never received the call and was adamant about that. “I was never asked, and as far as I know, Adam was never asked, so it’s hard to say. But when there have been opportunities to collaborate, I have been collaborative in the past,’ he pointed out. Kahn even said that he would “not have undermined” any arrangement if both sides had come to an agreement. It just never came through. Why didn’t AEW’s Adam Copeland/Edge wrestle John Cena during his WWE retirement tour? Joe Camporeale-Imagn Images. Edge didn’t get to wrestle Cena because, according to Khan, WWE never inquired about the AEW star. Edge, who now goes by his real name, Adam Copeland, is part of AEW’s roster. He left WWE in 2023. Cena, meanwhile, got to face a lot of his greatest foes during his retirement tour. He ran it back with matches against the likes of CM Punk, Randy Orton, and AJ Styles. However, he had a long history with Edge while he was in WWE. After all, he cashed in his first Money in the Bank contract on Cena to win his first world championship. They would feud for years until the “Rated-R Superstar’s” initial retirement in 2011. Cena’s farewell tour took place in 2025, going from the Monday Night RAW on Netflix premiere in January to the December edition of Saturday Night’s Main Event. His final match took place on Dec. 13. He lost to Gunther in his last match at Saturday Night’s Main Event, tapping out for the first time in years to the “Ring General.” The post AEW’s Tony Khan reveals whether or not he really would’ve let Edge wrestle John Cena appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: SEC presidents formally vote to codify NFL player ban, penalties for infractions
articles.summary: The SEC presidents formally voted today to confirm the penalties for playing a former NFL player outlined in reporting earlier in the day by On3’s Wilson Alexander. The league vote was 15-0 in favor of the ban and subsequent penalties, with LSU abstaining from the vote, according to ESPN&#8217
articles._body: The SEC presidents formally voted today to confirm the penalties for playing a former NFL player outlined in reporting earlier in the day by On3’s Wilson Alexander . The league vote was 15-0 in favor of the ban and subsequent penalties, with LSU abstaining from the vote, according to ESPN’s Pete Thamel . Violating the new SEC-pro sports rule will result in a coach suspension of 50% of contests and a hefty fine, Alexander has confirmed. The fine will amount for 50% of that sport’s annual operating budget, and the head coach’s suspension will include all coaching, recruiting and administrative duties. The punishment is similar to the one the NCAA has in place for “ghost transfers,” or players who leave one school for another without entering the transfer portal . [ $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage ] The SEC was not the only conference to implement such a restriction. The Big Ten also has decided to pass a rule that will prevent players in the NFL from returning to college, while the Big 12 voiced unanimous support for a similar ban. Notre Dame has also followed suit. The restrictions come following a flood of former class of 2022 athletes seeking a return to the college ranks after a few court rulings paved the way. Some of the athletes were on NFL teams this fall. LSU, in particular, has been the hotbed for returning prospects. The Tigers have sought to add a small handful of players who fit the bill for the SEC’s new pro sports ban, including former Ole Miss tight end Dae’Quan Wright and former Ole Miss defensive lineman Zxavian Harris . Others, like former Colorado and Oregon State running back Anthony Hankerson and former Florida and LSU defensive end Jack Pyburn , were reportedly considering a similar move . Wright was in NFL training camp for the Cleveland Browns, Harris suited up for the New Orleans Saints, Hankerson was with the Seattle Seahawks and Pyburn remains with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. The SEC action taken Thursday could put a halt to any returns to college, though there are potential legal remedies available to the players that could escalate the situation further. In any case, for now the kibosh has been put on the NFL-to-college pipeline. Formally.

articles.title: Report: NFL to prohibit players that go back to college from signing with an NFL team in the same year
articles.summary: The NFL has put its foot down on players who have decided to leave training camps/preseason rosters to return to the sport of college football. A player that goes back to college this season will be prohibited from signing with an NFL team in the same year, ESPN’s Adam Schefter has reported. A
articles._body: The NFL has put its foot down on players who have decided to leave training camps/preseason rosters to return to the sport of college football. A player that goes back to college this season will be prohibited from signing with an NFL team in the same year, ESPN’s Adam Schefter has reported . A player signed to an NFL contract who is subsequently cut, such as former Cleveland Browns tight end Dae’Quan Wright (who played CFB at Ole Miss ) was, is considered a free agent. That player will then be allowed to sign with another NFL team, head to the CFL (or another professional football league), or return to college (like Wright did). That player, however, will now be considered a free agent and will not be allowed to enter a future NFL Draft. $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage On Aug. 19, 16 players were granted a temporary restraining order against the NCAA, allowing them to return for the 2026-27 college football season with a fifth year of eligibility. A handful of these players participated in preseason activities with NFL teams, and were now setting their sights on returning to college football. A few of these players included Wright, former Ole Miss defensive lineman Xzavian Harris (was with New Orleans Saints as UDFA), former Oregon State running back Anthony Hankerson (played preseason with Seattle Seahawks), and former SMU running back TJ Harden (also played preseason with Seahawks). SEC joined Big Ten in prohibiting former professionals from returning to college football Wright and Harris have already committed to play for LSU this upcoming season, which would prohibit them from signing with an NFL team in the same calendar year. Whether or not the duo will actually be allowed to suit up for Lane Kiffin ‘s team remains questionable, however, as the SEC passed a rule on Tuesday that prohibits players who have moved on to professional sports from returning to play college sports at an SEC school. Notre Dame has also said it agrees with the Big Ten and SEC , Yahoo! Sports’ Ross Dellenger reported. Additionally, Big 12 athletic directors met Tuesday and voiced unanimous support for a ban on professional athletes returning to play in the conference, per Yahoo! Sports . The conference said commissioner  Greg Sankey  has the authority to enforce the rule, according to a statement from the presidents, chancellors and ADs. “Following meetings with the presidents, chancellors, and athletics directors of the Southeastern Conference, the SEC will enforce the following policy: An SEC institution is NOT permitted to have an athlete on its roster who has: Previously declared for the NFL, NBA, or WNBA DRAFT, and did not appropriately withdraw, Signed a contract with an NFL (or other professional football league), NBA/G-League, or WNBA (or affiliate) team, or Been listed on an NFL (or other professional football league), NBA/G-League, or WNBA (or affiliate roster). “The commissioner is authorized to enforce this expectation with penalties against members institutions,” the statement from the SEC presidents, chancellors and athletic directors said Tuesday night.

articles.title: Dollywood’s Doors Are Open Following Dolly Parton’s Death: ‘The Show Must Go On’
articles.summary: "Together, we honor her by carrying forward her message of love, perseverance, and hope," a statement from the park reads.
articles._body: Dolly Parton ensured that her memory would live on through a number of endeavors during her lifetime, and one of them was her beloved Dollywood. Related Miley Cyrus Mourns Her Godmother Dolly Parton: ‘I Have an Angel by My Side’ Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library Program Honored by Library of Congress: ‘Titan of Children’s Literacy’ Dolly Parton Apologizes For Missing Dollywood Attraction Opening Amid Ongoing Health Issues, Says Doctor ‘Kinda Clipped My Wings’ That’s why the theme park confirmed that it would remain open following her death at the age of 80 on Tuesday (Aug. 25), announcing in a statement on its website that carrying on with operations is exactly what the legendary singer-songwriter had wanted. “With heavy hearts, the Dollywood family mourns the passing of our beloved Dreamer-in-Chief, Dolly Parton,” the message began. “Everyone at Dollywood shares the sorrow of countless people around the world touched by Dolly’s warmth, wisdom and generous spirit. “Dolly’s heartfelt wish was that Dollywood always remain a place of joy, hope and togetherness — a space where families and friends could honor her memory, not with silence, but with laughter, music and shared dreams,” it continued. “Dolly’s enduring legacy extends beyond her music and generosity to her remarkable work ethic — an inspiration to people everywhere. “In her spirit, Dollywood will be open Wednesday as Dolly wanted, always reminding everyone with her signature sparkle — ‘the show must go on,'” the statement added. “Together, we honor her by carrying forward her message of love, perseverance, and hope.” Parton passed away Tuesday after a brief cancer battle. As previously scheduled, Dollywood had been closed on Tuesday, meaning Wednesday (Aug. 26) is the first day the park greeted guests since the loss of Parton. “The greatest privilege of my life has been helping Dolly bring her dreams to life at Dollywood,” said the park’s president, Eugene Naughton, in a statement. “While we grieve her loss, we are honored and committed to carry her light forward. Her legacy will continue to shine in every melody sung, every smile shared and every dream kindled within these gates.” The 10-time Grammy winner founded Dollywood in 1986, when she became co-owner of the property previously known as Rebel Railroad located in Tennessee’s Smoky Mountains, where Parton grew up. The park has blossomed into a booming business, allowing the star to contribute indelibly to the local economy and fuel philanthropic projects such as her Imagination Library and Grow U Program, which offers 100% tuition coverage for Dollywood employees. “As the Scripture says, ‘To whom much is given, much is required,'” Parton told Billboard in her 2020 cover story, which focused in part on her efforts to keep Dollywood on its feet in the face of the COVID-19 pandemic. “So I look at my life with that every day and think that God expects it of me. I expect it of myself, and I think people expect it of me. If I can be an inspiration, then I want to be that. That makes me feel good.” Parton has made frequent visits to the park over the years, including its 40th anniversary celebration in March 2025, which took place less than two weeks after the death of her husband of nearly 60 years, Carl Dean. She was scheduled to appear at Dollywood a couple of weeks prior to her death to support the opening of its new NightFlight Expedition ride, but canceled due to then-unspecified health issues. Still, Parton was her usual chipper self in a video that played on site. “My Nashville doctor has kinda clipped my wings, saying, ‘You ain’t traveling this week,'” she explained to park-goers at the ride’s Aug. 14 opening. “So I guess, if your doctor tells you, ‘you ain’t traveling this week,’ you ain’t traveling this week.”

articles._body: The Chicago Cubs have wanted Ben Brown to get back on the mound for them consistently, but he’s been dealing with some neck issues. Unfortunately, those symptoms recently returned, and it’s uncertain when he’ll return to the team, according to MLB insider Bob Nightengale. “Chicago Cubs pitcher Ben Brown had a return of neck symptoms Tuesday, manager Craig Counsell said, leaving his potential return in question,” Nightengale wrote on X, formerly Twitter. The hope is that Brown can get back sooner rather than later, as he’s been one of the Cubs’ best pitchers this season. The team was working him into the pitching plans, but with this setback, they’ll have to put it to rest for now. After Brown meets with his doctors, there should be more clarity regarding the severity of the injury and how much time he could potentially miss. The Cubs have been hot as of late , and before their recent game against the Arizona Diamondbacks, they scored 19 against the Seattle Mariners and 7 against the Diamondbacks in their series opener. Unfortunately for the Cubs, the Diamondbacks put that to a halt in their second game and handed them a loss. Overall, it’s been a solid season for the Cubs, as they’re currently 76-57 and are in second place in the NL Central. The biggest thing for them is to keep stacking wins down this stretch of the season, and they could find themselves overlapping the Milwaukee Brewers. They’ll need help to do that, but it’s still very possible. The post Cubs’ Craig Counsell shares concerning Ben Brown injury update appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.summary: The Baltimore Ravens could look like a brand new team in 2026. Baltimore’s new offensive coordinator Declan Doyle should bring plenty of schematic changes on that side of the ball. Could that mean a return to MVP form for QB Lamar Jackson? Baltimore’s franchise quarterback was asked h
articles._body: The Baltimore Ravens could look like a brand new team in 2026. Baltimore’s new offensive coordinator Declan Doyle should bring plenty of schematic changes on that side of the ball. Could that mean a return to MVP form for QB Lamar Jackson? Baltimore’s franchise quarterback was asked how much he will run during the 2026 season after Wednesday’s training camp practice. Lamar gave a very honest response to the question. “I believe you know, I know, a lot of people know I was hurt last year too,” Jackson said, per ESPN’s Jamison Hensley. “I really couldn’t do anything I wanted to, you know? So it really wouldn’t put my team in a good position if I was just running hurt. Losing yards, things like that was happening. But whatever it takes to win, that’s what I’m all about and I’ve always been about that too.” Lamar dealt with multiple injuries throughout the 2025 season. He picked up a hamstring sprain early in the season before also suffering a back contusion in December. That is all on top of several other nicks and bruises throughout the meat of the regular season schedule. Jackson was then asked if he thinks 2026 will be like previous seasons as far as running the football. “Whatever it takes to win,” Jackson replied with a big smile on his face. That smile suggests that Jackson does plan to get back to his scrambling ways in 2026. If that does happen, he could become an elite fantasy football asset once again. Remember, Lamar never had fewer than 100 rushing attempts or 695 rushing yards in a single season before 2025. But he only managed 67 rushing attempts last season. That leaves a lot of room for him to rebounds this fall. It will be exciting to see how Jackson looks in Doyle’s new offensive scheme . The Ravens open the regular season with a road game against the Colts on September 13th. articles.title: Phoebe Bridgers Rules Top Rock & Alternative Albums Chart for First Time With ‘Lost Weekend’
articles.summary: Bridgers also charts her first Hot 100 hits without any collaborators.
articles._body: Phoebe Bridgers is No. 1 on Billboard ’s Top Rock & Alternative Albums chart for the first time, as Lost Weekend debuts atop the Aug. 29-dated survey. In its first week, ending Aug. 20, the set earned 124,000 equivalent album units in the United States, according to Luminate. The album’s triumph exceeds the No. 6 debut and peak of Bridgers’ previous solo effort, Punisher , in 2020. In between the two sets, Bridgers appeared in the top 10 as part of Boygenius , alongside Julien Baker and Lucy Dacus ; the band’s debut full-length, The Record , reached No. 2 in 2023. As previously reported , Lost Weekend roars in at No. 2 on the all-genre Billboard 200 , marking Bridgers’ first-time top 40 entry as a solo act. The Dead Oceans label earns its highest-ever Billboard 200 placement. On Top Rock & Alternative Albums, it adds its second No. 1, following Mitski ’s Laurel Hell in 2022. Lost Weekend ’s 83,000 in album sales spark a No. 2 debut on Top Album Sales . Of that sum, 65,000 are vinyl copies, leading to a No. 1 arrival on Vinyl Albums . Concurrently, multiple songs from Lost Weekend reach the Billboard Hot 100 , marking Bridgers’ first tracks to make the chart without billed collaborators, and her first from any of her solo albums. She first appeared on the chart in 2020 with a No. 57-peaking duet cover of Goo Goo Dolls ’ “Iris” with Maggie Rogers . She followed with featured turns on Taylor Swift ’s “Nothing New (Taylor’s Version) (From the Vault)” (No. 43, 2021) and SZA ’s “Ghost in the Machine,” her first top 40 hit (No. 40, 2022). “The Governor’s Waltz” leads the quartet of Lost Weekend Hot 100 entries, starting at No. 80 with 3.8 million chart-eligible streams. “Lost Boys” (No. 85; 3.5 million streams, 2.2 million radio audience impressions), “Bobby” (No. 93; 3.4 million streams) and “Kill Me” (No. 100; 3.3 million streams) follow. On Hot Rock & Alternative Songs , those four songs rank in the top 25 (led by “The Governor’s Waltz” at No. 19), while 13 Lost Weekend tunes infuse the chart. As previously reported , “Lost Boys” hits No. 1 on Adult Alternative Airplay , as Bridgers tops a Billboard airplay chart for the first time solo and second time overall, following Boygenius’ seven-week Adult Alternative Airplay reign with “Not Strong Enough” in 2023.

articles._body: It doesn’t matter the sport — you will get caught if you gamble on sports as a professional athlete. Wednesday is just another example of it. PGA Tour golfer Matt Gogel is the latest professional athlete to get caught placing bets and violating the integrity of the game, the PGA Tour announced. Here is the league’s statement below : “The PGA TOUR announced Wednesday that PGA TOUR Champions member Matt Gogel has been suspended for violating the PGA TOUR Integrity Program. Gogel placed bets on PGA TOUR competition but did not bet on tournaments in which he was a participant. Gogel is suspended from PGA TOUR-sanctioned competition for six months. His suspension began on August 23, 2026, and is through February 22, 2027. Gogel has cooperated fully with the TOUR throughout the process.” Gogel then released a statement of his own . “In 2024 and 2025, I unknowingly violated the PGA TOUR policy by placing small recreational wagers on golf. I want to be clear that these wagers were not placed on regular PGA TOUR events, PGA TOUR Champions events or any tournament in which I participated. I would never knowingly violate the integrity of the game of golf. I made an honest mistake and I look forward to playing in 2027 on the PGA TOUR Champions.” This news comes on a day when LIV Golf is reportedly making major changes. LIV members are being laid off due to the real threat that the league will officially end in the coming days, weeks, or months. It may only be a matter of time. articles.title: Show HN: AI scientist builds an open-source Codex Micro from scratch for $40
articles.summary:
A few weeks ago, we open-sourced our design for a cost-effective but full featured alternative to OpenAI x Work Louder's sold out Codex Micro macropad. And now, we're pleased to share that we've actually built them and they work!

Quick recap of the I/O: - 13 assignable keys with individual LEDs
articles._body: A few weeks ago, we open-sourced our design for a cost-effective but full featured alternative to OpenAI x Work Louder's sold out Codex Micro macropad. And now, we're pleased to share that we've actually built them and they work! Quick recap of the I/O: - 13 assignable keys with individual LEDs - rotary encoder - joystick - touch disc - optional edge-lit LED band The cool part for us was just HOW our agent was able to do it when every other agentic skills, tools, and even commercial platforms failed. We put together a more detailed writeup in the linked blog post (plus pretty pictures!), but long story short, we asked our agentic scientist, Marvin, to treat the electrical engineering as a research problem. Marvin was able to synthesize vast technical documents and best practice guidelines (e.g. scientific literature), test specific placement and routing strategies (e.g. experiments), and selectively backtrack and combine learnings (e.g. interpreting data analysis). The end result was a fully routed board (made especially challenging by some hard constraints to keep cost down) plus a reusable runbook worfklow that demonstrated Marvin's ability to enter an unfamiliar domain, learn and improve through experimentation, and unlock novel capabilities. Some future work we've got marinating in our mind grapes: - an app for cross coding agent compatibility (shoutout to lop1381997 for contributing a codex-native firmware) - optional OLED screen, something like an SSD1306 that could fit right into the space between the knob and joystick - optional base with bluetooth and battery for full wireless functionality Let us know what you think, have any ideas or feature requests, and share pictures if you build it! articles._body: Becky G ’s Baraja Bendita is a blessed draw on Top Latin Pop Albums , as the set opens at No. 2 on the chart dated Aug. 29, marking her first debut on the ranking in over four years. Her fifth studio album also bows at Nos. 7 and 12 on Top Latin Rhythm Albums and Top Latin Albums charts, respectively. Before Baraja Bendita , Becky G managed her first No. 1 on any albums chart through the eight-week chart-topper Esquemas on Top Latin Pop Albums in 2022. Rewind two years, and Mala Santa dealt her another strong hand: the 2019 set debuted and peaked at No. 3 on both Top Latin Albums and Latin Rhythm Albums. A pair of later projects hit the Top Regional Mexican Albums chart: Esquinas (No. 3 in 2023) and Encuentros (No. 9 in 2024). Both also landed top 15 placements on the overall Top Latin Albums ranking. Related Karol G, Judeline & Rusowsky Take ‘BbY WOW’ To No. 1: ‘So Thankful’ Xavi Is First to Lead These 3 Latin Airplay Charts Simultaneously in 2026 Karol G Floods Hot Latin Songs Chart With ‘No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto’ Baraja Bendita starts with 7,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States on the tracking week ending Aug. 20, according to Luminate. Of that batch, streaming activity contributed 5,000 units — equal to 4.6 million official on-demand clicks of the album’s songs. Traditional album sales accounted for 3,000 units, while a negligible amount of activity derived from track-equivalent sales. Baraja Bendita also starts at No. 12 on Top Latin Albums , as her fifth career entry on the overall Latin albums tally. The set further deals her first Top Latin Rhythm Albums entry in nearly seven years, since Mala Santa in 2019. Baraja was ushered in by its second single, “EPA,” which climbed to No. 47 on the hybrid Hot Latin Songs chart in May. As Becky G reclaims upper territory on Top Latin Pop Albums , two tracks from the new album make chart moves of their own: “Chula” debuts at No. 11 on Hot Latin Pop Songs , while “Mal Tiempo” — the set’s lone tropical cut — opens at No. 19 on Hot Tropical Songs .

articles.title: Broncos player on roster bubble with most at stake in 2026 NFL preseason finale
articles.summary: The Denver Broncos have a deep roster with few weaknesses across the board. Their offensive line is one of the best in the NFL, and Jaylen Waddle’s addition made the receiving corps much deeper. Defensively, the team racked up 68 sacks last season, which is the fifth most ever. That illustr
articles._body: The Denver Broncos have a deep roster with few weaknesses across the board. Their offensive line is one of the best in the NFL, and Jaylen Waddle’s addition made the receiving corps much deeper. Defensively, the team racked up 68 sacks last season, which is the fifth most ever. That illustrates not only an elite front seven that can get after opposing quarterbacks, but a star-studded defensive secondary that prevents receivers from getting open. The point is, the Broncos are going to have talent top to bottom when they settle in on their 53-man roster, and some really good players aren’t going to make the cut. The Broncos play the Minnesota Vikings in their final preseason game of the year, and that exhibition game can be make-or-break for players on the roster bubble. So, which fringe roster player needs to show out in the last game before cut-down day? Drew Sanders needs to play and perform if he is to make the team Mike Dinovo-USA TODAY Sports Drew Sanders is firmly on the roster bubble, with the scales likely leaning toward him not making the team, as of now. The Alabama-turned-Arkansas product entered the NFL as a third-round pick in 2023, and there were immediate expectations for the linebacker. Sanders showed flashes as a rookie when he played in 17 games and recorded 24 tackles, but things have been downhill ever since. Sanders tore his achilles in 2024 and missed nearly the entire season, and a foot tendon injury did cost him his entire 2025 campaign. Ahead of training camp this year, the Broncos switched his position from off-ball linebacker to edge rusher. There is tons of competition at the pass-rushing position. Nik Bonitto was a Defensive Player of the Year candidate last year, and Jonathan Cooper is an incredible number two sack artist. Those starting pass rushers are backed up by Jonah Elliss, Que Robinson, and Dondrea Tillman, all of whom had big moments last season. Sanders, meanwhile, is not only learning a new position, but he has again been sidelined because of injury. The Arkansas product has been sidelined since the preseason opener, a game in which he actually showcased his potential with a sack. His injury is undisclosed, and it is unclear if he will be good to go for the third preseason game. If Sanders wants a remote chance of making this team, though, he will have to play against the Vikings. Denver just brought in even more edge-rushing depth with the signing of Ron Stone Jr., a former UFL player who had 9.5 sacks over 19 games with the Columbus Aviators and the Michigan Panthers. The good news for Sanders (not for Broncos Country as a whole) is that it is still unclear whether Cooper will or won’t be suspended. If he is, that could open up an OLB spot on the 53-man roster, which Sanders could earn with a big preseason performance. The talent is there, as the linebacker was a third-round pick for a reason. Sanders had 9.5 sacks during his junior season at Arkansas, and it has just been injuries that have been his demise at the NFL level. It is possible that a big preseason game would be too little, too late, and that is if Sanders can even play against Minnesota. A miraculous comeback and a standout performance, along with a little good luck when it comes to roster construction, just might save Sanders’ career, though. articles.title: DMX Estate Fighting Legal Dispute With Late Rapper’s Friend Over Songs on Decades-Old Tapes
articles.summary: DJ Superior says he’s got a trove of early DMX recordings on cassette tapes. The rapper's estate says releasing them would spark a lawsuit.
articles._body: Six years after DMX ’s death, his estate is quietly battling with a longtime friend and collaborator — over both unreleased recordings and his claim to be a co-writer of DMX’s breakout hit.  DJ Superior (Michael Murray), DMX’s friend from his early days in Yonkers, says he owns many items tied to the star, including VHS videos, handwritten lyric sheets and cassette tapes of never-released tracks. He tried to auction some of them last year, and now he wants to release music he says he co-owns. Related The Beatles’ ‘First Known’ Recording Sparks Legal Battle With UMG: ‘A Highly Valuable Artifact’ Dale Morris, Nashville Manager Who Guided Careers of Alabama & Kenny Chesney, Dies at 89 HYBE Pledges Over $300k for Colombia Earthquake Recovery But in a series of cease-and-desist letters over the past year, obtained by Billboard , attorneys for the DMX estate’s executors have said that’s very much a no-go. They say the physical items actually belong to the estate, and that a streaming release of the music would be grounds for a copyright lawsuit.  “The estate will seek all available relief against Mr. Murray and all others acting in concert with him in connection with this release and any and all other releases of DMX’s work that the estate has not authorized,” lawyers for the DMX estate wrote in a June letter.  In a statement to Billboard , estate manager Ashley Austin reiterated those warnings, saying they had made “substantial good faith efforts” to find a resolution to the dispute but that Superior has been “unreasonable” and that the estate is tasked with “protecting DMX’s legacy.” “Let us be crystal clear: any unreleased DMX material cannot be commercially distributed, published, released or licensed without the estate’s consent,” Austin said. “Mr. Murray and any other party attempting to exploit such material risks legal action.”  Superior’s manager, Jonah Levine , tells Billboard they’re still eager to reach a deal with the estate to release the music, calling it “a piece of history” that ought to be heard by fans: “Our ultimate goal is not to make money, is not peddling our wares. Our goal is to allow Superior’s work to be put out in public.”  DMX (Earl Simmons) soared to stardom in the 1990s with Billboard Hot 100 hits “Ruff Ryders’ Anthem,” “Party Up (Up In Here)” and “What These Bitches Want.” Known for his unusual flow and aggressive delivery, he’s one of the most influential MCs in hip-hop history. He placed 16 different tracks in the Hot 100, and was the first-ever artist to have their first five albums debut atop the Billboard 200 .  Superior says he was there for much of DMX’s rise in the late 1980s and early 1990s, recording “street tapes” with the future star in his Yonkers apartment that they would then sell from the trunks of cars. He says he helped write songs that later became hits, rapped verses on the tapes, and produced many of the tracks on equipment he owned. The pair seemingly had little to no professional relationship during the peak of the rapper’s career, but Superior claims he was in the hospital room in April 2021 on the night DMX died following a heart attack: “I was there in the beginning and at the end,” he said in a 2021 interview . “I loved him.” In the years since his death, DMX’s estate has been run by his ex-fiancée Desiree Lindstrom and his daughter Sasha Simmons (Tashera Simmons, his wife of 16 years before a 2016 divorce, claimed she owned half his IP rights, but a judge rejected that argument last year.) The estate’s affairs are managed by Artist Legacy Group , Austin’s company that oversees rights licensing for late stars like Sam Cooke , Dean Martin and Iggy Pop .  Related 50 Cent to Produce Podcast Hosted by Jadakiss Exploring DMX’s Life Story Three years after DMX’s death, Superior produced a July 2024 live show in Los Angeles called “The Rise of Dark Man X,” where fans could experience “unreleased material recounting the humble beginnings of DMX.” At the bottom of the webpage, a warning read: “Unauthorized show not endorsed by DMX estate. Content is solely that of its creators.” Weeks before that event, Superior had gotten a message from Jessica Wood, a lawyer at the law firm Manatt Phelps & Phillips, on behalf of DMX’s estate executors. The note was cordial by the standards of such letters, but insisted that the DJ disclose what materials he had in his possession and agree not to violate the estate’s intellectual property rights.  “We can assure you that our client, the estate, welcomes your enthusiasm for DMX and the DMX franchise,” Wood wrote. “Further, as a friend of DMX, we are certain that you can understand that the estate must protect the integrity of [DMX’s copyrights and trademarks] so that future generations of fans can enjoy them as well.”  Things got much less friendly in 2025, when Superior tried to auction off DMX-linked items, including lyrics sheets and tapes of unreleased tracks. In a May 2025 letter to the auctioneer, the estate warned that the DJ had “never owned the physical materials” and that DMX had instead only “entrusted” them to him for safekeeping.   In another letter days later, the estate sharply criticized the auction house after it apparently defended the planned sale by suggesting that the estate simply buy back the items. Robert A. Jacobs, another attorney at Manatt and a veteran music litigator, called that suggestion “offensive.”  “That [the auctioneer] and [Superior] seek to auction off important pieces of DMX’s legacy that do not belong to them just to make a buck is problematic enough,” Jacobs wrote. “That [the auctioneer] and [Superior] would do so while asking the Estate to fund their profiteering is shameful.” The DJ quickly backed down. articles._body: Recently, the Indiana Fever improved to 25-14 on the WNBA season with an impressive blowout road win over the Chicago Sky by a score of 113-90 . Caitlin Clark put together an epic game in this one, recording a stat line of 37 points and ten assists on 8-12 shooting from beyond the arc. Now, some reports are coming out about the astonishing viewership numbers the game pulled in for the league. “Wow. Fever-Sky was the highest watched WNBA regular season game since the league’s opening weekend in 1997 (like when the league started), according to the league and NBC. 3.31 million people watched on NBC+Peacock,” reported Mike Vorkunov of The Athletic on X, formerly Twitter. WNBA viewership has steadily increased over the past few years since the arrival of Clark and other young stars in the league, along with the growing profile of women’s basketball as a whole around the globe. Games between the Fever and Sky used to feature the matchup of Clark and former college rival Angel Reese, although Reese is now a member of the Atlanta Dream, which makes it even more odd that it was Sunday’s matchup that ended up garnering the most views. Reese has been putting up some epic stat lines of her own, including recently setting the WNBA record for rebounds in a game, and it wouldn’t be a shock to see the Fever and Dream match up in the WNBA playoffs this year. Meanwhile, Clark and the Fever are looking to continue peaking at the right time ahead of the postseason. The Fever are set to continue their season on Friday with a home game against the Connecticut Sun. articles.summary: The future of LIV Golf has been uncertain for quite some time. There is uncertainty around the future of the league because Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund pullin their financial backing. Adding to the speculation was a cryptic message from Bryson DeChambeau. Now, the league is making
articles._body: The future of LIV Golf has been uncertain for quite some time. There is uncertainty around the future of the league because Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund pullin their financial backing. Adding to the speculation was a cryptic message from Bryson DeChambeau . Now, the league is making another move that casts doubt over the future of LIV Golf, per Joel Beall of Golf Digest. LIV Golf has informed a majority of its staff that their jobs have been terminated as of Wednesday. “The move is not a surprise. In July, leaders informed employees there would be layoffs in the coming months. LIV also filed a Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act notice, which signaled a workforce reduction was possible. The law generally requires businesses with more than 100 employees to provide 60 days of advance notice of potential mass layoffs or plant closings. The United Kingdom has similar layoff notification requirements,” Beall wrote. The layoffs come just days after the LIV season ended after the final tournament of the season was cancelled. “The funding commitment announced by PIF earlier this year will reach its conclusion. As a result, we are scaling back operations as we transition to the next chapter of LIV Golf and work toward making LIV 2.0 a reality. This week, we informed many of our colleagues that their employment under LIV 1.0 will end in the first week of September. We are grateful to our employees for their hard work and dedication in building LIV Golf, and we remain committed to supporting those affected through this transition,” a spokesperson for LIV said in a statement to Golf Digest. The league, which began play in 2022, may not be completely dead overall. LIV Golf previously announced that a new lead investor was in place . Regardless, it was not enough to keep layoffs from happening. The post LIV Golf increasingly uncertain future leads to layoffs being announced appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles._body: Recently, the Chicago Bears unveiled their new “rivalries” uniforms for the upcoming season , which they will be wearing at times along with seven other NFC teams. The news comes with just over two weeks to go until the Bears kick off a 2026 season filled with high expectations after last year’s success under head coach Ben Johnson. Johnson has never been known to care much about trivial things, and recently, he broke down his simple reaction to the team’s new uniforms. “#Bears marketing department should be thrilled with Ben Johnson. He was asked about club’s rivalry uniforms that were unveiled this AM. He didn’t know about them. ‘What uniforms?’ Johnson asked. The franchise has a coach singularly focused on football. That’s what matters,” reported Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune on X, formerly Twitter. Clearly, Johnson isn’t paying much attention to the wardrobe department ahead of the new season. Instead, the head coach will be looking to help the team build off the success of last year, with plenty of doubt afoot as to whether or not last year’s success is a repeatable formula. In 2025, the Bears relied heavily on late-game magic and comebacks, much in the way the Washington Commanders did the prior season before falling off a cliff last year. However, if quarterback Caleb Williams can take another step forward in his development, and Johnson can continue to find new ways to unlock Chicago’s offense, there’s no reason why the Bears can’t vault themselves into legit contender status in the NFC heading into this season and beyond. The Bears are slated to kick off their new season on September 13 with a road game vs the Carolina Panthers. Now, the team has become partially involved in the Buss family drama, which has stemmed from the sale of the Los Angeles Lakers by owner Mark
articles._body: The San Diego Padres have been playing some solid baseball lately, winners of four out of their last five games with the MLB playoffs quickly approaching. Now, the team has become partially involved in the Buss family drama, which has stemmed from the sale of the Los Angeles Lakers by owner Mark Walter. “Buss Sports Capital – the investment firm formed by Joey and Jesse Buss – have purchased stakes in the San Diego Padres, giving them approximately 5 percent of Mark Walter and the Dodgers’ division rivals. The brothers grew up in San Diego,” reported Dan Woike of The Athletic on X, formerly Twitter. Earlier this month, Walter sold the Lakers to Josh Kushner and Bob Iger in a shocking move. Shortly thereafter, it was reported that the Buss siblings would also be selling their remaining share of the team, after having previously sold the rest of it to Walter in the original deal. This move would remove Jeanie Buss from her role as Governor of the team, although she has since contested those reports, which could lead to a drawn-out legal process before things are finalized. The Buss siblings have been the subject of constant rumors about their infighting and drama in the years since their father, the late Lakers owner Jerry Buss, passed away, and Joey and Jesse are now apparently quickly pivoting to sports ownership in the baseball world, albeit with a minority stake. The two brothers are now rivals of Walter in the MLB, as Walter is still the owner of the Los Angeles Dodgers two hours up the highway. In any case, it wouldn’t be a surprise to see even more layers unfold in this financial drama in the coming weeks. articles.title: Ravens’ Lamar Jackson compares rookie stud to Odell Beckham Jr., DeAndre Hopkins
articles.summary: The Baltimore Ravens have showcased several high-powered offenses during Lamar Jackson’s time as starting quarterback, but the 2026 unit could reach unprecedented heights with the emergence of rookie wide receiver Ja’Kobi Lane as a true perimeter X receiver. Throughout Jackson’s career, the
articles._body: The Baltimore Ravens have showcased several high-powered offenses during Lamar Jackson’s time as starting quarterback, but the 2026 unit could reach unprecedented heights with the emergence of rookie wide receiver Ja’Kobi Lane as a true perimeter X receiver. Throughout Jackson’s career, the offense has primarily relied on smaller slot targets and underneath receivers such as Zay Flowers, Hollywood Brown, and Nelson Agholor. However, Lane’s impressive performance during training camp and his standout preseason debut against Philadelphia, where he recorded three catches for 38 yards and one touchdown, have significantly raised the ceiling for the passing game. Standing tall on the boundary, Lane provides Baltimore with a physical, contested-catch weapon that they have desperately needed in critical downfield situations. Lane’s unique combination of size, jumping ability, and reliable ball-tracking has quickly earned him the ultimate endorsement from Jackson. Speaking to the media on Wednesday, and reported by Jeff Zrebiec on X, Jackson compared the rookie to some of the most dominant pass-catchers in the league, including Odell Beckham and DeAndre Hopkins. This comparison highlights the immense trust Jackson already places in Lane’s catching abilities and natural skills in contested situations. This growing rapport comes during an “all-in offseason” for Jackson, who enters 2026 highly motivated after a 2025 season disrupted by injuries. With Jesse Minter establishing a new culture and Declan Doyle implementing an innovative scheme, ESPN’s Dan Graziano noted that Jackson has fully embraced the new playbook while remaining focused on a championship bounce-back, even as contract discussions take place in the background. If Lane’s dominance on the boundary translates into the regular season, Baltimore’s offense could become unstoppable. Per the San Francisco Chronicle, Vitello tr
articles._body: Ever since she was first linked to Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce, Taylor Swift has become part of the culture, but San Francisco Giants manager Tony Vitello prefers another icon in the country music genre, Dolly Parton, who died on Aug. 25, 2026 . Per the San Francisco Chronicle, Vitello tried to call into the Howard Stern Show when she was on it to express his gratitude for her impact on Tennessee. Of course, he coached the Volunteers baseball team from 2018 to 2025. While he didn’t get through, he got to meet her at one of the Volunteers football games, saying, “The Kansas City Chiefs can have Taylor Swift all they want, we’ll take Dolly Parton on Saturday.” He had to keep his distance due to COVID-19 precautions, but he felt lucky to have gotten to meet her. “Everybody’s pretty heartbroken,” the Giants manager said about Parton’s death. “There’s no one on that level, that’s a worldwide level.” Dolly Parton’s tragic death Scott Utterback/Courier Journal / USA TODAY NETWORK. Parton’s death was announced on Tuesday, Aug. 25, 2026, by her nephew, Bryan Seaver, in a video posted on her social media accounts. “My name is Bryan Seaver, son of Cassie Parton, and I’m representing the Parton and Owens family today announcing the passing of my aunt, Dolly Rebecca Parton Dean, Sister, Sis, and Granny to one generation and Gigi to the next,” he began. “This video announcement is something Dolly asked of me years ago, before I fully absorbed it as a future reality. “As her head of security for more than two decades, a role my father Larry held before me, I have imagined the heaviness of this moment but haven’t truly felt it until now,” Seaver continued. After her death was first announced, Parton’s team confirmed to People that she died following a “brief battle with cancer.” However, the type of cancer she fought was not disclosed. articles._body: Roman Anthony has not played for the Boston Red Sox since May 4. Anthony was placed on the IL on May 5 after dealing with a partially torn tendon and ligament in his right ring finger. Anthony has begun his rehab assignment and could be back in the majors soon. Still, there has been talk that one of the reasons Anthony has not returned quicker is that he was more focused on the Boston nightlife rather than rehabbing, per Chris Cotillo of MassLive. “I won’t really talk on that because it’s not even something that’s relevant and it hasn’t been relevant in our clubhouse,” Anthony said of the rumors. “It’s never been a problem and it’s never really even been a thing. I prioritize getting to bed and doing everything I can to show up and give it all to my teammates and to the fans. I think when things aren’t going your way and you’re a 22-year-old kid that does anything other than just goes home and goes straight to bed, people have something to say.” “I get it, right?” he continued. “I hold myself to a standard. My teammates hold me to a standard. The fans hold me to a standard. So if people are going to write things about me and say things about me that are untrue, it’s easy for fans to fall in that trap and believe it when I’m not playing and hurt. If it were true, it would be a different story. This entire process was just about recovering and doing everything I could to get back as soon as I could, just blocking out other things.” Anthony initially was sent to Fort Myers, rehabbing away from the team, and was in Florida from the start of July through last week, when he went to Double-A Portland for some rehab games. The Red Sox are 73-59 on the season , which places them in third in the AL East. They are five games behind the Tampa Bay Rays in the division. The Sox are also currently holding the second wild card spot in the American League. The Red Sox continue their series against the Miami Marlins on Wednesday night. articles.title: Robert Griffin III claims Browns’ Todd Monken wanted to start Shedeur Sanders over Deshaun Watson
articles.summary: The Cleveland Browns recently caused a stir when they named Deshaun Watson their starting quarterback over Shedeur Sanders for the new season. The move was interpreted by many as having been made by head coach Todd Monken, although some have speculated that the decision could have come from highe
articles._body: The Cleveland Browns recently caused a stir when they named Deshaun Watson their starting quarterback over Shedeur Sanders for the new season. The move was interpreted by many as having been made by head coach Todd Monken, although some have speculated that the decision could have come from higher up in the organization. Recently, former NFL quarterback Robert Griffin III weighed in on the discourse with a hot take and some apparent investigative journalism. “Sources tell me Deshaun Watson WAS NOT Todd Monken’s choice as the starter and many in the building thought Shedeur Sanders was the right move for the team on and off the field after Watson attacked the fans. Browns want Deshaun to play for his pay. The fans deserve better,” wrote Griffin III on X, formerly Twitter. It’s unclear what sources Griffin III has or whether or not they are legitimate, but RG3 is not the first person to speculate that the Browns’ ownership could have forced Monken’s decision due to the large amount of money the team has tied to Watson. Of course, had Sanders played better during his starts last season and throughout training camp and this year’s preseason, that stance might have been met with considerably more resistance. It’s also not out of the question that Sanders could still get a chance to start again at some point this year if Watson looks like he did the first time he suited up in a Browns uniform. Still, for the time being, fans are understandably frustrated with the team not going with the younger, and seemingly more promising, option of the two. The Browns will kick off their regular season on September 13 vs the Jacksonville Jaguars. articles.title: Bryce Young’s blunt reaction to Panthers getting killed by Danielle Hunter, Texans in joint practice
articles.summary: The Carolina Panthers are currently taking part in joint practices with the Houston Texans as the two teams prepare for their upcoming preseason game later this week. The Panthers are hoping to build off their success of last year, when the team defied expectations by making the playoffs and givi
articles._body: The Carolina Panthers are currently taking part in joint practices with the Houston Texans as the two teams prepare for their upcoming preseason game later this week. The Panthers are hoping to build off their success of last year, when the team defied expectations by making the playoffs and giving the Los Angeles Rams a run for their money when they got there. Unfortunately, the Panthers didn’t exactly meet the moment on Wednesday, with the Texans’ defense dominating them throughout the day’s scrimmage. “Danielle Hunter with what is at least the fourth sack on Bryce Young. Beat Monroe Freeling. Tough day for the rookie. And a tough assignment against Hunter and Will Anderson,” reported Joe Person of The Athletic on X, formerly Twitter. After the game, Panthers quarterback Bryce Young spoke on how the team needs to bounce back from the adversity. “We’re competitors. We want to win, and they got after us today. It’s not a good feeling… I look in the mirror, we all look in the mirror. A day like this, you’ve got to grow from it. We’re excited about that process,” said Young, per Person. Panthers head coach Dave Canales also spoke on how the setback will only make the Panthers better moving forward. “Those guys are fantastic players,” he said of the Texans’ defense. “That’s exactly what we need to see.” The Panthers have heightened expectations for Young this year after somewhat of a resurgent 2025 campaign, but questions persist about his status as the long-term answer at quarterback moving forward for the franchise. Carolina will kick off its new season with a game against the Chicago Bears on September 13. articles.title: Falcons’ Tua Tagovailoa, Michael Penix Jr. QB plan for Dolphins preseason game
articles.summary: The Atlanta Falcons are giving Tua Tagovailoa one more opportunity to prove he deserves the starting quarterback job — and the setting could not be more fitting. According to Ari Meirov, Tagovailoa will start Friday night’s preseason game against his former team, the Miami Dolphins. Michael Penix
articles._body: The Atlanta Falcons are giving Tua Tagovailoa one more opportunity to prove he deserves the starting quarterback job — and the setting could not be more fitting. According to Ari Meirov, Tagovailoa will start Friday night’s preseason game against his former team, the Miami Dolphins. Michael Penix Jr. will not play, and Atlanta’s Week 1 starter remains undecided. That makes Friday’s game an important audition for Tagovailoa. The former Dolphins quarterback has struggled since arriving in Atlanta and has yet to separate himself in the competition. Facing Miami may add another layer of attention, but the Falcons will be more concerned with whether Tagovailoa can operate the offense efficiently and avoid costly mistakes. Penix’s absence should not be viewed as confirmation that Tagovailoa has won the job. If Tua struggles again, Atlanta could still name Penix the starter without giving him another preseason appearance. Recent comments from Falcons offensive coordinator Tommy Rees suggest the team remains encouraged by Penix’s progress. “A lot of joy for Penix to be out there yesterday, and a lot of joy from his teammates,” Rees said. ESPN’s Marc Raimondi reported that Rees noticed renewed enthusiasm from Penix and his teammates when the quarterback returned to practice. “I could not be more pleased with the work that he’s put in and where he’s at mentally,” Rees added. For now, the spotlight belongs to Tagovailoa. A strong performance against Miami could give Atlanta more confidence in starting him when the regular season begins. Another disappointing outing could leave Penix as the favorite despite watching Friday’s game from the sideline. The Falcons may not announce their decision immediately, but Tagovailoa’s final preseason opportunity could decide it for them. articles.title: The Porsche 911 GT3 Touring punches above its weight class
articles.summary: The "everyday" GT3 delivers, despite looming regulations and an ever-inflating price tag.
articles._body: The GT3 occupies a singular place in the 911 lineup. Whereas the range-topping Turbo S piles on power, technology, luxury, and all-weather capability, the GT3 has always pursued something more elemental: a lighter weight, more focus, and a finely honed setup that puts the driver at the center of the experience. Porsche has expanded the GT3 formula since the model’s debut in 1999, adding the more extreme GT3 RS to the lineup in 2003 and the slightly more reserved GT3 Touring in 2017, along with the GT3 S/C earlier this year. While the concept behind the drop-top S/C requires some mental gymnastics to make sense of it, the Touring’s original premise was refreshingly simple: Take the standard GT3—including its naturally aspirated 4.0 L flat-six and track-tuned chassis—and replace the fixed rear wing with the deployable spoiler from the Carrera. The result is a subtler version of the homologation car that recaptures the classic 911 silhouette without giving up the hardware that makes a GT3 a GT3. Fresh from its 992.2 mid-cycle update, the latest GT3 Touring sticks closely to that original design. Its 4.0 L flat-six still spins to 9,000 rpm and produces 502 hp (375 kW) and 331 lb-ft (449 Nm), sending its output exclusively to the rear wheels through either a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic or six-speed manual gearbox. Massive brakes, rear-axle steering, a GT3-specific suspension, active sport exhaust, and plenty of other road course-oriented hardware remain standard. Read full article Comments

articles.title: Coinbase and Better Mortgage Announce General Availability of Bitcoin-Backed Mortgages
articles.summary: Bitcoin Magazine
articles._body: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase and Better Mortgage Announce General Availability of Bitcoin-Backed Mortgages Coinbase and Nasdaq-listed Better Mortgage have announced the availability of Bitcoin-backed mortgages for Americans.  The crypto exchange and lender said Wednesday that the service was designed in accordance with the Federal National Mortgage Association, or Fannie Mae.  Coinbase and Better announced the funding of the first Bitcoin-backed mortgage in June. The service now hopes to cater to younger wannabe homeowners who have Bitcoin holdings.  JUST IN: Coinbase announces the expansion of their Bitcoin-backed mortgages "Borrowers in the US can now use Bitcoin as collateral for a down payment – without having to sell it or face margin calls." pic.twitter.com/PXNojVSVrl — Bitcoin Magazine (@BitcoinMagazine) August 26, 2026 “In 2025, high interest rates, record home prices, and limited inventory pushed the median age of a first-time homebuyer to 40,” Chief Technology Officer at Better Mortgage, Ziggy Jonsson, said.  “Coinbase counts millions of monthly users worldwide, and by allowing Coinbase One members to pledge crypto as collateral without selling their holdings, we’re opening a new path toward homeownership for a generation of borrowers whose wealth increasingly lives onchain.” Ben Shen, head of financial services and loyalty products at Coinbase, added: “By enabling borrowers to pledge their digital assets in the mortgage underwriting process, we are allowing crypto to be more useful and powerful in the real-world — expanding the pathways to homeownership while preserving long-term investment positions.” The announcement added that Coinbase One members will be eligible for a rebate equal to 1% of the mortgage value, up to a maximum of $10,000. The debut loan by Coinbase and Better was closed by a married Michigan couple, Joe and Amy, in June. The couple used their Bitcoin holdings as collateral to fund their down payment rather than liquidating their position, the companies said at the time.  Crypto-backed lender Milo said earlier this year that it had surpassed $100 million in digital asset mortgages, including a record $12 million loan, as more high-net-worth and institutional clients were using Bitcoin as collateral for home financing. Bitcoin-backed loans are still a niche product but one of the biggest lenders in the space, Ledn, has released research claiming that the space could grow from its current size of $3 billion to $1 trillion in the next 10 years.  This post Coinbase and Better Mortgage Announce General Availability of Bitcoin-Backed Mortgages first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

articles._body: The St. Louis Cardinals are currently on a four-game losing streak. They also recently lost one of their star players, as Cardinals shortstop Masyn Winn has landed on the IL . Now, an update is being given about the status of Winn, per MLB.com. “Imaging showed fracture, which primarily impacts Winn when swinging a bat. Expected to miss only the current homestand and return after a minimum stay on the IL,” the update read. Winn was placed on the 10-day IL retroactive to August 22nd, meaning he would be able to come off during the series with the Los Angeles Dodgers that starts next week. Winn has been solid this year, hitting .238 with five home runs and 51 RBIs. He also has scored 4 runs this year while playing in 122 games. JJ Wetherholt is expected to slide over to shortstop while Winn is out of the lineup. Meanwhile, Nolan Gorman has been recalled to the major league roster. He is hitting just .190 this year with seven home runs and 26 RBIs. Gorman had not been on the major league roster since June, after hitting just .050 in his first seven games of the month. His first game back in the majors did not go well either, as he went 0-4 at the plate with three strikeouts agaisnt the Baltimore Orioles. The Cardinals are now 66-67 on the year , which places them in third place in the NL Central. They are also five games behind the San Diego Padres in the National League wild card race. The Cardinals will look to break their four-game losing skid when they face the Orioles again on Wednesday night. articles.title: Miley Cyrus Mourns Her Godmother Dolly Parton: ‘I Have an Angel by My Side’
articles.summary: "Dolly would want me to feel it, write a song about it, and then continue on and be strong," Cyrus wrote.
articles._body: One day after Dolly Parton ‘s death at the age of 80, Miley Cyrus honored her famous godmother in an emotional post on Instagram on Wednesday (Aug. 26). Related Dolly Parton, One of Country Music’s Biggest & Brightest Icons, Dies at 80 Dolly Parton Remembered by Reba McEntire, Paul McCartney, George Strait & More: ‘We Will Always Love You’ Jay-Z 30 Pop-Up Experience to Open In London Ahead of Historic Tottenham Hotspur Stadium Shows “The feeling of losing my Aunt Dolly is beyond what feels right to share,” Cyrus began alongside a black-and-white photo of a younger Parton. “Our most sacred moments were private and they’ll stay there behind the stage, beneath the glamour & between our hearts.” “What I KNOW is Dolly would want me to feel it, write a song about it, and then continue on and be strong,” she continued. “I have an angel by my side. I always have. One of our last conversations was about music and metamorphosis.” Cyrus went on to say that she “will always love her and want to make her proud,” adding that her “heart breaks for the world, her family and friends who will miss her deeply.” “We’re in this loss together,” the star concluded, “and we will see her in all of the most beautiful things.” Parton died Tuesday (Aug. 25) after “a brief battle with cancer,” according to a statement shared by her team that day. The news was formally announced to the world by her nephew, Bryan Seaver, who served as her head of security for two decades. “Sadness lies with us, not Dolly,” Seaver said in a video posted to his famous aunt’s social media. “Dolly has lived in the light and is in the arms of Jesus, surely met by Carl, her parents and countless others who had watched her and longed for her to meet them in the heavens. She never saw a door she couldn’t open and the doors she opened made and changed history.” The close bond between Parton and Cyrus was special to fans across the world, many of whom watched them act alongside each other on Hannah Montana , on which the Queen of Country made a couple of cameos as Cyrus’ character’s godmother. Parton also joined her real-life goddaughter for Miley’s New Year’s Eve Party in 2022, and the two women collaborated on songs such as “Rainbowland” from Cyrus’ 2017 album Younger Now and a revamped version of “Wrecking Ball” for Parton’s 2024 LP, Rockstar. The pair were also open about their love for one another in interviews. “I love my Miley,” Parton said in a clip for Billboard in 2023 while discussing their joint version of “Wrecking Ball.” Cyrus’ post about Parton comes on the heels of her father’s. Billy Ray Cyrus posted his own tribute to the music legend on Tuesday, writing on Instagram , “I have so many moments and memories with Dolly, it’s hard to know where to start.” “Like every little boy, I grew up loving Dolly Parton,” he continued. “She was a part of our lives, on our TV’s, right in our living rooms … Dolly recently sent me a beautiful message, telling me she loved me with her whole heart. I will always love her in the same way ….. with my whole heart … and I always will.”
