articles.title: Paramount-WBD Merger Fight Splits Red States and Blue States
articles.summary: REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni/File Photo
articles._body: Paramount’s attempted $110 billion takeover of TNT Sports parent company Warner Bros. Discovery is devolving into a fight between blue states and red ones. Iowa attorney general Brenna Bird is suing California, leading a 12-state antitrust lawsuit against Paramount, the parent company of CBS Sports, and WBD, and is taking the matter directly to the U.S. Supreme Court. “California is once again trying to be the country’s regulator,” Bird wrote in an op-ed in The Daily Wire . “And once again California is defying common sense to raise costs around the country. That makes this a dispute between states, and the Constitution says those can only be heard in the U.S. Supreme Court. … Just like California should keep its hands off America’s bacon, California needs to understand that it doesn’t get to decide what Americans can choose to watch or stream.” Soon after that article appeared online, Bird filed a motion with the Supreme Court, with another conservative state, Montana, joining in the action that seeks to accelerate a closing of the Paramount-WBD deal. “A merger that is delayed past the point of viability is not restored by a favorable judgment years later,” the two states’ filing reads in part. Last month, California attorney general Rob Bonta led the initial antitrust suit against Paramount and WBD , involving a dozen blue-leaning states. In six weeks, that action has already had significant impact, including an agreement to delay closing of the merger until a scheduled trial in March 2027 . Bonta has also begun negotiations with Paramount on a potential settlement that, despite some recent finger-pointing between the two sides, could lead to Paramount shedding some of the WBD assets. To Bird, however, none of that should be happening. “Two storied American companies are frozen,” Bird wrote. “Warner Bros. cannot confidently green-light a film, upgrade its technology, or sign a long-term contract without knowing whether it will exist as an independent company next year. Paramount cannot execute its plans without a merger either. Employees cannot plan careers. And a movie that does not get made this year may never get made at all. Financing expires, talent moves on, and production slates are abandoned. No court ruling in 2027 can go back and produce the film that was never shot.” More broadly, Bird argues not only in favor of the deal, but that Paramount needs far greater scale in order to compete with entities such as Netflix. “When regulators in 68 jurisdictions with different laws, different politics, and no stake whatsoever in American elections all reach the same conclusion, the outlier is not the consensus,” Bird wrote. “California is just dreaming up something radical.” Legal Matters The motion from Iowa and Montana seeks a declaration that California and the other 11 blue states cannot obtain an injunction against the Paramount-WBD deal and enjoins them pursuing their case further, as well a declaration saying that the merger does not violate the federal Clayton Antitrust Act. There is no guarantee, however, that the Supreme Court will take up the case from Iowa and Montana, and in fact, it only hears a very small percentage of the petitions it receives. The Supreme Court is also currently out of session until early October. While the Paramount legal case focuses primarily on the potential Hollywood-related impacts of the deal, and an alleged violation of federal antitrust law, the Paramount-WBD agreement also has far-reaching sports impacts . The planned combination of TNT Sports and CBS Sports would have touchpoints in nearly every major pro and college sports entity in the U.S., with the notable exception of the NBA. The Daily Wire was cofounded by conservative political commentator Ben Shapiro. The post Paramount-WBD Merger Fight Splits Red States and Blue States appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles.title: ESPN’s Louis Riddick claims Keelon Russell under most pressure of any college football player
articles.summary: Alabama named its starting quarterback for the start of the 2026 season this week, tapping second-year player Keelon Russell for the job. He inherits some seriously high expectations, with the Crimson Tide once again gunning for the College Football Playoff. It won’t be an easy role, that&#821
articles._body: Alabama named its starting quarterback for the start of the 2026 season this week, tapping second-year player Keelon Russell for the job. He inherits some seriously high expectations, with the Crimson Tide once again gunning for the College Football Playoff . It won’t be an easy role, that’s for sure. One ESPN analyst put it into pretty stark terms when asked what Russell is facing as the starter going into the season. He might not be wrong, either. [ $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage ] “I don’t think there’s a single player who has more pressure on him in college football this year, to be quite honest with you,” ESPN analyst Louis Riddick said on First Take . And while that might seem like a ton of pressure for a player stepping into the limelight, it might well be justified. The Crimson Tide faithful won’t settle for long, and the way last year ended — blowout losses in both the SEC Championship Game and the playoffs — won’t sit well. Keelon Russell will feel that pressure. “Because think about it like this: Austin Mack had a relationship with Kalen DeBoer going back to Washington and then transfers to Alabama, so that was Kalen’s guy,” Riddick explained. “That was Ryan Grubb ‘s guy. Now Keelon has taken the reins now and they’ve decided this is the guy who’s going to inject a lot of energy, playmaking ability, improvisation into this offense here for 2026. That’s a lot.” That’s not to say the burden is entirely on Keelon Russell. Alabama has plenty of other facets of the team that need beefing up. But the backdrop is there. “This is the most inexperienced quarterback room in the SEC,” Riddick said. “Amongst the most inexperienced quarterback room in the SEC. In a conference that is loaded with top-notch, top-level quarterback play. And this team, with the way it struggled last year in terms of offensive line continuity and consistency, being one of the worst rushing teams in all of the FBS, Ryan Williams struggling last year after having a sensational freshman year, struggling as a sophomore. Supposedly he is supposed to be back on track this year from a receiving standpoint, a consistency standpoint, that he’s corrected all the issues he’s had with drops. “Look, a lot of this though is going to all come back to what can Keelon Russell do in order to infuse some energy and some excitement and some optimism into this offense. Defensively, they’re going to be fine. But I’ll tell you what: A week from now or about 10 days from now that opening game against East Carolina that me and my colleague Bob Wischusen are going to call on ABC at noon ET, that will be one o the most intriguing games of Week 1, simply because of Keelon Russell and this decision that Kalen DeBoer has made.”

articles.title: Crain and Cone: South Carolina is SEC’s ‘sneakiest team’
articles.summary: The crew on On3's Crain and Cone podcast argued that South Carolina could be the sneakiest team in the SEC this fall.
articles._body: On3’s Crain and Cone crew did their preseason SEC prediction show this week . All three hosts (Jake Crain, Blain Crain, and David Cone) picked South Carolina to go 7-5 overall in the 2026 regular season. In each of the three predictions, Shane Beamer’s team went 4-5 in SEC play. They also all picked Carolina to sweep their non-conference games against Kent State, Towson, and Clemson. However, the trio revealed they think the Gamecocks could have a little more in the tank in 2026 than a solid-but-unremarkable 7-5 season. Questions about this story? Kevin Miller is discussing it with subscribers on The Insiders Forum. When Jake Crain asked his co-hosts for their pick for the “sneakiest team in the SEC,” Cone responded, “To me, it’s South Carolina…you have really great football players at critical positions.” As one might expect, Cone specifically shouted out quarterback LaNorris Sellers, EDGE Dylan Stewart, and wide receiver Nyck Harbor. The three Gamecock stars are the most famous players in garnet and black for a reason, and if things go well for them, South Carolina could make some noise in the Southeastern Conference. “To me, they could be the fly in the ointment in the SEC,” Cone then concluded. Crain agreed and laid out a path for USC contention, both for the College Football Playoff and in the SEC. “The South Carolina at Florida game on October 10 could be massive in the grand scheme of things,” he said. “If you can find a way to go on the road and beat Florida, then get a bye week, and then Tennessee at home the next week?” Based on current prediction markets, a win over the Gators would make the Gamecocks 5-1 to start the year. That would include wins over Kent State, Towson, Mississippi State, and Kentucky before the Florida contest. Both Crain and Cone revealed that they are picking Alabama to beat South Carolina in week four. Even so, they firmly believe the Gamecocks could upset the Crimson Tide in Tuscaloosa. A 5-1 (or even 6-0) start to the season would certainly push USC firmly into contention. For now, though, neither Crain nor Cone is picking South Carolina to knock off Alabama or Florida. If it happens, the Gamecocks will drastically alter the 2026 season’s landscape. Have a question for the GamecockCentral staff? Ask it now on The Insiders Forum. You can see South Carolina’s full-season game picks from Jake Crain, Blain Crain, and David Cone below. In the end, all three picked the same exact victories and defeats for the Gamecocks. vs. Kent State: Win vs. Towson: Win vs. Mississippi State: Win @ Alabama: Loss vs. Kentucky: Win @ Florida: Loss vs. Tennessee: Win @ Oklahoma: Loss vs. Texas A&M: Loss @ Arkansas: Win vs. Georgia: Loss @ Clemson: Win What do you think? articles.title: Michael Porter Jr., Lonzo Ball would press a button to kill random person in order to get $1 billion
articles.summary: In a bizarre moment, NBA stars Michael Porter Jr. and Lonzo Ball revealed that they would press a button to kill a random person if it meant they received $1 billion. The question arose during an episode of Porter’s podcast, Curious Mike (via Basketball Network). Ball didn’t hesitate,
articles._body: In a bizarre moment, NBA stars Michael Porter Jr. and Lonzo Ball revealed that they would press a button to kill a random person if it meant they received $1 billion. The question arose during an episode of Porter’s podcast, Curious Mike (via Basketball Network). Ball didn’t hesitate, saying, “You gotta do a click.” To be clear, he’s “doing it strictly for the billion. Nothing else here.” He acted aloof about the consequences of his action, saying, “This is what I’m gonna say: I didn’t catch the body. It wasn’t me. I have no ties. My hand slipped type s**t. I need the billion. We can figure out everything else after that.” While Porter had a similar verdict, he arrived at the destination differently. He justified killing a random person by saying he’d use some of the money — $300 million, to be exact — to “go save thousands of lives.” “Go give it to somewhere over there in Africa or somewhere that has a lot of poverty going on and save a bunch of lives,” he reasoned. “So that makes up for the one life that was lost for the billion. Then take the other $700 million to the crib. That’s how I would justify it.” As Basketball Network notes, they have both made a lot of money throughout their NBA careers. Ball has earned over $122 million while Porter has made over $153 million. However, that would not stop them from pulling the trigger to make $1 billion. Porter is currently on the Brooklyn Nets and entering his second year with the team after being traded there in 2025 . He spent the first seven years of his career on the Denver Nuggets, who drafted him with the 14th pick in the 2018 NBA Draft out of Missouri. Ball is currently a free agent. He spent the 2025-26 season with the Cleveland Cavaliers. Previously, he had runs with the Los Angeles Lakers, the New Orleans Pelicans, and the Chicago Bulls. articles.title: Alabama basketball to play Auburn in preseason exhibition game
articles.summary: Alabama basketball will play rival Auburn in a preseason exhibition in Birmingham this coming October before the season begins.
articles._body: Alabama basketball will play a preseason exhibition game against rival Auburn this October, per a report from Auburn Sports’ Justin Hokanson. The game will take place on Thursday, Oct. 22 at the BJCC in Birmingham. Hokanson reports that if the game sells out, both the Alabama and Auburn programs could earn upwards of six-figures for participating in the event. It will be the Crimson Tide’s second of two preseason exhibition games to kick off the eighth season under head coach Nate Oats . The first will be against another SEC opponent, Ole Miss, in Boutwell Auditorium a week earlier on Oct. 15. Alabama and Auburn met two times last year in the Tigers’ first season under head coach Steven Pearl. The Tide won both matchups, winning 96-92 in Auburn, followed by a 96-84 win in Tuscaloosa. The two rivals will meet twice once again in the 2026-27 regular season, first in Tuscaloosa on Saturday, Jan. 30, and again to close out the regular season in Auburn on Saturday, March 6. articles.title: College fantasy football: Top 10 quarterbacks in 2026
articles.summary: Week 0 of the college football season is just days away. Some teams have already established starting quarterbacks, while other teams, such as Vanderbilt, have just named their starting quarterback. Unlike the NFL, which has 32 options at quarterback, college fantasy football has 138 teams to cho
articles._body: Week 0 of the college football season is just days away. Some teams have already established starting quarterbacks, while other teams, such as Vanderbilt, have just named their starting quarterback . Unlike the NFL, which has 32 options at quarterback, college fantasy football has 138 teams to choose a quarterback from. Last year, Byrum Brown from South Florida was the top fantasy quarterback , as he threw for 3158 yards and 28 touchdowns, while running for 1008 yards and 14 scores. Brown has left USF and is now at Auburn. Meanwhile, many of the top quarterbacks from last season are no longer in the college ranks. Diego Pavia, Fernando Mendoza, Colton Joseph, and Haynes King were all top-ten quarterbacks in 2025, but are all gone. With eight of the top nine quarterbacks from 2025 in new spots or out of college, these are the top ten college fantasy quarterbacks in 2026. 1. Devon Dampier | Utah Devon Dampier has been great over the last two seasons. In 2024 at New Mexico, he passed for 2,768 yards and 12 touchdowns, while running for 1,166 yards and 19 scores. Then, last year at Utah, he passed for 2,490 yards with 24 touchdowns. He also cut down his interceptions from 12 to 5. Dampier continued to run well too, running for 835 yards and ten scores. That made him QB12 last year, and one of the top returning options. Dampier has always shown his dual-threat ability, but he will be working under a new offensive coordinator. Dampier has reached his peak in the last two seasons under Jason Beck, who left with Kyle Whittingham to Michigan. Bryson Barnes was solid under the new offensive coordinator, Kevin McGiven, at Utah State. With Utah not having to face some of the best defensive units in the Big 12, Dampier is set for a huge year. 2. Trinidad Chambliss | Ole Miss Joe Rondone/The Republic / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images Trinidad Chambliss was phenomenal last year. He was QB7 last year after passing for 3,937 yards and 22 touchdowns. He also ran for 527 yards and another eight scores. The potential Heisman candidate was also still able to put up points against some of the best defenses he faced. Against Georgia, he passed for 263 yards and a touchdown, while rushing in another two. He still has to face some tough defensive units this year, with games against LSU, Texas, Georgia, and Oklahoma. Chambliss has shown the ability to perform against that level of defense in the past. The biggest concern is the rushing numbers of Chambliss going down after Lane Kiffin left. If his rushing numbers drop, his overall fantasy value will drop some as well. 3. Arch Manning | Texas There is plenty of hype around Texas quarterback Arch Manning coming into the year . Manning was QB19 last season, but he struggled early in the year. Manning threw for just 170 yards, with a touchdown and an interception, in his first game against Ohio State. He then completed just 11 of 25 passes for 114 yards with a touchdown and an interception against UTEP two weeks later. In the last six games of the season, including the bowl game against Michigan, he threw 14 touchdowns to just two interceptions. He also ran in five scores. If Manning can replicate his final six games all season, he will be a top quarterback in fantasy. 4. Drew Mestemaker | Oklahoma State Drew Mestemaker was named the starting quarterback as a redshirt freshman in 2025 at North Texas. He proceeded to light the world on fire. The North Texas QB threw for 4,379 yards and 34 touchdowns. He led FBS in yards and was tied for second in touchdowns. Unlike the top quarterbacks, he does not have a major ground aspect to his game. He ran for just 89 yards but did score five times on the ground. Now, Mestemaker is joining his former head coach, Eric Morris, at Oklahoma State. Wyatt Young and Miles Coleman, who combined for 1,700 yards, come along with him as well. Still, the value of Mestemaker is on his passing volume, and if Oklahoma State is behind on a consistent basis, Mestemaker could get that volume in 2026. 5. Brad Jackson | Texas State Matt Bush/Special to the Clarion Ledger / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images The only non-power conference quarterback on the list comes from Texas State. Brad Jackson was QB3 last year, only behind Byrum Brown and Diego Pavia. Last year he passed for 3,224 yards and 21 touchdowns. He also was a huge weapon on the ground, running for 744 yards and 17 touchdowns. Jackson will have plenty of solid chances to put up huge games in 2026, with contests against North Texas and Colorado State among other weaker defenses. He could have a rough start, though, as the Bobcats face Texas in Week 1. 6. Kamario Taylor | Mississippi State Jeff Lebby has already improved Mississippi State. After a 2-10 season in 2024, he led Mississippi State to a 5-8 season in 2025 with a loss in the Duke’s Mayo Bowl. Mississippi State could continue to improve this year. With Blake Shapen gone, Kamario Taylor is taking over the starting job. As a freshman, Taylor only started two games, but showed he can be a threat. He passed for 629 yards and five touchdowns. Taylor also ran for 458 yards and eight scores. He was used on the ground against Georgia, and he accounted for all three touchdowns. Meanwhile, in his start against Ole Miss, he ran for 173 yards and two scores. Taylor is a massive threat on the ground, and that brings him tremendous value. 7. Byrum Brown | Auburn Byrum Brown was QB1 in fantasy last year while playing for South Florida. He passed for 3,158 yards with 28 touchdowns, while running for 1,008 yards and 14 touchdowns. This was the second time in his career that he was a top fantasy quarterback. In 2023, he passed for 3,292 yards and 26 touchdowns, while running for 809 yards and 11 scores. The only reason he is not higher on the list is the fact that Brown is now at Auburn. He will be facing much more difficult defensive units, but if he can still be a threat on the ground, Brown will be a top ten QB. 8. Demond Williams | Wa

articles.title: Orioles’ Craig Albernaz gets mad at reporter for Pete Alonso injury question after he literally referenced calf issue seconds before
articles.summary: The Baltimore Orioles just beat the St. Louis Cardinals by a score of 13-1. The dominant win came at an important time for the Orioles, as Baltimore had lost five of their previous seven games, and tensions were clearly starting to come to a boil. Even after the big-time win, Craig Albernaz prove
articles._body: The Baltimore Orioles just beat the St. Louis Cardinals by a score of 13-1. The dominant win came at an important time for the Orioles, as Baltimore had lost five of their previous seven games , and tensions were clearly starting to come to a boil. Even after the big-time win, Craig Albernaz proved that he is still frustrated with how things are going. During a postgame presser after the game, Albernaz explained why Pete Alonso was pulled after the fifth inning. “Precautionary. Game state; get him off his feet,” Albernaz started. “Obviously, he was dealing with his calf, so there was no point to push him there, and we had the guys to go mix and match with Sammy going to first and to get Narvy behind the plate.” Albernaz’s explanation of Alonso’s injury was nothing out of the ordinary, but when a reporter asked the manager to confirm that this was the same calf injury that the first baseman was dealing with against the Tampa Bay Rays and not a new one, Albernaz snapped. “I didn’t say anything was bothering him,” Albernaz replied. “Took him off his feet because of the Tampa outing… Please don’t put words in my mouth.” I don’t super love this and how it went down. Can’t even enjoy a blowout win anymore man… pic.twitter.com/Waskr6x38u — Jason Benowitz (@jbenowitz1831) August 26, 2026 Injury woes have been detrimental to the Orioles in recent years and have played a big part in why the team can’t seem to live up to both their potential and to expectations. Clearly, they’ve started to frustrate their manager, too, because there was no reason to snap at the reporter for a reasonable question. Fatu appeared during a main-event match between Grayson Waller and Cruz Montana and attacked them both. The following week, he found himself doing promos in front of a live audience. However, while Fatu botched one of his lines during the promo, he gained more traction as the trolls made him trend on social media. Ahead of this week’s episode of Tuesday Night NXT, WWE’s social media team sent out a digital promo featuring Fatu, who is set to challenge for Tony D’Angelo’s NXT Title at Heatwave on Sunday, Aug. 30, 2026. Steadily gaining popularity amongst WWE audience, Fatu’s debut has now been acknowledged by The Rock himself. The Rock replied to the social media post and wrote, “Time to eat fam.” Although, it should also be noted that, Fatu is a member of the Anoa’i family bloodline and not the WWE Bloodline faction. View this post on Instagram It quickly became a talking point on the internet, where The Rock is a lready heavily trending for a potential return at WWE WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia to face off against Roman Reigns. Despite the heavy rumors, The Rock’s WWE WrestleMania return currently seems unlikely due to several external factors. The Rock had recently praised former WWE rival Seth Rollins A few years ago at WWE WrestleMania 42, The Rock had a memorable rivalry against Cody Rhodes and Seth Rollins. Over time, however, The Rock has moved past his rivalry with Rollins and now has a positive relationship with him. A few weeks ago, while speaking to Complex, The Rock was asked which WWE finisher could take on Te Ka in Moana besides his Rock Bottom. “I would say Seth Rollins’ stomp. It’s my favorite. I took it at WrestleMania. I am a glutton for punishment, so I… there’s some finishing moves I loved taking. His is so iconic and I took that. It’s a wild… just a face stomp into the mat. It was cool,” the Jumanji actor said. The post The Rock sparks WWE return rumors by acknowledging Bloodline member debut appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Giants insider demands more Jaxson Dart in preseason as John Harbaugh waffles
articles.summary: The New York Giants are entering a new era, with young quarterback Jaxson Dart fully embracing the leadership at the helm. Head coach John Harbaugh, known for his proven championship track record and meticulous attention to detail, stands out because of his ability to connect and build personal r
articles._body: The New York Giants are entering a new era, with young quarterback Jaxson Dart fully embracing the leadership at the helm . Head coach John Harbaugh, known for his proven championship track record and meticulous attention to detail, stands out because of his ability to connect and build personal relationships with players, according to Dart. As the regular season approaches, questions arise about how much exhibition work Dart needs before Week 1. Harbaugh has kept his plans regarding personnel relatively ambiguous for the exhibition finale, leading local media figures to argue that resting the starters would be a significant mistake. New York Daily News columnist Pat Leonard made a strong case on X, advocating for live exhibition snaps: “Dart and the offense need to play Friday. They’ve been preparing as if they will this week, from my vantage point.” Leonard emphasizes the importance of Dart mastering timing with his receivers, sharpening his pocket navigation under actual pressure, and establishing rhythm within a new offensive system, rather than relying solely on practice repetitions. The sense of camaraderie and on-field chemistry was evident during the Giants’ intense joint practices with the Miami Dolphins. When multiple physical altercations broke out, Dart quickly ran into the middle of the action to support veteran quarterback Jameis Winston . Dart expressed his instinctive reaction to reporters, stating that as soon as he saw Winston’s red jersey in the scuffle, his immediate thought was to defend his teammate. This loyalty and competitive spirit reflect the strong culture developing under Harbaugh in East Rutherford. articles._body: The Los Angeles Dodgers have enjoyed the riches of Tarik Skubal since he was traded from the team. They’ll have a matchup against his former team soon, and he’s supposed to start the first game of the series, according to Detroit news sportswriter Chris McCosky. “Tarik Skubal will make his return to Comerica Park with the Dodgers on Friday, starting the first game of the series,” McCosky wrote on X, formerly Twitter. It’ll be Skubal versus Drew Anderson on the mound, which should set up for some entertaining baseball toward the end of the week. Skubal just got his first win for the Dodgers earlier in the week against the Pittsburgh Pirates, and it almost felt like he had a sign of relief. He threw 11 strikeouts in that game, and it ultimately was the Skubal the Dodgers have been waiting to see since the trade. “I’m not gonna be perfect out there, but I definitely need to be better in the first inning,” Skubal said via the Associated Press. “But other than that, I thought my execution was good. The stuff coming out of my hand is as good as it’s ever been.” Manager Dave Roberts was also pleased with Skubal’s performance. “That’s the guy that we needed. Completing seven innings, reset the bullpen, great outing,” Roberts said. “He’s very physical, and you can see that when he needs to reach back for more, it’s in there.” There’s no doubt that Skubal is going to try to put on his best against his former team, and many people will probably be tuned in for the matchup. articles.title: Show HN: Shelf Protocol – Robots.txt for Commerce
articles.summary: My project helps merchants, consumers, and ai agents. We are at the point ai agents will be buying things for consumers. My product verifies the merchant, highlights the store to agents, brings stores and their products into one registery and gives the ai agent speed by calling my registry instea
articles._body: My project helps merchants, consumers, and ai agents. We are at the point ai agents will be buying things for consumers. My product verifies the merchant, highlights the store to agents, brings stores and their products into one registery and gives the ai agent speed by calling my registry instead of the agent going searching each merchant one at a time. I have a function "can_buy()" that does a few things. It gives agents an understanding of what they can and can't do. It helps them know if a merchant allows ai agents to buy without a human involved, it lets the agent know my product prove the store is really who it says it is and not a fake site, and it lets the agent know how much it can spend before it has to ask a human for permisssion to proceed. For the consumer it lets your agent do things autonomously without always asking for permission to buy if its under a certain amount. And the agent is going to a store that is verified by my system. For the merchant this gives you another avenue to sell. Where things are heading agents using this system will skip stores that it can't verify. With guardrails that will most likely be in place for agents if you're not listed in this system you'll be invisible. It's one DNS record, free and five minutes. It gives you control on what agents see. Such as your products, how much you allow them to purchase and you are verified as the domain owner of your store for AI agents. I didn't want to launch with an empty directory so I pre-filled the registry with already public product data from real stores on Shopify. I have 8 real merchants and 834 real products. They aren't verified and there is a 0 spending limit at this time. I need the merchants to claim their listing first. It's early and I would love some feedback, especially on the shelf.json schema. I would also like your thoughts on whether DNS-TXT is the right verification long term. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49449679 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

articles.title: 15,000 years of solar wind in four hours? A Seattle company gives it a go.
articles.summary: "We're living in this world of scarcity with the Moon."
articles._body: As part of its nuclear fusion processes, the Sun produces a particularly interesting isotope of helium, known as helium-3. Some of this helium-3 escapes the Sun's gravitational pull as part of the solar wind, a stream of charged particles that emanates out across the Solar System. Over billions of years, this wind has bombarded every body in the vicinity of the Sun, including Earth's Moon. Lacking a magnetic field or atmosphere, the Moon's surface has no barrier to prevent the constant flow of this wind. This means that helium-3 has been striking the lunar soil, or regolith, for a long time. These helium ions penetrate only a little way into the individual grains of this soil, but periodically meteorites have struck the lunar surface to churn the soil, mixing some of this helium-3 a little below the surface. articles.title: SoundCloud to Allow Direct Music Purchases
articles.summary: The new feature rolls out in beta with 200 Artist Pro users to provide their feedback ahead of a wider launch in the fall.
articles._body: SoundCloud announced that it will begin rolling out direct music purchases, now in beta, on the streaming platform direct from artist pages. Starting Wednesday (Aug. 26), around 200 Artist Pro creators will be able to sell songs directly from their profiles on SoundCloud, providing an additional source of revenue for artists. “Artists should be able to build their audience in one place, on one platform,” Eliah Seton , SoundCloud’s CEO, said in a statement. “SoundCloud has always been where artists find their first fans and build real communities. We’re continuing to bring more of what they need to grow their careers into that same experience, while letting fans directly support the music they love.” Related SoundCloud Rolls Out Features to Put ‘New Dollars on the Table’ for Artists Dale Morris, Nashville Manager Who Guided Careers of Alabama & Kenny Chesney, Dies at 89 HYBE Pledges Over $300k for Colombia Earthquake Recovery Creators participating in the program will have the ability to set the price of eligible tracks for sale via Artist Studio and the platform’s Fan Support Dashboard. Fans seeking purchase of the songs will be able to download the platform in either MP3 or WAV format. Artists will be able to keep 100% of each sale, excluding standard fees and taxes. According to a press release, SoundCloud plans to receive feedback from the initial set of users in order to refine the offering ahead of a gradual expansion, with wider availability of the service expected to roll out in the fall. In October, SoundCloud announced that artists signed up to the Artist and Artist Pro plans would be able to keep 100% of their royalties when distributing songs via SoundCloud to other streaming platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok and YouTube. Prior to the change, SoundCloud had taken a 20% cut. For streams on SoundCloud’s platform, artists also receive 100% of royalties. The company also began a Fan Support program in October, which allows fans to donate from $1 to $1,000 in exchange for their names to be featured on the artist’s page. In July 2025, SoundCloud partnered with elasticStage to offer print-on-demand vinyl for users.

articles.title: 5 Fantasy Football Running Backs Who Will Lose The Most Touches In 2026
articles.summary: The workload squeeze is coming for some elite running backs in 2026. It means the margin for error is shrinking. A runner who loses four or five touches per game can suddenly fall from an unquestioned RB1 into a touchdown-dependent weekly flex. The fantasy football managers who recognize those wo
articles._body: The workload squeeze is coming for some elite running backs in 2026 . It means the margin for error is shrinking. A runner who loses four or five touches per game can suddenly fall from an unquestioned RB1 into a touchdown-dependent weekly flex. The fantasy football managers who recognize those workload shifts before they become obvious will have a major advantage. Here are five prominent backs whose touch counts could take the biggest hit in 2026. Travis Etienne Jr. | New Orleans Saints Mandatory Credit: Stephen Lew-Imagn Images Travis Etienne Jr. is perhaps the clearest example of a player whose fantasy football value has been transformed by a change of scenery. After establishing himself as a high-volume weapon in Jacksonville, Etienne signed with New Orleans this offseason. The Saints did not, however, remove Alvin Kamara from the equation. Instead, Kamara restructured his contract in July to remain with New Orleans for 2026. That matters enormously for fantasy managers. New Orleans head coach Kellen Moore has publicly envisioned a backfield featuring both players. Kamara’s continued presence means Etienne is unlikely to inherit every passing-down, two-minute and change-of-pace opportunity. The interesting wrinkle is that Etienne should still be the primary runner. The Saints did not give him that contract to make him a glorified committee back. However, losing even a handful of receptions and high-leverage snaps to Kamara could create a meaningful difference over 17 games. Fro, over 15 carries per game in 2025, look for Etienne to have 12-13 this year. Kyren Williams | Los Angeles Rams Kyren Williams has spent the past three seasons proving that Sean McVay trusts him with serious work. He has topped 1,100 rushing yards and 10 touchdowns in each of his last three seasons. That includes 1,252 rushing yards and 10 rushing touchdowns on 259 carries in 2025. However, there is now a legitimate second act developing in the Rams backfield. Blake Corum exploded for 746 rushing yards and six touchdowns on 145 carries in 2025. He averaged an impressive 5.1 yards per carry. That efficiency is difficult for McVay to ignore, particularly when the objective is keeping Williams fresh over a long season. No, Williams will not lose his starting job. Far from it. That said, Corum has earned more work. That could mean Williams drops from his usual massive workload. Even a modest reduction could make Williams more dependent on touchdowns and receiving production to maintain his elite fantasy ranking. Josh Jacobs | Green Bay Packers Josh Jacobs remains one of the most powerful volume runners in football. His 2026 fantasy football outlook, though, carries a different level of uncertainty. The Packers are already prepared to manage his workload when necessary. Jacobs is currently dealing with a groin injury that kept him sidelined during part of training camp. Meanwhile, MarShawn Lloyd has impressed sufficiently to receive first-team opportunities. Green Bay has multiple backs capable of contributing There is just little incentive for the organization to force Jacobs into an enormous workload every Sunday. Lloyd’s development is particularly important. The young back has been given an opportunity to demonstrate that he can shoulder more responsibility. Chris Brooks also remains part of the equation. Recent preseason usage has shown how quickly the rotation can change when Jacobs is unavailable. Jacobs can still finish among the league leaders in touchdowns. But fantasy managers expecting another season built almost entirely around volume should recognize the warning signs. Bucky Irving | Tampa Bay Buccaneers Bucky Irving’s situation is tricky because the threat to his workload is Tampa Bay’s desire to build a more versatile backfield. Irving was spectacular in 2024, rushing for 1,122 yards while adding 47 receptions. His 2025 campaign was interrupted by injury, however, and he finished with 588 rushing yards and 277 receiving yards across 10 games. Now, the Buccaneers, though, have deliberately added Kenneth Gainwell to the equation. Gainwell brings a completely different dimension as a receiving back. Tampa Bay specifically highlighted his pass-catching ability and third-down versatility. That will directly cut into Irving’s fantasy workload. Irving remains the player with the greatest explosive potential. He has also taken first-team reps during camp. Still, the result could be a frustrating distribution in which Irving remains highly efficient but sees fewer total opportunities than fantasy managers expect. Saquon Barkley | Philadelphia Eagles Bill Streicher-Imagn Images Saquon Barkley is perhaps the most uncomfortable name on this list. The argument is not that Philadelphia has stopped believing in him. It is that the Eagles have every reason to protect him. Barkley handled 280 carries for 1,140 yards and seven touchdowns in 2025 . That followed an enormous workload during Philadelphia’s championship run the previous season. Of course, he is the unquestioned No. 1 back on the Eagles’ depth chart. That said, the Eagles’ bigger objective is obvious: have Barkley at his best when the postseason arrives. That makes workload management all but certain. Philadelphia can reduce some of Barkley’s early-down carries and allow Jalen Hurts to remain a major factor around the goal line. None of that makes Barkley a bad fantasy pick. It simply makes another 300-touch campaign considerably improbable. The post 5 Fantasy Football Running Backs Who Will Lose The Most Touches In 2026 appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: DAZN Acquires EverPass Media, Gains NFL Sunday Ticket’s Commercial Rights
articles.summary: REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon
articles._body: DAZN is significantly accelerating its U.S. market expansion, acquiring EverPass Media in a large-scale agreement that brings in the exclusive commercial distributor of NFL Sunday Ticket. In the latest of a six-month wave of aggressive dealmaking, the London-based DAZN will rebrand EverPass to “DAZN for Business,’ marking the latest shift for the EverPass business that the NFL’s 32 Equity arm and RedBird Capital Partners originally formed in 2023. Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed. The EverPass pact adds to a still-growing run of agreements for DAZN as it seeks to gain a bigger foothold in the American market. Its other recent deals include: An acquisition of streaming technology developer ViewLift Individual team-level deals with the Timberwolves and Pacers, with several more soon to arrive, building off the recent demise of regional sports network operator Main Street Sports Group An agreement with the Gotham Sports partnership involving the YES Network and MSG Networks in which DAZN will become the exclusive local streaming home for seven pro teams, including the Yankees and defending NBA champion Knicks. Each of these agreements extends beyond DAZN’s original base in soccer and combat sports. “DAZN can now serve every type of customer in the U.S., from individual sports fans using the DAZN app to commercial venues,” said DAZN Group CEO Shay Segev. 32 Equity, RedBird Capital Partners, and TKO Group Holdings will become minority shareholders in DAZN. Sunday Matters In this new structure, DAZN for Business will retain its exclusive commercial distribution rights for NFL Sunday Ticket, mirroring the consumer-level service offered by YouTube TV. The EverPass commercial business has relied on an IP-based technology platform to provide games to multiscreen venues. A recent contract extension between EverPass and satellite carrier DirecTV after a protracted negotiation, however, ensures that bars and restaurants will not necessarily be forced to stream NFL Sunday Ticket. In some pockets of the country, there has been heavy resistance to shift to streaming for NFL games, the most-watched programming in all of U.S. television, given the cultural and technological issues still often associated with the digital medium. Other existing EverPass commercial distribution rights conveying to DAZN in this acquisition include streaming agreements with ESPN, Amazon, Peacock, and Apple TV, among others. Those pacts involve live games for nearly every major pro and college league. Editors’ note: RedBird IMI, in which RedBird Capital Partners is a joint venture partner, is the primary investor in Front Office Sports . articles.title: Patriots rumors: Mike Garafolo ‘reads between lines’ of Christian Gonzalez’s contract frustrations
articles.summary: The New England Patriots are still struggling to extend their best defender. Christian Gonzalez sounded off on his contract dispute with the Patriots on Tuesday after weeks of negotiations. A deal does not look any closer to being done with the regular season just a few weeks away. NFL Network
articles._body: The New England Patriots are still struggling to extend their best defender. Christian Gonzalez sounded off on his contract dispute with the Patriots on Tuesday after weeks of negotiations. A deal does not look any closer to being done with the regular season just a few weeks away. NFL Network’s Mike Garafolo gave another update on the contract talks between Gonzalez and the Patriots. He expected that Devon Witherspoon’s recent contract extension would make negotiations easier. “I thought well, that should make it easy for the Patriots and Christian Gonzalez, for both sides. There’s the number at the top of the market, we should get something done in short order,” Garafolo said on Wednesday via Good Morning Football. “… Now, Christian Gonzalez talking to the media, and remember this is a soft-spoken guy… sensing the frustration when he was talking to reporters and saying that he knows his worth. Eliot Wolf, the general manager of the Patriots, said they are still willing to make him the highest-paid cornerback in the league. That’s one metric. That’s the only thing we know from both sides.” Witherspoon reset the market with a four-year, $132 million deal. Gonzalez clearly wants a deal that is in the same ballpark, if not higher. So what’s the hold up? Garafolo speculated that other details in New England’s proposed contract, beyond the simple value per year, must not be up to Gonzalez’s standards. “But we don’t know the guarantees, we don’t know the cash flow, we don’t know any of this,” Garafolo added. “I can only read between the lines from what Gonzalez is saying, saying all those metrics are not there yet. And that would be a reason why, at this point, we still don’t have a deal done here. There is no deadline, but as we get closer to Week 1, you would think that both sides would want to get something done.” Patriots fans must be hopeful that the upcoming regular season will create some urgency around the situation. In the meantime, the Patriots have their preseason finale against the Browns on August 27th. articles._body: The Jacksonville Jaguars are getting a lot done at joint practices . Jacksonville is ready for the regular season after surprising the league with an impressive 13-win campaign last year. The Jaguars could have a dangerous offense if they can enter the regular season with all of their key players healthy. Fortunately, that now looks more possible than ever. Jaguars wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr. is out at practice on Wednesday morning wearing a non-contract jersey , per ESPN’s Michael DiRocco. Thomas picked up a shoulder injury on Tuesday after awkwardly landing on it. He sat out the rest of practice, creating concerns about the star wide receiver’s health before the regular season. “I think it’s alright. Just came down on his shoulder. Holding him out was smart, keep him out and then get him go for Cleveland,” Coen said after practice. It is great to see that Thomas is immediately back out at practice after that injury scare. Still, Jaguars fans should keep a close eye on his practice reps while his recovery continues. At this point, it is too early to know if Thomas will miss Week 1 because of his injury. Or if he’ll be on a snap count while he continues to get healthy. Jacksonville will likely take the safe path with their star wide receiver, especially ahead of a crucial 2026 season. The Jaguars are hopeful that Thomas can produce like he did during his rookie season, when he had 87 receptions for 1,282 receiving yards and 10 touchdowns. Fortunately, the Jaguars have some contingency plans in case Thomas starts the season off a bit slow. They can always lean on their other receivers, including Parker Washington, Jakobi Meyers, and superstar Travis Hunter. Next up for the Jaguars is their preseason finale against the Buccaneers on August 28th. articles._body: During a recent night out, NBA star Luka Doncic and Playboy model Anja Jenko were at the same nightclub during the Los Angeles Lakers’ offseason trip to Slovenia . However, they seemingly did not cross paths , as a source clarified that “Luka did not see or speak to Anja.” Sources told Žurnal24 that Doncic “allegedly avoided the beauties,” and it appears Jenko only made a brief appearance at the party. According to Žurnal24’s report, she was seen with another man and a group of girls at a restaurant that same night. The clarification comes after Slovenian news outlet Nedeljski dnevnik (via the New York Post) reported that the Lakers players went to “a Ljubljana restaurant that also serves as a nightclub.” According to the report, there were strict rules in place for the party. Among them were no pictures or videos allowed inside the venue. Jenko was reportedly seen partying with the team at the nightclub, but it doesn’t appear to be the case. She was born in Slovenia’s capital city, and she was on the cover of Playboy Magazine in 2014. The New York Post notes that there wasn’t any reporting that any Lakers stars were specifically hanging out with Jenko. Editor’s note: Representatives for Luka Doncic reached out to clarify that he did not cross paths with Anja Jenko, hence the amended headline. Luka Doncic and the Lakers’ offseason trip to Slovenia Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images Doncic has taken his Lakers teammates to his home country of Slovenia during the offseason. He is now the unquestioned leader of the team following LeBron James’ departure. Among the activities they have engaged in are meals, partying, and a bike race in the streets of Ljubljana. They appear to be having a great time, which is a positive sign for the Lakers’ camaraderie. Doncic is entering his second full season with the Lakers. He was traded to Los Angeles by the Dallas Mavericks during the 2024-25 regular season. In his first full year with the Lakers, Doncic led the league in points per game, averaging 33.5 per contest. They narrowly survived the Houston Rockets, nearly blowing a 3-0 series lead, before being swept by the Oklahoma City Thunder in the next round. articles.title: Ronda Rousey is back training months after her MMA retirement
articles.summary: Just months after dominating and easily defeating Gina Carano at Jake Paul’s MVP MMA 1, Ronda Rousey announced her retirement from the sport. A celebrated Olympic, UFC, and WWE legend, Rousey parted ways with UFC in 2016 before beginning her WWE career. However, a few years later, in 2023,
articles._body: Just months after dominating and easily defeating Gina Carano at Jake Paul’s MVP MMA 1, Ronda Rousey announced her retirement from the sport. A celebrated Olympic, UFC, and WWE legend, Rousey parted ways with UFC in 2016 before beginning her WWE career. However, a few years later, in 2023, Rousey also parted ways with WWE. She later enjoyed a brief indie wrestling stint before appearing on AEW TV and then fighting Carano on Netflix. Now, months after hanging up her boots, Rousey was spotted back in training. The Professional Fighters League recently posted a picture of Jean Bishop training with Ronda Rousey in preparation for his upcoming rematch against Liz Carmouche for the inaugural PFL women’s flyweight championship. View this post on Instagram On Oct. 16, 2026, Bishop and Carmouche will headline PFL Chicago at Wintrust Arena. The fight will crown the promotion’s first-ever women’s flyweight champion and also become the promotion’s first new title since the PFL’s merger with MVP [Most Valuable Promotions]. The upcoming fight is a rematch of last year’s PFL women’s flyweight tournament final, where Carmouche stopped Bishop in the third round of that bout. However, following the loss, Bishop has rebounded with victories over Borena Tsertsvadze and Ariane Lipski da Silva. Carmouche is set to enter the fight following a submission win over Viviane Araujo in Jun. 2026. UFC Hall of Famer Rousey also shares a history with Carmouche. She defeated her at UFC 157 in 2013, in the first defense of her UFC women’s bantamweight title and her UFC debut. Despite her retired status, Rousey is now back training Bishop to avenge last year’s loss. The post Ronda Rousey is back training months after her MMA retirement appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Pablo Alborán Cancels 2nd Show Due to Pneumonia: ‘I’m Recovering Little by Little’
articles.summary: The Spanish star provided an update on his health on Wednesday (Aug. 26).
articles._body: UPDATE (Aug. 26): Pablo Alborán will not be able to perform this weekend at the Festival de la Luz in Boimorto, Spain. The Spanish star, who is recovering from a “severe pneumonia” that forced him to cancel a performance last week in Ciudad Real, remains on bed rest under doctor’s orders. “Family, I am recovering little by little from pneumonia, but the doctors insist that I continue resting for a few more days. For this reason, and much to my regret, I will not be able to take part in the Festival de la Luz this Sunday, August 30, in Boimorto,” Alborán said in a statement on his Instagram account on Wednesday (Aug. 26). “The recovery is taking a little longer than I’d like, but it’s on the right track; now it’s a matter of being patient and respecting the necessary timeframes so I can return to 100% and tackle the upcoming projects and concerts with full energy,” he added. “I am truly sorry for any inconvenience this may cause, and I sincerely appreciate your understanding, patience, and all the affection you’ve been sending my way these past few days.” Alborán, who is currently on his Global Tour KM0, announced U.S. dates for 2027 this week, kicking off on February 6 in Miami and making stops in cities including New York, Washington, D.C. and Los Angeles before concluding on February 21 in Dallas, Texas. PREVIOUSLY (Aug. 20): Pablo Alborán has been forced to cancel a show he had scheduled this week in Spain after being diagnosed with “severe pneumonia.” The Spanish pop star shared the news with his fans Thursday (Aug. 20) through his social media. “I have just been diagnosed with severe pneumonia, and on medical advice, I need complete rest for the next few days,” he wrote in a post on his Instagram account. “We are unfortunately forced to cancel the concert scheduled for tomorrow, August 21, in Ciudad Real. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for filling this very special concert, and I hope we can see each other very soon.” Related Billboard No. 1s Spain Lights Up Starlite Madrid With Ana Mena, Pablo Alborán & More: Here Are the Best Photos Pablo Alborán’s Ultra Personal Album ‘KM0’ & More Best New Music Latin Pablo Alborán & Julio Reyes Copello Create Music at Latin Music Week 2025: ‘We Share the Same Vision of Beauty’ The singer of hits like “Solamente Tú,” “Saturno” and “Te He Echado de Menos” also urged that “this information be handled with care and calmness, avoiding clickbait, misinterpretations or headlines that could cause unnecessary concern” to his loved ones. “It’s just pneumonia,” he emphasized, “and I’ve already started a round of antibiotics that will have me back to normal in no time.” Billboard Español reached out to a rep for Alborán, who had no further comment. Alborán is currently in the middle of his KM0 2026 world tour, with his next performance scheduled for Aug. 30 in Boimorto, Spain, at the Festival de la Luz, according to his website . In September, he is set to tour Latin America, starting on the 27th in Costa Rica and including stops in El Salvador, Panama, Mexico and Puerto Rico. The trek supports his latest album, KM0 , a deeply personal 14-track project with four bonus tracks born out of the pain and uncertainty caused by a loved one’s illness, as the artist shared in an interview with Billboard . Released last November, the set was included in Billboard ‘s list of the 2 5 Best Latin Albums of 2025 . Read Alborán’s full statement below. View this post on Instagram

articles.title: Psychiatry’s diagnostic bible is finally getting a biological upgrade
articles.summary: Biology is coming to psychiatry’s diagnostic manual, even as reliable biomarkers remain rare.
articles._body: The “ bible” of clinical psychiatry —the DSM, short for the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders—is one of the most popular psychiatry reference books around the world. Clinicians use it to diagnose patients and scientists use it to guide research. Despite its wide impact, the DSM has never integrated biology in its diagnoses of mental illness. This omission was largely because the underlying biology of mental illness was too preliminary to be included in such a widely used clinical manual. The most recent version of the DSM— the DSM-5 , released in 2013— has attracted significant criticism from clinicians and researchers , including on how its lack of objective biological measures risks medicalizing human suffering and reducing the validity of psychiatric diagnoses. articles.title: Carrier Eyeing Fort Worth for $433M Plant
articles.summary: HVAC giant Carrier is seeking the best deal from any one of three cities in a competition to build a $433.8 million manufacturing plant. Fort Worth is one of them. The city is proposing a seven-year tax aba
articles._body: HVAC giant Carrier is seeking the best deal from any one of three cities in a competition to build a $433.8 million manufacturing plant. Fort Worth is one of them. The city is proposing a seven-year tax abatement agreement valued at $10.9 million as an incentive for the company to bring the plant there. The city would also nominate the company for a Texas Enterprise Zone grant with an estimated value of $2.5 million. In return, the company would agree to a minimum capital investment of $433.8 million in a new plant by the end of 2028. Of that, $36 million would be spent on real property construction costs and $397.8 million on equipping the plant. The company would also pledge to spend 30% of construction costs with small businesses and provide a minimum of 495 jobs by the end of 2029 with a minimum average salary of $75,000. The proposed location is Alliance Westport 12, a 1.2 million-square-foot building.,being developed by Hillwood. Carrier plans to make a decision on the new manufacturing plant in the third quarter of this year. The post Carrier Eyeing Fort Worth for $433M Plant appeared first on Connect CRE .

articles.summary: The Chicago Bears were worried about Darnell Wright after he suffered an injury in practice ahead of their preseason finale this weekend. They’ve received some good news, and it looks like he’ll be back on the practice field soon, according to ESPN’s Courtney Cronin. “The
articles._body: The Chicago Bears were worried about Darnell Wright after he suffered an injury in practice ahead of their preseason finale this weekend. They’ve received some good news, and it looks like he’ll be back on the practice field soon, according to ESPN’s Courtney Cronin. “The Bears have a light practice at 11 a.m. before they’ll fly to Tennessee for a joint practice with the Titans on Thursday. I’m told that Darnell Wright is ‘fine’ after leaving practice early yesterday with what looked like an elbow injury. We’ll see if he’s out there today,” Cronin wrote on X, formerly Twitter. Wright suffered the injury during red zone drills and had to be replaced by Theo Benedet. It’s good news that he didn’t suffer anything serious, and the battle for the left tackle position can continue. Just recently, head coach Ben Johnson seemed uncertain about who would be at left tackle when the season starts against the Carolina Panthers, and he has a few weeks to make that decision. “Ben Johnson said that the left tackle battle remains ongoing, calling it ‘a hot spot’ for the team that still doesn’t have answers yet among the 4 players that have been in the mix (Jones, Benedet, Amegadjie, Wills). Johnson: ‘I don’t know know that we’re 100% sold on who that guy is going to be in Carolina for us,'” Cronin wrote on X. It would seem like Wright had the upper hand, and then he got injured, which left even more doubt in Johnson’s mind. Now with Wright coming back soon, he should still have the lead, but it wouldn’t be surprising if someone else jumped him. Things could get interesting in the preseason finale against the Tennessee Titans, and that game could determine who wins the starting job for the position. articles.title: Chet Holmgren’s workout video with Kevin Durant filled with fans making Victor Wembanyama quips
articles.summary: If there is one player who is out to seek redemption, it is Oklahoma City Thunder forward Chet Holmgren. Holmgren was heavily ridiculed by fans after his terrible performance in the Western Conference Finals against the San Antonio Spurs. He was badly outplayed by his supposed rival, Spurs center
articles._body: If there is one player who is out to seek redemption, it is Oklahoma City Thunder forward Chet Holmgren. Holmgren was heavily ridiculed by fans after his terrible performance in the Western Conference Finals against the San Antonio Spurs. He was badly outplayed by his supposed rival, Spurs center Victor Wembanyama, with Holmgren looking like he forgot to play basketball. The 24-year-old Holmgren has been busy with his individual training in the offseason. In a new video, he was shown working out with Houston Rockets forward Kevin Durant. The one-time champion looked good as he honed his new moves , scoring on Durant multiple times. View this post on Instagram Fans, however, still roasted Holmgren with quips about Wembanyama. “None of this matters if he’s not doing this against Wemby,” said @hype_b. “Until he sees Wemby, none of this matters,” echoed @justj3ffo. “Till Wemby walks in, then he’s a deer in headlights,” added @milk_s4vage. “Wemby is locking that s*** up,” posted @agentglenn. “All this skill just to get dog-crapped by Wemby,” commented @zorr_ow10. “Offense is nice, but you still afraid to guard Wemby?” asked @jon_the_disney_photographer. While he disappeared against the Spurs, Holmgren had a strong campaign overall. He earned his first nod to the All-Star Game and the All-NBA Third Team. He also finished as runner-up to Wembanyama for Defensive Player of the Year. Holmgren averaged career-highs of 17.1 points, 55.7% shooting, and 8.9 rebounds on top of 1.9 blocks in 69 games. He helped the Thunder to a league-best record of 64-18. Working out with Durant will only make Holmgren even more lethal. But he also has to improve on the mental aspect, which will allow him to play better and with more intention. articles.title: Charli xcx Nominated for Best Original Song at 2026 World Soundtrack Awards: Will Oscar Nod Follow?
articles.summary: The 26th edition of the World Soundtrack Awards Ceremony & Concert is set for October.
articles._body: UPDATE (Aug. 26): The World Soundtrack Awards announced nominations in four additional categories today, including the public choice award. Fittingly, the nominees in that category hail from around the world. Simon Franglen ( Avatar: Fire and Ash ) and Daniel Pemberton ( Project Hail Mary ) are English, Kevin Smithers ( Soy Frankelda ) is Mexican; Ludek Drizhal ( Starbright ) is Czech; and Marcelo Zarvos ( KPop Demon Hunters ) is Brazilian. Winners will be announced on Saturday Oct. 10 at the annual WSA Ceremony & Concert during Film Fest Gent, Belgium’s biggest international film festival. PREVIOUSLY (Aug. 5): We won’t know if Charli xcx will receive an Oscar nomination for her songs from Emerald Fennell’s film Wuthering Heights until the nods are announced on Jan. 21, but Charli is vying in that category at the 2026 World Soundtrack Awards. Film Fest Gent and the World Soundtrack Academy revealed the first wave of nominations for the World Soundtrack Awards on Wednesday (Aug. 5). Related Charli xcx’s ‘Wuthering Heights’ Soundtrack Hits No. 1 in U.K. Charli xcx Gets Gothic in ‘House’ Video for Emerald Fennell’s ‘Wuthering Heights’ Adaptation Charli xcx’s ‘Wuthering Heights’ Debuts at No. 1 on Billboard’s Soundtracks Chart “House,” which Charli cowrote with John Cale, Nathan Klein and Finn Keane, is competing with four songs from 2025 films: “Golden” from KPop Demon Hunters , which won the Oscar for best original song in March; “Train Dreams” from Train Dreams , which was nominated in that category; “No Place Like Home” from Wicked: For Good , which was shortlisted but not nominated; and “Stolen Tale” from Hedda , which wasn’t shortlisted. Icelandic composer Hildur Guðnadóttir is double nominated at the World Soundtrack Awards. She’s vying for best original song for the aforementioned song from Hedda and film composer of the year for her work on The Bridge!, Hedda and 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple. The other nominees for film composer of the year include Alexandre Desplat ( Frankenstein ), Jonny Greenwood ( One Battle After Another ) and Max Richter ( Hamnet ), all of whom were nominated for Oscars for best original score in March, and Daniel Pemberton, who has yet to be Oscar-nominated for best original score (though he was nominated for best original song for cowriting “Hear My Voice” from The Trial of the Chicago 7) . The second wave of nominations — in the categories discovery of the year, public choice award, game music award and Belgian film composer of the year — will be announced on Sept. 3. The 26th edition of the World Soundtrack Awards Ceremony & Concert is set to take place on Saturday, Oct. 10, at Music Centre De Bijloke in Ghent during Film Fest Gent, Belgium’s biggest international film festival. articles.title: Post Malone’s Beloved ‘August 26th’ Mixtape Available on Streaming For First Time
articles.summary: The rapper marked the 10th anniversary of his newly remastered first full-length project by issuing it on vinyl as well.
articles._body: Post Malone is marking a landmark date in his career by re-releasing his August 26th mixtape on streaming and vinyl for the first time. Newly remastered, the rapper’s first full-length album and major label debut, was originally issued on May 12, 2016 on Republic Records and featured collabs with 2 Chainz, Lil Yachty, Jaden Smith, Jeremih and others. The 10-track tape that followed the MC’s breakout debut single, 2015’s “White Iverson,” featured a preview of what fans could expect from Austin over the next decade, including the stoney opener “Never Understand,” as well as the melodic jam “Money Made Me Do It,” woozy “Git Wit U” and the no-holds-barred come-on “F–k”; It was preceded by the self-released 2014 mixtape, Y.A.T.R. The collection’s title originally referred to the planned release date for Posty’s debut solo album, Stoney , which was pushed back to December 2016 after several delays. The wait was worth it, though, as the LP featured a trio of A-list collaborators, including Justin Bieber (“Deja Vu”), Quavo (“Congratulations”) and Kehlani (“Feel”), as well as production by Metro Boomin, Mustard, Pharrell, and frequent collaborators Louis Bell and Frank Dukes. Malone, 31, recently announced his engagement to on-and-off girlfriend Christy Lee. According to TMZ , Malone proposed to Lee on Tuesday in Utah, where friends also flew out to celebrate the occasion. The rapper, born Austin Richard Post, was first linked to Lee in early 2025, when they were spotted together during a dinner in Rome. Later that year they were spotted together in Paris, though the couple reportedly broke up in June 2025 and then were photographed together again in New York in February of this year. articles.title: NBA rumors: Insider hints Lakers vs. Timberwolves Jonathan Kuminga battle will end ‘soon’
articles.summary: Jonathan Kuminga is still one of the top remaining players left in free agency, but there’s a chance his wait could be ending soon. For most of the offseason, the Los Angeles Lakers have had interest in signing him, but it hasn’t been that easy to do so because of a possible sign-and-
articles._body: Jonathan Kuminga is still one of the top remaining players left in free agency, but there’s a chance his wait could be ending soon. For most of the offseason, the Los Angeles Lakers have had interest in signing him , but it hasn’t been that easy to do so because of a possible sign-and-trade with the Atlanta Hawks. The Minnesota Timberwolves have shown interest since they’ve traded both of their forwards, and Kuminga is obviously the best remaining option on the market. It’s going to come down to those two teams, and according to NBA insider Jake Fischer, a resolution should be coming . “I think Kuminga has seemed to prefer going to the Lakers,” Fischer said. “They have the most opportunity to negotiate there. Minnesota is just limited to signing Kuminga to the taxpayer mid-level. He would walk into a starting job in both situations, where Minnesota is thin at the forward spot. The Lakers have been selling him on this vision of having him start next to Luka [Doncic]; they’re going to have the spending power to reward him next year if all goes to plan. That’s going to come to some type of conclusion soon. Jake Fischer says he thinks Kuminga prefers the Lakers over the Timberwolves and that his decision will come to a conclusion soon (Via: @BleacherReport ) pic.twitter.com/d1bWv0HPuA — LakersMuse (@LALMuse) August 25, 2026 “I thought it could’ve happened last week, but I still have been told nothing to suggest that Kuminga’s situation is coming down to the Lakers or the Timberwolves.” The Lakers have built their roster throughout the offseason, and adding Kuminga would be the cherry on top. He’s the athletic forward that they need, and he’d fit right in with what they’re trying to do. The same thing goes for the Timberwolves, who are in desperate need of a player like Kuminga at his position. It’ll be interesting to see what he decides, but it looks like the Lakers are in the lead, like they have been all along. articles._body: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers are ready to make some noise during the 2026 NFL season. Tampa added edge rusher Rueben Bain Jr. during the 2026 NFL Draft, giving them another excellent player in their front seven. Bain just got some positive injury news after a brief scare during a recent training camp practice. Bain suffered an AC sprain , but it is said to be “nothing serious” per ESPN’s Adam Schefter. The injury occurred on Tuesday at joint practices with the Jaguars . Fortunately, Bain is expected to be ready to play in Week 1 against the Bengals. Tampa will be counting on Bain to make an impact right away during his rookie season. Bain is projected to start on the edge next to Yaya Diaby and will hopefully bring some juice to Tampa’s defense. The former Hurricane had an excellent three-year run at the University of Miami. He impressed scouts with a fantastic junior season, logging nearly 10 sacks, 15.5 tackles for loss, and an interception in 2025. Buccaneers fans are hopeful that he can reach those same heights during his career in the NFL. It is great news that Bain should be available in Week 1. Still, it is fair to question whether the rookie will be at full strength with the regular season just two weeks away. If Bain is still recovering in Week 1, the Buccaneers do have a backup plan. Tampa signed veteran edge rusher Al-Quadin Muhammad to a one-year, $6 million contract during NFL free agency. Muhammad impressed with 11 sacks as a rotational player in Detroit during the 2025 season. He should be ready to split time with Bain, or temporarily take over his starting role, if needed. Either way, it will be exciting to see how Tampa’s new-look defense performs when the regular season kicks off soon. But before then, the Buccaneers must play their preseason finale against the Jaguars on August 28th. articles.title: Dolly Parton Dead at 80: Music Executives Remember the Country Icon
articles.summary: Following the music legend's passing at the age of 80, industry executives are sharing their reactions and condolences
articles._body: Following the death of Dolly Parton on Tuesday (Aug. 25) at the age of 80, those who worked with the country icon and others across the music industry are remembering the singer and songwriter’s impact across her 60-year career.   Parton was named Billboard ’s Top Country Artist of All Time , with the singer having scored 25 No. 1s on Billboard ’s Hot Country Songs chart, the most of any woman, and 49 top 10s on Billboard ’s Country Albums chart. In addition to her success as a songwriter and recording artist, Parton has long been recognized for her business acumen. Related Dolly Parton, One of Country Music’s Biggest & Brightest Icons, Dies at 80 Dale Morris, Nashville Manager Who Guided Careers of Alabama & Kenny Chesney, Dies at 89 HYBE Pledges Over $300k for Colombia Earthquake Recovery She co-owned Dollywood, a theme park located in her hometown of Pigeon Forge, Tenn., and she also operated the Imagination Library — a program that mails free books to children from birth until they first begin school. She had also been a co-owner of Sandollar Productions alongside her former manager, Sandy Gallin , which produced Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Father of the Bride and Sabrina , among others. See below for all the reactions. We will update this story as more come through. Sarah Trahern, CEO, Country Music Association “At the end of the day, few artists define Country Music better than the one-word, Dolly. Over her decades-long career, I worked with her on a number of programs. She was always the most professional in every setting, often walking off the bus in heels and hair and makeup ready to go, before expected and before the cast and crew. However, along with the music, our biggest loss today is her work as a philanthropist and the genuine difference she has made in people’s lives throughout the world. There will only ever be one Dolly.”  Academy of Country Music “The Academy is deeply saddened by the passing of Dolly Parton. She leaves behind a legacy that reaches far beyond the stage. Through her unmistakable voice, unforgettable songs, generosity and larger-than-life spirit, she touched generations and made the world a little brighter. “A member of the Country Music Hall of Fame and the Grand Ole Opry, Dolly was a 14-time ACM Award recipient and three-time host of the ACM Awards. She gave us some of country music’s most enduring songs and moments, and at this year’s ACM Honors, she was honored with the ACM Poet’s Award — a beautiful recognition of the songwriter whose words became a part of so many lives. “As we look back on these ACM moments, we’re reminded of the incredible mark Dolly left on country music and on all those who grew up with her songs. Her music will live on, carrying her voice and her story forward for generations to come. “Rest in peace, Dolly.” View this post on Instagram Sony Music Group “We are deeply saddened by the passing of singer-songwriter, music legend, actress, author, businesswoman and philanthropist Dolly Parton. Every superlative you could apply to her would be accurate.  “Dolly was a monumental talent and trailblazer whose extraordinary artistry touched millions around the globe. For nearly three decades, we were lucky she called our record labels and publishing company home. She made songs that became part of our shared vocabulary and crossed genres and generations.  “Her generosity was as extraordinary as her talent. She created opportunities for others that she herself never had. Dolly showed that an artist’s legacy is measured not only in songs, but in lives changed.  “We send our deepest condolences to her family, friends and fans around the world.  “We will always love you.” Kyle Young, CEO, Country Music Hall of Fame “Dolly Parton’s legacy is not celebrity, but humanity. She was a champion of equality and literacy. She was a picture of dignity, even when dressed outrageously. Anyone who seeks to be more like Dolly is on the right track, but they’ll never get to the finish line. She came from poverty to become the most important native of Tennessee. She shared her fortunes for the good of all of us, and shared her soul in every note she sang.” View this post on Instagram Rock & Roll Hall of Fame “Rest in peace, Dolly Parton 🦋 “Today we honor 2022 Inductee @dollyparton , a groundbreaking singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, performer, actor, and media mogul. articles.title: Barry Manilow Taking a Break From Las Vegas Residency After Canceling Shows: ‘We All Need To Sit Down and Shut Up’
articles.summary: The singer who had surgery for stage 1 lung cancer in December, promised to be back on stage in October.
articles._body: Barry Manilow is taking a break. The legendary “Copacabana” singer posted a note to fans on Tuesday (Aug. 25) announcing that he is pulling the plug on planned residency shows at the International Theater at Westgate Las Vegas planned for this weekend, as well as six shows scheduled for September in order to rest and recuperate. “Hi everybody — Barry here,” he wrote in an Instagram post . “And I want you to be the first to know that we’re going to take a quick break. We just finished a fantastic summer tour. 29 shows in 68 days. The shows were fantastic. The audiences were fantastic. And I sounded fantastic,” he added. “But it seems that we were pushing a little too hard.” The decision came after Manilow, 83, postponed his planned 2026 arena tour and delayed his February residency shows in Vegas in the wake of surgery for lung cancer in December. He was slated to return to the stage at Westgate last Thursday (Aug. 20), but that show was called off just before curtain, followed by the cancelation of last weekend’s Friday and Saturday gigs due to reported “ technical and vocal problems .” In addition to last week’s The Hits Come Home residency shows at Westgate, Manilow’s note indicates that he has pulled the plug on concerts slated for this weekend (Aug. 27, 28 and 29), as well as Sept. 17, 18, 9, 24, 25 and 26; at press time Westgate had not yet removed those dates from their calendar and a spokesperson for Manilow had not returned Billboard ‘s request for comment. Manilow’s note to fans continued with his signature good humor, with the singer writing, “Now we all need to sit down and shut up. So we’re going to take a break until we return to the Westgate Las Vegas on October 8th. When I’ll be singing like a bird. Hope to see you then.” The message ended with Manilow adding that new Westgate dates will be announced next week. Prior to last week’s Westgate call-off, Manilow postponed a show in Lexington, Ky. just before curtain on Aug. 4, citing “ unforeseen circumstances “; it was the second time that show did not go on, following a March postponement in the wake of Manilow’s lung cancer treatment. Manilow had treatment for stage 1 lung cancer in December, including surgery to remove a cancerous spot from his left lung, which resulted in the singer pushing back his planned February Las Vegas residency dates, as well as his February, March and April arena shows on doctor’s advice to rest.
