articles.summary: Jose Fernandez has never been one to sugarcoat things, and he was not about to start on the biggest night of his first WNBA season. Moments after the Dallas Wings clinched a playoff berth with a 96-78 win over the Portland Fire on Tuesday, the first-year head coach closed his media session with a
articles._body: Jose Fernandez has never been one to sugarcoat things, and he was not about to start on the biggest night of his first WNBA season. Moments after the Dallas Wings clinched a playoff berth with a 96-78 win over the Portland Fire on Tuesday, the first-year head coach closed his media session with a thank-you that was equal parts gracious and gloriously blunt. “Thank you guys, I appreciate you guys covering us all year,” Fernandez told reporters after the game . “Through the good, bad, and me being an asshole as well.” Jose Fernandez: “Thank you guys for covering us all year. Through the good, bad… and me being an asshole as well.” pic.twitter.com/DQB41Mjh6U — Drake (@DrakeKeeler) August 26, 2026 It was the perfect punchline for a season that has featured plenty of all three. Fernandez arrived in Dallas after 25 years at South Florida and immediately made headlines for his fiery, no-filter press conferences, including a viral May rant in which he accused his own locker room of selfishness just three games into the year . A handful of blunt, widely dissected media moments followed. The candor rubbed some fans the wrong way, but the results eventually caught up. Dallas improved to 23-16 with the victory, setting a franchise record for regular-season wins with five games still on the schedule. It marked the Wings’ first trip to the postseason since 2023, a stunning turnaround for a team that won a combined 19 games over the previous two seasons. Paige Bueckers powered the clincher with 22 points and 11 assists, notching her 23rd 20-point game of the year. Jessica Shepard added 21 points, nine rebounds and six assists, while Arike Ogunbowale chipped in 17. Awak Kuier posted 12 points, 12 rebounds and five blocks, and all five Dallas starters scored in double figures. The playoff push has come without No. 1 overall pick Azzi Fudd, who is out for the season with a knee injury , making the accomplishment that much more impressive for Fernandez’s group. Veterans Ogunbowale and Shepard have helped steady the young core in her absence. With the eighth and final playoff spot secured, the Wings can now play the closing stretch with seeding in mind before the postseason opens on September 27. And if Fernandez’s parting words to the media were any indication, he is not about to soften up now that the pressure is only going to rise. articles.title: Rookie stuns Cubs with feat not seen before in Diamondbacks history
articles.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks were down to their final out on Tuesday against the Chicago Cubs, facing a 4-3 deficit in the bottom of the ninth inning. The Diamondbacks had a runner on base when manager Torey Lovullo called upon rookie center fielder Ryan Waldschmidt to pinch hit, emerging as the team
articles._body: The Arizona Diamondbacks were down to their final out on Tuesday against the Chicago Cubs, facing a 4-3 deficit in the bottom of the ninth inning. The Diamondbacks had a runner on base when manager Torey Lovullo called upon rookie center fielder Ryan Waldschmidt to pinch hit, emerging as the team’s final hope. Waldschmidt made no mistakes during his at-bat against Cubs closer Jacob Webb. He tattooed a hanging slider from Webb and sent it over the left field wall to give Arizona a 5-4 walk-off victory, much to the delight of the fans in attendance at Chase Field. The 23-year-old is developing a bit of a clutch gene for the Diamondbacks as they remain right in the thick of the hunt for a postseason spot in the NL Wild Card race. In fact, Waldschmidt became the first rookie in MLB history to hit two walk-off home runs in the same calendar month while trailing, as pointed out by OptaSTATS on X. Waldschmidt also hit a walk-off home run on the seventh of August; down 3-2, the Diamondbacks center fielder came to the plate and homered off of the struggling Edwin Diaz to earn his team a victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers. Perhaps this was the moment that gave Lovullo confidence that Waldschmidt can do a job against the Cubs on Tuesday. Waldschmidt was not the most conventional pick to pinch hit, as he only had two home runs and an OPS of .719 on the season entering the night, but the Diamondbacks clearly knew what they were doing by entrusting the moment to the 23-year-old. Waldschmidt has been a solid piece for the Diamondbacks for additional depth in the outfield. But now that he’s showing off a penchant for clutch hits, there might be more untapped potential than people think the 23-year-old outfielder has. Given the strength
articles._body: The NFC now has arguably the two best defensive players in the NFL this season. Green Bay Packers OLB Micah Parsons and Los Angeles Rams EDGE Myles Garrett are two of the best pass-rushers in the league, and they’ll be competing against each other in the same conference. Given the strength of their teams, it wouldn’t be a surprise to see the two players face each other twice this season: once in the regular season, and the next in the postseason. There are plenty of debates on who’s the better defensive player between the two. One of the potential arguments one can use is how much attention each player draws from the offense. After all, the stronger a player, the more likely a team centers their offensive gameplan around neutralizing them, right? The two NFL stars debated who between the two of them drew more attention from their opponents. WATCH: Micah Parsons and Myles Garrett debate who gets more offensive attention. The numbers don't lie in #NFL 's "Iron Sharpens Iron." #Packers #Rams Micah: 70 chips, 88 doubles, 37.4% attention Myles: 139 chips, 60 doubles, 39.5% attention ( @NFL ) pic.twitter.com/BrOnVuUM6C — Michael Gross (@MichaelSGross) August 26, 2026 NFL Next-Gen Stats paint a picture of just how dominant both pass-rushers are at their jobs. Last season, Parsons was doubled 88 times and received a chip block 70 times. His “attention” percentage sat at around 37.4%. On the other hand, Garrett was doubled less at just 60 blocks. However, he significantly received more chip blocks than Parsons, getting chipped 139 times for an attention percentage of 39.5%. Both players are essentially next to each other in these stats. It’s not like these chips and double-teams mattered to both Garrett and Parsons: both players still got their production and then some. Last season, Garrett set the single-season sack record with 23 sacks on the year. Parsons was 7th on the list with 12.5 sacks, though it’s worth noting that Parsons played in just 14 games due to a torn ACL he suffered later in the year. The two NFL stars are some of the most dominant players the league has ever seen at their positions. The Packers and Rams will face each other in Week 12 of the 2026 NFL season. This will be an explosive matchup between two of the top contenders in the league this year. Let’s see how Garrett and Parsons perform against each other. She has seen her popularity rise in recent years, including getting endorsement deals from
articles._body: Alysa Liu has become arguably the most prominent figure skater in the world. She won two gold medals at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics in February, further cementing her status on the global stage. She has seen her popularity rise in recent years, including getting endorsement deals from big-name brands and hanging out with Taylor Swift and Laufey. Her followers on Instagram have grown to 8.2 million. Liu, however, will be out of the spotlight for a while after announcing that she will sit out this season. In a post on Instagram, she cited the need for “personal growth” and to allow her “artistry and skating” to “evolve.” “I’m gonna take the time to recalibrate, fine-tune things, and whatnot. So fear not, I’ll be back, and in the meantime, I’ll be rooting for my teammates near and far,” wrote Liu. View this post on Instagram In a report from NBC Sports’ Nick Zaccardi, the 21-year-old star said she will continue training despite not competing. She is eyeing a return next year . “I really want to improve my skating, and I wanted to take the time to do that for myself and just to evolve, and then I’ll be back after that is done,” explained Liu. “Logically, emotionally, and physically, this just makes the most sense. I will miss seeing the international competitors at all the international (competitions), but there will be more, so it’s fine.” Aside from her pair of gold medals at the Winter Olympics, she has also won two gold medals at the US Figure Skating Championships, a gold medal and a bronze medal at the World Figure Skating Championships , and a gold medal at the Grand Prix of Figure Skating Final. Devers hit his 48th homer in his first 222 games with San Francisco. His 400-foot solo shot off Cincinnati Reds starter Brady S
articles._body: San Francisco Giants first baseman Rafael Devers joined exclusive company in franchise history Tuesday, reaching a home run mark achieved by Barry Bonds and Willie Mays. Devers hit his 48th homer in his first 222 games with San Francisco. His 400-foot solo shot off Cincinnati Reds starter Brady Singer extended the Giants’ lead to 3-0 in the fifth inning of a 3-1 victory at Oracle Park. The ball bounced into McCovey Cove, but the homer did not qualify as an official splash hit because it reached the water after landing. NBC Sports Bay Area’s Alex Pavlovic cited a statistic supplied by Giants PR on X, formerly Twitter, after Tuesday’s game. “Quite the stat from Giants PR: Rafael Devers became the third Giant to hit at least 48 homers in his first 222 games with the organization. The others? Barry Bonds and Willie Mays.” The distinction covers home run production during a player’s first 222 games with the Giants. It does not include Devers’ totals with the Boston Red Sox or compare the three players’ complete careers. Devers also hit a 427-foot, three-run homer Monday in San Francisco’s 5-0 victory over Cincinnati, giving him home runs on consecutive nights. Tuesday’s blast was his 28th of the season and his 16th at Oracle Park, the most by a Giants hitter there since Bonds recorded 16 in 2007. San Francisco acquired Devers from Boston on June 15, 2025. He produced 20 home runs in 90 games for the Giants last season before adding 28 through Tuesday this year. The Giants improved to 54-78 with their second straight win. Devers increased his season totals to 74 RBIs and an .802 OPS while moving within two home runs of 30. articles.title: Bears’ most agonizing roster decision looming on 2026 cutdown day
articles.summary: The Chicago Bears’ most difficult roster decision may come down to a player who never sees the field on opening night. With Caleb Williams certainly comfortable in Ben Johnson’s offense and the starting units beginning to take shape, Chicago’s roster picture is becoming clearer
articles._body: The Chicago Bears’ most difficult roster decision may come down to a player who never sees the field on opening night. With Caleb Williams certainly comfortable in Ben Johnson’s offense and the starting units beginning to take shape, Chicago’s roster picture is becoming clearer by the day. Yet the battle for the final running back spot has refused to follow that script. Roschon Johnson and Salvon Ahmed have created a fascinating collision between reliability and explosiveness. This will force general manager Ryan Poles and Johnson to decide exactly what they value most from the bottom of their offensive depth chart . Pressure points Mandatory Credit: David Banks-Imagn Images Chicago enters its exhibition finale against Tennessee holding a 1-1 record. They opened the slate with a thunderous 34-10 rout of the Cleveland Browns. In their second outing against Cincinnati, the starting offensive unit finally made its live debut. A leaner and lightning-fast Williams engineering an efficient opening scoring drive before the reserves took the reins in a 27-9 exhibition setback. Across two full weeks of live snaps and intense joint sessions, the Bears have witnessed fierce position battles. However, while starting lineups have naturally crystallized, the back end of the depth chart remains a pressure cooker. That is particularly true in the backfield. D’Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai have established themselves as the leading options . This has left the coaching staff to determine whether there is room for a third traditional running back. If there is, Johnson and Ahmed are fighting for it. Neither has made the decision easy. Collision course Roschon Johnson has long offered the type of dependable versatility coaches love in a reserve back. His physical running style gives the Bears an option in short-yardage situations. His pass-protection ability also provides important insurance for Williams . That latter trait could prove particularly valuable in an offense expected to place significant responsibility on the quarterback. A running back who can recognize pressure, step into a blitz and keep his quarterback upright does not always produce spectacular preseason statistics. Still, those snaps can determine whether an offense stays on schedule or loses a possession. Johnson also brings meaningful special-teams value. The ability to contribute beyond offense can be the difference between making the 53-man roster and becoming a practice-squad candidate. Ahmed, however, has attacked the competition from an entirely different direction. His summer has been defined by the ability to create space in a hurry. Ahmed’s explosiveness gives Chicago a legitimate home-run threat from the backfield. Protection vs burst Keeping Roschon Johnson would represent the safer choice. He understands the physical demands of the offense and gives Chicago another body capable of grinding out difficult yards. There is also a locker-room component that should not be dismissed. Johnson’s reputation as a high-character contributor makes coaches trust him in difficult situations. On the flip side, Ahmed’s athletic upside presents an equally compelling argument. The Bears need a player who can provide a different dimension. Ahmed’s burst potentially gives the offense another way to punish defenses that overcommit to Williams, Swift, and Chicago’s motion-heavy concepts. His receiving ability only strengthens that argument. In Ben Johnson’s offense, a running back who can take a simple screen or checkdown and transform it into an explosive gain can force defensive coordinators to account for every inch of the field. Ahmed has shown enough during the preseason to make that possibility increasingly attractive. Waiver-wire gamble Of course, Chicago cannot simply cut one player and quietly bring him back later. If Ahmed continues to showcase explosive ability, running-back-needy teams around the league will have every reason to put in a waiver claim. That makes exposing him to waivers a genuine gamble. The same is true, albeit for different reasons, with Johnson. His pass-protection expertise and special-teams value could attract teams searching for a dependable third-down back. Chicago could therefore lose either player without receiving anything in return. For Poles and Ben Johnson, that makes the final decision much more consequential than a simple RB3 designation. They are effectively deciding which skill set they can most afford to lose. Defining choice Daniel Bartel-Imagn Images Ultimately, Chicago must choose between systemic security and explosive upside. Roschon Johnson is the player who makes the offense safer. Ahmed is the player who potentially makes the offense more dangerous. For a team trying to establish itself as a legitimate NFC contender, that intriguing distinction matters. The argument for Johnson is built around trust. The argument for Ahmed is built around ceiling. And if the Bears believe their championship window is opening now, ceiling may ultimately win the debate. articles.title: Show HN: LLM-powered webapp to build LLM-powered webapps
articles.summary:
Hey all,

The goal is to earn on token margins for LLM calls when you build an AI-powered webapp. I proxy OpenAI and Anthropic calls so that when you deploy a site to a subdomain, your users token usage will be tracked. I charge 2x the token cost to the end user, where the webapp creator gets 80
articles._body: Hey all, The goal is to earn on token margins for LLM calls when you build an AI-powered webapp. I proxy OpenAI and Anthropic calls so that when you deploy a site to a subdomain, your users token usage will be tracked. I charge 2x the token cost to the end user, where the webapp creator gets 80% of the profit and I get 20%. The idea is to ramp your revenue from simple AI apps directly with your popularity and real usage I've built this over the last 3 years. The system behind it is kind of crazy: I use Abstract Syntax Trees and have the LLM write AST transformation code to implement code changes to files. I haven't benchmarked it in a while, but last time I did, it cost more in tokens but produced more targeted code changes (as compared to other agent harnesses). I wrote a blog post about this idea when I first built it: https://codeplusequalsai.com/static/blog/prompting_llms_to_m... Your development project is run inside a docker container, and you can publish it to make it public and get users, and hopefully earn revenue. The real big goal is to make it easier to build small LLM webapps and not worry about revenue model: as users grow (and token costs grow), so does your revenue, proportionally. Do please tell me what you think about the idea and my implementation! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49444234 Points: 1 # Comments: 2

articles.title: Show HN: Propose and Dual-Control for DNS Changes
articles.summary:
Hey, Hacker News. I just want to pick your brain for a feature we're working on.

I don't know whether you have seen this as a pain point, but when I work in a company, a lot of times I try to launch something and need to change a DNS record.

It's always a source of friction in the organizatio
articles._body: Hey, Hacker News. I just want to pick your brain for a feature we're working on. I don't know whether you have seen this as a pain point, but when I work in a company, a lot of times I try to launch something and need to change a DNS record. It's always a source of friction in the organization. I have to email someone or give a link to a co-worker. They have to figure out how to do it, but also whether I have a business justification for doing it. So, when we built this platform, we're trying to come up with a feature that makes it easier. Someone can send you a proposal for DNS record updates. Our system will take the instructions, whether they come from a website, copy and paste, email, or Slack. Anything put in here becomes a proposal for a DNS change, and then someone can approve it. In addition, we believe that for sensitive DNS record changes, it is good to treat them like a bank transfer. So we are building a new feature for dual control, two-person control, or multi-person control of the approval flow, as well as an audit history of who proposed what, who approved something, the date and time, and what changes were made. In addition, we also want to get feedback. I have observed the design slop of the AI that I use, ChatGPT. There are multiple problems. This is the one-shot outcome, and then we massively simplified it to this. Basically, the summary is that it keeps using very bold and solid colors that are very attention-grabbing. The AI also tends to print out a lot of text that is noisy to the user. AI doesn't really understand the structure of the system or the relationship between which components contain which conversations. For example, this requirement for person approval probably fits best in the system where you approve or reject something, right? It is also very verbose. So it took us a little bit of iteration to improve the design. I'm not a designer. I would love to get feedback about the design and whether the observation of AI slop is the same. Have you experienced the same thing? There are other kinds of AI slop. That's it. Thank you. (AI Disclosure: ChatGPT 5.6 Luna was used for grammar fix and spell check) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49444218 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

articles.summary: Allen Robinson II has decided to call it a career after playing 11 seasons in the NFL. He last played for the Detroit Lions in 2024 and failed to find a team last year. He had his best stretch with the Jacksonville Jaguars, who drafted him with the No. 61 pick in 2014. The following […]
articles._body: Allen Robinson II has decided to call it a career after playing 11 seasons in the NFL. He last played for the Detroit Lions in 2024 and failed to find a team last year. He had his best stretch with the Jacksonville Jaguars, who drafted him with the No. 61 pick in 2014. The following year, he earned a nod to the Pro Bowl and finished as the league’s receiving touchdowns co-leader. Before starring in the NFL, Robinson was a standout at Penn State from 2011 to 2013. He became a two-time All-Big Ten First Team and a two-time Big Ten Receiver of the Year. He was also named to the All-American First Team. He tallied 177 receptions for 2,479 yards and 17 touchdowns with the Nittany Lions. Penn State paid tribute to the 33-year-old Robinson on X, touting his achievements in college and in the NFL. “A career that speaks for itself,” read the post. A career that speaks for itself. @AllenRobinson pic.twitter.com/Ltuyy5HIji — Penn State Football (@PennStateFball) August 25, 2026 Robinson is among the notable players from Penn State, along with Saquon Barkley, Micah Parsons, Chris Godwin, Pat Freiermuth, Joey Porter Jr., Jack Ham, Franco Harris, and Lenny Moore, just to name a few. In a video announcing his retirement from football, Robinson looked back on his long journey and expressed his deep gratitude. “To every love story, there comes a final chapter. Football gave me more than I ever could’ve imagined. It challenged me, shaped me, humbled me, and rewarded me in ways I’ll carry for the rest of my life,” wrote Robinson in the caption. “I came, I saw, I conquered, and I leave with nothing but gratitude.” Aside from the Lions and the Jaguars, he also played for the Chicago Bears, the Los Angeles Rams, the Pittsburgh Steelers, and the New York Giants. articles._body: The San Diego Padres just so happened to be on the receiving end of a few trend-busters from the Pittsburgh Pirates on Tuesday. Not only did Paul Skenes, who was mired in the worst slump of his big-league career, look more like the Skenes of old after throwing six scoreless innings, the Pirates were also able to touch closer Mason Miller, who’s proven to be one of the most unhittable relievers in all of MLB. Miller faced the Pirates in scoreless ballgame to start the ninth inning and he got the first two outs of the inning quite comfortably, setting up a two-out confrontation with Pirates slugger Oneil Cruz. Cruz watched a near-101 MPH heater near the top of the zone go by for a called first strike, but he swung for the fences in the second pitch of the at-bat. Cruz was all over a changeup from the Padres closer, which he then deposited to the right-field bleachers to give the Pirates a 1-0 lead, which eventually proved to be the final score. This was the first home run Miller allowed since the fifth of August in 2025 — making it over a year since he last allowed a long ball. Oneil Cruz's homer was the first off Mason Miller since August 5th … of 2025! https://t.co/rdoyeDPf0H pic.twitter.com/obnXjM0J3H — MLB (@MLB) August 26, 2026 Miller entered the night with an ERA of 0.81, and the recipe for victory for the Padres is simple — get the ball in his hands with the lead in their grasp. Alas, it just didn’t happen for San Diego on Tuesday even though everything seemed to line up for them on paper. The 28-year-old being out on the mound is almost always a sign of victory for the Padres, but even the best have their off-nights. Miller did allow five home runs last year, so it’s not like he’s completely infallible. But considering how elite he’s been in 2026 , it must have come as a shock to the entire Padres fanbase that they lost due to a home run the best closer in MLB allowed. articles.summary: With roster cut down day looming, the Chicago Bears will have plenty of decisions to make. At cornerback, Jaylon Johnson and Tyrique Stevenson are locked in a
articles._body: With roster cut down day looming, the Chicago Bears will have plenty of decisions to make . How players on the bubble perform in their preseason finale vs. the Tennessee Titans will play a pivotal role in who gets the final spots. At cornerback, Jaylon Johnson and Tyrique Stevenson are locked in as starters. Kyler Gordon is as well, but he may open the year on the Physically Unable to Perform List . As a fourth-round pick, Malik Muhammad is also safe, while Josh Blackwell and Jaylon Jones are key contributors on special teams. Assuming the Bears carry seven cornerbacks, three players are battling for one spot – Dontae Manning, Beanie Bishop Jr. and Terrell Smith. In Courtney Cronin of ESPN’s latest 53-man roster prediction, she has Manning winning the battle . “Given the lack of a timeline for Kyler Gordon’s return from PUP, it’s possible the Bears move him to reserve/PUP during cuts, where he must remain for the first four games,” Cronin wrote. “Muhammad has been the Bears’ nickel in Gordon’s absence. Manning snags the final spot over Beanie Bishop Jr., who will serve a suspension for the first three games, and Terell Smith, who continues to struggle to stay healthy.” For Manning, the preseason finale will be crucial. He is coming off of a brutal performance against the Cincinnati Bengals. A bounce back against the Titans could put him in much stronger graces. Dontae Manning must earn Bears roster spot Mandatory Credit: Katie Stratman-Imagn Images Against the Bengals, Manning let up six catches for 87 yards and two touchdowns, via Andrew Freeman of 247Sports. Cincinnati targeted him 11 total times, spying a weakness. Another performance like that would have his roster chances looking grim. However, as Cronin points out, Bishop is suspended for the first three games while Smith has battled through injuries. Manning may look like the only option. But as teams around the league begin cutting their roster down, cornerbacks will become available. If the Bears deem the position a serious need, they will be scouring the waiver wire intently. Manning will have to earn his spot rather than see it handed to him. The cornerback has yet to appear in an NFL game, making the preseason finale all the more important. He won’t be facing off with the Titans’ top offense, at least not for long. But this is Manning’s best opportunity to prove he can hang at the NFL level. Chicago’s defense has been a point of contention all offseason. Throughout the 2026 campaign, the Bears are looking to prove they’re better than the consensus opinion. How Manning fares to close out training camp will determine if he comes along for the journey. Making his debut calling the game in the booth for Spectrum SportsNet LA, Kershaw
articles._body: When the Los Angeles Dodgers players took the field to face off against the Atlanta Braves on Tuesday night, they had a long-time teammate and future Hall of Famer in the booth calling the action in Clayton Kershaw . Making his debut calling the game in the booth for Spectrum SportsNet LA, Kershaw watched a flurry of offense early on, then a lull for the middle innings before the Dodgers attempted to field a thrilling comeback in the ninth inning, only to come up short and go down in Atlanta 4-3. Discussing what he saw of his former team and what it was like to call a game as millions watched, Kershaw noted it was “ a lot of fun, ” even if there was one aspect of the evening that kept it from being perfect. “I had a blast. A lot of fun to talk baseball, obviously,” Kershaw noted. “I wish the Dodgers could have won my first one, but to watch Glass throw, to watch our guys play some good baseball, it was really fun to be here.” Stuck in a 3-3 standstill from the fourth inning on, Tanner Scott gave up the go-ahead run in the bottom of the eighth inning, when Ozzie Albies singled into center to score Matt Olson. Down to their last inning but with the top of the order ready to go, Shohei Ohtani hit a triple on the second pitch he faced but was ultimately stranded, with Freddie Freeman and Mookie Betts both getting out before Max Muncy was intentionally walked to put the game on the line for Saturday’s hero, Tommy Edman . With men on the corners, Edman flied out on his fifth pitch, leaving Kershaw with a fun experience but no rousing celebration in the Dodgers dugout afterward. Clayton Kershaw & Joe Davis recap the #Dodgers 4-3 loss in Atlanta, snapping their 6-game winning streak. pic.twitter.com/m7Jl2YAvud — SportsNet LA (@SportsNetLA) August 26, 2026 The post Clayton Kershaw had just 1 disappointment in Dodgers broadcasting booth debut appeared first on ClutchPoints .

Adrian Houser left tonight's game after appearing to experience some discomfort in his throwing arm … pic.twitter.com/0ZmxZsUcWI — SF Giants on NBCS (@NBCSGiants) August 26, 2026 Houser had been effective before leaving. He struck out two batters and had worked through 1 2/3 innings in one account of the outing. His fastball reached at least 96 mph during the first inning, consistent with recent outings in which he had touched 97 and 98 mph, before his velocity dropped in the second inning. San Francisco now awaits an MRI to determine the severity of Houser’s injury. The 10-year veteran entered Tuesday with a 4-7 record and 4.08 ERA across 25 appearances, including 15 starts, and 108 innings this season. He had also logged a 1.50 ERA across his previous 11 appearances as a long reliever, earning an opportunity to return to the rotation. The Giants pitching depth has already been tested heavily. Whisenhunt was announced Tuesday as needing Tommy John surgery , joining Hayden Birdsong and Trevor McDonald as the starters whose seasons were cut short by the procedure. Spencer Bivens was called up to replace Whisenhunt, while Tristan Beck and Matt “Tugboat” Wilkinson are potential options if Houser’s injury proves serious. Anthony Molina made his San Francisco debut after replacing Houser and earned his first win. He threw 4 1/3 innings, allowing only one hit and one walk. Carson Seymour recorded his first career save. The Giants had built a 3-0 lead through five innings, with Drew Cavanaugh driving in two runs and Rafael Devers hitting his 28th home run. Devers became only the third player in franchise history to reach at least 48 homers in his first 222 games, joining Willie Mays and Barry Bonds. San Francisco improved to 54-78 and will attempt to complete the sweep Wednesday, with Landen Roupp scheduled to face the Reds starter Nick Lodolo. articles.title: Blazers’ Damian Lillard recalls coach’s brutal message before making it
articles.summary: Long before Damian Lillard became a household name for the Portland Trail Blazers, he was just a benchwarmer getting laughed at by his high school basketball coach. Lillard recently took to social media to share a true story from his sophomore year at St. Joseph Notre Dame High School in Alameda,
articles._body: Long before Damian Lillard became a household name for the Portland Trail Blazers , he was just a benchwarmer getting laughed at by his high school basketball coach. Lillard recently took to social media to share a true story from his sophomore year at St. Joseph Notre Dame High School in Alameda, California. His coach sat him down, laid out the microscopic percentage of high school athletes who actually make the NBA, and bluntly asked if Lillard thought he would be one of the few to break through. “I was on the bench that whole season and he told me I prob wouldn’t be on the team the next year,” Lillard recalled. “I said yea and he smiled and chuckled right in my face … true story … you just never know.” My high school coach as a sophomore at St Joes broke these #s down to me and asked me if I thought I would be one of them… I was on the bench that whole season and he told me I prob wouldn’t be on the team the next year. I said yea and he smiled and chuckled right in my face …… https://t.co/HqCunEALH3 — Damian Lillard (@Dame_Lillard) August 25, 2026 Rather than folding, the Oakland native transferred to Oakland High School, earned a scholarship to Weber State, and eventually went No. 6 overall to Portland in the 2012 NBA Draft. That doubt fueled one of the most prolific scoring careers in modern basketball history. The eight-time All-Star went on to drop a franchise-record 71 points in a 131-114 victory over the Houston Rockets on February 26, 2023, finishing 22-of-38 from the field and burying 13 three-pointers along with 14 free throws. Lillard’s path serves as a reminder that early rankings and roster spots do not dictate long-term success. The same kid told he might get cut from a high school team went on to earn NBA Rookie of the Year honors, an All-NBA First Team selection, and a spot on the NBA 75th Anniversary Team. Betting on himself paid off, and the laughter from that high school office faded long ago. articles.title: Cubs stunned by Diamondbacks in brutal 9th inning meltdown
articles.summary: The three-game series between the Chicago Cubs and Arizona Diamondbacks already started off on a sour note for both parties, with the Diamondbacks alleging that the Cubs third base coach was relaying signs to the players — something that starting pitcher Merrill Kelly deemed to be “bu
articles._body: The three-game series between the Chicago Cubs and Arizona Diamondbacks already started off on a sour note for both parties, with the Diamondbacks alleging that the Cubs third base coach was relaying signs to the players — something that starting pitcher Merrill Kelly deemed to be “bush league” . On Tuesday, the Diamondbacks got revenge for the 7-0 loss they suffered in the series-opener, with the Cubs losing in particularly brutal fashion. The Cubs entered the ninth inning with a 4-3 lead, and it looked like it was going to go smoothly for them on their way to a victory. A Tim Tawa walk was sandwiched in between lineouts from Nolan Arenado and Ildemaro Vargas, putting the Diamondbacks on their final out of the night. Pinch runner Jose Fernandez then complicated matters for both teams; Fernandez tried to steal second base, and getting caught stealing with two outs would have been a disastrous way to go for Arizona. In the end, Fernandez was safe on second, and a replay review upheld that call. This simply set the stage for pinch-hitter Ryan Waldschmidt to play the role of the ultimate spoiler for the Cubs, as he hit a walk-off home run off of Jacob Webb to give the Diamondbacks a 5-4 victory. RYAN WALDSCHMIDT WITH THE WALK-OFF HOMER FOR THE DIAMONDBACKS pic.twitter.com/uFsZKnqyTJ — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) August 26, 2026 Webb did tee up a hanging slider for Waldschmidt, and the Diamondbacks center fielder made no mistakes on that swing. Waldschmidt was a bit of an unconventional pick for a pinch hitter, as he only had two home runs and 19 runs batted in on the season while playing more of a bench role. Nonetheless, the Cubs melted down, and they have to take a closer look at how to set up their bullpen moving forward. This was Webb’s sixth blown save of the season, and he now has an ERA of 6.43 over his past seven outings. articles.title: Diamondbacks end Cubs’ unanswered runs streak in anticlimactic fashion
articles.summary: The Chicago Cubs had one of the most impressive streaks in the last two games. They won their last two games by scoring 26 total runs: 19 against the Seattle Mariners and 7 against the Arizona Diamondbacks in their season opener. Those 26 runs came unanswered too, with the outburst against the Ma
articles._body: The Chicago Cubs had one of the most impressive streaks in the last two games. They won their last two games by scoring 26 total runs : 19 against the Seattle Mariners and 7 against the Arizona Diamondbacks in their season opener. Those 26 runs came unanswered too, with the outburst against the Mariners coming after they scored just two runs and the Diamondbacks held scoreless. After scoring three more against the D-Backs, it looked like Chicago was on their way to greatness. However, that streak was short-lived, and it ended in anti-climactic fashion. The Cubs ran up the score against the D-Backs at first, scoring four runs through eight innings of play. Gabriel Moreno was up on the plate with two runners on base and just two outs at the top of the eighth inning . It was in this scenario that the Cubs conceded their first run after scoring 30 runs, and it happened after Moreno’s check-swing somehow found the outfield for a double to bring in a run. Unfortunately for the Cubs, this was only the start of their troubles in this inning. The Diamondbacks still had two men on base, both of which were in scoring position. Leadoff man Lars Nootbaar was up next, and he hit a single to center field to clear the bases and drive in two more runs to make the score 4-3. Palanco got out of the inning later on after inducing a groundout, but the damage was already done. The Cubs failed to score in the next inning. Pedro Ramirez reached first base on a infield single with one out, but was caught stealing. After Michael Conforto struck out, the momentum was squarely in the Diamondbacks’ favor, and they took full advantage of it. The Diamondbacks got after Cubs close Jacob Webb, with Tim Tawa reaching first. Pinch runner Jose Fernandez stole second base later on, setting the D-Backs up for success. Then, pinch hitter Ryan Waldschmidt hit his third homer of the night, sending Chicago packing with the two-run blast to win the game. The Cubs are still 76-57 and are in prime position to hold one of the Wild Card spots. articles._body: Notre Dame has produced countless football stars in its rich history. To name a few: Joe Montana, Alan Page, Jerome Bettis, Tim Brown, Paul Hornung, Joe Theismann, Quenton Nelson, Zack Martin, and Harrison Smith. This year, more players of the Fighting Irish will try to join the elite club . They will need to undergo rigorous training and perform well on the gridiron. They will be tested physically, mentally, and emotionally. The challenges will be relentless and unforgiving. That is why they have to learn a deeply important move: “The Lambeau Leap.” Notre Dame made a hype video for its season opener against Wisconsin at Lambeau Field on September 6. It featured Jermichael Finley, who played for the Green Bay Packers from 2008 to 2013, hilariously teaching several players how to do “The Lambeau Leap.” “It is a tradition that has been passed down from generations of professional athletes. But if you fail at this, you will be embarrassing yourself, your team, and your country, and you’ll be a disgrace to the sport of football,” warned Finley. The power to leap was inside them all along… The only thing missing was the uniform. #GoIrish pic.twitter.com/3DQaDDOiKe — Notre Dame Football (@NDFootball) August 25, 2026 For the unaware, Lambeau Field is the home field of the Packers. It is also worth noting that Finley is the father of Kaydon Finley, who is in his first year with the Fighting Irish. The younger Finley was part of the funny video, which was also used to promote their new uniform, along with James Flanigan, Nolan James Jr., Brayden Robinson, and Aneyas Williams. Notre Dame has a strong chance to make the CFP, with CJ Carr returning for his sophomore season and coach Marcus Freeman entering his fifth year with more experience and wisdom. articles.title: Pirates’ Paul Skenes hits impressive mark for the 1st time since May 12
articles.summary: There has been plenty of concern surrounding Pittsburgh Pirates ace Paul Skenes amid a bit of a down year in 2026. After putting up two consecutive seasons with a sub-2.00 ERA, Skenes’ ERA has ballooned all the way to 3.95 as he entered play on Tuesday against the San Diego Padres. His fast
articles._body: There has been plenty of concern surrounding Pittsburgh Pirates ace Paul Skenes amid a bit of a down year in 2026. After putting up two consecutive seasons with a sub-2.00 ERA, Skenes’ ERA has ballooned all the way to 3.95 as he entered play on Tuesday against the San Diego Padres. His fastball velocity is also down considerably, and many are wondering whether or not Skenes is already breaking down physically . Skenes, of course, continues to be one of the most durable pitchers in MLB. He made his 27th start of the season on Tuesday, and he even turned things around on the mound. In fact, he allowed zero earned runs in a game for the first time since the 12th of May, according to Underdog MLB on X. The 24-year-old has made 17 starts since the 12th of May, and it hasn’t been the smoothest ride for the Pirates ace. Over those 17 starts, Skenes put up an ERA of 5.06, suggesting that there truly is something wrong with him compared to his previous seasons. In 2025, Skenes held opponents scoreless in 14 of his 32 starts. During his rookie campaign, he did so in seven of his 23 starts. This year, he has only had five such starts out of 27 thus far. He’s allowed four or more runs on seven different occasions this year; out of the first 55 starts of his career, he only did so in five different outings. The Pirates ace isn’t fully out of the woods just yet. But it was promising to see his fastball velocity tick up on Tuesday (up by 0.4 MPH on average), and his fastball topped out at 98.6 MPH against the Padres. Moreover, Pittsburgh won on Tuesday, taking a 1-0 victory in what is a signature Skenes game through and through. Getting Skenes back to his customary elite level is going to be key, and perhaps the Pirates can take it easier on him should they fall further in the postseason picture. Smith began a minor league rehab assignment after missing nearly three months with an inflamed disc in his neck. He went 1-for-3 in the Comets’ 4-3 loss to the El Paso Chihuahu
articles._body: Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith homered Tuesday for Triple-A Oklahoma City in his first game action since June 5. Smith began a minor league rehab assignment after missing nearly three months with an inflamed disc in his neck. He went 1-for-3 in the Comets’ 4-3 loss to the El Paso Chihuahuas. After a lineout and a flyout, Smith hit a two-run homer to left field in his final at-bat. The veteran also caught five innings, matching the workload manager Dave Roberts outlined before the game. His appearance came 81 days after his last major league game and tested his neck through hitting and catching. The Comets shared an update on Smith’s rehab appearance through their official account on X, formerly Twitter, following Tuesday night’s series opener. “Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith hit a two-run home run as part of a Major League Rehab Assignment for the Comets who were edged by El Paso, 4-3, Tuesday night at Chickasaw Bricktown Ballpark.” Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith hit a two-run home run as part of a Major League Rehab Assignment for the Comets who were edged by El Paso, 4-3, Tuesday night at Chickasaw Bricktown Ballpark. The series continues tomorrow with a doubleheader of two seven-inning games… pic.twitter.com/H8VyWAGvTb — Oklahoma City Comets (@OKC_comets) August 26, 2026 Los Angeles initially placed Smith on the 10-day injured list June 11, retroactive to June 8, because of neck inflammation. The Dodgers transferred him to the 60-day injured list July 21 after his recovery stalled. Smith eventually progressed to live batting practice at Dodger Stadium before receiving clearance for game action. Roberts said the Dodgers hope to activate Smith around September 1, when rosters expand, although the timetable remains dependent on his health. Smith completed Tuesday’s planned workload, but the club must evaluate how his neck responds before determining the next stage of his assignment. Continued progress would move Smith closer to rejoining the club for the final month of the regular season. His home run offered an encouraging start, while five innings behind the plate provided another test following the lengthy layoff. articles.title: Savage Garden’s Darren Hayes’ Career Celebrated at Music In The House Gala
articles.summary: The Australian singer and songwriter received two awards on the night.
articles._body: It was anything but an ordinary Tuesday night (Aug. 27) in Sydney as Darren Hayes was feted with the Excellence in Community Award at the 17th annual Music In The House event. The ex- Savage Garden singer and songwriter was on hand at the Support Act fundraiser, presented at The Linseed House, The Grounds of Alexandria, where he doubled up with induction into APRA AMCOS’s Billions Club — recognition of the pop group’s Billboard Hot 100 leader from 1997, “Truly Madly Deeply,” one of their two U.S. No. 1s. Savage Garden, the pairing of Hayes and Daniel Jones, was one of Australia’s biggest exports of the 1990s. Their self-titled debut album — which houses “Truly Madly Deeply” and top 10 hit “I Want You” — peaked at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, while sophomore and final release Affirmation , which houses No. 1 smash “I Knew I Loved You,” reached No. 6. The group split in 2001. For the past quarter century, Hayes has enjoyed a solo career, one that has yielded five studio albums, most recently the 2022 release Homosexual . Across his career, Hayes has sold over 35 million albums worldwide, and collected 14 ARIA Awards and 10 APRA songwriting awards. Away from the studio and the stage, Hayes has been a tireless leader of community, a stance that saw him appointed a Member of the Order of Australia (OAM) for his services to the music industry in 2019. The Queenslander has candidly shared his personal journey with mental health, resilience, and LGBTQIA+ representation, Support Act explains, and used his global platform to break stigmas and foster safer, more supportive spaces across the creative industries. “I’m deeply honored to be recognized by Support Act for my achievements beyond commercial success and chart statistics in the Australian music industry,” he remarked on receiving the Music In The House award. “I’m grateful to have been a voice advocating for an end to violence against women, homophobia, and racism, and I’m a passionate advocate for removing the stigma associated with mental health.” Longtime friend Claire Marshall presented Hayes with his Excellence in Community Award, with television presenter Osher Günsberg serving as emcee of the celebration. Hayes added, “Receiving any recognition from Support Act is an extreme honor. I hope that by highlighting my career, we can shine some of that spotlight on the much-needed funding crucial to the survival of this essential organization.” On the night, a lineup of guests performers covers of Hayes and Savage Garden songs, including including Tania Doko, Electric Fields, Meg Mac, Michael Paynter, and Sister2Sister. “Darren Hayes is not only one of the greatest songwriters and performers Australia has ever produced, but he is also a beacon of courage, openness, and empathy,” comments Clive Miller, CEO of Support Act. “His bravery in speaking out about mental health, trauma, and identity has paved the way for healthier, more compassionate conversations across the music community. We are thrilled to present him with this year’s Excellence in Community Award.” Hayes left with his hands full, his APRA AMCOS prize for entry into the 1,000,000,000 List with “Truly Madly Deeply,” which has surpassed one billion streams across major services including Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube. APRA chair and ARIA Hall of Fame inductee Jenny Morris presented the Billions Award to Hayes. “When APRA’s founding publishers first met 100 years ago in 1926, they could never have imagined we’d be here in 2026 celebrating songwriters and publishers for reaching one billion streams,” Morris said. “It’s an extraordinary achievement, a testament to the staying power and connection of the song. I’m thrilled to announce that Savage Garden’s ‘Truly Madly Deeply’ has reached that major milestone and will be added to our coveted Billions List.” Established in 2006, Music In The House gathers the nation’s music industry to salute leaders in music for both their artistic achievements and their broader contributions. Previous recipients include Troy Cassar-Daley, Powderfinger, Marcia Hines, Midnight Oil, Tina Arena, and the late Archie Roach. All proceeds raised on the night go to Support Act’s much-needed initiatives, which include the charity’s Wellbeing Helpline, Crisis Relief grants, and mental health prevention programs for struggling music workers. Visit supportact.org.au for more.

articles.summary: The New York Mets appeared to be on their way to breaking their fans’ hearts for the umpteenth time this season, as the Milwaukee Brewers loaded the bases in the ninth inning with the game tied at 2-2 on Tuesday. Mets reliever Jefry Yan faced third baseman David Hamilton, and Hamilton worke
articles._body: The New York Mets appeared to be on their way to breaking their fans’ hearts for the umpteenth time this season, as the Milwaukee Brewers loaded the bases in the ninth inning with the game tied at 2-2 on Tuesday. Mets reliever Jefry Yan faced third baseman David Hamilton, and Hamilton worked the count to 2-1 before hitting a line drive that seemed destined for the outfield, which would have driven in at least two runs for the Brewers. Instead, Francisco Lindor came to the rescue . He made a bonkers diving catch going to his right and snagged the third out of the inning for the Mets. They eventually sent the game to extra innings, and Lindor even won the winning run in the 11th after Hamilton airmailed a throw to home which would have gotten the Mets shortstop on a force out with the bases loaded. However, SNY’s broadcast of the Mets-Brewers game on Tuesday encountered a few hiccups, some of which came on absolutely the most inopportune time. Just as Lindor was making his epic catch in real time, their broadcast befuddlingly cut to black, as shown by Awful Announcing on X. Someone unplugged the wrong cord… pic.twitter.com/JWIXbzdXHg — Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) August 26, 2026 This would have added to the suspense Mets fans were already dealing with prior to the start of the at-bat. This must have had fans wondering whether or not Lindor actually made the catch, as the broadcast cut at the exact moment of the Mets shortstop’s play. The blackout lasted for almost 15 seconds, and when the broadcast finally caught up, a sense of relief must have rained down upon fans after seeing Lindor being all smiles after pulling off one of the best defensive plays of the year. The Mets have gone 13-6 since the trade deadline, and they are at least ending the season on a better note. They are far from must-see TV still, but their increased level of competitiveness since selling off a few veteran pieces at the deadline has to be catching the attention of many. Texas football’s Arch Manning completely shuts down goal of winning Manning Award
articles.summary: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning is not interested in expanding his family’s trophy case if it comes at the expense of his team’s standard. When asked directly if winning the Manning Award, the prestigious honor created by the Allstate Sugar Bowl to recognize the nation’
articles._body: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning is not interested in expanding his family’s trophy case if it comes at the expense of his team’s standard. When asked directly if winning the Manning Award, the prestigious honor created by the Allstate Sugar Bowl to recognize the nation’s top college quarterback, was on his personal checklist, the redshirt sophomore did not hesitate. “Nah. Nah, nah. Hell no,” Manning said. Texas QB Arch Manning was asked if it’s a goal of his to win the Manning Award… “Nah. Nah, nah. Hell no.” pic.twitter.com/H9KOHJzIsj — Tyler Horka (@tbhorka) August 25, 2026 The blunt response perfectly captures the mindset of a signal-caller focused on winning games rather than chasing accolades named after his grandfather, Archie Manning, and uncles, Peyton and Eli Manning. While outsiders naturally link the Texas football program’s star to the award because of his famous surname, Arch is intent on forging his own path under head coach Steve Sarkisian. Manning stepped into the spotlight for the Longhorns following an injury to starter Quinn Ewers, taking over the offense with high expectations resting on his shoulders. During his starting stint, Manning displayed the dual-threat capability that made him a five-star recruit coming out of Isidore Newman School in New Orleans. In his first career college start against the Louisiana-Monroe Warhawks, Manning completed 15 of 29 passes for 258 yards, throwing two touchdowns alongside two interceptions in a 51-3 victory. He followed up that performance by steering the Longhorns to a 35-13 win over the Mississippi State Bulldogs in their Southeastern Conference opener. In that contest, Manning went 26-of-31 passing for 325 yards and two touchdowns, while adding 33 rushing yards and a score on the ground. Through his initial starts, Manning proved he could handle the pressure of leading a national championship contender. Yet despite the sudden media frenzy and constant speculation about his individual ceiling, the young quarterback remains grounded. For Arch, individual silverware—even an award bearing his family legacy—takes a back seat to leading Texas back to the College Football Playoff. articles.title: Ralph Carr, Australian Talent Manager Convicted of Rape, Sentenced to 6 Years’ Jail
articles.summary: The disgraced promoter and artist manager will serve at least four years behind bars.
articles._body: MELBOURNE, Australia — Ralph Carr , the disgraced promoter and talent manager who once guided the careers of Kate Ceberano, Tina Arena, Vanessa Amorosi and others, is behind bars after a court found him guilty of rape. The Melbourne businessman was this week sentenced to six years’ jail for crimes committed on the night of March 23, 2023. “Your conduct was appalling,” Judge Frank Gucciardo said during sentencing this week, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation reports . “Rape is a crime of violence. This was committed by you in an egregious breach of trust.” Carr is said to have faced the County Court of Victoria via video link, sobbing, and unrecognizable without the hairpiece that had earned him the nickname “The Rug,” as the judge read the sentence, according to the public broadcaster. The 66-year-old must serve a minimum of four years before he is eligible for parole. Earlier, prosecutors alleged Carr committed the attack against a woman at his Melbourne home, after a night when the pair had been consuming drugs and alcohol. He pleaded not guilty at the trial. A jury, however, found him guilty of two counts of rape and one count of sexual assault. “You maintain your innocence of these offences and consequently there is no evidence of your remorse or contrition,” Judge Gucciardo remarked. Carr is currently held at the Melbourne Assessment Prison but will be moved to Hopkins Correctional Centre in Ararat. The sentencing judge is said to have taken into account several factors, including the public nature of Carr’s downfall, his lack of a criminal record and his mental health. “These offences strike at the most basic values, the norms of a decent society,” Judge Gucciardo explained. A high-profile professional in the worlds of Australian sport and music, Carr was publicly identified on Monday, Aug. 3 when an almost three-year-long suppression order was lifted by the County Court. Media outlets were unable able to disclose Carr’s identify until then, due to a suppression order granted under Section 18(1)(c) of Victoria’s Open Courts Act. Carr’s legal reps had called for the gag order, arguing his personal safety was at risk if he was outed in the press. The secrecy ended when Carr was found guilty and an application to extend the order was abandoned. Ralph Carr Management (RCM) clients once included Vanessa Amorosi, Rick Price, Mark Vincent, and ARIA Hall of Famers Kate Ceberano and Tina Arena, to whom he was married for several years in the mid-to-late 1990s. His live entertainment company RCM Touring Pty Limited went into liquidation in 2018, after reportedly owning A$120,000 to another touring enterprise, Big Deal Touring. Two years later, in 2020, Carr was questioned in a “public examination” at Sydney’s Supreme Court in relation to RCM Touring’s financial affairs. Speaking on Episode 6 of the “GLOW Stories” podcast, Arena reflected on her former partner and the culture that enabled improper behavior. “I think what happened to Mr Carr a couple of weeks ago is the culmination of very, very inappropriate behavior that has been going on for a very long time,” she remarked. Carr’s legal team is expected to lodge legal documents with the Court of Appeal within the next two months, according to the ABC.

articles._body: The Chicago White Sox will be without reliever Huascar Brazoban for at least the next two weeks after the team placed him on the 15-day injured list Tuesday with a left lat strain. The move comes as Chicago tries to build momentum following an 11-12 start to August. Brazoban’s injury surfaced during Monday’s 11-2 loss to the Texas Rangers, when the right-hander worked one inning and surrendered one run and one hit. He was acquired from the New York Mets on Aug. 3 and has recorded a 6.30 ERA across 10 appearances with the White Sox. Overall this season, Brazoban has a 3.16 ERA and 1.13 WHIP over 62.2 innings, but he has given up seven earned runs in 10 innings since joining the White Sox. His earliest possible return is Sept. 9. Chicago recalled right-hander Jonathan Cannon from Triple-A Charlotte to fill Brazoban’s roster spot. Cannon has gone 5-6 with a 5.18 ERA in 17 starts and five relief appearances for Charlotte this season. He has also appeared once for the White Sox, walking three batters and allowing one run without logging an out in an April 12 outing against the Kansas City Royals. Brazoban’s absence adds to a difficult stretch for the White Sox’s trade-deadline additions. Luis Castillo has a 5.89 ERA with Chicago and has completed five innings only once in four starts since arriving. Jose Urquidy has a 5.68 ERA with the team after being acquired in a minor-league trade before the deadline. The White Sox also placed Andrew Benintendi on the bereavement/family medical emergency list Tuesday and recalled Rikuu Nishida from Charlotte. articles.title: 49ers’ 53-man roster prediction for 2026 NFL season
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers are one of the most consistent teams in the NFL. They have registered double-digit victories in four of the last five years, but that’s simply not good enough when at team competes in the NFC West. The 49ers have to face the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seah
articles._body: The San Francisco 49ers are one of the most consistent teams in the NFL. They have registered double-digit victories in four of the last five years, but that’s simply not good enough when at team competes in the NFC West. The 49ers have to face the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks twice a year and they also have to do the same with the Los Angeles Rams, the team that many believe will win the championship this year. Good enough is not good enough for the Niners, and there is significant pressure on head coach Kyle Shanahan and to drive this team to the top in 2026. The Niners will get some answers in Week 1 when they take on the Rams in the NFL’s first venture to Australia. It will be one thing to play the Rams on foreign soil, but it will be quite another to fly back and forth between Los Angeles and Melbourne. The Rams will have 16 games after this season-opening extravaganza and the team could find itself emotionally drained with a full season to go. It will be up to Brock Purdy, Christian McCaffrey and the Niners’ hard-hitting defense to get through the physical, mental and emotional grind of playing in the land down under. The 53-man roster must show the talent and the depth to give this team a chance to take down its two powerful rivals. Here’s our projection as to what that 53-man roster will look like at 6 p.m. ET Sunday. Quarterbacks (2) Brock Purdy, Mac Jones The 49ers need Purdy to stay healthy for a full season and they don’t need him to take unnecessary chances that will lead to injury. Jones is an adequate backup and could even fill in for a game or two, but the Niners will lose potency if the backup has to play more than that. Youngster Kurtis Rourke is likely to be a practice squad addition. Running Backs (4) Mandatory Credit: Kevin Ng-Imagn Images Christian McCaffrey, Kyle Juszczyk, Jordan James, Kaelon Black If the 49ers are going to give the Seahawks and Rams a run for their money this season, they need McCaffrey to be at the top of his game. That means showing he is still one of the top three ground gainers in the league and the best pass catcher among NFL running backs. Juszczyk is almost certainly the best fullback in the league based on his sensational blocking. The Niners could add a fifth running back, but Isaac Guerendo is likely to end up on the PUP list. Wide Receivers (4) Mike Evans, De’Zhaun Stribling, Deebo Samuel Sr., Demarcus Robinson, Jordan Watkins, Christian Kirk, Jacob Cowing This could have been a position of great strength, but the season-ending injury suffered by Ricky Pearsall is a major blow for the San Francisco offense. Kirk has not been able to show much in training camp because of his calf injury. However, Watkins and Cowing may be able to join the fray for the Niners. Stribling and Samuel should be the starters next to the brilliant Evans as he makes an adjustment Purdy and the San Francisco offense after 12 seasons with the Buccaneers. Tight Ends (4) George Kittle, Jake Tonges, Luke Farrell Kittle’s health has been a concern throughout training camp, but it looks like he will be good to go in the season opener against the Rams. Tonges and Farrell have shown they can block, but it would be beneficial if either or both can show improvement as receivers. Offensive Line (9) Trent Williams, Jake Brendel, Colton McKivitz, Dominick Puni, Robert Jones, Brett Toth, Drake Nugent, Vederian Lowe, Carver Willis There have been a number of injuries to this group throughout training camp, so depth is likely to be an issue in the early part of the season. However, the Niners have to count on Williams and McKivitz at the left and right tackle spots, respectively. The 49ers have had to contend with concussions to Toth and Willis. That is clearly a concern. Defensive Line (10) Nick Bosa, Osa Odighizuwa, C.J. West, Alfred Collins, Sam Okuayinonu, Romello Height, Keion White, Gracen Halton, James Thompson Jr., Quinton Bell Bosa is clearly the star of this group and he needs to get a big assist from Odighizuwa. Those two should form an excellent partnership. The Niners are hoping that Mykel Williams can contribute, but he will begin the year on PUP as he tries to return from a torn ACL. Most of the defensive linemen — including Bosa — have dealt with injuries and that has given Thompson a chance to make a solid impression on the coaching staff. Linebackers (7) Mandatory Credit: Darren Yamashita-Imagn Images Fred Warner, Dre Greenlaw, Jaden Dugger, Tatum Bethune, Luke Gifford, Nick Martin, Garret Wallow This is the position on defense that has the most depth and that means the Niners could decide to upgrade in other areas by trading one of their linebackers. Warner has been a game-changer when he is healthy, and the Niners are hoping that he can bounce back from last year’s ankle fracture. Dugger may be the most versatile linebacker in this group as he had 59 tackles, 2 interceptions and 5 passes defensed while playing for the Steelers and Patriots last season. Cornerbacks (5) Deommodore Lenoir, Renardo Green, Upton Stout, Jack Jones, Ephesians Prysock The Niners could be vulnerable in this area as they lack playmakers who can make key interceptions and they are not shutdown types, either. Nate Hobbs would give this group a bit more punch, but he has a groin injury that will likely land him on the PUP list. Safeties (5) Ji’Ayir Brown, Malik Mustapha, Marques Sigle, Siran Neal Brown is clearly the best player in this group, and defensive coordinator Raheem Morris is going to have to figure out if Mustapha starts next to him. If not, Sigle will get the call. Ashtyn Davis will challenge for a position and is a likely practice squad addition. Special Teams (3) Eddy Pineiro (K), Corliss Waitman (P), Jon Weeks (LS) Pineiro is solid as they come after making 28-of-29 FG attempts last season. Jack Bouwmeester made a push for the punting position, but Waitman appeared to hold him off.   &

articles.title: Twins’ Byron Buxton exits Athletics game with apparent injury
articles.summary: Things have gone from bad to worse for the Minnesota Twins during their Tuesday night clash against the Athletics. They may have cut into the four-run deficit they faced earlier in the game, as they only trail by two runs, 4-2, with the game headed to the bottom of the eighth at the time of [R
articles._body: Things have gone from bad to worse for the Minnesota Twins during their Tuesday night clash against the Athletics. They may have cut into the four-run deficit they faced earlier in the game, as they only trail by two runs, 4-2, with the game headed to the bottom of the eighth at the time of writing. However, they lost star outfielder Byron Buxton to an injury in the bottom of the seventh. With Taj Bradley, he of the immaculate inning earlier in the contest, still on the mound, Athletics center fielder Henry Bolte hit a line drive towards right-center field — towards Buxton territory. Buxton had to hunch over a bit to try and field the ball and prevent it from going all the way towards the wall. However, just as he was making a play for the ball, he seemed to tweak something in his back. Byron Buxton was removed from the game with an injury after reaching down for a ball in the outfield pic.twitter.com/rVZiRD71d4 — Talkin' Baseball (@TalkinBaseball_) August 26, 2026 Buxton immediately had to leave the game with a trainer, as Trevor Larnach came in to replace him, necessitating some defensive shuffling in the outfield for Minnesota. Considering Buxton’s history with injuries, this is a worrying sign for a Twins team that’s looking to keep in step in the postseason hunt. Games against the 51-81 Athletics are ones the Twins should be taking care of handily, and having Buxton around for the night would have given them a better chance at completing the comeback. Buxton hasn’t had the best outing on Tuesday. He went down on strikes in all three of his at-bats, and this injury is the final nail in the coffin of what has been a dreadful night for the Twins star. This season, Buxton has suited up in 93 out of a potential 133 games for the Twins thus far this year. A clear diagnosis for Buxton’s injury should come out once tonight’s game has concluded. I built Masker after needing to share financial PDFs with a tax strategist without also sharing names, addresses, tax IDs, phone numbers, and account numbers.

It is a native macOS app. It finds repeated PII, uses Apple’s on-device OCR for scanned pages, and lets you review every mask before exp
articles._body: I built Masker after needing to share financial PDFs with a tax strategist without also sharing names, addresses, tax IDs, phone numbers, and account numbers. It is a native macOS app. It finds repeated PII, uses Apple’s on-device OCR for scanned pages, and lets you review every mask before export. Institution names and amounts can remain visible while account identifiers are covered. Mask sets and labels can be reused across folders. Everything runs locally. The tests generate fake PDFs, export them, and use text extraction and OCR to check that the selected values are gone. Built with Swift, SwiftUI, PDFKit, and Codex. Free and open source. Feedback on missed matches, false positives, and the folder workflow would be useful. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49444084 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

articles.summary: I write a lot, and I got tired of the ChatGPT-in-a-second-tab shuffle: paste a paragraph in, describe the change, copy the answer back, lose track of what actually changed. So I built an editor where the AI suggestions show up in place — you review and accept/reject them like a diff, instead of r
articles._body: I write a lot, and I got tired of the ChatGPT-in-a-second-tab shuffle: paste a paragraph in, describe the change, copy the answer back, lose track of what actually changed. So I built an editor where the AI suggestions show up in place — you review and accept/reject them like a diff, instead of reconciling a wall of chat text by hand. It's a chat panel next to a real editor. Ask for a rewrite, a tighter opening, a different tone — the suggestion lands as an inline, reversible edit, not a new chat bubble to copy out. Guest mode gets you 5 generations with no signup, so you can try it cold. Built solo in 5 weeks, deployed, and never shown to anyone outside me until right now — so it's rough in a few honest ways: credits (one-time purchase, no subscription) are built but still waitlist-only until launch day. Would love feedback, especially on where the "review before it's yours" flow feels slow or gets in the way rather than helping. articles.title: Mets’ Andy Green celebrates Francisco Lindor for ‘really, really special’ defense
articles.summary: Francisco Lindor was certainly one of the stars of the show for the New York Mets on Tuesday in their 3-2 win in extra innings over the team with the best record in MLB, the Milwaukee Brewers. Not only did he score the winning run after a throwing error from David Hamilton towards home plate [
articles._body: Francisco Lindor was certainly one of the stars of the show for the New York Mets on Tuesday in their 3-2 win in extra innings over the team with the best record in MLB, the Milwaukee Brewers. Not only did he score the winning run after a throwing error from David Hamilton towards home plate allowed him to cross safely, he also hit a home run earlier in the game to tie the game for the Mets at 1-1 in the bottom of the fifth inning. But for all the glitz and glamour of Lindor’s game, it’s his ability to nail the fundamentals at an elite level that makes him one of the most well-regarded players in MLB today. In addition to all his heroics on offense, he also saved the day on defense . With the bases loaded in the top of the ninth and two outs in the inning, reliever Jefry Yan allowed Hamilton to hit a line drive that appeared destined for the outfield. The Mets’ star shortstop came to the rescue and made an incredible diving catch to keep the game tied at 2-2. This drew all the deserved plaudits from interim manager Andy Green, who gushed over his star man after the game. “I already saw that ball down. It’s that deflating feeling when you know the ball’s about to land. Came out of nowhere. Really, really special,” Green said, via SNY Mets on X. "I already saw that ball down. It's that deflating feeling when you know the ball's about to land. Came out of nowhere. Really, really special." Andy Green talks about Francisco Lindor's defense tonight: pic.twitter.com/XkvpGUIT02 — SNY Mets (@SNY_Mets) August 26, 2026 Lindor almost seems like a new man ever since the trade deadline passed, and the Mets, as a team, have been following his lead. They have gone 13-6 since the trade deadline, and Lindor has been playing much better baseball during that span (.764 OPS since the third of August). The season isn’t truly over until all 162 games are played, and the Mets are at least looking to end what has been a disastrous 2026 season on a high note. articles.title: Brewers walked off in worst possible way by Mets
articles.summary: Losing a baseball game via a walk-off is always heartbreaking. However, the Milwaukee Brewers experienced a walk-off loss in one of the most brutal ways possible. The Brewers fumbled a bases-loaded scenario at the top of the ninth inning and left three runners stranded. However, they still had a
articles._body: Losing a baseball game via a walk-off is always heartbreaking. However, the Milwaukee Brewers experienced a walk-off loss in one of the most brutal ways possible. The Brewers fumbled a bases-loaded scenario at the top of the ninth inning and left three runners stranded. However, they still had a chance to potentially win the game if they were able to hold off the New York Mets. They were able to force extra innings, but failed to bring in any runs at the top of the tenth even with a ghost runner. And then, tragedy struck. The Mets loaded the bases themselves in the bottom of the tenth after two walks issues by the Brewers, one of which was intentional. With runners on all three bases and just one out, the pressure was on Milwaukee, and it got the best of them. Christopher Morel grounded to third base, allowing David Hamilton to field the ball and throw it to home plate. However, Hamilton’s throw was way off course, completely missing William Contreras and allowing Francisco Lindor to score the walk-off run. The Mets get the walk-off on the errant throw home for the win pic.twitter.com/UsiC6bp5t6 — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) August 26, 2026 Hamilton, who lined out in the ninth inning with the bases loaded, was distraught, and understandbly so. The Brewers were heavy favorites to win this game , leading the entire MLB ahead of the Los Angeles Dodgers. Meanwhile, the Mets had a sub-.500 record and were struggling for most of the year. On paper, this should have been an easy win for Milwaukee. Instead, their failure to bring in runs (2-of-14 with runners in scoring position) allowed New York to swoop in and capitalize on just one mistake. The Brewers will be fine: they still hold an 81-51 record above the Dodgers. They’re still on track to get one of the two byes in the postseason. They’ll have a chance to clean things up tomorrow in the second game of their three-game series against the Mets. articles.title: Mississippi State football lands ex-West Virginia defensive lineman
articles.summary: Mississippi State football reportedly signed former West Virginia defensive lineman Eddie Kelly Jr. on Tuesday, adding a veteran before the Bulldogs’ 2026 season kicks off. His eligibility remains unresolved. Kelly is listed at 6-foot-5 and 288 pounds. He played 12 games for the Mountaineer
articles._body: Mississippi State football reportedly signed former West Virginia defensive lineman Eddie Kelly Jr. on Tuesday, adding a veteran before the Bulldogs’ 2026 season kicks off. His eligibility remains unresolved. Kelly is listed at 6-foot-5 and 288 pounds. He played 12 games for the Mountaineers in 2025, making four starts and recording 26 tackles, 1.5 tackles for loss, half a sack, and three pass breakups. Kelly began at South Florida before stopping at Georgia Tech, Missouri, and West Virginia. Mississippi State would be his fifth program in five seasons. He has a total of 103 tackles in 49 games. CBS Sports’ Matt Zenitz reported the signing Tuesday on X, formerly Twitter, while crediting colleague Chris Hummer. “Mississippi State has signed former West Virginia defensive lineman Eddie Kelly, @chris_hummer and I have learned. Posted 26 tackles last season at WVU.” Mississippi State has signed former West Virginia defensive lineman Eddie Kelly, @chris_hummer and I have learned. Posted 26 tackles last season at WVU. pic.twitter.com/LqgMvtafZP — Matt Zenitz (@mzenitz) August 26, 2026 The 22-year-old defensive lineman would join a Bulldogs defensive front that added Dealyn Evans, Amaree Williams, Jayson Jenkins, and Gus Cordova over the offseason. Mississippi State opens the season on Saturday, September 5, 2026, against Louisiana Monroe at Davis Wade Stadium, giving Kelly little preparation time if cleared. Kelly exhausted four seasons without using a redshirt and has pursued a fifth year through the courts. The 10th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals paused a federal order Friday that would have granted thousands of athletes from the 2022 high school class another season. Mississippi State had not announced Kelly’s addition or listed him on its roster as of late Tuesday. The reported signing, therefore, does not confirm that he can compete immediately. If cleared, Kelly would provide rotational depth for the Bulldogs after playing in the SEC, ACC, and Big 12. His production and familiarity with multiple defensive systems could help Mississippi State reinforce its front as Jeff Lebby enters his third season.
