articles.title: Saints’ Chris Olave injury update after hard fall brings sigh of relief
articles.summary: Recent contract negotiations between the New Orleans Saints and superstar wide receiver Chris Olave have concluded with a four-year, $132 million extension that includes $90 million guaranteed. However, this lucrative deal contains specific protective language tailored to his health history. As d
articles._body: Recent contract negotiations between the New Orleans Saints and superstar wide receiver Chris Olave have concluded with a four-year , $132 million extension that includes $90 million guaranteed. However, this lucrative deal contains specific protective language tailored to his health history. As documented by ESPN’s Katherine Terrell, particular contractual stipulations allow the Saints to void injury guarantees if Olave suffers from recurrent concussions or pulmonary embolisms that permanently sideline him from NFL play. While these stipulations help protect the franchise financially, the Saints faced a scare during Tuesday’s training camp practice when Olave went down awkwardly. The star wide receiver exited the session early after hitting the ground hard, creating a moment of tension across the practice field. Fortunately, head coach Kellen Moore provided an encouraging update shortly after, which offered a sigh of relief to the entire organization. Reporting on X, ESPN’s Katherine Terrell captured Moore’s reassuring evaluation after practice : “Kellen Moore said Chris Olave landed hard on his back. When asked if he’s okay, he said he got the wind knocked out of him. When asked if further testing was needed or if there was cause for concern, Moore said the medical staff did not raise any issues.” With no structural issues identified by the medical staff, the incident was quickly deemed a minor setback rather than a serious injury. Avoiding a significant injury is crucial for New Orleans’ offense, especially with rookie receiver Jordyn Tyson already expected to miss early-season action. This clean bill of health allows Olave to maintain his momentum without interruption . Having secured his long-term financial stability, the Second-Team All-Pro recently expressed that he feels reinvigorated to receive medical clearance and is eager to focus on leading New Orleans’ passing game in 2026. articles.title: Ukrainian Women’s Basketball Player Leaves LSU After Kim Mulkey Signs Russian
articles.summary: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect
articles._body: Nine days after LSU women’s basketball announced it had signed a 17-year-old Russian player, the program’s anticipated starting center—who is from Ukraine—left the team. Kate Koval, a junior from Kyiv, was heading into her second season with the Tigers after playing her first year at Notre Dame. Her father, Oleksandr, is a drone operator in Ukraine’s war against Russia. His 6-foot-5 daughter played all 35 games for LSU last year and started 17. Coach Kim Mulkey announced on Monday that Koval came to her the day before to quit the team “for personal reasons.” A spokesperson for LSU tells Front Office Sports that Koval also has expressed her intention to withdraw as a student at the school. Koval’s next steps are tricky, given the transfer portal is long closed, and classes have already started at many schools. She may need to transfer in April in order to find a new team. According to the NCAA , midyear basketball transfers can’t compete for another school if they were enrolled somewhere else during the first semester, even if they never played a game. LSU’s classes started on Monday. “We will respect her privacy on her decision, but we had a long talk about it, and it was a hard decision for her,” Mulkey said. “I know it is hard because she loves LSU. Kate is a great person. She has to do what she feels is right for her, and we fully support her in that.” Mulkey didn’t explicitly say Koval left because she didn’t want to share a locker room with Russian pro Anna Minaeva, whose signing was announced on August 14. Last week, Mulkey said in an interview with The Advocate that she met with Koval about Minaeva, and when the coach suggested perhaps the two players could even help end the war, Koval told her: “I doubt that,” in Mulkey’s telling. “Know that what I have to do in this business, I cannot make a decision to not recruit somebody that can help our program because of a conflict between two countries,” Mulkey told The Advocate she told Koval. The center has spoken in the past about the war’s impact on her and her family. “I was just blaming myself,” Koval told The Athletic while she was still at Notre Dame, where she played one season before transferring to LSU ahead of last year. “Why am I here and my family is over there? Why am I safe and my family has to go through all that?” LSU’s spokesperson said the withdrawal process can take a while, and couldn’t say if Koval was technically withdrawn yet. She would need to pursue some kind of waiver from the NCAA if she wanted to compete for another school this year. Koval said last year that she was living with her brother, who was attending LSU as a graduate student. Another brother played junior hockey last season in Amarillo, Texas. The Russia–Ukraine conflict has bubbled up in other sports, although it’s not clear if athletes from the two countries have ever played on the same Division I women’s basketball team. Ukrainian tennis star Elina Svitolina has refused to shake hands with Russian players for years, while Oleksandra Oliynykova said at the French Open this summer that Russian players on tour “don’t want to communicate and “have these horrible beliefs.” Russia has been banned from the Olympics and many other international competitions since invading Ukraine, but a lifting of that ban looks likely ahead of the 2028 Games . The post Ukrainian Women’s Basketball Player Leaves LSU After Kim Mulkey Signs Russian appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles.title: Top Doubles Players Eliminated Early in Revamped US Open Mixed Doubles
articles.summary: Mike Frey-Imagn Images
articles._body: NEW YORK — The two best doubles players in the world lost in the quarterfinals of the revamped US Open mixed doubles format—to two singles players. Elina Svitolina and Gael Monfils, two singles players, defeated Kateřina Siniaková and Henry Patten, the world No. 1 in women’s and men’s doubles, respectively, in a tightly contested three-set match in the quarterfinals of the US Open mixed doubles on Tuesday. Svitolina and Monfils are married, though Tuesday was the first time they teamed up in an official tennis match in their careers. Monfils, who turns 40 next week and is playing in his final US Open, is a former top-10 men’s singles player but is currently ranked No. 306. Both said they did not expect to advance to the semis given their lack of preparation. “We had zero expectations,” Svitolina said. “We practice quite a lot together back at home or at tournaments, but only yesterday we worked on a few things for doubles.” The duo did say it helped that they had chemistry as a married couple. Siniaková and Patten weren’t the only doubles specialists to fall Tuesday. Two-time defending champions Sara Errani (women’s doubles No. 9) and Andrea Vavassori (men’s doubles No. 8) fell to Mirra Andreeva (women’s singles No. 5) and Andrey Rublev (men’s singles No. 24). Kristina Mladenovic (No. 11 women’s doubles) and Marcelo Arevalo (No. 6 men’s doubles) were also knocked out in the Round of 16 by the Czech pairing of Karolina Muchová (No. 7 women’s singles) and Jakub Mensik (No. 16 men’s singles). Mensik said that it helped that the US Open mixed doubles has accelerated rules. “If we will play regular rules like until six games, it will be much more difficult,” said Mensik, who said it was his first time playing mixed doubles since he was 9 years old. “Because we are just playing until four games, sometimes you get lucky.” Each set in the US Open mixed doubles goes to four games, unlike the traditional six games required in doubles. There is also no traditional deuce, as teams can win a 40–40 tie by winning just one point. If the two teams split the first two sets, the tiebreaker third set is a first to 10 points. The US Open overhauled its mixed doubles format last year in an effort to attract more singles stars and bring in more fans for its opening week. The USTA raised the grand prize from $200,000 in 2024 to $1 million last year; this year’s championship prize is also $1 million. Last year’s format had 16 teams, and Errani and Vavassori were the only double specialists in the draw. The pair had complained about the revamp on social media months earlier in 2025. “We see it as a profound injustice, that disrespect an entire category of players. Put money above tennis is never a good idea,” Errani and Vavassori wrote in a joint social media post in February 2025. They went on to win the 2025 US Open mixed doubles tournament. “I think this one is for all the doubles players that couldn’t play this tournament. I think this one is also for them,” Errani said after the win. This year’s format added an 8-team qualifying format played Monday that featured numerous doubles specialists. The change allowed for four doubles specialists to make the main draw. Mensik and Muchová deferred to the organizers when asked whether more doubles players should be featured in the draw. But Muchová said the additional doubles team this year delivered a “nice mix” for the tournament. “I think it’s nice that they actually expanded a little bit of the draw and there is more space as well for doubles players,” Muchová said. articles.title: A Timeline of Dolly Parton’s Good Deeds
articles.summary: A timeline of the country superstar’s biggest philanthropic efforts.
articles._body: Dolly Parton was more than a country icon. She was also one of the entertainment world’s most prolific philanthropists, using her success to support causes ranging from childhood literacy and education to healthcare, disaster relief and more. Following her death at age 80 on Tuesday (Aug. 25), Parton’s charitable legacy remains as impactful as her music. From the launch of the Dollywood Foundation in 1988 to the creation of her Imagination Library in 1995, she spent decades giving back to communities and causes close to her heart. By 2025, the Imagination Library alone gifted more than 300 million books to children around the world, providing free, age-appropriate books to children from birth to age five. Parton’s philanthropy also reached the worlds of medical research, education and emergency relief. In 2020, she donated $1 million to coronavirus research at Vanderbilt University, a contribution that helped support research that led to the development of Moderna’s COVID-19 vaccine. She also donated millions of dollars to organizations including children’s hospitals and provided substantial aid to communities affected by natural disasters. Her generosity continued into the final years of her life. In 2024, she contributed $1 million toward Hurricane Helene relief efforts in East Tennessee, while her businesses and the Dollywood Foundation contributed an additional $1 million. In 2025, her Imagination Library gifted more than 40 million books to children. See below for a timeline of the country star’s biggest philanthropic efforts and the charitable legacy she leaves behind.

articles.title: Dolly Parton’s Family Shares Statement After Her Death: ‘The Doors She Opened Made And Changed History’
articles.summary: The icon died on Aug. 25 at age 80.
articles._body: Country music legend Dolly Parton was known for her timeless songs such as “I Will Always Love You” and “Jolene,” her unmistakable singing voice, her charismatic and charming personality, her glitzy style and her always-giving heart. Just as undeniable was her strong relationship and dedication to her family. It was a member of Parton’s family, her nephew and longtime head of security Bryan Seaver, who made the announcement that Parton had died on Aug. 25, 2026, at age 80. Seaver, representing the Owens and Parton families, announced the passing of country music icon Dolly Parton in a social media video. “This video announcement is something Dolly asked of me years ago, before I fully absorbed it as a future reality,” Seaver said in the video. “As her head of security for more than two decades, a role my father Larry held before me, I have imagined the heaviness of this moment, but haven’t truly felt it until now. It is an honor, an honor that is mixed with absolute pride and great sadness. But sadness lies with us, not with Dolly. Dolly has lived in the light and is in the arms of Jesus, surely met by Carl, her parents, and countless others who have watched her and longed for her to meet them in the heavens.” Seaver recalled, “I first went on the road with Dolly as a kid, getting a taste of the road life in the early 1980s. Dolly opened doors, not just for me, but for her entire family to reach the potential we didn’t even know was possible. Dolly also opened doors for generations of singers, songwriters, musicians, and dreamers from every walk of life and across every continent. By her example, we believed that anything was possible. She never saw a door she couldn’t open and the doors she opened made and changed history. My family and I have shared a lifetime of beautiful memories with Dolly, but so have you. She has always been on your television, your record player, your CD, and on your phone playlist, becoming an extended part of your family whether you liked it or not. “Our family and the team she has entrusted with her legacy will work diligently to ensure her spirit will live with us forever. Dolly was a farmer, just like her Daddy. He farmed the soil, she farmed songs and happiness. Dolly called me and said she wants to rest in a beautiful bed of plush cotton because after a life wearing heavy rhinestones, she finally deserves to be comfortable and have some rest. Rest in peace, Aunt Dolly. Aunt Granny. Gigi. May God Bless Dolly Parton and may God Bless you all. She will always love you.” View this post on Instagram Parton’s passing comes 17 months after the death of her husband Carl Dean, who died in March 2025 at age 82. In 2024, Parton released the album Smoky Mountain DNA: Faith, Family and Fables , which featured Parton performing with members of her extended family, spanning five generations of musicians. The project rose to No. 1 on the Billboard Bluegrass Albums chart. Parton is preceded in death by her husband Carl Dean, as well as Parton’s mother Avie Lee Caroline Owens (1923-2003), her father Robert Lee Parton, Sr. (1921-2000) and her brother Coy “Denver” Parton (1943-2026). In a release regarding the country superstar’s passing, it was noted that Parton’s life will be celebrated in a small, private service for immediate family. The family also asked that in lieu of flowers, donations be made to Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library , which has long served to provide children up to age five with free books.

articles.summary: The Chicago Bears are scheduled to take on the Carolina Panthers in the Week 1 opener to kick off the new season. While hype surrounds the team heading into the 2026-27 campaign, it does appear that the club has an Achilles heel at left tackle. Head coach Ben Johnson admitted on Tuesday that he a
articles._body: The Chicago Bears are scheduled to take on the Carolina Panthers in the Week 1 opener to kick off the new season. While hype surrounds the team heading into the 2026-27 campaign, it does appear that the club has an Achilles heel at left tackle. Head coach Ben Johnson admitted on Tuesday that he and the coaching staff have not yet determined who will be the starting left tackle come Week 1, according to Courtney Cronin of ESPN. It is currently a four-player race between Braxton Jones, Theo Benedet, Kiran Amegadjie, and Jedrick Wills Jr. “Ben Johnson said that the left tackle battle remains ongoing, calling it ‘a hot spot’ for the team that still doesn’t have answers yet among the 4 players that have been in the mix (Jones, Benedet, Amegadjie, Wills),” Cronin reported. “I don’t know know that we’re 100% sold on who that guy is going to be in Carolina for us,” Johnson said. Tuesday’s practice provided some clarity on the Bears’ left tackle predicament. Cronin also reported that Jones received all of the first team reps in multiple drills. Additionally, it appears that Wills is working as the No. 2 option, while Benedet returned to the right side of the offensive line. “Braxton Jones has gotten all the 1s reps at left tackle during 9-on-7 run drills at the start of practice and during both 11-on-11 periods so far,” Cronin said. “The LT competition was said to be between Jones and Theo Benedet, but Benedet has been back at right tackle with the 2s with Jedrick Wills at left.” Ben Johnson still has a few weeks to decide who will be the club’s starting left tackle. Ozzy Trapilo is also working his way back from a ruptured patellar tendon in his left knee. Chicago is hopeful he can return sooner rather than later, but he is not on track to be ready by the Week 1 matchup against the Panthers. articles.summary: Over the weekend, San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York was arrested at a trailer park in Ohio for allegedly arranging to pay a woman $140 for sexual activity. The Ohio trailer park wanted it to be known that he was arrested there by coincidence. ESPN obtained an incident report that revealed York u
articles._body: Over the weekend, San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York was arrested at a trailer park in Ohio for allegedly arranging to pay a woman $140 for sexual activity . The Ohio trailer park wanted it to be known that he was arrested there by coincidence. ESPN obtained an incident report that revealed York used a pseudonym — going by “Joe” — and responded three times to a fictitious ad for a prostitute before his arrest. He was arrested at the site of the agreed-upon meet-up spot, Wheat Hill Mobile Home Community. York was communicating with someone he thought was a woman on a “known prostitution web site” that was actually an undercover cop. They set the meet-up location on the day of the arrest (Sunday, Aug. 23), and he was arrested upon arrival. York was charged with two misdemeanors. The first was engaging in prostitution, and the second was for possession of criminal tools. His first charge was later changed to disorderly conduct as part of a plea agreement. The Niners owner pleaded no contest. He paid $1,150 in fines and was sentenced to two days in jail (one day was already accounted for). Trailer park responds to 49ers owner Jed York’s arrest Joe Nicholson-Imagn Images Per ESPN’s report, Wheat Hill claims to have “no other knowledge of the situation.” An anonymous representative claimed to be assured by East Palestine Police Department chief Chris Weingart that “they were not using addresses in the park as part of their sting operation.” According to the incident report, York was told to meet at a “fictitious lot number.” Since 2024, York has been the majority owner of the 49ers. He has been with the team longer, though, becoming CEO in 2008. His parents, John and Denise DeBartolo York, are the co-chairs of the team. His uncle, Edward J. DeBartolo Jr., was previously the team’s owner. The post 49ers owner Jed York used fake name in desperate response to fake prostitute ad before trailer park arrest appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Main Street Sports Group Sues Comcast, Charter Over Unpaid Fees
articles.summary: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images
articles._body: What’s left of the shuttering Main Street Sports Group has sued the two largest U.S. cable distributors, accusing them of underpaying contracted carriage fees. The FanDuel Sports Network parent company has filed separate suits in Delaware Superior Court against Charter Communications and Comcast, Nos. 1 and 2, respectively, among domestic pay-TV operators, alleging breach of contract by each of them. More specifically, Main Street Sports said the two carriers sought to improperly enrich themselves by terminating their distribution pacts upon the conclusion of the 2025–26 NHL and NBA playoffs. The first round of the NHL playoffs represented the final live games Main Street Sports carried. Neither league nor any of its teams renewed with the financially struggling Main Street Sports, and the remaining batch of MLB clubs previously aligned with the company left in February . “A termination does not excuse Comcast Cable’s obligations to pay accrued license fees,” Main Street Sports said in its lawsuit against that carrier. While the public filings of the two lawsuits are heavily redacted, and obscure any specific financial and contractual details, Main Street Sports said the outstanding carriage fees are “significant.” Both Charter and Comcast declined to comment. Industry sources say both companies are likely to contest the allegations. Bigger Shifts Main Street Sports is now in a wind-down process , as most of its prior staff has either left or been laid off, and it is no longer airing any live major league games. The company, which emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in early 2025 after a prior existence as Diamond Sports Group, has been a key indicator of the heavy struggles of this part of the sports media business. For many years, the company was the country’s largest single operator of regional sports networks. More recently, though, Main Street Sports was steadily battered by a series of issues, including accelerating cord-cutting by consumers that cut heavily into subscription bases, as well as rising rights fees with teams. As a result, its post-bankruptcy recovery was fleeting at best. In the lawsuits, Main Street Sports also suggested that it is looking to recoup distribution revenue to help pay out rights fees that it still owes teams. Prior non-payment and underpayment of rights fees to several clubs helped accelerate the company’s loss of all of its live rights. “The licensed fees paid to MSSG are passed along to MSSG’s NBA and NHL team rights partners, as well as other creditors,” Main Street Sports said in the complaint against Charter. “By refusing to pay MSSG what it is owed for the work performed, Charter is also harming the NBA and NHL teams whose games were aired by MSSG.” The post Main Street Sports Group Sues Comcast, Charter Over Unpaid Fees appeared first on Front Office Sports .

articles.title: Stability AI’s New $76M Funding Round Is Backed by Universal, Sony and Warner
articles.summary: Stability is now the first AI company to secure direct equity investment from all three major music companies.
articles._body: Stability AI announced on Tuesday (Aug. 25) that it has closed a $76 million Series B strategic funding round, including investments from the three major music companies — Universal Music Group, Sony Music Group and Warner Music Group — as well as Electronic Arts. This makes Stability the first AI company to receive equity investment from all the majors in a funding round. According to a company blog post, “the capital will fuel the development of its product suite for creative production, deepen its applied research discipline, and expand its professional services arm.” Related Stability AI Launches Improved Music Models Dale Morris, Nashville Manager Who Guided Careers of Alabama & Kenny Chesney, Dies at 89 HYBE Pledges Over $300k for Colombia Earthquake Recovery The four entertainment firms join other investors like Stability AI chairman and Napster founder Sean Parker , Coatue, Greycroft, Kadmos Capital and Eric Schmidt in the Series B round, investing for a second consecutive round under new leadership. The announcement follows the launch of Stable Audio 3.0 in June — a family of three new AI music models and one audio special effects model. The majority of models in the Stable Audio 3.0 family are “open weight,” a term used to describe models created via licensed training data that are publicly available, and can be downloaded and built on for further development. Total funding for Stability AI since the appointment of CEO Prem Akkaraju has now reached $232 million, including two equity rounds and convertible notes. Akkaraju joined the firm in June 2024 and previously served as the CEO of Weta FX, a visual effects and computer animation company. According to LinkedIn, he remains on the Weta FX board. Stability AI has been pursuing music-making models for several years. Its first foray into music creation was the open-source generative audio label, HarmonAI, which is designed to create accessible and playful music production tools “by musicians for musicians.”  Then, in 2023, it launched the first iteration of Stable Audio , which could create up to 90-second songs for commercial projects. Since Stable Audio’s inception, it has licensed music for its training set. In its initial announcement of the platform, the company also unveiled a licensing deal with music library Audio Sparx. Then, in late 2025, Stability announced its partnership with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group to develop “next generation professional music creation tools” together, as stated in the UMG partnership deal.  “This unmatched group of investors is an affirmation of our vision where generative AI empowers every producer, musician, and storyteller,” says Akkaraju. “Stability is unique in the AI field because we are creative people making tools for creatives. Developing industry-defining technology means assembling a team of industry-defining titans, and that’s what we have done here. Our investors set us up for long-term success because they provide not only capital, but expertise, credibility, and direct connection to artists.”

articles.title: Tate McRae Stars in Iconic Denim Brand’s New Campaign: ‘I’ve Been Dreaming of This for a Long Time’
articles.summary: The Canadian pop star follows in the footsteps of Justin Bieber, Kendall Jenner and Kate Moss.
articles._body: You can’t spell Tate without ate. Calvin Klein announced on Tuesday (Aug. 25) that Tate McRae is the face of the designer’s fall 2026 Feel the Fit denim campaign, which is directed by Carlijn Jacobs. The Grammy-nominated singer slips into a pair of the High Rise Loose Jeans and breaks into a choreographed dance across the hallway, which calls back to the brand’s signature ’90s looks. “I’ve been dreaming of this for a long time,” the Canadian hitmaker said in a behind-the-scenes clip. “I’ve always been a fan of Calvin Klein jeans,” McRae added in a statement. “Every style has its own personality, but they all give you that same undeniable confidence. This campaign is about that moment when you put on your favorite pair of jeans, and everything just clicks. I loved being able to move, dance and bring my own energy to every look.” Instead of utilizing the 23-year-old’s catalog, clips from the energetic campaign are soundtracked by the 1990 Deee-Lite classic “Groove Is in the Heart,” which reached the top five of the Billboard Hot 100 (No. 4 peak). “Denim has always been at the heart of Calvin Klein, shaping our distinct point of view on confidence, sensuality and self-expression,” said David Savman, who serves as the global brand president at Calvin Klein. “Defined by iconic design codes, superior fit and seductive styling, Calvin Klein jeans have long been worn by those who shape the moment, helping the brand become a defining force in denim. ‘Feel the Fit’ brings that legacy to life for a new generation in a way that feels unmistakably Calvin Klein and entirely current.” Tuesday’s campaign launch has the Low Rise Baggy Jean, High Rise Loose Jean and 90s Straight Jean available at Calvin Klein retail stores and the brand’s online shop. Calvin Klein said that other global stars will follow Tate McRae as ambassadors of the Feel the Fit campaign this fall. Musically, the Canadian superstar teased a new era while headlining OSHEAGA and Lollapalooza earlier in August, which featured her viral golden dip to close out the memorable sets. McRae also told Harper’s Bazaar in an interview posted on Tuesday that she’s been recording. “I always get comments like ‘[She’s] everywhere but the damn studio,’ and I’m like, ‘Girls, I’m in the studio,’” she said. The “Sports Car” singer earned her first Billboard 200-topping album with So Close to What in 2025, which earned 177,000 equivalent album units. Not only did Kiffin leave Ole Miss last year under controversial circumstances , but he is also bringing former NFL players back to college football. As this situation unfolds, Kiffin is defending himself . “Sometimes the difference between the hero and the villain isn’t very far apart..A lot of times people want you to apologize when you’re chasing greatness..,” Kiffin said, per The Pat McAfee Show. “Our players and fans know that we’re doing what’s best for our program.” "Sometimes the difference between the hero and the villain isn't very far apart.. A lot of times people want you to apologize when you're chasing greatness.. Our players and fans know that we're doing what's best for our program" ~ @Lane_Kiffin #PMSLive pic.twitter.com/dofOkjMqUW — Pat McAfee (@PatMcAfeeShow) August 25, 2026 Kiffin gave a reference to the legendary wrestler Hulk Hogan. “He was a villain, then a hero, then a villain, then a hero again, and then a villain,” Kiffin added. “…It happens sometimes.” Kiffin’s LSU team gets ready to kick off the season on September 5. The Tigers will battle Clemson. This upcoming season, Kiffin will also return to Ole Miss to play his former school on September 19. Lane Kiffin is ready to get things rolling at LSU Kiffin may be a villain to some, but there is no denying that he is a talented football coach. He takes over from Brian Kelly, who underachieved while leading the Tigers program. The LSU head coach has a new quarterback for the 2026 season . That is Arizona State transfer Sam Leavitt, who is coming off an injury. Kiffin says that Leavitt has been working hard to get back to full health. “Sam Leavitt battled back from injury and he’s so competitive.. He’s focused on being great and he’s got a chip on his shoulder,” Kiffin said Tuesday on Pat McAfee’s show. LSU football fans are certainly excited to see what the Tigers do moving forward. articles.title: Rory McIlroy Backs ‘Big Swing’ Tour Championship Overhaul
articles.summary: Jeff Curry-Imagn Images
articles._body: ATLANTA — PGA Tour players are mostly supportive of the new season-ending Tour Championship format, which will have a World Cup feel featuring groups and sudden-death match play for the first time beginning in 2028. “It’s cool—I think they’ve taken a big swing,” Rory McIlroy said shortly after the announcement of the format on Tuesday. “And conceptually, I think I really like it.” Nearly $100 million of bonus money has been paid out this season after last week’s BMW Championship—the second of three playoff events. The 30 players at this week’s Tour Championship are competing for a $40 million purse, including $10 million for the eventual tournament winner and FedExCup Champion. Under the new structure—which will come alongside the PGA Tour’s shift to a two-track scheduling model —a regular-season champion at the top-tier Championship Series will be crowned and season-long bonus money will be paid out after the final regular-season event. The top 32 players in the season-long points list will advance to a revamped two-week Tour Championship, which will have its own prize money pool. “I think all the incentives are there, and the regular-season champion is going to be adequately rewarded after that final stroke-play event,” McIlroy said. The first week of the new Tour Championship will feature eight groups of four players, who will each face off in three head-to-head matches. The top two players from each group will advance to the second and final week, where the remaining 16 players will compete in a single-elimination bracket across four days to determine the Tour Championship winner. “I think it’s exciting,” PGA Tour rookie Alex Fitzpatrick said. “I’m a massive fan of football—obviously the World Cup has that group stage, and then you keep playing until you have a winner. I think it’s a good take on the game, and it’s different than the regular season.” Added Wyndham Clark: “The two-week thing kind of reminds me of a major in tennis, and it’s kind of fun. Those guys spend two weeks at Wimbledon, and that’s what it is. It’s unique to golf and new to it, but I think over time people will accept it and like it a lot.” Si Woo Kim said he has “always liked” match play. “It’s going to be fun,” he said. “I don’t know how other players like it, but to me, it’s going to be way more fun than 72-hole stroke play.” New Tour Championship Feel The new-look Tour Championship will be played at two different courses each year, rotating among venues that typically do not host PGA Tour events. That will mark the end of East Lake Golf Club’s longtime run as the annual host of the Tour Championship dating back to 2004. With the shift, the Tour Championship is likely to have fewer fans than typical professional golf tournaments with fewer grandstands and little-to-no corporate hospitality buildouts. “It really depends where we go,” PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp said Tuesday. “I think there’s an acknowledgment and understanding on some of these sites that you don’t see very often at a PGA Tour event, the footprint might be smaller.” Those logistical demands associated with top-tier golf events can be “limiting,” Rolapp said. “I think we wanted to take that out of the equation so we could reach the best courses in the country.” Specific host venues have not been announced. Highly ranked, ultra-private clubs like Pine Valley (New Jersey), Cypress Point (California), and Seminole (Florida), as well as top-tier public resorts like Bandon Dunes (Oregon), have been in the rotation for the Walker Cup, a biennial Ryder Cup-style, match play competition for amateur golfers from the U.S. and Great Britain and Ireland. articles.title: Kraken Says ‘Dust Attack’ From Sanctioned HTX Wallet Locked Out Customers
articles.summary: Bitcoin Magazine
articles._body: Bitcoin Magazine Kraken Says ‘Dust Attack’ From Sanctioned HTX Wallet Locked Out Customers Crypto exchange Kraken clients were reportedly locked out of their accounts after receiving tiny amounts of sanctioned digital coins. In a statement to Bitcoin Magazine, Kraken said the coins were transferred in what is known as a “dust attack” — when small quantities of cryptocurrency is sent to numerous wallet addresses to track and de-anonymize them. Kraken said the aim of the transactions was to trigger compliance checks by spreading sanctioned funds onto other platforms. Bloomberg first reported the news.  “We don’t know who is behind these attacks, but they likely expect that if sanctioned funds land in a client account, it triggers a full account lock, causing operational disruption for a large number of users,” a Kraken spokesperson said.  The spokesperson added that its customers were briefly locked out of their accounts but its “compliance team mobilized quickly to restore access while continuing to hold the sanctioned funds as required.” “We are working with authorities to ensure these attacks don’t have their intended impact,” the statement added. A total of 12,000 such transfers were sent from the wallet to addresses linked to Kraken between this month, Bloomberg reported, citing Arkham Intelligence. Arkham identified the wallet as linked to HTX based on addresses the exchange has publicly disclosed as part of its proof of reserves. Chinese exchange HTX, formerly known as Huobi, is one of the world’s biggest crypto exchanges. The European Union sanctioned it in July because it has, according to European authorities, helped ​Russians evade sanctions.  “Recent dust attacks from HTX-owned wallets appear to be an attempt to spread UK- and EU-sanctioned funds to other platforms in order to discredit the broader industry,” the Kraken spokesperson continued.  Dusting has been happening for years. Back in 2022, someone sent celebrities Ethereum from a Tornado Cash wallet one day after the U.S. Treasury Department sanctioned the coin mixing app used by North Korean state-sponsored hacking groups.  Celebrities targeted in the 2022 dusting attack included comedian Jimmy Fallon, YouTuber Logan Paul and Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong. The feds said they wouldn’t prosecute the celebrities hit with sanctioned crypto.  This post Kraken Says ‘Dust Attack’ From Sanctioned HTX Wallet Locked Out Customers first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

articles.summary: The New York Giants are currently gearing up for their final preseason game of the schedule against the New York Jets on Friday. On Tuesday, the team got a rough injury update regarding a key member of their wide receiver room. “Giants WR Calvin Austin was carted off today from practice wit
articles._body: The New York Giants are currently gearing up for their final preseason game of the schedule against the New York Jets on Friday. On Tuesday, the team got a rough injury update regarding a key member of their wide receiver room. “Giants WR Calvin Austin was carted off today from practice with what one source described as a ‘serious knee injury,'” reported ESPN NFL insider Adam Schefter on X, formerly Twitter. Austin III was expected to play a sizable role as a supplementary receiver for the Giants this year, but if he is forced to miss extended time with this injury, that could open up a roster spot that would have otherwise gone elsewhere. The most high-profile name competing for a spot in the Giants’ wide receiver room is franchise legend Odell Beckham Jr., who burst onto the scene as a star for New York in the mid-2010s and has bounced around the league since, not having played last year. Some had speculated that the chances of Beckham Jr. securing a roster spot at the age of 33, and with a storied injury history of his own, might be long, but they could certainly get a bump depending on the status of Austin’s status moving forward. Meanwhile, the team is hoping for a full injury recovery from number one wideout Malik Nabers, who went down with a torn ACL last season against the Los Angeles Chargers. The Giants are slated to kick off their 2026 regular season schedule on September 13 with a home game against the divisional rival Dallas Cowboys. It is the obvious choice for Penn State’s biggest home game, and the Trojans will have to wal
articles._body: Penn State fans can officially circle Oct. 10 on their calendars. The Nittany Lions announced their first White Out game of the 2026 season will come against USC, with kickoff scheduled for 7:30 p.m. ET. It is the obvious choice for Penn State’s biggest home game, and the Trojans will have to walk into one of college football’s most intimidating environments under the lights. For first-year head coach Matt Campbell, the matchup could define whether Penn State capitalizes on an incredibly favorable schedule. The Nittany Lions open their nonconference slate against Marshall, Temple, and Buffalo. All three should be victories, and even the road trip to Philadelphia against Temple will likely feel like another home game considering how well Penn State fans travel. The Big Ten schedule also gives Campbell plenty to work with. Wisconsin, Purdue, Minnesota, Rutgers, and USC all visit Happy Valley, putting Penn State in a position to run the table at home. The Trojans represent the toughest challenge of that group, but a White Out atmosphere should give the Nittany Lions a significant advantage. The fans will let Lincoln Riley hear it all night long. Penn State’s road schedule features Northwestern, Michigan, Maryland, and Washington. The trip to Ann Arbor stands out as the most difficult game, while Washington could present another challenge. Still, the path is there for an outstanding season. Two weeks ago, I predicted Penn State would finish 11-1 , with its only loss coming against Michigan. The schedule supports that projection, especially if Campbell’s team handles business at home. And if the Nittany Lions are serious about competing for a College Football Playoff spot, beating USC in front of a roaring White Out crowd would make quite the statement. Bring on the Trojans. Related Dolly Parton, One of Country Music’s Biggest & Brightest Icons, Dies at 80 Dolly Parton’s 25 Best Songs: Critics’ Picks Dexter and the Moonrocks Want 'to Set the Tone of What Rock Music Is Going to Be' In the time since the news was announced in a video message by her nephew Bryan Seaver — who served as her head of security for more than 20 years — countless artists have attempted to put the incomprehensible into words with posts on social media expressing grief and disbelief over her passing, as well as awe for the country icon’s singular legacy. One of them was fellow country queen and longtime friend Reba McEntire, who shared a carousel of photos of herself and Parton on Instagram and wrote, “There will never ever be another you … She’s gonna have a blast in heaven singing all her favorite songs with all her family and friends who have gone on before her.” Paul McCartney made a thoughtful statement on Instagram , sharing a black-and-white photo of himself meeting Parton and Porter Wagoner at the Grand Ole Opry. “She was such a wonderful woman,” the former Beatle wrote. “She was so bubbly and full of life it is difficult to take in the news that she has passed. Her songwriting, her singing and her philanthropy were unrivaled in the world of country music and it is hard to imagine living in a world without Dolly.” Elton John wrote on his Story that he was “shocked and devastated” to hear that Parton had died, calling her “a giant of an artist — unique and irreplaceable, with the kindest heart.” “What a wonderful songwriter and singer Dolly was,” Mick Jagger wrote on X . “She brought so many people together, we will all miss her so much.” “Dolly Parton had a way of making everyone feel special, and seen, and welcomed, and as if you were old friends,” Kelly Clarkson wrote on X . “I will miss her heart and her voice as I am sure millions will. What an incredible gift and talent she was and still is with an amazing catalogue of art she has left behind for all of us.” George Strait also took a moment to mourn, writing on his Instagram Story, “You’ve had such a huge impact on so many people all over the world, @dollyparton. We will all miss you.” “I will certainly miss her laughter, jokes and her being,” Dionne Warwick wrote on Instagram , sharing a sweet photo of herself and Parton holding hands. “Rest well and in total peace my friend. My heart is heavy.” Jack White simply posted an old photo of Parton on Instagram and wrote, “Instant Sainthood,” while Waylon Jennings shared a throwback snap of himself with the late star captioned, “We will always love you Dolly.” “The death of Dolly Parton is as big as Elvis,” stated Don McLean on Instagram . “This rocks the country and the world in the same way and we won’t get over this for a long time. She was an incredible story teller musically and in real life.” Parton’s death comes nearly a year and a half after her husband of about 60 years, Carl Dean, died at the age of 82. The last month of the Rock & Roll Hall of Famer’s life was also marked by loss, with her brother Denver dying at the age of 82 in August. “Dolly. This really really hurts,” Kacey Musgraves wrote on X , adding in other posts , “The world feels a lot less sparkly all of a sudden … So glad she’s with her Carl Dean. No one talk to me today.” Brad Paisley shared a clip of his duet with Parton, “When I Get Where I’m Going,” on Instagram . “I never imagined this day would come,” he wrote. “Getting to know Dolly was life changing, but not just for me. For everyone. She seemed immortal.” Kimberly Perry of The Band Perry shared an emotional story of Parton giving her a pep talk during a tough moment on Instagram and added: “She is my hero. My queen. There will never be another her.” “The Daniels family is devastated to hear of the passing of a genuine American institution, @dollyparton,” reads a post on Charlie Daniels’ profile . “Her impact on music – not just country – entertainment and pop culture in general is unparalleled.” Maggie Rogers shared a video of herself mournfully covering Parton’s 1977 hit “Here You Come Again” and wrote on Instagram , “one of the greatest songwriters of all time … thank you thank you a million times dolly.” “I’ve said often in my life, ‘What will the world be without Dolly?'” Carly Pearce wrote on Instagram . “From the time I was a little girl, I wanted to be just like her … Since then, I’ve had the privilege of not only working with Dolly, but getting to know her. She was exactly who we all hoped she would be — kind, funny, gracious, and one of a kind. Heaven got a whole lot sassier, funnier, and brighter today.” Kid Rock called Parton “simply The G.O.A.T” and wrote , “Thanks for the songs, the laughs, the humility and grace. articles.title: Bruce Springsteen & Alex Warren to Play Stand Up for Heroes on 20th Anniversary of Veterans Benefit Show
articles.summary: The show will also feature comedy performances from Jon Stewart, Josh Johnson and Hasan Minhaj.
articles._body: Bruce Springsteen is returning for another year of supporting veterans at the annual Stand Up for Heroes event, which in 2026 is celebrating its 20th anniversary with a lineup that also includes Alex Warren, Jon Stewart and more. Related Bruce Springsteen and 5 Other Memorable Moments From Stand Up for Heroes Benefit New York Comedy Festival Announces 2025 Stand Up for Heroes Lineup of A-List Comedians, Musicians Writer Liz Meriwether Has Been Listening to Britney Spears 'A Lot' While Writing Script For 'The Woman in Me' Biopic As announced Tuesday (Aug. 25), The Boss will perform at the event — which raises money for members of the military facing injury or illness, as well as their families — on Nov. 9 at Lincoln Center in New York City. The Billboard Hot 100-topping “Ordinary” singer will also contribute live music in addition to The Resilient, a band that includes wounded U.S. combat veterans. Stewart, Josh Johnson and Hasan Minhaj are locked in to deliver comedy sets. It marks a special milestone for Stand Up for Heroes, which is entering its 20th year of providing entertainment in partnership with the New York Comedy Festival to champion one of the country’s most vulnerable populations. Since 2007, the event — presented by Bob Woodruff Foundation — has raised $117 million for veterans, their families and caregivers. “Twenty years ago we put together Stand Up for Heroes with a simple idea: bring people together with laughter and music in honor of those who have sacrificed so much for our country,” Bob Woodruff said in a statement. “When we started this way back in 2007, we thought it would just be a one-time concert. But it’s become one of the most meaningful nights of the year.” This year’s benefit will take place three days into the 2026 New York Comedy Festival, which will run from Nov. 6 to Nov. 15 with a lineup spanning Adam Friedland, Ilana Glazer, Jordan Klepper, Ms. Pat, Sarah Sherman, Ziwe and more comics. The festival’s founder, Caroline Hirsch, added of Stand Up for Heroes, “What started as a single night has grown into a powerful and enduring tradition … as we celebrate this milestone, we look forward to continuing to honor our heroes and share their stories for years to come.” Springsteen has a nearly perfect attendance record at Stand Up for Heroes, appearing at almost every one of the annual showcases since 2007. Over the years, musicians such as Sheryl Crow, Norah Jones, The Lumineers, John Mayer, John Mellencamp and the Red Hot Chili Peppers have performed, as well as comedians like Stephen Colbert, Jim Gaffigan, Shane Gillis, Seth Meyers, Tracy Morgan, John Mulaney, Trevor Noah, Conan O’Brien, Jerry Seinfeld and Robin Williams. Tickets for Stand Up for Heroes 2026 are available for purchase on the event’s website .

Fever guard Caitlin Clark has been unstoppable lately, leading Indiana to their most regular-season wins in franchise history. Clark just received some incredibly high praise from one national analyst. C
articles._body: The Indiana Fever are at the height of their powers with the WNBA playoffs just a month away. Fever guard Caitlin Clark has been unstoppable lately, leading Indiana to their most regular-season wins in franchise history. Clark just received some incredibly high praise from one national analyst. Colin Cowherd issued some attention-grabbing praise for Clark during a recent segment on The Herd with Colin Cowherd. He compared the young superstar to two legendary figures from the NBA. “She is Steph Curry but with a little bit of a Michael Jordan mindset,” Cowherd said on Tuesday. “All business, all basketball. Has no opinion or comment on the controversies.” Those controversies include Enes Kanter and Royce White attempting to join the WNBA . The Fever were first-hand witnesses to Kanter being tossed from their last game . But any number of off-the-court distractions cannot take Clark off her game. Clark has been one of the WNBA’s best players throughout the 2026 season. There’s a reason why Clark is receiving MVP hype headed towards the end of the regular season. Cowherd also praised Indiana’s offense for being arguably the best unit in league history. “The Fever offense is not only number one in this league at 97 [points] per game, it’s the best offense in league history because of Caitlin Clark,” Cowherd continued. “So with all this nonsense and drama around her, Caitlin Clark [is] number one in assists, number three in scoring, best offense in league history, greatest shooting range in league history. She’s not driving the controversy like Michael Jordan. She’s all business.” Clark is averaging 22.1 points, 8.3 assists, and 3.8 rebounds per game this season. If she continues playing at such a high level, Indiana could make a deep playoff run this fall. Next up for the Fever is a home game against the Sun. That matchup tips off at 7:30PM ET on August 28th from Gainbridge Fieldhouse. The post Caitlin Clark gets attention-grabbing Michael Jordan, Stephen Curry comparison appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Giants’ 53-man roster prediction for 2026 NFL season
articles.summary: The New York Giants are two preseason games in with one more to go before Week 1 is on the horizon. And as the Saturday, August 30, cutdown day looms, John Harbaugh is readying to get the Giants’ 2026 53-man roster in order. Before that happens, though, we’ll predict what that final W
articles._body: The New York Giants are two preseason games in with one more to go before Week 1 is on the horizon. And as the Saturday, August 30, cutdown day looms, John Harbaugh is readying to get the Giants’ 2026 53-man roster in order. Before that happens, though, we’ll predict what that final Week 1 roster will look like. OFFENSE QB (2): Jaxson Dart, Jameis Winston The quarterback situation is pretty cut and dry for the Giants. Jaxson Dart is the unquestioned starter and, hopefully, the franchise quarterback of the foreseeable future, while Jameis Winston is the experienced veteran backup who can come in and actually win games if Dart goes out. As for QB3 on the practice squad, it looks right now like Jake Haener will take it over Brandon Allen, but the Giants’ third preseason game against the New York Jets could decide that battle. RB (5): Cam Skattebo, Tyrone Tracy Jr., Devin Singletary, Najee Harris, Patrick Ricard The Giants seem destined to keep 26 on offense, and 24 on defense instead of an equal 25/25 split like some teams do on the 53-man roster. One of the big reasons for that is the five running backs who should make this team. The addition of Najee Harris gives the G-Men four legit halfbacks who all can play slightly different roles and get carries, depending on the matchup. As for the fifth back, Ricard came with Harbaugh from Baltimore, so he’s a lock at fullback. Plus, he can play some tight end as well, which will come in handy if the Giants only keep three at that position. WR (7): Malik Nabers, Darius Slayton, Calvin Austin III, Malachi Fields, Darnell Mooney, Braxton Barrios, Odell Beckham Jr. Jalin Hyatt is the odd man out here, as OBJ may have done just enough in preseason and camp to earn a seventh roster slot, despite not playing special teams. The other option here is a trade. Outside of Nabers and Fields, Joe Schoen may be willing to part with any of these receivers to get a nice mid-round pick back in next year’s draft. TE (3): Isiah Likely, Theo Johnson, Chris Manhertz Like Richard, Likely followed Harbaugh from Charm City to the Big Apple, so he will be the man in the tight end room, and Johnson is a big man and an intriguing prospect, not unlike Likely was a few years ago with the Ravens. Manhertz is a below-average TE3, but again, Richard can fill that role in several formations as well. OL (9): Andrew Thomas, Jon Runyan, John Michael Schmitz Jr., Francis Mauigoa, Jermiane Eluemunor, Marcus Mbow, Aaron Stinnie, Bryan Hudson, J.C. Davis (Evan Neal, Josh Ezeudu, Jake Kubas, Hudson makes the team here over veteran center Lucas Patrick, and after the young lineman showed talent while filling in due to injuries to Patrick and Schmitz, he could challenge the latter for the starter role as the season goes on. Mbow and Stinnie seem to have locked up the primary swing guard and tackle backup spots, and sixth-round pick Davis has shown enough that he will be on the Giants’ roster this season as well. This means Evan Neal and Josh Ezeudu are out. UDFA Ryan Schenercke from Kutztown State is an interesting player here. He has shown big flashes in the preseason, and if the Giants don’t think he’ll survive waivers to make the practice squad, he could end up on the roster, too, with an RB getting scratched. DEFENSE DL (4): DJ Reader, Shelby Harris, Darius Alexander, Leki Fotu OLB (4): Brian Burns, Abdul Carter, Kayvon Thibodeaux, Chauncey Golston These are pretty set groups along the defensive front, though interior linemen like Bobby Jamison-Travis and Josh Toupou could end up on the practice squad. It will likely be a smaller positional group, though, as players like Golston or even Thibodeaux have inside/outside versatility. At times, if they slide inside, Arvell Reese could become more of an outside ‘backer, too. ILB (5): Tremaine Edmunds, Arvell Reese, Micah McFadden, Jack Kelly, Zaire Barnes At off-ball linebacker, the Giants have arguably their deepest position group, even with all the talent at OLB. Edmunds is a longtime NFL starter, Reese is a top-five pick, McFadden has started 36 games in the last four years, and Kelly is looking like an absolute steal in the sixth round. Plus, Barnes is a high-level special teams player, which Harbaugh will love. CB (6): Greg Newsome II, Deonte Banks, Paulson Adebo, Colton Hood, Dru Phillips, Korie Black We move from possibly the best position group on the team to the worst. This cornerback room is tough, and while the G Men will take six players into the regular season, it’s hard to see these six making it the entire season. Either New York will find a better player or two on the waiver wire or make a trade at some point. S (5): Jevon Holland, Tyler Nubin, Jason Pinnock, Ar’Darius Washington, Elijah Campbell There isn’t a lot of drama surrounding the Big Blue safeties here, as far as making the Giants’ 53-man roster goes. However, there is still no clear-cut starter next to Holland. It won’t be Campbell, who is primarily a special-teamer, but if it was any of the other three, it wouldn’t be a big surprise. SPECIAL TEAMS K (1): Dominic Zvada P (1): Jordan Stout LS (1): Ben Mann Harbaugh made his name in the NFL as a special teams coach, so this unit will have more importance than ever in the Giants organization. Stout was an All-Pro for Harbaugh last season in Baltimore, so that’s a huge upgrade there. Rookie long snapper Mann from Boston College will take that all-important role, while Michigan rookie Zvada is on track to beat out Ben Sauls after making an incredible 70-of-74 kicks in training camp . The post Giants’ 53-man roster prediction for 2026 NFL season appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Preserving glow-in-the-dark art and fashion for future generations
articles.summary: Understanding unique photochemistry of such materials will help in conservation, storage, and exhibition.
articles._body: Fashionistas of a certain age no doubt remember the late designer Stephen Sprouse , who gave Blondie's Debbie Harry her distinctive Bowery punk style. Sprouse's first collections in the mid-1980s made a major splash, melding graffiti prints, a playful '60s aesthetic, and bright Day-Glo colors that won admirers such as Andy Warhol. Several examples of Sprouse's work are preserved in the textiles collection of the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, where conservationists are trying to learn more about the phosphorescent and fluorescent pigments the designer used in his creations in order to keep the colors from dulling over time. They described recent advances in that research at a meeting of the American Chemical Society (ACS) held this week in Chicago. Scientists began describing minerals that glowed in the dark as phosphors in the Middle Ages. Typically, such materials take on a charge when exposed to light, storing the absorbed energy and releasing it gradually as re-emitted light. Henri Becquerel discovered radioactive decay in 1896 because of his work with phosphorescent uranium salts: He left the salts in a closed drawer with photographic plates, which fogged up even without a light source. DayGlo paints and similar materials exploit the related phenomenon of fluorescence. DayGlo pigments fluoresce in daylight by essentially converting UV light into visible light to produce brighter, more vibrant colors. Read full article Comments

Dolly Parton’s story has been told through countless songs, performances and interviews, but Martha Ackmann’s Ain’t Nobody’s Fool: The Life and Times of Dolly Parton offers a more sustained look at her life. Published on Dec. 30, 2025, the biography traces Parton’s early years in Tennessee, her rise to country music stardom and the career that cemented her status as a cultural icon. In the wake of Parton’s death at 80 , the book offers a timely look at the path that made her one of music’s most enduring stars. That journey began early. As Ackmann details in the biography, Parton was just 13 when she first performed at the Grand Ole Opry , the famed Nashville institution that has long been a cornerstone of country music. It was an early glimpse of the determination that would carry her through decades in the spotlight. By the time Parton released “Jolene” in 1973, she had already established herself as a formidable country artist, but the song would become one of the defining recordings of her career and help propel her into the mainstream. Ain't Nobody's Fool: The Life and Times of Dolly Parton $19.74 $30.00 34% off Buy Now On Amazon $0.00 Buy Now On Audible $30 Buy Now at Barnes & noble A Dolly Parton biography. The book details Parton’s transition from being an impoverished child in the Smoky Mountains to her eventual rise to international stardom as a singer, songwriter, actress, businesswoman and philanthropist. Parton’s music career is just as iconic as her big hair and even bigger personality, with Billboard charting hits like “9 To 5,” “Heartbreaker” and her famed track “I Will Always Love You,” covered by Whitney Houston in 1992 for The Bodyguard film’s soundtrack. The song also caught the eye of a certain “King of Rock & Roll.” “Well, actually, Elvis (Presley) loved that song. That was when he and Priscilla (Presley) were having their problems.” Parton explained in an interview in 2025 with AXS TV . “She (Priscilla) told me that Elvis sang that to her on the day of their divorce,” Parton continued. The track peaked at 47 on Billboard’s Hot 100 charts and remained on the charts for a total of 10 weeks. The song was released in 1974 as a single, part of Parton’s wildly popular Jolene album as a farewell to her mentor Porter Wagoner. “Colonel Tom Parker (Elvis’ manager) calls me the day before and says, ‘now you do know that Elvis is recording songs and you do know that Elvis doesn’t record anything that he doesn’t publish or at least get half the publishing. He would have rights to the publishing of the song. I said I can’t do that,” Parton explained in her recent AXS TV interview. “I was so disappointed. I was going to have to tell my friends Elvis didn’t record it.” Parton attributes her business-savvy thinking in situations like this one to her father, who was a hardworking farmer and construction worker. All this, and more, can be found in Ackmann’s new book, available on Amazon , Audible and at Barnes & Noble now.

Joining her in the famous “confessional” was Chilean-Mexican star Mon Laferte , who brought a new dimension to the Catalan artist’s iconic heartbreak anthem, “La Perla.” Related Rosalía’s ‘La Perla’ ‘Wouldn’t Exist’ Without Paquita la del Barrio’s ‘Rata de dos Patas’ A List of All the Guests in Rosalía’s Confessional on Her ‘LUX’ Tour Mon Laferte Will Receive Social Justice Award & More Uplifting Moments in Latin Music Dressed in a pink corset and a striking fuchsia long skirt, Laferte took the stage after Rosalía introduced her as a woman who “sings about love, heartbreak, desire, pain, rage (…) turning everything she touches into art,” sparking curiosity about the reflection the guest singer of “Tu Falta de Querer” would share regarding relationships. articles.title: Show HN: Ifso – a personal finance simulator for major life decisions
articles.summary:
Hello all!

Ifso is a personal finance simulator that takes all of your various accounts (like taxable brokerages, retirement accounts, loans, etc) and various life events (like income changes, retirement, purchasing a home, increasing principal contributions to your home mortgage, etc.) and pla
articles._body: Hello all! Ifso is a personal finance simulator that takes all of your various accounts (like taxable brokerages, retirement accounts, loans, etc) and various life events (like income changes, retirement, purchasing a home, increasing principal contributions to your home mortgage, etc.) and plays it out year by year for you. The simulation engine underneath the hood handles all of the tax math, capital gains math, investment growth rates, home appreciation, vehicle depreciation, loan amortization, and more. You can then create multiple scenarios by duplicating an existing one or creating a fresh new one, and compare two scenarios side by side, helping you understand how big decisions would affect your overall financial wellbeing and goals. This project started off as something I wanted to use myself. I didn't really find a lot of the one-off calculators helpful since they don't take all of the other factors in my finances into account, and they also don't allow flexibility in what you can get out of it. For example, if I wanted to drop investment contributions for a few years and then resume later, a typical investment calculator doesn't allow for that level of granularity. On the other hand, there were a few solutions available out there that did financial simulations (and they're definitely useful, much respect for them), but they felt a bit over-complicated trying to get off the ground. Additionally, they were too pricey for me, and their free tiers don't necessarily let you save your simulations, which I found frustrating. I also had a bit of a hard time with decision making since it didn't feel like comparing scenarios was a first-class citizen feature. That's what led me to start building a simulator myself, I wanted something that felt more intuitive for me and actually catered towards decision making. I wanted to see, for example, what would happen if I sold my house in a few years versus renting it out (I simulate rental properties in Ifso as well). How do both of those scenarios play out if I get a promotion this year and also decide to upgrade my wife's car? Some things to note about Ifso: - The free tier currently gives you access to the entire simulation engine and one saved scenario. Your scenarios are saved, so it persists across sessions/devices. - The paid tier is $9/mo or $69/year (dropped down to $59/yr for the first 100 users, and this price is locked in until you cancel). This includes everything in the free tier + unlocks building multiple scenarios and comparing them side by side + Monte Carlo simulations. - The app is US-specific as of now, if there's demand for supporting other locations I can always look into it. - There's a number of account types and events that you can configure, and I'm constantly working on adding more. I ultimately want this to be as helpful and dynamic as possible, while remaining approachable and as intuitive as possible. - There's no bank or account linking, so everything is manual input. You can export your data and you can also delete your account altogether. Data is never shared or sold. - Sign-in is done via Google OAuth so your setup persists across sessions and devices. There is a short demo video on the site in case you want to see what things look like before signing in. Let me know what you think! In particular, I want to make sure that the overall UX and UI is intuitive. My first set of users had given me feedback that helped me improve the UX, UI, and onboarding flow. If there's parts of the UX that work for you, and other parts that you find unintuitive, please be sure to share. Things make sense to me as I'm building it out, but ultimately it's what you guys think that matters. If there's other features, account or event types, etc. that you think would be valuable, please share that as well! Now, fellow former NBA star Charles Barkley has weighed in, voicing his support for the gay and transgender communities appearing on Michael
articles._body: A lot has been made about transgender athletes in the WNBA, with people ranging from Sophie Cunningham to former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom weighing in. Now, fellow former NBA star Charles Barkley has weighed in, voicing his support for the gay and transgender communities appearing on Michael Smerconish’s radio show (via Awful Announcing). However, he doesn’t believe “men should play against women.” “First of all, I always support the gay community. I always support the transgender community,” he said. “I got nothing but love and respect for gay people and transgender people, but under no circumstances do I think men should play against women. Zero. I’m disappointed in Adam Silver and Cathy [Engelbert], the commissioner.” “People are looking for attention now,” Barkley said of Kanter and others who are looking to capitalize on the politicization of the league. “But he has a point though.” Speaking about Kanter Freedom, Barkley sees through his efforts, knowing he’s seeking “attention.” At the same time, he believes he “has a point.” “People are looking for attention now,” Barkley said of Kanter and others who have been trying to make a stand. “But he has a point though.” Kanter Freedom recently caused a stir by attending the Chicago Sky and Indiana Fever’s recent game. He wore a shirt with the definition of a woman on it. At one point after a Sophie Cunningham score, Kanter Freedom celebrated the bucket. This prompted Natasha Cloud to yell at him, starting a heated exchange. Eventually, Kanter Freedom would be ejected from the venue. Kanter Freedom has also declared for the 2027 WNBA Draft. While the league ruled him ineligible, he believed he should be able to play. He self-identifies as a woman, which, per his estimation, means he should be able to play in the WNBA. This was done to challenge the support of transgender women playing in the league. articles.title: Lane Kiffin on conferences stepping in against court orders for NFL players returning to college: ‘Doesn’t work like that’
articles.summary: LSU head coach Lane Kiffin believes conferences like the Big Ten and the SEC will have a challenging time interfering with the court orders allowing players who were on NFL rosters to return to college football. On The Pat McAfee Show, Kiffin explained that LSU did everything right after reportedly
articles._body: LSU head coach Lane Kiffin believes conferences like the Big Ten and the SEC will have a challenging time interfering with the court orders allowing players who were on NFL rosters to return to college football. On The Pat McAfee Show , Kiffin explained that LSU did everything right after reportedly adding former Ole Miss Tight end Dae’Quan Wright and former Ole Miss defensive lineman Zxavian Harris . “All court orders have been followed,” Lane Kiffin said. “I think you’re going to get in a really interesting situation of now, as a conference, you start to say, ‘Well, we’re not going to follow this court order that’s been issued. And we’re going to say that these kids that the courts said can go anywhere, we’re going to say no, you can’t.’ That’s some issues there.” [ $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage ] Kiffin then told Pat McAfee that conferences can’t pick and choose the court orders they want to follow. “Doesn’t work like that. You can’t decide, ‘Hey, I like that injunction, I don’t like that one, that play I kind of like, and I like the way that they got him eligible, so we’re going to follow those rules, not these,'” he said. It really doesn’t work that way. Lane Kiffin says the players are ‘making the best decisions for them’ “These aren’t pros that have been playing in the NFL that all of a sudden their career was over just like, ‘Hey, I just wanna go back.’ These guys were not told that they had five years in December, January when they made their decisions. These athletes all around the country in different sports would have stayed in their fifth year. They weren’t told that and then found out later on they were supposed to be told that, so the judge said, ‘Hey, you have five years.’ And that’s all they’re doing is protecting their families and making the best decisions for them.” On Tuesday, the Big Ten passed a rule banning former NFL players from returning to play college football for any of its schools. On3’s Pete Nakos reported that the ACC and SEC are considering similar rules, and the Big Ten meets on Tuesday afternoon to vote on the new rule that would prohibit former players returning to college football if they were already on an NFL roster.

articles.title: Ravens OC reveals what he’s learned from Ben Johnson, Sean Payton
articles.summary: Following a major organizational shakeup, the Baltimore Ravens appointed head coach Jesse Minter to take over the defense and handed offensive responsibilities to Declan Doyle in an effort to revitalize their attack. Throughout the preseason, Doyle has primarily operated from the coaches’ b
articles._body: Following a major organizational shakeup, the Baltimore Ravens appointed head coach Jesse Minter to take over the defense and handed offensive responsibilities to Declan Doyle in an effort to revitalize their attack. Throughout the preseason, Doyle has primarily operated from the coaches’ booth instead of the sideline, orchestrating the offense from above during a 13-3 victory over the Minnesota Vikings. According to Ravens team reporter Ryan Mink, Minter confirmed that working from high above the field is Doyle’s preferred vantage point for analyzing defensive alignments leading up to Week 1. As Doyle prepares for his first season calling plays in Baltimore, he attributes much of his tactical development to his experience working alongside two prominent offensive minds: Chicago Bears head coach Ben Johnson and Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton. In an interview with ESPN’s Kevin Clark on X, Doyle detailed the daily standards he adopted while coaching with Johnson in Chicago: “He’s very demanding regarding standards. Whatever we agree upon as ‘this is what we want to be,’ he holds everybody to that every day… that’s really what I’ve tried to emulate.” In a subsequent post on X, Clark shared insights on what Doyle learned from Payton during their time together in New Orleans and Denver: “He walks into a room and takes over the room. It’s the same way when he calls a game. There’s something to that— the playcaller having a ton of confidence. As a coach, you’re a teacher but also an actor.” Doyle explained that Payton’s commanding presence and confidence taught him that a playcaller must project absolute authority and conviction with every call. I asked Declan Doyle what he took from Sean Payton. Every coach should watch "He walks in a room and takes over the room. It's the same way when he calls a game. There's something to that, the playcaller having a ton of confidence. As a coach you're a teacher but also an actor" pic.twitter.com/oOrtTJi2A4 — Kevin Clark (@bykevinclark) August 25, 2026 By combining Johnson’s meticulous operational standards with Payton’s fearless bravado, Doyle aims to develop an aggressive and explosive identity for Lamar Jackson and the Ravens’ revamped offense. The post Ravens OC reveals what he’s learned from Ben Johnson, Sean Payton appeared first on ClutchPoints .

articles.title: Why Colin Cowherd isn’t completely buying Cowboys Super Bowl hype
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys haven’t made the Super Bowl in decades, and team owner Jerry Jones wants that to change this year. Some analysts aren’t buying into the Cowboys just yet. That includes the famed sports commentator Colin Cowherd. “They were 7-9-1 last year and awful against pla
articles._body: The Dallas Cowboys haven’t made the Super Bowl in decades , and team owner Jerry Jones wants that to change this year. Some analysts aren’t buying into the Cowboys just yet. That includes the famed sports commentator Colin Cowherd. “They were 7-9-1 last year and awful against playoff teams… Don’t convince yourself that average meal you ate at the restaurant was great because it’s better than what you cook at home,” Cowherd said on his show, The Herd with Colin Cowherd. "They were 7-9-1 last year and awful against playoff teams… Don't convince yourself that average meal you ate at the restaurant was great because it's better than what you cook at home." @colincowherd throws some cold water on the Cowboys Super Bowl hype pic.twitter.com/OnWnuhb4ER — Herd w/Colin Cowherd (@TheHerd) August 25, 2026 The Cowboys famously haven’t won the Super Bowl in more than 30 years. Dallas has made the NFL Playoffs many times since then, but always come up short. During the 2025 season, Dallas missed the NFL Playoffs. Cowboys have some new weapons heading into 2026 One young Dallas player that is standing out this summer is wide receiver Camden Brown. Brown has been praised by former Cowboys wideout Dez Bryant . Brown is making his mark this summer, even though he was an undrafted player. “Shoot, I just feel like I’m making the best of the opportunity whenever it comes my way,” Brown said, per the team. “I’m blessed to even say I’m in his locker room with a bunch of vets that’s done it big. I feel like practice was really good, and that’s just where it started. I start it from practice, and that’s the preparation piece of it. So when I come out here, it slows down for me. “I feel like just stacking a week on top of a week, that’s how I can make this team and keep doing what I got to do. So really, that’s really what it is, for real.” Brown is working hard to make the team’s Week 1 roster. He has made some spectacular catches during preseason games. He caught two touchdown passes in a preseason victory over the Seattle Seahawks. The Cowboys play their final NFL preseason game against the New Orleans Saints. That contest is scheduled for Friday. articles.title: Padres minor league coach detained by ICE released, back with family
articles.summary: Last week, Sam Blum of The Athletic reported that Padres minor league coach Oswaldo Pirela was detained by ICE at an airport in Texas. Here was the Padres’ initial response to the situation. “We recently became aware of the detainment of minor league catching coordinator Oswaldo Pirela in E
articles._body: Last week, Sam Blum of The Athletic reported that Padres minor league coach Oswaldo Pirela was detained by ICE at an airport in Texas . Here was the Padres’ initial response to the situation. “We recently became aware of the detainment of minor league catching coordinator Oswaldo Pirela in El Paso, Texas,” the Padres said last Monday. “We are working to gather additional information and will not have any further comment at this time.” Dennis Lin, The Athletic’s Padres writer, reported on Tuesday that Pirela was released on bond and is back home with his family. The Padres released another statement, but will no longer comment about the situation. “We are pleased that Oswaldo Pirela has been released on bond and reunited with his family,” the Padres said in a statement issued to The Athletic. “Out of respect for his privacy and the ongoing matter, we will have no further comment at this time.” Pirela remained with ICE for about a week after he “overstayed his welcome,” according to a spokesperson from the Department of Homeland Security. Pirela was on a work trip when he was detained at the airport. Lin also reported that Pirela is seeking asylum and is a resident of Peoria, Arizona. “Pirela’s wife, Kemberly Avila, said last week that Pirela and her family have pending asylum applications, while Jorge Pirela said his brother was not carrying his work permit when he was detained.” The hope is that this can be kept in the past and the entire Padres organization and Pirela’s family can move on.
